reviews.comment: Virginia Tech's math department is known to be very subpar. However, Prof. Mahmud is the exception. He genuinely cares, explains clearly, and keeps Canvas organized, which is great for HW and exams. He's responsive in class/office hours. The only downsides are that grades are private, and he can grade harshly. Put in effort, and you'll do well.

After having a bad calc 2 experience this professor was much needed. He was very caring and always showed how he wanted his students to succeed. The exams were easier than other classes, which made the MC on the final a little more challenging, just to warn. Not too much homework and was always grateful & helpful when students came to office hours.

I really liked Mahmud.  Most important things: ask questions/be involved, look like you are paying attention, and stay off your phone.  He is such a nice guy and his lectures are very helpful as long as you stay focused.  He has a strong accent but it is not necessarily make or break.  I highly recommend him for diffeq.

His attitude was unprofessional at times, and disrespectful, making personal comments even during an exam. Every student can have their moments outside of the class that can impact their grades and attendance, but I don't think anyone deserves to be treated like that. I was very disappointed. It affected my confidence and motivation to participate.

Nice guy, he cares about his students and wants them to succeed, but he can be a little difficult to follow during lectures on some occasions. Has written homeworks every week along with web assign which can be very time consuming and long so be sure to start them early. I didn't find the tests to be too bad, but the class average was somewhat low.

(Review for MATH 2214 Diff Eq) Good afternoon dearest students. I am a cinematography major and avid movie critic and was forced to take this class for a pathways. Extremely easy class but it was to my great displeasure that I must not watch movie during lecture.

Had him for 2214 (diff eq). One of the best math professors at VT. You can tell he really cares about his students, always encourages students to stay engaged and participate. Prints out notes, and tests are similar to homework/notes. Inspires students with advice. Talks about how he "appreciates our presence." Don't watch a movie my dear students.
Good afternoon my dear students. Top 3 differential equations professor and he's not number 2 or 3. The GOAT.

Dr. Alam was the best professor I've had at Virginia Tech. His lectures were always detailed and he explained things in a way that would even make sense to people who didn't know a ton about math. The tests were a big part of the grade, but they were fair and he gave a lot of partial credit.

He gets very frustrated with students easily and his mood depends on the day. His written homework is about 10 pages each and he gives no extra credit. He tries his best but he's not the best professor to learn from.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He's really nice, but slow to respond to emails. (Keep in mind I took this in the summer) I dropped it because the work daily took 6 hours (in lecture videos and assignments). When I didn't understand something I was screwed because he took days to respond and was confused in the video chat reviews by my questions. Also a little hard to understand

This is for MATH 2214, Differential Equations. Mahmud is a nice guy, but he is not a great teacher. His lectures are just bad, he's hard to understand and jumps around back and forth too much making him hard to follow. Past the lectures it's ok. He grades fairly, tests aren't too hard, and one of the midterms gets dropped. You'll just need tutoring

Really awesome guy and really enjoys teaching. A little difficult to understand at times and talks really fast but he basically tells you what is going to be on the test and answers questions during the test.

Genuinely not good teacher/person. Very arbitrary with grading, borderline rcist, and very unfair. Can't accept any sort of disruption and passive-aggressively punishes the entire class rather than one person. Some sexism is apparent and there is a definite higher rate of male punishments compared to females.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great he was a good teacher and knew what he was talking about.

I was surprised to see all of these bad comments about Prof. Dalton
He teaches really well and helps you learn everything you need. I would definitely take his class again.

He is a great teacher, a little strict, but also fun. we do lots of games in class that help us on the test. I currently have a 100 because of how easy and helpful this class is. I learn every day and am motivated to study. Many people have given negative comments but I believe they just don't look at the good side.

Dalton is such a chill teacher, I'm surprised he's rated this badly. I think I spent less than an hour a week doing stuff for his class besides watching movies. His lectures are interesting and it's obvious he wants you to learn and excel. There are weekly quizzes but they are SO easy if you watch the movies/grammar assigned (plus it's open note).

Awful professor. The worst I have had. Made my anxiety sky rocket every time I would go in his classroom. Did nothing to help me outside of class even thought he emphasized going to office hours. Do not take his classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He obviously didn't think very highly of me because when I did good on a quiz he accused me of cheating. He is very passive aggressive and I'm not one to just throw accusations, but he was racist towards me and obviously didn't like me.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I highly recommend this professor if you want to learn Spanish from a teacher who is truly invested in his students. He puts time and effort into each of his lectures and assignments. I learned more in one semester with him than all three of my previous semesters in Spanish. Participate and be ready for a healthy challenge and you will do great!

Makes fun of students. Can be arbitrary in grading things. I should have taken a higher level class because I already speak and he still made class a pain for me. He is just not kind to his students. Don't use your phone in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This professor is awful. He makes fun of students in the class if they don't know the answer. He's also very demeaning/condescending of others when it comes to their knowledge in Spanish. The tests don't make sense sometimes and for an intermediate level it is unnecessarily hard for no reason. I would not recommend this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This Spanish class has been disheartening. Criticism overshadows support, and fear of mistakes stifles learning. Heavy grading on minor errors and vague assignment instructions add to the stress. Hoping for a change towards a more encouraging environment.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I despised this class. I tried my hardest every day in class and completed every homework assignment. However, I would get docked participation points almost every class period. I would recommend avoiding taking this professor all 4 years at Tech.

Do not take this class if you have social anxiety. He cold calls regularly and gives sarcastic, negative comments to students if you do not answer how he wants you to. There was tension in every class and I did not feel welcome to learn. My Spanish did improve, though. If you keep up with the class and put time into it, the class is bearable.

Professor Dalton is one of the worst professors I have had at VT. He is extremely disrespectful and will make you feel awful. He would make unwarranted comments when asking questions or make a rude mark that had nothing to do with the presented material or education. If you are required to take this class, try to find another one who offers it.

Let me just say that administrative actions are pending against this Prof. His standards of conduct and methods of teaching are so dishonest and intentionally harsh that around 80% of his students drop the class each semester without exception. He is a blatant bully and his main goal is to keep his students in abject misery for as long as possible

I think positive reviews are written by the Prof. They sound exactly how he writes and they're wildly inaccurate. I have a theory that this man holds a secret disdain for his students. Even the native speakers who write excellently have problems. His class is run in a deceptive and malicious way. You will struggle, it wont be fair and he wont help.

Prof. Dalton explains everything so well, but you have to pay attention and participate to get a good grade. All the tests follow the same format from the textbook, and all of the homework directly helps you on the test. He loves answering questions, so go to office hours if you're struggling! One of my favorite professors at VT.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: dont take him
He makes it very difficult to learn or be passionate about Spanish. Rather than uplifting students or simply correcting them if they make a mistake, he shames and humiliates them.

Very harsh aggressive professor. Seems like he is bullying most of the class and trying to give everyone the worst grade possible. Many have dropped out early in the semester. I participate 3-4 times in class and still get low grades in participation. Grades like you're supposed to know every single thing, feels like I'm under attack during class

worst professor I've ever interacted with. Always passive aggressive and bullying students. Very hard for the level of class it is, many students dropped him a few weeks in and he grades you so harshly it feels unfair to my other courses the amount of time I have to study for this class. Very aggressive and peasant-like teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Certainly the worst language professor I've ever had, and among the worst I've ever had in any department. A very typical "my way or the highway" kind of mindset, clearly felt he was better than everyone else around him. If you forgot the homework even once, he'd make sure that was known to the whole class.

lol super rude to kids. i would participate at LEAST 3 times each class and i would never get full participation credit. if you didnt do your hw he will know and make it known to the entire class. wouldnt take him again. god forbid youre confused on something he literally shames you in front of the whole class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Rude, passive aggressive, and unwilling to be compassionate. Not a native Spanish speaker so he teaches straight from the textbook which is not applicable to real life. For example, I got tutoring from a native Spanish speaker and he got most of my homework wrong. Class structure is practice on grammar from textbook not covered in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very harsh and unwilling to be compassionate to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Rude, fails to teach material on tests, and grades very harshly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is often condescending and passive-aggressive. This makes it hard to enjoy his class. We learn but I also leave every day feeling a strong rage.

This is the worst spanish professor I have ever had. He is very passive aggressive and grades as if you are a born native spanish speaker. Awful teacher, does not help outside of class. Falsely accuses people of cheating. 2/3 of my class dropped and I wish I had to.

He has extremely high expectations and even if you have reasons to miss class you have to fully makeup everything on your own time, he will not help much! He grades hard, and attendance is MANDATORY and will mess with your whole grade. You have to remind him to fix grades often.

participate as much as you can. i personally wouldn't take him again but he has very high standards and is very knowledgeable. he can be funny sometimes but overall i wouldn't recommend taking his class.

Grades us as if we are already fluent in Spanish. If you struggle with grammar, do NOT take this class. One-third of our class dropped, and I was warned not to take the professor the semester prior because he can be passive-aggressive at times and grades harshly. But he does care about his students, teaches the vocab well, and is always prepared.
He has high standards, unlike some of the other instructors that I've heard about.  Great variety of activities in class, some extra credit opportunities, really knows how to teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I feel like my Spanish finally started to come together after taking this class. Prof Dalton seems to have a great understanding of how students actually learn a foreign language.

I learned more in one class with Prof. Dalton that my previous 2 or 3 classes put together! I really like his style and his dedication to his students. He also clearly loves the ins and outs of learning a language.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Best teacher I've ever had! His dedication to his students' success is clear from day one. He loves Spanish and loves helping his students achieve their language goals. And he can be funny sometimes too :)

One of the worst professors at Tech. Not very resourceful and genuinely seems to not care about a students well being. To the people who have said he is "forgiving" is a lie. Don't take this class if you aren't a teaches pet, because that seems to be the only people he cares about in his classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Overall good class. Professor Dalton gives lots of homework, but it is all good practice material. Gives "pop" quizzes every Friday. Can skip 3 classes and then your grade is affected by further absences. Has his own textbook that he made that you are required to buy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: You're expected to learn everything in each section of the course, and his homework release is a little sketch, but he's fair and VERY clear with his expectations. This course isn't too hard and he's pretty forgiving with grading, so you can expect a good grade if you show up, participate, and study like you're supposed to.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Dalton has been the best Spanish instructor I've ever had. He uses so many different materials and goes out of his way to make sure that everyone understands. And not just in a basic way, but in meaningful ways. He's great.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dalton was very intimidating and I personally witnessed him make several students cry. He had a tendency to accuse students of cheating, but instead of reporting it to Virginia Tech he would make up tests for the accused and make them take the tests during his office hours to prove they hadn't done it. In the end he would just drop the accusations
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: worst professor ive ever had at virginia tech. made me hate spanish and simply does not care about his students. he is condescending and had to go to class even though he taught nothing. I along with most of my fellow classmates usually received fairly high grades in previous spanish classes, however class averages were in Cs for ever single grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Señor Dalton is a really great professor so if youre willing to participate and put in a lot of effort, then youll be fine but hes pretty unforgiving and challenging.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Professor Dalton is extremely helpful, always encourages students to go to his office hours, and is very patient. He can sometimes be a bit sarcastic sometimes and it scares some people, but I always thought it was funny. Good guy! Don't be afraid to speak up in class, participation is huge.

Often rude and inconsiderate towards students. He makes all of the content for ECE2514, so the content will not change per professor but at least the others make an attempt to smile. Many students deal with unfair testing environments as the way he sets up tests crashes some people's browsers, for which he provides no grace or extra time.

Soysal is not great at teaching and can be rude and condescending. The problem is with the tests; they now use lockdown browser. I had tech issues half of the test time because of that I gave up and withdrew. Theres a reason students are cheating, so change the format instead of making it worse. It's not worth your time to take here, take at a cc.

Avoid this professor at all costs. He is insulting and condescending to anyone who asks questions during class. His lectures are pointless, and I usually end up leaving class more confused than if I just skipped. He deliberately makes the exams impossible, and half the class receives a score of 20% or less. Ended up withdrawing from the class.

Very frustrating professor. Smug and condescending at times. Moreover, the grading on the tests is entirely unfair. You will get a 20% or a 100% on the exams, as they rely on an autograder. No extensions/extra credit even for valid cases.

Important to mention: 95% of the learning comes from the assignments. 60% of the class skips lectures

Pretty good professor for someone without any C++ experience. Lectures are generally pretty good. He didn't prepare us well for the first midterm, but did a great job preparing us for the second one and the final. The projects can be tricky, but you can usually manage on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: ECE 2514 is a horrendously run class, I do not think it is entirely the professor's fault but the class sucks. Lectures aren't really helpful, and the midterm exams are very poorly run. I am pretty sure this professor is the best of the three, but it doesn't really matter much because you have to learn this course all by yourself.

They made the class a lot harder this past semester, so for a first time coder it was pretty difficult. I failed the first exam and I initially blamed him for lack of teaching. However, I met with him multiple times outside of his office hours to relearn concepts I didn't understand in class. Doing that and taking good notes shot my grade back up.

Half the class failed the midterm, and this was arguably the professors fault, as he even admitted that we should have been taught the material via a different method. This class is a cakewalk if you already understand C++, if not, it's better to learn it on your own than to pay attention to his lectures. Attendance rarely made a difference.

Soysal is entertaining and gives helpful analogies for people who haven't coded before. The class isn't terrible although most of the averages seem to be 50's since half the class doesn't know anything and the other half has coded before. If you wanna pass, just do the assignments... don't use chatgpt (half the class failed the midterm).

Alkan Soysal doesn't know how to teach people how to code. The assignments in the course were poorly made, often having mistakes or requiring students to do things in the wrong way only to then cause students problems because they did it in the wrong way. This doesn't help the students learn better, it just adds a lot of confusion and extra work.
Knows what he's doing and tries his best to make sure everyone in his lectures does too.

Dr. Soysal is an awesome professor. This was my first forte into coding, and after doing poorly on the midterm exam (yes ik it was easy, I improved a lot over the last 8 weeks), he very much helped me get back on the right track. Take him if you have the chance, you won't regret it!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Soysal is a very accessible and often funny professor, while most people in this class have already had coding experience or something similar Professor Soysal works hard to add onto topics and match the rigor of the class with input from the students(if they ever speak up haha)

I barely ended with a 90.01 in Business Calc after getting a 72 on the final. Honestly the stuff you learn up until the final three weeks is fine. The thing I hated was the final was basically Calc 2 or Linear Algebra stuff we learned in Business Calc which is why many people did bad. I would recommend anyone else.

Homework is really hard and expect to spend time on it. It is considered an honor code violation if you use any method or notation which he doesnt put in his notes. During class youll think hes the flash and he is he will  go through everything at lightning pace even if it does not make sense

Genuinely run, if you have him lowkey, good luck. He will find any method in order to take points away from homework and tests, and he does say mid-semester that he makes his section much more difficult than others intentionally

Rude professor, speeds through lectures as if they are something he has to check off his to-do list, does not care if you get the concept or not, and sloppy handwriting. If it weren't for the amazing TA I had I would have dropped the class and taken a W. Oh and can't forget the tests are not partial credit.

There are not enough words in the English lexicon to describe the experience that was this class. He goes so fast when he's teaching that its less understanding the material and more racing to keep up with what he's writing. Also, all the exams are only 12 questions long so its basically over if you get just a few wrong. Don't take.

He is not very good at teaching and is not very open to answer questions. Almost feels insulted that you asked a question. This dude makes me upset simply cause I had a 93 before the final and then ended with an 89.97 and would not round up or offer any extra credit. Take someone else.
Never take a class from this guy

I made a few obvious typos on exams, and he refused to give me any type of partial credit? Also he doesn't award partial credit for work you show. To top that, I ended with 89.99, and he refused to round me. I calculated and if he gave me credit for those typos, I would have ended with an A. Class is easy if calc was taken before. Don't take him.

This guy is the worst. All of his tests are on WebAssign which means absolutely NO partial credit on any questions. He teaches too fast and whenever I asked him questions about the math problems he never directly answered them. If you took Calc in high school you should be fine. All of the tests are either 20 or 12 questions.

Tests are 12 questions with no partial credit and each is about 20 percent of your grade. There is no test prep material. Fast paced and intimidating. This class will be easy if you took AP Calc, but if your highest was pre-calc it is tough. Printed $35 of notes that can change. Many students dropped the course. You can't view your grade on Canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Hulko's lectures are my biggest issue about him. If someone asks a question about a problem, he will make the student feel kind of down and Hulko doesn't care to answer the question in the best way possible. He rushes through lectures very quickly and even simple concepts can be difficult. Taking Calc AB in high school helped.

His class sucks, he makes it even worse. The course as a whole is really poorly set up with 12 question tests and no partial credit but he just makes it so much worse. The dude cannot teach whatsoever he sits there and doesn't even do half of his notes problems. Complains all the time about people contacting him and his TAs grade everything for him

The math is not that hard, especially for those who took calculus in high school. However, the class exam has only 12 questions and heavily influences your grade, making it easy to struggle if you don't do well. The professor often comes across as rude, demanding participation, and if you answer incorrectly, he belittle you for attempting to engage

This class absolutely sucks. There is no partial credit on tests. There is so much homework every week yet they count for such little points. If you took calculus in high school you should be fine, but I only took pre-calc and it was extremely difficult at the end. First test is super easy so make sure to get a good grade, as there wont be many.

Swear on my life I never cried more out of frustration for a class than this. I didn't have the opportunity to take Calc in Hs so if you have no prior knowledge you will struggle. I have to take this class again cuz he is truly a bad teacher. Avoid him!

There wasn't much he could do since this is one of those classes led by the math department. He taught things clearly and answered questions, but there was so much work outside of class. Exams are few questions, lots of points so a small mistake costs a LOT. He's very straightforward & doesn't mess around (he did try to joke at times but not rly).
He is not a useful teacher for learning material, his tests are never what they are supposed to be on, lectures are boring, try as hard as possible to get out his class.

No partial credit on tests. Extremely condescending, saw him rip a student's test in half right in front of their face. Assigns homework during breaks and makes tests happen right after breaks. I hoped to get hit by the BT campus shuttle every time I went to his class. Do not take.
My grade barely stayed at a 90 after today exam. That exam was so bad probably cause this dude can't teacher for anything. NO PARTIAL CREDIT. Leave him at all costs.

He does not care whether you pass or not, he'd probably rather see you fail. If you took calc in high school, it's mostly a review until the last 2 units. If you didn't, don't expect to get taught by him at all. There's no partial credit on exams, and exams are worth too much. He takes the "teach" out of teacher.

This class in general is VERY easy. I don't understand how people don't understand the bare minimum to calculus. Is he the best teacher? No. But is the class easy so it doesn't matter? Yes. Just do the homework and study for tests and you will recieve an A

Do NOT take this class with him if you did not take calc in hs. Overall a nice guy if you speak to him 1 on 1, but teaching style is very overwhelming. 3 exams, 15% and final is 20%. SO much busy work, review the quizzes before exams though. Get VT math tutor, worth the money.
Terrible professor and doesn't really care about the students success

This dude is horrible. His lectures are boring and not helpful. He does not care about his students at all and thinks he is some amazing man. The class in general will be easy tho if you took calc in high school. I only went for tests after the first week. However, for those who didn't take calc in high school, I would stay away from this dude.
It is literally like pulling teeth out of someone to get this man to respond to an email.
Don't skip class and ignore your homework and then cry about how your grade was bad

reviews.comment: Worst professor at Virginia Tech, avoid him at all costs, does not like to help students, no partial credit on exams.
I really don't even know how this man is employed at VT. He literally hates his own students.

Doesn't teach at all. He moves so fast during lectures that most students stop going. I am only doing well because I took Calc and Pre-Calc in high school otherwise I couldn't imagine taking this course without any prior calculus knowledge. You are better off learning on youtube and the textbook then from his lecture.
test/quizzes are due on sundays but also makes things due right before/after break
Homeworks/Quizzes are due on sundays and right after break.
Boring and not helpful

An awful professor who doesn't care about students and treats them as if they are beneath him. Tests have ZERO partial credit, and refuse to give partial credit. He won't respond to emails, and if he sees it, he thinks any email is dumb and will call you out in class. Avoid him, if you get him and can't change, good luck, it's going to be awful.
