reviews.comment: She is so funny and sweet, is very patient with her students, answers questions and truly cares how her students perform in the class. A great professor and I would love to have her again, she is so supportive and helpful.

Professor Arachchige is a serious go to for understanding difficult concepts. She moves fast, so its good to watch her lectures Ahead of class and then use her zooms as a review. Will answer any question without patronizing u for it! Very fast replies too for emails, wants students to succeed very much.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Arachchige is a great prof. She explains every concept in detail and gives plenty of example problems and worksheets. She seems strict, but she wants to see all of her students succeed. The class itself is challenging, but Dr. Arachchige does her best to make everything make sense, even though she can be a little boring (but thats everyone)
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Arachchige was an excellent professor for CHEM 1035. I've heard about lots of students struggling in general chem, but Dr. Arachchige is great at laying out exactly what you need to know. I had previously taken a chemistry class in high school, but Dr. Arachchige definitely made me really understand the concepts on a deeper level.

You can tell she cares a lot about everyone's success in the class. She makes videos that are available about 3-4 days before she gives a lecture on the topic. WATCH THE VIDEOS, they're super easy to follow along and you can increase the speed if you want to get through it faster. Ask questions during lectures and DO the homework to get above a B.

She always makes announcements and reminders about tests and homework at the beginning of the class. Lecture videos are uploaded, Zoom classes are recorded, and notes and slides are posted. (I personally don't participate much in class and seldom reach the materials because I already learned most concepts in high school in Taiwan.)

Amazing professor. Her lectures are so clear and well organized and she makes sure to do demonstrations to keep kids engaged with her teaching. She makes jokes during lectures and gives stretch breaks or phone breaks during her lecture. She always has announcements at the beginning of class to make sure no one falls behind. Take her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you are an organized-minded person who needs everything to be connected and explained, shes the perfect professor for you. Her lectures follow the class notes handout so its easy to follow along and look back at your notes later! Shes also great about explaining things at her office hours. Her exams are hard but study from her past exams!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Fairly good choice for chemistry. She will get the information across effectively, but isn't exactly engaging. Chem 1036 also has a recitation with quizzes every week, which is helpful in the long run but weekly quizzes plus four exams and a final gets to be a lot. I only went to office hours once, but she was accessible and helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures are super boring, and in my opinion really unnecessary. Most of the material you will need to pass her exams is learned through the online homework.

Arachchige is the best chemistry teacher on campus. She clearly explains all the concepts so everyone can understand. If you like your lectures "dumbed down" or need all the details explained she is the one for you. However if you want to pass chem in general you need to put in the work.

Dr. Arachchige was a fair professor. The class is extremely lecture heavy and she very harsh when it comes to respect (so have your phone off and keep talking to a minimum). Lectures are long and kind of boring, but how interesting can chemistry be anyways? Overall, conveyed the material well and was fair to students.

Dr. Arachchige is a very good teacher. Test are difficult but her review sessions are very helpful. You do have some other assignments that help buffer you grade if you do poorly on a test you grade won't suffer. Just show up to class and work hard and you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Multiple choice tests. Homework is easy to bs but make sure you understand it. She is easily the best teacher I've had and made me understand chemistry. I will barely use chemistry but this was the one class I enjoyed. Sit up front. Study for tests. Put as much effort in as for calc to do well.

She's literally the nicest professor there is! She's super clear and makes it extremely easy to understand problems, she's accessible outside class, and she makes sure you have 1000 opportunities to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Arachchige was a fun teacher but over simplified things in the course. I suggest doing many connect problems. This class is a hard class in general. Talking to many students, it is not uncommon to have to re-take the course here.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I felt that she was truly cared for her students. She went through the lecture material fairly quickly, but introduced several demonstrations to pique her students' interest. Overall, she's a great teacher, but be prepared to use a tablet/ tablet computer for notes. She uses outlines and printing them packets is a "no go".
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The professor complicates everything by actually trying to make it TOO simple. She gives too many steps to problems that may only need a few steps. Chemistry can be simple if taught right, but she complicates it too much.
Professor was easy to understand and was fair. Just pay attention in class and use the practice tests and worksheets, you'll do fine.
Really good professor. Knows the material extremely well and really knows how to explain topics. She cares about her students. Chem is a tough class so going to class is very important.

They say professors can make or break the class. She explains concept clearly and her powerpoint notes are always posted. Had friends with other professors who wouldn't release notes?!? Best gen chem prof out there. Bonus: she's kinda funny and talks to student about things other than chem

After having not-Arachchige last semester and having her this semester, I can say that, although the material and exams are the same across Gen Chem classes, it really does matter who is lecturing. I really understood concepts when she taught them and I would highly recommend her. She also has extensive office hours, so you can always get help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She was a very helpful and informative professor. She really cared whether or not you understood the material. You MUST however show up to class or you WILL have a difficult time in this class if you haven't taken AP chemistry before. She really likes it when you go to her office hours and help sessions as it develops a more one-on-one connection.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I love her! Her accent might be hard to understand at first, but very good professor! Lectures can get kinda boring though
Go to office hours and exam review sessions. Really take time to understand the learnsmart homework assignments and you'll be fine.

She is a good teacher when it comes to her explanation skills and how she answers questions.  She is straight forward on what we need to know.  Her office hours and review sessions are extremely helpful and imperative for the average student to succeed.

Arachige is pretty easy to understand after a few classes. Her accent just takes a little getting used to. The class is easier as it's a lot of material from high school Chemistry, but the book and online resources will definitely be useful. She drops 1 of 4 exams and has in class iClickers.
She's not good at teaching. She is good at lecturing. The class is boring and sucks, but if you study and work hard you will do fine. If you enjoy chemistry then you'll definitely be fine.

Dr. Arachchige is one of the best professors I've ever had. She is so clear and cut when it comes to teaching difficult concepts in a difficult (for me, anyway) subject. Her notes are easy to follow, doesn't make you write them all by yourself, will help if you need it, tests are "hard", but only if you are ill prepared.

Seriously the best General Chemistry professor out there. If you get to have her for both semesters like I did, consider yourself lucky. Her notes were so helpful, even to people who weren't even in her class. Connect really boosts your grade, and helps solidify concepts as well. I would definitely recommend her to anyone.

She always gives opportunities for students to prepare themselves for her tests.  I've used her chapter worksheets online, practice connect assignments, suggested textbook problems, and test review sessions.  I'd say the only reason I got a B instead of an A in her class is because I kept falling asleep in her lecture, so that was my fault.
Extremely Detailed notes that were easy to follow. You will be able to tutor the other people in Chem with different professors.

Arachchige was awesome!! She was the most helpful teacher I have had at VT and is always willing to take extra time with you. Exams are easy as long as you do the homework and take the practice tests! Wish I could take her again

She is amazing!! Highly recommend! If you can't get her then get Amateis. But if you have her, keep her!! All of her practice tests will prepare you for the test. Final was really hard but that's cause it was accumulative.

Good professor. Posts a lot of material and holds review session every weeks. Basically does every practice problem in class and her tests are pretty easy if you use all of the resources. Final is a lot harder than the other tests.
She's very nice & knows what she's talking about. Very helpful.

She's a very nice teacher. She explains the material fairly well. She taught me with 500 other students. So, there was not a lot of interaction with students. Her tests are really easy. Just do the practice tests she provides, and attend the review session before the tests and you'll do fine.
Do all of the worksheets, practice problems, and ARIS problems. If you do that carefully, you should be able to get an A.

Decent teacher, posts a lot of resources to help students do well on tests.  Writing down example problems from class is crucial for learning how to do problems on the tests.  Taught myself most of the material from example problems.

Best teacher ever!! Homework was due before every class, but is graded for participation. She likes to cold call in class, but usually you'll only be called on once per class. She was so nice and willing to work with everyone. Its super easy to get an A if you show up and do all of the assignments.

Early on, I could tell Dr. Hesp truly cares for her students' success in and outside of class: she ensures course content is applicable to the real world, and she's very knowledgeable on personal finance, study abroad, etc. She's always willing to answer questions and chat after class. Highly recommend, and one of the best profs I've had at VT!

She is helpful, attentive, and truly cares about her students success. She replies quickly to emails and goes out of her way to meet with you. The class does require a lot of reading with a 30min-1 hr assignment along with it. She is very engaging and fun. I learned a lot and would highly recommend her.

i highly recommend this professor, she genuinely cares about her students and makes sure that doing well. the random participation isn't bad at all and it really helped me learn. there's around 30 mins of homework due before every class, and sometimes the books/short films in them are part of the exam. the oral exams are also easy to prep for

Highly recommend Dr. Hesp. She clearly loves and cares about her students, the class requires participation and homework but she makes class fun and engaging, easy to reach out to. She puts in the effort to get to know her students on a personal level.

Lovely lady. Lots of reading, but she's very helpful and class discussions are interesting. I was nervous at first because she picks on random people to answer questions, but the environment is comfortable, and it's no big deal if you don't know an answer or don't understand something. Tip: buy the books second hand, not new.

Dr. Hesp is very kind and fun. She truly wants you to succeed and wants to help you! She gives great advice and is very knowledgeable about study abroad programs. She also does a workshop on cheap smart travel. Participation is important in this class and you must take notes/study but it is well worth it and not terribly difficult! Amazing overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I love Professor Hesp! She was my first professor at Virginia Tech and was the reason I added Spanish as a major. She requires effort and participation but, makes the classroom supportive and fun. She was a great teacher and made her class enjoyable even at 8:00am! I highly recommend her.
Very casual and fun class. Do your work outside of class and participate and it's an easy A.

Annie is only my 2nd spanish prof, but she is definitely the best by far. She is so kind & truly wants you to do well. I was kinda terrified the first day because she said she doesn't have voluntarios, she has victímas, meaning everyone talks everyday. However, this really helped me in my speaking ability. She is so genuine & gives the best advice!
My previous Spanish professors had ruined my passion for the language. Professor Hesp changed that. My favorite course of the semester by far and my favorite professor of all time
Annie truly cares about her students' success. She is upbeat, fun and manages to still teach the material in a way that has a lot of real world application.
She is friendly, outgoing,and excited about what she teaches.  You can tell she cares about her students as people, and she values their opinions.  Best Professor.

Great professor who is passionate on teaching. Makes things funny and engaging. There are 4 essays and a mid-term and final. She grades not only on how you use Spanish, but also on your writing skills. She always has office hours and helps you out.
Lets you finish the class early to avoid paying for the McGraw Hill textbook. If you need an easy elective, this is the one!

Took her for personal health and drug education—both were self-paced and so easy I finished them in 2 days. You definitely want to finish the class during the free textbook trial so that you don't have to pay. I can't recommend these classes enough if you just want a free A for a GPA boost. Inadvertently learned some things while taking them too.

Prof. Smith sets up this course to be very easy and straightforward. She opens all the assignments on the first day of class, and you can work ahead of the due dates. If you are able to time manage, you can easily complete all the work within the two-week free trial window and not have to pay for access to the textbook and homework assignments.

Finish the assignments in the first two weeks!!!! It is a lot of work, but I knocked it out over a weekend. The professor seems very nice and she sent a lot of reminders about due dates, which was nice. Overall, not a hard class at all!

It was an easy A and I paid the $100 before realizing I could have just done everything in two weeks. If you need help, everything is on quizlet and the more personal assignments are easy. It is Smartbook so it just takes a lot of time.

finished the class in the 2-week window even though professor doesn't recommend that method. i just didn't want to have to pay the $100 for the program. it's do-able to finish in 2 weeks but there's A  LOT of content and tests so you have to set a lot of time out for it. it was nice finishing it early and not having to worry about it.

class is easy overall, I finished it within the 2 week trial so I did not need to buy the textbook. lots of people say you can get it done in 1 weekend, but imo i think thats if you absolutely grind it non stop. More realistically I'd say it took a week to finish. Entire class is on smartbook connects.

a very easy asynchronous class with useful information. since it's online i don't really have much to say about the professor but she's nice, lenient, and emails us with reminders for what we need to be doing. take this class if you want an easy A.
She made my grade go from an A to a C+. 0/10 would transfer to Wisconsin.
This class is an easy A if you put in the work. I finished in less than 2 weeks and didnt have to buy the online pack.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: very easy class if you need a GPA boost. Give it some effort and you'll definitely get an A. I finished the class in a month.

Easiest class at Tech! I did the outside events at Schiffert and they're not as bad as they seem. The homework and exams are super easy. I finished the class in a little over a month, but it is definitely possible to do it in less time than that.

Very passionate about the topic and explains subjects very clearly. Makes an effort to ensure that students can follow along. The capstone lab he teaches too is also a great class. Very educational but not stressful at all. One of my favorite professors I've ever had.

Dr. Lowell is an incredible professor. His lectures are very clear. Practice tests are very similar to the tests. He makes the content engaging & fun. I hated OChem 2 but he somehow revived my love for OChem in Bioorganic (OChem 3). Definitely recommend this class whether a Chem major or not. This has been my favorite class even though challenging.

He was very responsive and enthusiastic. He gave a lot of feedback during office hours and after lectures. The homework and exams were reflective of the material and the practice exams were very similar to the actual exams which was very helpful. He was also very approachable and friendly. There was a lot of material, but it was doable.

Decided to withdraw but I would have gotten around a C+-B- had I continued. Other than the final exam there are only two tests and 5 homework assignments. Problem sets are lengthy and you prob won't receive full points. I could have done better in this class, but after getting a bad grade on the first exam, it has been impossible to recover.

There were only 8 graded assignments, so they are all very important. He didn't make any of his material - got all of the homework and lectures from the previous professor who taught this class - so he has a hard time answering questions effectively. During his lectures he generally just read off of the PowerPoints - which was ineffective.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class has a lot of small projects/assignments.  If you do them you will do well in class. If you skip them or the class - plan on retaking.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: My favorite accounting professor at VT. I've gotten fairly close with him by talking to him after class and such. I also had him in 3115 and have sat in the front both times and have gotten to know him fairly well. He's an amazing person and professor.
He doesn't really help if needed, entire course is self taught, not tons of homework but if you actually want to learn don't take him. He was also outright rude to me when I would ask questions lol.
He's the best. Simple as that.

If you really want to learn the material, I would suggest not taking Boylan for this class. While he does give you review problems that are exactly like the exams, you basically just learn to memorize. He does no actual teaching so watch the online lectures if you have to take his class. Good guy, not a good teacher,
There is a lot of work in this class. If you follow the instructions and do as you are instructed you will be fine.

Lowkey the goat makes study guides that are exactly like the exam. It's just Connect homework's and 3 exams. Offers a good chunk of extra credit and attendance doesn't actually get graded. Lectures don't really teach much but overall a great guy.

Very kind professor ! Provided video reviews for the final, learning was done through pre recorded lectures but were very straightforward, lots of practice problems were made available for each topic, as well as practice tests for other exams.
He's a phenomenal person, and if you take the time to do the practice tests and read outside of class, you will do really well.

The class I took with Professor Boylan was online, he is genuinely such a great person and teacher. He wants to help students and does everything he can to do so. He made the class easy to follow and straightforward. As long as you are studying for each exam and practicing the provided test reviews you will be just fine. Everything is very clear!
This is a great class. He gives a lot of resources. Videos of how to work problems, word files, and a Super Review for exams.  If you are willing to do the work you will be good. He plays no games
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He's cool but the class is hard.

Boylan is by far my fav professor at VT. This class isn't the easiest but if you show up to class, do the work, and participate Boylan will help you out. He is such a nice professor and doesn't deserve any hate. I fear the people who rated him bad probably didn't go to class, participate, or do the work.
One of my favorite professors at Virginia tech. Adds a lot of “experience” to the classroom to explain difficult materials.
Great instructor. My favorite at VIrginia Tech.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He's chill and really nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall, he's an amazing person and offers a lot of extra credit, but his lectures are not the best at times. He barely gets through the slides and gets sidetracked very easily. Great person though.

He taught my 1106 class, and I think he's a good professor and just has a bad rating because the class is hard. it's a lot of material in very little time but he accounts for that and does his best to make it easier. his test are easier than some teachers for sure. watch the before class videos and take notes on the HW and iclickers, it will help.

Dr. Wills was great. I had him for 1105 and 1106 and ended with A's in both. If you take notes on the video and pay attention to the lectures, you'll be fine. His test reviews are helpful and tells you what you need to know.  If he emphasizes it in class, it's on the test. 10/10, most caring guy, wants his students to perform well, and curves.

I think he was great! He offered a lot of insight on topics (a lot of which is not in the slides). He wants the best for his students and is super nice and understanding when help is needed. Sometimes he does crash out though. Overall 1105 is a hard class and he does what he can to make it easier. He also gives the most generous curve, easy tests.

He his students to succeed, but generally just reads from slides and sometimes gets to point where he's not sure what to say about subject. Words questions oddly making them hard to answer, but gives credit for them if he sees where the misunderstanding comes from. Makes an effort to connect with his students, so I give him credit where it's due.

He is a sweet professor and cares about his students. However, he reads off the slides and finishes 25 slides in like 20 minutes, so he moves very fast. Sometimes I question whether he knows what he's talking about, and the tests are hard and don't make sense, with questions not from the notes or videos. He's super nice but not a great teacher.

I don't get why he has a bad reputation. I took his 1105 class and liked it. The course is standardized, so it's not just him. He clearly cares about teaching and wants students to succeed. He even cracks dad jokes in lecture, which makes class more fun. If you go to class, watch the videos, and use the review slides and objectives, you'll be fine.

Dr. Wills class is not hard if you actually study before exams and go to class. The homework were very manageable and the tests questions were basically straight from the slides and iClickers. Dr. Wills was also very nice and uses a lot of good examples to help understand material.

Most ratings complain about things that have to do with the 1105 curriculum, which are not within his control. All bio professors "read off the slides" because it's a review from the homework. As long as you watch the videos and take notes, you will do fine. He is open to criticisms about test questions and will curve if he sees an issue.
He does have a monotone voice, but I was able to learn by listening in class. He is willing to help and work with students

I am very confused why this guy's rating is so low. His lectures were boring but so are most. He was overall a funny dude and this was one of my easier classes. If you go to all your classes and do the participation quiz at the end of each class you are guaranteed a C or above. Also very generous with points and grades. Would 100% take again

He does give a lot of in-class assignments, but I didn't really need to use much more than those to study for exams — if you're following along in class and taking notes you should do well; Dr. Wills is a pretty chill guy overall, too.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Wills is a funny guy. However, his tests are very hard. The only reason i'd take him again is because he's the only Bio professor at VT that gives a slight curve on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Wills does not deserve such low ratings. His courses are content heavy but that's not his fault? I had him for evolutionary biology and there were 4 tests including the final, and he went over each test and gave back points if questions were confusing. Weekly homework (easy) and a quiz per test that helped you study. Tests are like 90% vocab.
Guy seems like he doesn't even feel like teaching the class, snarky guy but his curves on the tests are nice.

I don't understand why others gave him low ratings. Yes his lectures are content-heavy, but you're expected to do work outside of class. If you do that for his class, the content he covers is what you should've already done. Other than that, everything else is pretty easy and straightforward.

Dr Wills is a great professor. He gives crazy big curves on the tests and is super helpful if you try to ask him questions. He gets a bad rep because his tests are hard, but he always curves. If you study you can get an A.

Funny guy but does not explain concepts very well, be prepared to teach yourself the majority of the class.  Attendance is mandatory as he utilizes iClickers and in class assignments, but he drops the lowest 2 grades for each of those.  It was a difficult class, but overall I would take him again.

There is no reason for Professor Wills to have a bad rating. Biology is a hard class and any bad grade is mostly not his fault. He explains in class what exactly is going to be on the exams and tells us when there is an important topic that we need to know. He is also the only bio professor that curves the exams.

He is super funny and genuinely cares about our learning. Sometimes his explanations are confusing but he is super self aware and will clarify material wherever needed. He is also super generous with giving points back on tests.

I am shocked he has such a low score I love this man. Bio is a hard class, but he tries to give people tips during class and during group activities he is always walking around to help people. He seems to genuinely want us to do well. I found the class pretty simple if you just watched the videos beforehand like you were supposed to. He curves!!
Seems like he really cares. Very funny, actually gives helpful study tips, bio is just really hard its not his fault. Give him a break.
hes a funny guy and he does a lot of ant research. very test heavy but he said rizzler in class so that pretty great. would take again even if i fail
Chill guy very funny. Tests are really hard but not really his fault bio just blows.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Wills is so caring about all of his students, and I loved going to his lectures. Most people with complaints didn't fully utilize all of the many resources he gives for his students to succeed.
Just reads off the slides and the tests are hard. You are assigned group work to complete at the end of each class but its not hard. He does curve the tests a little which is nice.

Had him for 2 semesters and he's not as bad as he seems if you try. However his tests are written HORRIBLY to the point it wasn't always worth studying. He reads off the slides and put me to sleep every other day for a year. Avoid him if possible, but if you have him it's not his fault if you fail.

biology is a hard class no matter who you take it with. He is the ONLY biology professor who curves. if you don't want to apply yourself then don't take college level biology at all. half these negative reviews are from people who didn't try, got a bad grade and are taking it out on the professor. he rly cares and it's sad to see all the slander.

Took him for zoology and I was not a fan. He makes you do in-class worksheets as attendance, which isn't too bad but the tests are hard. He does provide extra credit though. Claims he wants you to succeed, but each test is super hard. Get ready to memorize 80 different species of animals per test.
This professor RUINED MY LIFE. How am I supposed to be a doctor now??? This man is definitely online savvy.

he doesnt even deserve to be on rate my professor, this guys barley a professor.  He calls him self "doctor" but ive eaten so many apples and this guy wont stop talking.  He doesnt even deserve a 1 on this rating. Worst teacher of all time

Dr. Wills' tests are not written very clearly. The wording of them can be very confusing. However sometimes he gives an obvious throwaway answer. His lectures are extremely boring and he gives little to no context about the material. You HAVE to watch the videos and do the readings before class. He is nice but not a very effective professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Worst professor, he just reads off of the slides and his tests do not match what he teaches. Then he gets mad when people dont get good scores and he blames it on them not paying attention.
Terrible. The only plus is that he curved the grades at the end of the semester. And he may have worn a Dwight costume on halloween.

Dr. Wills tests did not match what he went over in class, there was no practice or review sessions, and the test questions were very confusing. He wouldn't let me reschedule my final when I had the flu, the only positive is that he gives heavy curves.

His class really wasn't that bad these reviews are extremely misleading. All the bio 1105 courses are structured the exact same from every professor. That being said no matter what professor you get you are going to have a study a lot. he literally gave 10 extra points on our final for completing the spot survey like thats insane. No other prof did

He just seemed to not care about his students and blamed us for our lack of understanding when the reality is he sucks as a professor. It does not matter how much you study because the test are unreasonably hard. Unlike other biology professors, he does not offer review sessions, or have practice tests so you're really on your own so good luck!

This class was a nightmare. He mumbles so bad during lectures what he's saying is barely understood half of the time. The tests are so hard and heavily weighted, no amount of studying or all nighters can help prepare you.

I was so sad to see this rating. It is evident that he cares about his students and wants us all to succeed. Many of my peers did not like the class structure but it was the same across the entire course, not just for him. I personally loved him and thought he was super sweet. He also curves like CRAZY and NONE of the other BIO1105 teachers do.

I won't lie, this class was extremely difficult, but I can tell that Dr. Wills cares about his students. Unlike the other professors, he curves the tests by over 10 points. If you don't master the material, you will definitely struggle on application questions. However, if you put in a lot of effort and time, it isn't impossible to end with an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I dont agree with all the other comments. Dr. Wills was a great teacher, and he was kind and loving and wanted us students to do their very best. The tests were hard; however, we are not going to get spoon-fed all through college. He prepared me for the future, especially because I am on a pre-med path. He also curved, which other teachers didn't.

He is a nice person, and he cares about his students, but his tests are almost impossible. I don't know a single person that passes them. Even with the curve, so many people still fail. There are 4 tests throughout the semester, and that's basically your entire grade. Everything else weighs like barely any percent and doesn't even matter.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I would say that his exams are necessarily difficult, and very very very specific. Be prepared to study for hours and still get pretty bad grades. You will probably rely heavily on curves to pass his class. The UTAs generally have to reteach content to us.

This professor makes BIOL 1105 feel a lot harder than it should. Not only does he mostly just read off the slides, but the in-class assignments and iClickers sometimes feel a lot harder than they should with many application-based questions. Even with studying, I struggle a lot in this class, as the exams are difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: his tests are way harder than anyone else's, people put in like 20 hours studying and still get bad grades. most tests have like a 10 point curve and many people still fail.
dont take him. Spent hours of my life studying just for him to give the most complicated intense questions on the test.

I think that rate my professor should include more information because Dr. Willis is a nice person who wants to see his students succeed. However, the exams are extremely difficult and conceptual, and only a true microbiologist/evolutionary biologist would know the answer to them. I failed every single test taken this year. Ty curve for saving me
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: nice guy, cool halloween costume! But wouldn't recommend the class.

The UTA's don't even seem to like him, they have told students that his wording for exams has misspellings and is overly complicated that they go in and tear them apart. His class averages have the worst out of all the other professor's classes. He also does not provide any study material for exams Other professors hold Zoom review sessions, etc.

Although he is a pretty nice guy, he is a horrible lecturer. You learn everything yourself in the pre-lecture videos because in class he briefly skims over not even half the material that winds up being on the exams. I have spent hours prepping for the exams just to get a C, with big curves that he adds to make the average not as low.
Hard Exams

Mostly read directly off the slides. Exams were barely anything we learned in class. He provided barely any test review. If you went to exam review, he was doing something else and if you asked why you got a question wrong, he didn't explain it well. He always asked the class why his students performed so poorly and it was primarily because of him.
His tests are unnecessarily hard, his lectures are unhelpful, I should have chose the 8am.

Unfortunately, he is a nice person but not a great professor. His tests are complicated for no reason and it always seems like multiple answers are right. I understand being tough so students learn better, but he is mostly unhelpful and does not lecture well. I am passing the class, but I have to put an abhorrent amount of time into studying.

He is perhaps a nice person, though the test making could definitely use some work. The only reason why I succeeded in this course without studying 20 hours per week for his class is because I took IB bio HL in highschool. His tests could genuinely use some work to improve.

He is genuinely a very bad teacher. Expect to do at least 2 hours of prep before every class to understand what he's talking about as he gives little to zero context on most topics.  The time spent in class is borderline useless despite being mandatory for the in-class activity. The large majority of people I talk to are in the 60's and 70's.
CS 3754- He is a really nice guy who is extremely responsive and helpful to any questions. Lectures can be a little fast sometimes but if you ask questions he gives good explanations

Systems is an incredibly hard class--prepare for 20+ hours of coding/studying per week if you want an A. However, Prof Back does a great job teaching the class in a manner which makes you (1) learn the material well and (2) learn to vibecode well. The 20+ hours weekly was hard, but I was learning every second and would do it again.

This professor is just horrible at lecturing. He reads off of power point slides and even when he is doing something active, he is flying through a linux terminal typing at 100 wpm and you can barely follow along. You basically just have to sit there and stare at what he's doing but you can't learn well  "absorbing" information with you eyes.

Dr.Back is one of the smartest professors I have seen at VT. He is super active on the class website and help channel. He is not paid to help us after class hours, but I can see he wants us to learn and understand the material of the system, which I believe is super useful. As a student, I have gained a lot of knowledge by taking this class.

Though he can sometimes come off as stern, Dr. Back is one of the smartest and hardest-working professors I've ever met. He is extremely active on the class help forums, and the live demos he sprinkles into his lectures are enchanting displays of pure skill. (Ever wanted to watch an rlogin node get overloaded?)
Very snarky. Will find you a discussion thread for a question instead of answering a yes or no. Most outdated and irrelevant course material that is made unnecessarily hard for no reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Dr. Back is very knowledgeable about computer systems, so as someone who finds this topic interesting, I really enjoyed his class. He is always willing to answer questions and his lectures are clear.

Projects are big and you *must* start early or you *will fail the class* (this goes for all professors that teach computer systems).

Super knowledgeable and engaging lecturer. Has the same general sarcastic/sassy CS professor attitude which can come off as condescending for some. Super active in class forums and discord. Has a bit of an accent but you'll get used to it pretty quickly. Class is very front loaded workload wise so lock in early and make sure to utilize the TAs!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor is a little bit smarter than the other professors in the CS department but unfortunately his personality is horrible. He's ego is through the roof and he hates looking at other views. He is the reason this class is so impractical.

I took Williams for Systems but I'm going to rate Back as the class assignments are the same among all professors. Definitely the hardest CS class here but the most useful I've taken. Projects and exercises are hard but if you go to the TAs, they will help. You will struggle (cush/threadpool is a pain) but try to work as much as possible.

Grades are returned extremely slowly. Classes end next week and I have no idea if I'm passing or failing. He has decent lectures but they don't relate very clearly to the projects and exercises, which take up most of your time. You'll learn more from the TAs than from him. He is on Discord pretty much all the time but don't ask a stupid question.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Back is very knowledgeable about his topic; often explains complex topics in, well, a complicated manner. He is good at dumbing stuff down if you ask him one-on-one. Very respectful guy, would take his class again. Systems is difficult so make sure you have a good partner for your projects, and go to office hours often! There's no shame to it :)

The issue isn't the professor, it's the class. Computer Systems is definitely one the hardest classes a CS major will ever take. The material isn't that difficult to understand, it's just the homework (exercises and projects) are just so much work. Just start early on everything and you're good. Dr. Back is a good prof and he posts lecture videos

Dr. Back is really knowledgeable and helpful. He designs almost all of the course material, so he is insanely familiar with the topics. Whenever I check his discord, he seems to be online like 20 hours of the day... does he ever go to sleep?

Most students get good grades in this class. Just keep in mind that C API sucks, so assignments take awhile

He makes fun of students when they ask questions he thinks are dumb. He does this on public forums which is humiliating. He also creates his own disorganized and badly designed website rather than using Canvas. He is hard to follow in lectures and expects us to learn everything on our own. Lecture notes are useless for projects/homework.
based prof
Why a 6 credit course is only worth 3 credit? Terrible schedule for the course. Lecture is out of date, material is also old.
Too difficult
Great and knowledgable professor.
Excellent professor
Excellent professor and very helpful.

I had Dr. Back several years ago, and I don't feel his overall quality rating here is fair. Yes, the course is difficult, but operating systems are difficult. He was *very* accesible and helpful. People might be turned off by his blunt personality, but if you ask him any question, he will answer it calmly and patiently -- and correctly.

Back is incredibly arrogant and mean spirited and his lecturing skills are non-existent. His courses are basically impossible and at the end you feel like you know less than you did when you started the course. The only positive things about Back is that he is insanely knowledgeable and easily accessible.
Great Professor!  Very helpful!

3204 is the notorious class for the CS dept at VT.  Back does a good job of presenting the material in the form of slides. Going to class is essentially pointless tho, as he's incomprehensible as a speaker. The combination of his accent and very low volume make him difficult to hear.  He really knows his material, and is always available to help.
No Comments
Lectures were not helpful for the exams, take Saluga because she writes them now. He goes on tangents during lecture so get ready to teach yourself everything from the textbook

Berg is a great; he tells you what to do to succeed. The textbook helps a lot; you can get it online you don't need to pay for it. Definitely get a model set, it helps a lot. Finally go to office hours for him or a TA, you can go to other professor's office hours as well. He drops the 2 lowest problem sets and test if you do better on the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Berg is an amazing professor. The first class Dr. Berg explicitly outlines the difficulty of the class. So while orgo is a difficult subject, he acknowledges it and outlines what you need to do to be successful in the class. Going to TA office hours after class and getting 100 on the homework will help your grade.

does not respond to emails, TAs grade homework very harshly, and he is a bad lecturer. did not explain concepts and thought it was funny to joke about everyone failing. plus two EC on every test though if you filled out a survey, and a +3 curve on every test as well

Berg was amazing and very much one of my favorites, you do need to be prepared to read and study often to do well but once you get a schedule going it gets easier. Berg is hilarious and so personable to be around and get help on questions with. I would take his class again in a heartbeat.

He was a great professor. Ochem I exams are common time, so he writes half of the exams and Dr. Saluga writes the other half. You have to read the textbook and do the practice problems to succeed in this class, as his lectures are supplementary to the textbook. You will get out of this class what you put into it.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I LOVE DR BERG!! I wish he taught every chem class :) He puts extra credit on tests & he offered us a retake on one of the exams. His lectures are so easy to understand & he is super kind and helpful if you have any questions. BEST prof

Very funny but also great at explaining the material and gives lots of in class examples that he works through. It does take a lot of self studying outside of class with the textbook problems, but he tells you what to practice and gives a lot of helpful study material for the tests. I will be taking him for my second semester of ochem as well!

Clearly knows his stuff and delivered the material in a way that was funny and interesting. Has all of his lecture videos posted on Canvas and plenty of practice exams available that look just like the actual tests.

Dr. Berg was a pretty good professor. His TAs are amazing, but I honestly felt I was learning the material from them rather than him. In my opinion, he saw his lectures as a supplementary resource. Definitely read the textbook or watch his recorded lectures from COVID in addition to going to class. His TA review sessions were also super helpful.

This class requires a lot of time but it is possible to get good grades. PLEASE read the textbook you never really know what is going to be on exams so just try to base your studying off of the textbook. Berg is so nice and approachable and he will definitely help you if you ask for it. Great TA system too. Homework's are a grade booster.
Great professor, good office hours. Class is daunting but doable.
Amazing professor really cares about the material and his students. Class is very hard but manageable if you put in the work.

Explains basic concepts as if you already know ochem and then puts the most complex questions ever in exams that sometimes he can't even answer. if you go ask him something he treats you like you are stupid and explains like if your question is very obvious. he has a great practice test system but he loves to make his tests extremely difficult.

Dr. Berg is the best option for organic chemistry. There are roughly 6-7 practice tests per test which reflect what you will score on real tests. There are extra credit questions on every test and will replace lowest test score with final if you score better. The textbook will be your best friend to succeed in this class. The TAs are very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Easy exams, plenty of practice exams (5-6 per exam) and extra resources. Very accessible, TAs are helpful. Drops one homework and provides extra credit at the end of the semester.
Best ochem professor! So many reasources and an excellent TA system. Tests are very fair and extra credit opportunities provided.
Great teacher but O chem is a hard subject, he provides plenty of resources for you to get a good grade.

I had Dr. Berg for O-Chem and I wouldn't recommend anybody else. He is very funny and uses a fun, memorable teaching style. For the 1st semester he gave us 3 tests and 1 final (final grade replaces lowest test grade) and 10 homework assignments that added to 15 % of the grade. The tests were hard but doable and he gives old tests for practice.

ochem is hard BUT im glad i had him to teach it! concepts are difficult but he is engaging during class, i enjoyed going. TAs v helpful and a lot of office hours offered. he gives multiple practice exams, has a long review session offered hosted by TAs, and is very approachable. utilize resources! no mc on tests, but given partial credit
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing professor overall. Office hours offered every day with around 8 TAs. Offers multiple (typically 5+) practice exams that are very similar to the actual test. Ochem is difficult, but manageable if you go to office hours when you have questions, do the practice exams, and make sure you are actually understanding the content.

Dr. Berg is the ochem professor everyone wishes they had. He goes over material very well in class and truly wants his students to succeed. He has a TA room with TAs that can help you at any time of day. This was still my hardest class; I studied as much for this one class as the rest of my classes combined. Lots of practice tests were a huge help.

Dr. Berg is by far my favorite professor here! He is passionate about chemistry and tries to make it as fun as possible. He has a great TA system and plenty of resources to help you succeed. Tests are worth a lot so practice as much as possible and come to class. He likes to use the scare tactic to make you study.

Awesome professor! He made learning Org at 8am as interesting and fun as you can make it for an early, difficult class. The class itself is very test heavy, with only a small portion of your grade being problem sets. He offers lots of help outside of class, and has a very strong TA system. Be prepared for lots of studying!

I took Chem 2535 with Dr. Berg this summer and wouldn't have wanted any other professor for the course. He explains the concepts very clearly and gave great analogies. He really wants his students to do well in the course. The course is difficult so studying and putting in the work is a must, but overall he is a really good teacher.

Organic chemistry is just hard, so this class is hard unless you have many hours a week dedicated to studying. He makes lectures fun and is always willing to help students with homework. TA's are also usually very accessible.

Very strong TA system (10+ with all their own office hours) for immense amounts of help outside of class. Don't believe the "Bump is better for Med School", Berg is a great teacher and will make you like the content more on your own. Tests are almost the only thing graded for the semester, multiple days of studying and effort will be necessary.

Lectures were kind of all over the place so I would look at past tests and review content from there. The tests are very similar to the practice tests and there are so many resources he provides for students to get extra help.

Dr. Berg is definitely the way to go. It's still ochem so you're going to have to put in the work, but he holds regular office hours and will answer questions. Good sense of humor, free response tests with partial credit.

A great professor for a difficult class. He made the lectures fun and always answered any questions during them. Tests could be difficult, but mostly just because it's organic chemistry. Try to not get behind in this class, it is very hard to catch back up!

Berg is the best Ochem Professor here at VT. He lectures really well and can be funny. His exams are fair, although sometimes difficult. If you do the practice exams and go over your notes you take in class, you will succeed. You must go to class to understand the material. Very exam heavy class with 90% of your grade being exams.
I love Berg but he is extremely fast and all over the place. He is hard to keep up with, BUT he has the best test prep around so I will stand by this man.

Many people told me Berg's class was easier. I would say the material learned is less intensive but the tests seem just as hard and so if you aren't spending a lot of time outside of class teaching yourself, you will not do well. I received an A in Bump's class but had to work hard for it. That same work hasn't paid off yet for Berg's class...
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Berg is an excellent professor if you are willing to put in the work and study. Accessible outside of class (office hours 5 days a week), answers questions before and after class, and stops class to answer questions if you raise your hand. Most important things to do are review heavily, go to office hours, and ask questions when you're confused

Dr Berg is super sweet and he wants his students to pass. Hes very patient with his students and is willing to help them out. He can get distracted very easily tho and will go on random lectures or talk about things not o chem related but hes funny and overall would recommend him! If you study the practice test you should be fine for the tests!

Professor Berg is a caring and genuine guy. He likes to make class as fun as possible but can get very distracted and his lectures can become confusing. His tests are very heavy but if you follow practice exams then you'll know what to expect. He has been very understanding and wants all of his students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: great professor, if you do the practice test and go to office hours you should do well in the class.!

I had Berg for CHEM 2535 and CHEM 2536, and got As both semesters. Make sure you know how to do every single question on the practice tests and problem sets. Go to office hours if you have questions and do NOT wait until the night before an exam to start studying. Nothing is curved but a 1% boost or an additional problem set may be dropped.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had him for both CHEM 2535 and CHEM 2536. I was scared going into Organic Chemistry but as long as you do his practice tests and go to office hours to ask about what you don't understand, you'll do fine. I ended up getting an A in both semesters.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Does a great job of making a difficult subject easy and fun to understand - tests are difficult but doable, and he posts lots of practice exams that help out. That being said, it's still organic chemistry at 8 in the morning. I found that if I missed a class, I often didn't do that well on that part of the test. Go to class, and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took Survey of O-Chem. Not bad overall. He gets easily distracted during lectures and there will be days you don't learn anything or days where you get through an entire chapter. No in-between. Easily approachable outside of class. You have to go to class to get the notes because he doesn't post any. Posts old tests for practice and review sheets.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I had Berg for survey of O chem and he was probably the best teacher I've had so far here. He is enthusiastic even though the class was only held at 8am and was really good about explaining topics thoroughly. Also, his tests are just like the homework he gives, so if you can do those, you'll do fine. I would highly recommend taking his class.

reviews.comment: For his chem 1035 class: Expects you to come in with prior chemistry experience which shouldn't be necessary for a Gen Chem class.  Goes through lectures way to fast and does not elaborate enough on certain topics.  Often gives examples only once and then moves on...

His tests weren't terrible, but they weren't easy- all short answer. He offered a lot of help sessions and let us turn in our homework then. Not much extra credit. HW can be confusing. Doesn't explain all of the time- leaves thought in middle of sentence and moves on. NICE and probably the easiest O. Chem  professor, but still not EASY.

he rambles a bit in class and goes off on random things but if you read the book and actually try the homework he will be willing to help you in office hours. use all of his extra worksheets and stuff he puts online. he also provides extra credit opportunities

Great Teacher. Truly willing to take the time to help you understand beyond just class time. If you are willing to show the effort for his class - he will go above and beyond to provide help. Overall great teacher!
he is not a good teacher like everyone says, he expects you to do a lot on your own and know everything on your own...take lizzar or bump 1st semester and kingston 2nd semester...DO NOT TAKE BERG

hes an okay teacher, but i would suggest BUMP if you can switch in, i had both each semester, and i liked Bump a lot better, a lot of people like berg but hes not very helpful and bump will work with you a lot if you go to review sessions.....take Bump!!

Dr Berg is the most unhelpful teacher I have ever had.I have stood outside of his office multiple times waiting for him to be there for "office hours" and he is never there.He will never answer any emails and does not try to work with the student unless you are smart and understand ochem.he is very bias on grading and isn't consistent. TAKE BUMP

Berg was the most unhelpful teacher when it comes to chem. He rambles a lot in class so you really don't get anything out of the lecture. He expects a lot out of you on the tests I would suggest Bump.
Great, awesome teacher! However, if you have to take the second part of Organic Chemistry you will not be prepared (think about MCATS too). Switch to another teacher if this is the case.

Dr. Berg is the best organic chemistry professor at VT. He makes the material easy to understand and he doesn't waste time teaching BS that you don't need to know. His tests are almost exactly the same as the practice tests he gives you study, just with different compounds. Take him if you can get a seat!

He's an awesome prof. makes organic chemistry easy to learn, understand, and to keep up. Of course it always helps to actually study and do the self study problems. Go to class, its really informative and interesting. and just do the work and you'll have no problem. I highly recommend him, he's the best.

Dr. Berg is one of my favorite professors I've had at VT.  Was worried about Drug Chemistry, but he made the class great to go to everyday and didn't expect you to know EVERYTHING by the time you were done.  Hilarious, straightforward, and a fantastic professor all around.

dr. berg goes over and beyond what he is expected to do as a teacher.  if you have bad test anxiety like i do he is more then willing to let you take his tests in his office instead of in the 200 person lecture.  he is a funny guy most of the time but he gets off track easily.  homework is really easy and helps a lot.
love this guy.  he is very clear and relates to students.  made is feel like a class of 20 instead of 200.  his tests were easy and the homework helps a lot!

Really good professor, kept lectures interesting. Had some bad jokes to tell, but whatever he's a really cool guy. His tests aren't too bad, he offers help sessions and office hours. If you get him, go to every study sessions they help soooo much.
Funny guy, really nice. The notes are slightly disorganized.  His tests are hard, but he does offer extra credit.

I took Rapid Prototyping (4644/5644) and it was pretty frustrating. The grading was insanely unforgiving since points were take off for things that weren't on the rubric. If you're not religious, pick one and start praying.

Get the calculator he recommends, go to class, and put in some time and effort and you'll pass. I'm not a numbers guy by any means and did just fine, it's not as bad as everyone says

he can be helpful if you know what to ask, dont be afraid to ask. the only ppl doing bad are the ones cheating on hw, not studying, and not going to class. study what he tells you to study and you'll do fine, no need to read txtbook. Ok he's not that bad, just go to the lectures because he does mean it when he kicks ppl out for using their phones (he's a crashout ngl). just no....never again

take someone else

If you go to class and study hard, it is not difficult to do well in the class. Exams take a lot of study time but it is nothing unattainable. actually gets nothing done during lecture, he talks the whole time about nothing related to what we are learning. do not go to him for help because he will not help you.
i rather be in a 10 year situationship than be in a room with this man again. Find another teacher.
He doesn't care

I took this class online. Lectures were 4 days a week and early at 9 however Professor Hart was an amazing professor. He had fun stories to teach us about his career in finance which was very insightful. Class was easy to follow.

He's fine. I put little effort into this course except the quizzes and the day before each exam and ended up with an acceptable grade. Oh my god I don't know how he still has his job. Take this class with literally ANY OTHER prof

TAKE A DIFFERENT PROFESSOR PLEASE. He is extremely rude to students and is completely inaccessible out of class. Even trying to talk to him or ask a question during class he acts as if he does not want to be there.

Took his Intro to Finance course and this material was not that difficult. Basic TVM, stock and bond calculations and some other minor things. However, Brian found a way to take a 20-30 minute lecture per day on material into an hour and fifteen minutes, often times branching off into irrelevant topics. His communication for exams was also so poor.

I have mixed feelings about Hart. I ended with an A-, but only by teaching myself most of the material. Exams sometimes covered content not taught in class, and notes aren't posted, so attendance is basically required. If you're willing to self-study a lot, it's manageable, but if another professor is available, take them immediately.

If this subject comes naturally you will do fine. However feedback is shit, provided online materials suck, not nearly enough HW/practice, vague exam questions, unfriendly attitude. I'm ngl most of these reviews are from people who aren't very smart or won't study. Worst prof ive ever had. only class ive had to retake
convinced the only good reviews are ones he wrote himself

Professor Hart is by far the worst prof ive EVER had. The material itself isn't that challenging, but he's incapable of teaching and is overall not a nice person. Do not listen to the other reviews saying he's not that bad. I attended every single class, took detailed notes, and reached out to him and still struggled greatly. He doesn't provide notes, doesn't respond to emails, and his lectures are nearly impossible to follow because he expects everyone to already know what he's talking about.

I understand why people hate & love this professor. Unsure about another, but 3104 is easy. As others said, the class ends early and he is very straightforward for what will be on the exam. Kinda talk too fast but just ask for what you need, and he'll be suppportive as students need. But I heard he's evil for another class, so good luck for that.

I found it very difficult to learn anything in this class. He just put up a couple numbers and a timeline everyday with little to no explanation and acted like we understood what he was talking about.

IF YOU DO NOT GO TO CLASS YOU WILL FAIL. The class was not hard by any means. He does a great job explaining the concepts, but does not use slideshows. This means the only way to get the information from class is to go to the lecture and take notes based on what he says. If you go to class, you will love the guy. If you don't, you will hate him.

Don't let these reviews scare you. He always ended class early and gets straight to the point. I will say he is much nicer to the girls then the guys. Overall, it's so doable, just study and ask questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: People are SO dramatic. This class wasn't hard as long as you actually go to class. His 2nd exam was lowkey hell but you get all the homework points which makes up for it. He's not the most kind and he's anal about using your phone, so just turn it off for an hour. If you're required to take this class, just bite the bullet and do it, you'll live.
He's horrible. Avoid.

Worst professor, not only because of his teaching but his character. He constantly makes rude comments at students. Threatens to leave class if students take a picture of a problem on the board to follow along with (that he is going to post later). After 2 weeks, no powerpoints to follow along with, just problems written in chicken scratch.
Nothing will ever prepare you for how indescribably impossible this class is
If you don't have a religion pick one and start praying. Hoped BT transit would hit me on my walk to class every day. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!!!!!!!!!

Professor Hart was extremely disrespectful to students during class, threatening to kick multiple people out of class for no reason. He would stop class for 5 minutes because someone looked at their phone, and then get upset with the class because we weren't on track.
He shouldn't be allowed to teach

For everyone saying that the people who did bad did not pay attention, you can still show up and he rushes through the problem set and rambles on about the most random things. I did well above the average on the first exam but however, the second exam is where I got completely cooked. It is known for most people to fail it. He also is not friendly

I took 3104 with this professor and didn't find it very difficult compared to other classes at this level. Hart is somewhat strict but is a perfectly good teacher and is very knowledgeable about the course material. Not much homework at all and if you attend class you should have no problem getting an A in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is a really tough class and if you aren't prepared to put in the work you will fail, but professor hart keeps his lectures engaging and always lets us go early.

Only class I have had to withdraw from. He is very unhelpful and a lot of what he was teaching was unnecessarily complicated and complex—I would do the book review and that would be easy but his lecture examples would be difficult and he would just tell you the answers without working through them

Please take classes with literally any other professor. His tests are insanely hard and he gives you no material to study. Attendance wasn't mandatory and he rushes through practice problems in class. Never responds to emails and isn't willing to help.

I attend every class and reach out to TA's to help but even they dont know what is going in class. Most of the time he just rambles and doesn't actually teach. He can be short with students when they ask questions. His test reviews are not helpful at all and this whole time it has just been me trying to understand what will be on the exam.
very bad teaching

This professor shows little to no concern for students' learning or success. He isn't approachable, doesn't take the time to explain concepts clearly, and lacks patience when students struggle. There's no sense of support, understanding, or effort to help you improve. He's also very rude. Overall, not a positive learning experience.

Grow up. So many professors here are just teaching for the check. Hart wants his students to get better and succeed in life. Learn how to fail. You will fail an exam in his class, if you don't, have fun on Wall Street. When you fail, maybe grow a pair and study for the next 2 exams. If you put the time in, he will help you in the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I agree with the people that say to grow up if you didn't like Professor Hart. Yes the exams are hard yes you will the first one if you don't prepare like crazy. People forget this is supposed to be the hardest finance class. He geniunely cares about his students and will help you out in the end. I promise you you'll be fine if you put the work in.

Brian Hart is by far one of the worst professors I have ever had at Virginia Tech. I showed up to every class, did all the homework, along with studying with what little information he would give. The lectures gave little information and the practice problems were like nothing on the exams, my best advice is to not take him or study the connect.

I enjoyed Hart, that being said, lots of people in the class or who had him in the previous class hated him. If you come to class regularly, ask questions, and don't go on your phone, he will like you. He is very experienced in the subject matter and ties it back to current events. My only issue was that he tended to rush through problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is harder than it needs to be. He doesn't explains things thoroughly. You'll pass if you study. Didn't give us a study guide until the final. Didn't get to see our final grades. Gave us a grade calculator on excel and ended up not even being the correct final grade. Didn't realize I wasn't going to pass till I saw my final grade on hokiespa..

He's fine. Just use the connect assignments to study for the exams. Go to class to learn how to do different problems, he ended like 15 minutes early every time. He definitely had this weird change in attitude around the end of the semester. I recommend getting the calculator because it made things way easier once you understand how to use it.

Prof Hart has a lot of bad reviews, mostly written by objectively poor students who want easy A's. This class is extremely hard… if you skip a lot and don't try on the HW. However, if you're a good student, it's an easy A.The phone rule is annoying but he is the professor and has every right to set his own rules. Lectures do wander sometimes.

Do not take him.  Exam one wasn't that bad, exam 2 was terrible and he doesn't curve,  the final was the only time he actually provided stuff to study. Don't bother emailing him cause he won't answer, TAs also occasionally don't answer. HW is easy and basically the only way you will learn the material because his in person classes have no benefit.

Started off thinking he was a tough teacher but overall seemed like he knew his stuff so I would learn something. Couldn't have been more wrong. Doesn't post lecture notes and makes his lecture a jumbled mess of tangents relating to a single question. Gave us “gifts” for finals. Literally just wrong answer keys to textbook questions. Hes cooked

Brian Hart screwed me over at the beginning of the year by saying “you can learn this entire class through algebra or through BA2 Calculator shortcuts” then put. questions on the exam that are mathematically impossible to answer using algebra without warning. 

He'll doesn't care enough to respond to emails so don't even try. He's simply terrible.

Imo, i think the criticism is unwarranted. I get he comes off hard-nosed and goes off into tangents during his lectures. Lowkey we just go over like 2-4 practice problems for the lectures and class usually ends in like 40 minutes. He gives a formula sheet every exam and ik other professors don't. Also material itself is not that bad to learn urself

In my opinion he really wasn't that bad. Homework's and quizzes were super easy and took like 30 minutes max. First exam and final were easy. Second exam was bad and I wish he curved it because it really messed up my grade. He only provided study resources for the final which I wish he did for each exam. Just practice and you'll be fine.

Became more rude towards students as every week in the semester passed. Besides exam 2 the exams weren't that bad if you just study the homeworks, but his lectures don't really help at all. Questions showed up on exams that were never shown in class.

Hart is an okay professor. His in-class lectures are good, but most of what he does usually isn't on the exams. Study the summary questions in the Textbook. He doesn't know what is on the homework or quizzes. If you have a question, ask the TAs. He doesn't make current grades available, so you cannot see them throughout the whole semester.

The only reason that I added hilarious for his tag is because of how much of a joke this guy is. His first test was alright, and what would have been expected for most people. However, the second test hit everyone like a train. The test average was a 56-60 and he didn't curve it at all. This on its own completely screwed everyone over.
hes lowk mean asl do not take this class if you care about your gpa, idk if sum happened in his personal life but the class gpa is not tuff anymore
This man needs to crawl back into his hole if he's going to treat his students like dirt.

Worst experience I've had at VT. Majority of classes started off with rants. He did not seem interested in student success. Tried to convience students on the first day of class to write good reviews on here. Blamed the bad reviews on a more difficult finance class, but clearly the experiences are relatable. Take with someone else!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I wanted to write a good review about Mr. Hart because he asked us to write better reviews, genuinely to start off, but he only proved why his bad ones exist. He was rude when asked questions and relied only on the textbook, using different formulas from it when teaching. The class wasn't hard, he just made it that way. Disappointing and unhelpful.

Not sure why he was the only professor available for the spring semester. He rants during class and crashes out on students for pointless reasons. Learned nothing from lectures and taught myself the material. Take with friends so you don't lose your mind.

It was genuinely laughable at how bad of a professor he is. He gets mad when a student is confused about something and blames all the problems he has on either his students or his TAs. He also refuses to curve even if average scores were low or even give extra credit. If you have the option, do not take him, he doesn't deserve to be a professor.

Doesn't really want people to learn in my opinion. Won't allow you to look at your exams to study (that's literally your job as a teacher?) 

Material is easy, but learn it on your own and don't waste your time going to his class.
Believe the other reviews VT should fire him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I've had at VT. A 65% test average with no curve and some questions we never learned is pretty ridiculous for an intro level finance course. If you end up stuck in his class, go to every classes, take notes, and be prepared to teach yourself a lot of the material, best of luck if you're that unlucky. Do not take him....
Believe all the other 1 star reviews, he's exactly as described and horrible as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not recommend. Hart does not post any lecture material on Canvas, lectures are very disorganized, and you don't know your class grade until 3 weeks before the final. 2 exams and a final make up 70% of your overall grade. The exam problems are different from the homework and students have no way to practice beforehand. Nightmare class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I spent more time teaching myself with ChatGPT than learning anything in his lectures. He does not care about his students at all.
Yall know that one scene in Mean Girls when Regina is writing in her burn book? Yeah, that's all I have to say about this professor.
Worst professor I've ever had at VT
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This man needs a job that doesn't involve dealing with people. Him & his TA's wouldn't respond to my emails. Went to every class got 100's on all homework and quizzes but the tests nuked me. Failing class averages no curves.

I read his rate my prof but wanted a class around noon. First class he introduced himself and pulled up his rate my professor saying it's not true to him. IT ABSOLUTELY IS. RUN. He won't respond to emails and allows test averages to be failing no curves. I'm sad he posts our grades with weeks left. He's trying to overcompensate for something.

Little is posted in canvas, not even your grade. His McGraw hill doesn't connect to canvas. Content was easy but he made it harder for no reason. Other professors may give practice problems, test reviews, and other online resources, Hart leaves a lot to be desired. "attendance graded" but he yaps about nonsense for most of the class.

This class should not be as difficult as he makes it. I have come to every single class and taken notes. Studied the homeworks. Majority of the test are problems he does not go over. It is unclear what you should study. I do not recommend this professor. If you can take another professor, I would.

The fact this man got demoted from analytics and is now making the intro class a weed out is very concerning. The fact he's been allowed to teach any class with his level of carelessness is incredibly irresponsible by him and the school. There's no denying his mind is brilliant, but he used his brilliant mind to waste time taking about rants.
I came on here tonight after the second exam to leave a negative review, but clearly people beat me to it.
I'm thousands in debt from student loans, trying to dig myself out of a hole and not retake this class because it's terrible believe me do anything you can do not take Brian Hart.
Whatever you do DONT TAKE THIS CLASS.

Wise man, solid experience, but terrible professor. He never responds to any email about anything, so don't even try.
