You can go to class every time and do every practice problem before the exam, but the exam will stump everyone because he doesn't teach what is on it. He then goes to class ranting nonstop, but will take zero accountability.
Just awful

Professor Hart truly wants his students to succeed and can come off extra but it is for the right purpose. He is genuinely trying to look out for the class and help academically and career wise! He's a great guy and you will learn the most you ever had in his class.

He is a rude "professor" that does not respect his students or create an environment for them to learn. He never responds to emails and changes test dates hours before they were supposed to be taken. Avoid this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hart is clearly a man of experience and is knowledgeable on the subject material, but unfortunately is horrible at actually teaching the subject material. He clearly expects you to know this material before coming into lectures,and gets agitated when asked questions,even lecturing multiple students about this when I had him last semester.

Professor Hart was actually the most knowledgeable and respectful professor I have had at Tech. He tells you exactly what is required from you to pass the class and only lazy students have negative things to say about him. The class itself is a beast and the weed out class for Finance majors at VT. The class is designed to be hard. Do the work!

This professor demonstrated zero concern for the success and wellbeing of his students. Taking his class was like going to war. Every day less and less people showed up, as they either dropped or withdrew from the course.

Professor Hart is a great professor with a lot of experience who happens to teach the first finance course with any difficulty. His rating  is entirely a representation of that. Hart gives the best lectures I've had at Tech and will always use real world examples in class to keep things real. Caring professor that is only hated on by lazy students.
He's a very intelligent and accomplished man, but an effective professor. Be prepared to be humbled if you have him.

Hart is a man of experience and it's evident, however he has the tendency to go off tangent and talk about the market and other aspects of his life. He teaches like he's just reviewing no matter how tough the material is. Overall, he a g, but if you didn't pay attention in 3104, take someone else cuz he's gonna treat u like u work on  Wall Street

Brutal class and a brutal professor. This man talks for minutes on end of random stuff, shows random excel files,  and rants about himself. Its no wonder this professor consistently has some of the lowest GPAs for his analytics sections.

This man is the definition of evil. He is never present when it comes to office hours or emails. He rants about irrelevant stuff rather than whats on the tests. And speaking of tests they are borderline impossible, especially the first TVM Exam. Not saying its impossible this class, but with him it sure is. Make sure your got all your Ws!

Avoid this professor at all costs. Extremely unhelpful.  Refused to respond to emails. The material is hard but he makes it harder. I think his goal is grades that force students to retake the class, because that gives a little man power, and its all subjective, he doesn't provide the actual number grade-just a letter grade with no proof.

After failing FIN3104 last semester under another instructor, Professor Hart has been a breath of fresh air. The material is clearly explained using examples and he's always open to questions. He cares about his students, and you can feel that. He has lots of practice available for points and overall grading is fair.

He makes this class so much more difficult than it actually is. The class content is hard, but doable if you have a professor who sticks to teaching the material. Hart unfortunately does not do that. He goes of topic, gets pissed at everyone, and as a result no one comes to class. His office hours are early in the morning, not very accommodating.

Hart is very temperamental and unapproachable at times. He goes on these random tangents on how hard the class is and how we're not doing well on the tests. Maybe just teach whats on the tests and not get so angry at us? There is no denying that he is an intelligent man, but he is not capable of being a professor.

Professor Hart's class isn't impossible to pass FIN 3134 is a difficult course regardless of who you take it with. Reading is very important to pass this class, Exam 1 is very hard, Exam 2 is the easiest, and the Final is the hardest. He doesn't curve exam scores only curves final grades. Read the textbook well and do the practice problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Do yourself a favor and avoid him for this class. You have a significantly higher chance of failing if you have him instead of literally anyone else.
Had him over the summer and overall thought he was a fine professor. You just have to put in some work so you know what your doing. Because working through this class in 6 weeks is a beast.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a hard guy, but I think its realistic to what he is trying to teach us. You can see that he is passionate about the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The GOAT. Super funny, understanding, and helpful. Interesting lectures where he is happy to answer questions. Sometimes goes on rants but he's entertaining to listen to so it's fine. Gave us extra credit, days where in class we just watched movies, but in the end I really feel I learned a lot and he made the class interesting. Take Prof Hart!

He's a good teacher for 3104. Had him for the summer and thought he taught the class very well within 6 weeks. But you have to show up to class and keep up with the assignments, the class goes by very quick.

Professor Hart is the worst professor I have had to date in Pamplin. For starters, if you ever need to ask him something over email you are almost guaranteed to get no response. Second, on the second exam and the final exam he added an ENTIRE UNIT that was never discussed in class a day before the exams. Project is hard to understand, & TA's grade.

This is the hardest class I have ever taken. There are 2 exams and a final which are extremally hard. The test averages were around a 65%. There is a final project and the directions are very unclear and wordy. Take this class with someone else!!

I missed two weeks due to serious medical concerns and his response was "tough luck" whereas other professors helped me pass their classes. Had to use a "W". Exams are very difficult and he was not too helpful in answering questions after class.

This class is kinda all over the place. Hart makes his TA's do a lot of the work for him so sometimes there is miscommunication when they make HW's and Quizzes. You have to go to class to do well, in my opinion. His exams aren't terrible as long as you pay attention in class and practice the examples.

Was a very tough class with exams being the majority of your grade. Even though attendance is not mandatory, if you don't show up you will likely fail. Textbook back of chapter problems are your best friend for tests. Hart is a super nice guy but expects you to work hard to earn your grade. He prepares you very well for future classes in Finance.

Did not appreciate how a professor was building a retirement fund off of poor students by charging $160 for a subscription model to submit assignments. 
$160 is for a textbook, but he knows and had stated textbooks did not need to be read. 
Advice: Make the most of it by going to class and reading! Doable if you do these and have an interest

Did not appreciate how a professor was building a retirement fund off of poor students by charging $160+ for a subscription. Charging $160 for access to homework "submissions" (with a "supplemental" textbook). 
Of course I am a good student (sarcasm), so I of course read the online textbook and made the most out of the payment. Read and go to class

Took this class over the summer, wasn't super hard and tests were really intuitive. Hart taught the class fine, but nothing exceptional. As long as you attend class and review your notes, and have a handy calculator you will be fine.
Amazing professor. Hard Class. I learned more in this class than any other. Attendance is not taken but highly recommended or you will probably fail.

Not a good teacher. Sent many emails throughout the semester and did not hear back once. Tests are the majority of the grade and the class examples aren't indicative of the questions on the test. He's a nice guy but not a good teacher.

Attendance not mandatory but highly recommended. Class is test heavy. He gives materials to prepare but are sometimes vague. Practice questions from textbook are useful but the test questions often use elements that combine or differ from the practice. Have to study A LOT. As for the professor, he is nice, sometimes a little tough but nothing bad.

I took analytics with Hart sophomore year. He talks about nonsense for about half of class. In his office hours and he was either on his phone for the zoom or wouldn't show up. He is also a tough grader. I really don't think he cares about his student's success.
He talks a lot about nothing. Do not recommend. Bradley Paye is way better.
Good professor, but has hard exams. Have to go to class and pay attention. Have to do tons of practice problems to prepare for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hart was excellent! This was certainly an introductory class as the material we covered was far from advance; however, he is very knowledgeable when it comes to Finance and he knows what he is talking about. As long as you showed up to class and paid attention it was a fairly simple course. (I did take this class over the summer online).

I took Professor Hart's Introduction to Finance class in the Summer for a 6 week period. Professor Hart was an outstanding professor! Hart has a ton of knowledge in the curriculum and the finance world. He is also extremely funny and his classes very rarely went over 45 minutes long. I highly suggest him for this course!

This is a really tough class no matter which professor you have. With that being said, I think Professor Hart is a solid choice. Make sure you attend class and take notes. Do the practice problems multiple times and read the textbook. He's tough to reach outside of class so make sure you ask questions during class. Work hard and you should be ok.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Please note that I took Hart for Intro to Fin, not his harder class: Hart was a super easy professor. Go to class bc he has attendance quizzes and the class rarely ever lasts over 45 min. He prepares you well for exams and there isn't any hw. He is by far the easiest professor for intro to fin while still teaching you what you need to know.

He knows it is a class that just has to be passed and would rather us learn the information then throw useless stuff at us. Very carefree and easy to learn from. All exam questions straight from practice set and always lets you out super early. Easily the best and easiest FIN3104 professor.

Brian Hart is the worst teacher I have ever had at Virginia Tech. Your grade is made up of 3 tests and 1 project. He doesn't respond to ANY emails you send and his communication sucks. His tests are very hard and some of the test is stuff he didn't teach. Tells class test will be graded in a couple of days but takes weeks. Goes off on tangents.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The entire class is graded on exams, except for a single quiz and 2 projects. 80% of your grade is exams, and they are difficult. He is a knowledgeable man, but he is NOT a good teacher. He tends to ramble, and does a poor job explaining concepts. The book will be better for you than him. If you can take the class with someone else, do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He can be your best friend or your worst enemy. If you show up outside of class and do the problems, read the book, and ask questions, you will be okay. If you do not do one of these things, you will probably not have a good fate. One thing I would say is he was quite hard to reach, but it was COVID, so I will give him the benefit of the doubt.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He's a really nice guy and loves his students. To do good: go to every class, do every problem in the book(related to the lecture), and the problems on the handouts. Don't do every problem in the hw, a lot of them you can skip. You can skip reading chapters too, you go over everything you need in class. If you don't put work in, you won't do good.

Professor Hart is one of the most knowledgeable professors I've ever had at Virginia Tech. He is a real gem at Pamplin. He explains concepts well in the classroom, and cares for his students. Beware however, his tests are EXTREMELY challenging. If you want to learn Finance, this is the class to take, you'll just have to really work for an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Really cares about her students. Amazing.
She is a great professor and clearly cares about her students. Most days class ends early and she is still available to help. 10/10 would recommend.

She really cares about her students. So many practice problems on canvas. The tests are very similar to the graded quizzes for each chapter. She does a form for attendance, but it isn't mandatory. Only if you come to her not knowing anything after not ever coming to class will she be a bit hesitant to help you. I would for sure take her again.
take with someone else

Great professor. She has a wonderful way of teaching lessons and provides many resources on her canvas like online videos and practice problems/test to help learn the material. She is easy to contact and very understanding. Her class is very doable if you pay attention and do the work. I wish she taught 2116!

An amazing professor with very engaging lectures. Her class was very test heavy but attendance is not required. She is very understanding and wants her students to do well and is happy to help with the content if needed.

Super nice understanding and helpful. Lots of ways to get help if needed and cares about her students and there wellbeing. Gives lots of tools to help with studying and outlines what will be on the test making it easy to learn what is needed. 100% recommend taking her if you need to take accounting!!
best professor every, I learned so much. Highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is a great professor who goes out of her way to make sure you understand the material. She's always willing to answer questions and while attendance isn't mandatory, it's still helpful to go to class. Exams are not difficult if you go to class and do the practice problems.

She is one of my favorite professors I have had at Tech!!! She is sooo experienced in accounting and loves what she is teaching about. She is very smart, but takes a lot of time to teach things in a way students understand. We always got out of class early. She is a kind person and cares about her students. Extra credit available!!!

I had one of Professor Brassine's Grad TA's and she was good. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I do recommend as my TA would give us information as to what would be on exams. The material can be difficult if you don't organize, and look over. Also if you're struggling with the projects visit the TA sessions, as they're SUPER helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had a grad student for class but all sections of 2115 take the exams together. McGraw Hill is where we did in-class problems and the homework/quizzes. Prof Brassine posts videos in modules explaining every topic from every chapter that will be on the exams. I stopped going to class and just watched those:much more straightforward than the grad ta

Very hard class and exams were hard but no matter what professor you have, everybody in this class takes the same exams all at the same time so it doesn't really matter in that aspect. LOVEDDDD her, she was so fun to be in class with and although she is a tough grader and the material is hard, I really liked her. Attendance is not mandatory.

Professor Brassine overall was a fantastic professor. She provided all the necessary resources to be successful in her class and if you just showed up and paid attention it was fairly easy. She also provided a lot of practice problems and videos. If you were still struggling, she was easy to get in touch with for help.

I loved her class! She was super nice and was great at keeping things simple and not overcomplicating her lectures. She's also very clear on what tests will be on, and there's only one homework a week, and one quiz every week. I would love to take her again.

Dr. Brassine taught in a way to make it simpler to comprehend. Her lectures were very informative and included class discussions, in class examples, as well as demo problems that she went over during class time. Homework/Quizzes was straight forward. If you actually study, the exams are not extremely difficult but challenges you to think.

Dr. Brassine is hands down the best lecturer I have ever had. It is extremely formulaic: She uses slides, and very explicitly outlines each concept we will see each class. She'll show an example of how to do it. Then she'll do an example and have us do it with her on our screens. Then, she has the students do it themself. Easy AF if you go to class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Don't take her! Take anybody else.
Extremely test heavy compared to how she taught at ECU last year.
Professor Brassine is a nice person, but not a good professor. The highest grade in my class on one of the tests was a 75% and she did not curve it at all. Clearly she is doing something wrong.

Makes a tough subject bearable. Class is very discussion based which makes everything so much easier to understand. Exams are difficult but if you put in the study hours, you will be okay. Dr. Brassine genuinely cares about all of her students and I hope to have her as a professor again in my time at VT.

Dr Brassine was a fantastic teacher. I got into an accident and had to switch to online half way through the semester and she was phenomenal. She worked with me on due dates, and made sure I was understanding the course material. She is also fantastic with SSD students which is hard to find. She never made you feel stupid for asking questions.

1. As of the week of finals, only 10 out of 20 assignments in the gradebook were graded. 2. Labs take between 5 to8 hours outside of class. 3. Homework and labs are graded with the same criteria as tests (class wide homework average was 80%, lab average was 70%). 4. Class attendance is very low, and I did not learn much from lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: We are engineers

Awful. First day of class he mentions how he hates being forced to teach this class. For our final, the only thing he has mentioned about it online is the time. No study problems, no scope, nothing. Great. Does not care.

Struggled to find value in his lectures. Voice drones on as he clicks through slides haphazardly. Constant theme of this class was that the labs and homework did not feel well thought out. Errors in problems and procedures were frequent and frustrating. Nice enough person, fast paced, pretty tough, draining course. Does curve!

He's a great guy and I like that he's very passionate about the subject. However, I think that the way he teaches (which I've heard is similar to the rest of the ECE dept.) is not my style. He only goes over slides and doesn't write anything down. I'd prefer if he would do problems in class at our pace. i.e. let us solve it and go over it after.

Ok. Here's the thing. Nice guy and all, but the lectures need to change. Typos...EVERYWHERE. And I mean stuff like numbering...For example, he'll number things going like this 5 3 1 2 4. It's funny cant lie but not good in the long run. And then he doesn't really write anything down...has he? This whole semester? Uses a laser pointer lmao

just reads the slides in a way that doesn't make anything easier to understand. midterms were open book open note with emphasis on using matlab and LTspice to make things easier, then says the final is open note but you can't use tablets or laptops (all my notes are on a tablet and i was banking on matlab scripts). told us to print them i guess -_-
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Generally does not really care about your success as a student. Attempts to get you to learn the "hard way". His lecture slides are awful. Don't go to office hours. I've definitely had worse professors but he is below average

Had him for 2054. This professor is so inconsistent. He is always changing the homework questions shortly before the due date. I was doing a homework assignment, and had the homework printed in front of me, and the question changed on the pdf 5 hours before the due date. Also his office hours are always getting cancelled. Boring lectures too.

Required pre-written MATLAB scripts to finish exams.
purposefully adds mistakes to notes.
teaches convoluted questions, not concepts.
reads math derivations from slides - lectures are hard to follow.
very responsive to email and questions - can clearly communicate explanations in 1-1 interactions.
cares - gives easy assignments for grade,10pm due.
Had him for ECE 2054, not 2024. Good professor but 2054 is just too much content for you to actually learn. If you have an A by the final you don't the final. Office hours help.

I stopped going to lectures halfway through because there was no point. Learned way more in office hours, TAs were hit or miss. Take at the same time as DiffEq (or ME2004), it'll help a lot especially with the damping unit. Exams are open everything, use MATLAB. He teaches us as if we're ECE students; not entirely his fault the course just sucks.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Centeno's Intro to Power Systems class is pretty refined. The difficulty comes from the material, and he teaches it well. Also worth adding that the exams are open note, open laptop, some students came up with scripts to do conversions. He generally doesn't like to see students fail his class.

Centeno is a good lecturer, but his materials made me question staying in the ECE major. He makes the homework and slides for 2024, and both are riddled with mistakes. Tons of typos, incorrect solutions, misnumbered problems, etc. This makes completing homework and studying far more frustrating and difficult than it should be.
Really good professor.  Class difficulty comes from the material not the teacher.  Centeno is super nice and ready to answer an inquiry.  Would definitely recommend

Nice professor but REALLY hard class. He also teaches higher level power classes. Centeno has a decent amount of industry experience and is really helpful at office hours. Sometimes his voice is a little boring but he does a good job explaining the concepts. You do not want to miss any lectures if you want to pass the class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He works in power systems.

I took him at the CGE program in Keiser University and he feels like he wants nothing but see you fail, apart from making mistakes when grading and making tests which make problems impossible. He designs the problems in the hardest way possible. I studied for hours a day for an exam yet failed. All his quizzes and tests feel rigged and unfair.

I heard he was a terrible professor but I decided it couldn't be that bad but boy was that the wrong move. He assigns pages of homework every class and that's in addition to the web assign every teacher assigns. he grades this homework but doesn't get it back to you and wont tell you what he took off for. finally his Tests are literally impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This professor is very unspecific. The results in no way show the amount of effort you put in. If you go to office hours he will not help much. He is a kind of nice person , but his teaching style is not clear and very uninspired.  Math is my favorite subject, but this class was awful, prepare to teach yourself. Exams are impossible

Heard he was bad, I said it couldn't be that bad, it was.  The tests will get you and the only way you will pass them is if you devote your weekend to going over every concept and every type of problem.
Easily the worst teacher on the face of the planet.   Do not take his class.

Failing multivariable calc test avgs. Doesn't curve.  On teaching probation for failing too many students.  Worst teacher I have ever had.  Does not care about your understanding.  Does not care about your grade.  Lectures make no sense.  He is rude during office hours thinking you should already know the material.  Drop his class right now.

If you go to class, study for the tests, and are even remotely competent at math, this class should not be too bad. His accent is not difficult to understand and he gave me an intuitive understanding of the material. His tests were difficult but they were just like the problems he did in class and the problems assigned for homework.

Lectures more so than teaching. Doesn't make an effort to convey an intuitive side of the material. Very literal. Lectures can be expected to reiterate material (read: state theorems and re-work problems) verbatim. The text used for the class was also not great. I put more effort into this class than I'm willing to admit for my grade.

Easily the worst teacher I have ever had. Difficult to understand what he's saying but even if you could understand him his methods of teaching aren't great. In addition he always gives easy examples in class then assigns the hardest homework and puts stuff on the test you feel like you haven't seen before

not the best teacher Ive ever had but definitely not the worst.  Definitely go to class and copy everything down, it will really help with the homework. he is helpful in office hours but only if you have at least looked at and attempted the problem.  The tests are half mult choice half open ended.  mult is pretty easy but open ended are curveballs
Tests are very difficult compared to all other teacher's within the same subject area.  Hard to follow and had to teach myself most of the material.
Gives horrible tests
His tests are nothing like the rest of his class. He doesn't let you use a calculator on the test and the tests are a complete curve ball with weird integrations.
He understands the topic, but he can not teach it in a usefully manor.

Neither good nor bad. If you are lazy and don't do the homework, then you will end up with a bad grade. If you pay attention in class and actually do the homework (like i did), you will get good scores. In summary: do the work or drop the class

Bartleby was a completely fair teacher. His tests were a exact reflection of the notes. He literally spoon feeds you everything you need to do well. People just don't study. I don't know why he has so many poor reviews, it's not his fault the material is challenging, step up your game!

Not at all a good teacher.  Accent is hard to understand at times and he really does not at all care about your grade.  Test average is always horrible but he says "the average is irrelevant" think about it
He grades hard and does not curve tests. His accent can be a little hard to understand at times. The notes hardly help unless you already know what you're doing. Avoid him at all costs.
He is not that good. Sometimes I cant understand his accent. He knows his stuff but cannot teach it that well. The textbook also sucks as.

By far the WORST teacher I have ever had. He knows the material himself but has absolutely no clue how to convey his knowledge to the class other than looking at a set of completed notes and rewriting them on the projector. Took me several weeks to fully understand his accent and even now, I still have to think twice about what he said.
Horrible. Everything from his voice, to his tests

This class feels so unnecessary with mind-numbing work that is so boring. The class itself isn't hard, but she makes it somehow harder than it is. The grading system is also so particular, where you will get points taken off for the slightest mistake. If you don't have nice TAs for grading a group you like, then wrap it up.
This class was by far the most boring class of all time. It moves extremely slow and the assignments are so repetitive. She will give you an assignment that is basically busy work.

If you see the 3-point-something rating and think the class can't be that bad, you'll be mistaken. Points are taken off for the smallest things. Assignment guidelines are often unclear, and points get deducted for things not specified. She uses Fusion instead of SolidWorks like other sections, and the CAD assignments are poorly explained.
Super easy class and instructor. Very understanding and personable prof. Just do the work, and its the freest A.
dddddddddddddsb
Alright prof, nothing special. Was understanding when groupmates didn't show up for weeks at a time.

Professor Twyman is a good general engineering professor. She knows the material and conveys it very clearly. She does take attendance. The class is fairly easy and it doesn't take a lot to get an A in it. There are 2 main group projects that make up most of the assignments. Her class is fun and I would take it again.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Just complete all your work, and if something has a low grade, ask to see if you can resubmit it. She is understanding of your situation as a student. Overall, a great teacher and person

This class was good overall. She allows redo of assignment (helpful for MATHLAB). The TA's were very hard graders, but you can challenge the grades give. It is a group heavy class, BUT any other 1215 and 1216 classes are the same. Overall, she is a great teacher and person and loves to learn more about her students.

Hella group work but I think that's for all sections anyway. Twyman is good because the class you don't even learn much so can't even be bad in that regard. They will prob take points off randomly but its still a pretty free class and the work is easy. Very light ahh class.
She says she doesn't give busy work but does anyways. Your enjoyment of the class depends on your group. Provides no real guidance and just says read the rubric.

The teacher is great, and the concepts are very simple. MATLAB is the "hardest" thing, and most other work is group-based. Watch out for the TAs, they grade harshly and take points off for the hell of it.

Everything is busy work, assignments are stuff like "Ask Chat-GPT for 10 things to consider about..." TAs will make up expectations just so they can take points off. Things like "it would be better to declare a new variable for every step" in MATLAB assignments, which doesn't make anysense and makes the most inefficient code possible.
Busy work, busy work, busy work.
Very nice and forgiving. All work is done is group projects. Easy grader.

The only bad thing I can say is that there was a lot of work for this class, but that is just the course itself, not the professor. She was so incredible, I loved being in her class. I would take her class again 1000x over. She is very accommodating and will work with you if you communicate and actually try in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is so incredibly stupid. Half the stuff we do in class feels like kindergarten work. Sit near the back if you can so you can do other work. This problem comes from the way the department sets up the class though and is not entirely her fault. She is very nice and will help you but the class is a ginormous waste of time.

Marked attendance as mandatory because missing teamwork days without notifying the team and professor leads to a 10% penalty on the assignment that day. Nice professor. Make sure to complete all your work on time. Not super difficult, just that some of the grading is a bit strict, so utilize office hours + class time as needed before submitting

Twyman was good as an overall teacher but her grading system didnt make sense to me at all she is good in lectures but she is a tough grader the class overall is easy if you keep up with the assignments but I would advise you to choose an other prof instead of Twyman.

This was an extremely easy class, however Twyman as a teacher is terrible. Her policies make zero sense as to the weighting of certain negative incentives and certain requirements to avoid them. If you put in effort you will make it through this class with ease. I advise if you can avoid the hassle of having to deal with Twyman to do so.

Dr. Twyman is pretty relaxed. Attendance was checked but you could leave if the rest of class was individual or group work. Several classes were asynchronous throughout the semester. Class was very project heavy in terms of grades, but TA wasn't super harsh and they didn't take super long.
Dr.Twyman does a ton of talking in class and also is super particular with citations and will honor code you.

Prof Cat is amazing! I very much disliked the class, however, she is the perfect professor. As long as you get your work done, she lets you leave early if you want the majority of the time, but attendance is counted. The GTAs sucked for my class (harsh graders), but Twyman allows you to submit grade reviews if you disagree with a grade.

Workload is slight, content is easy, and she holds your hand through all of it. Just get a good group that's willing to work, do your own work and get assignments turned in, and you're guaranteed an A.

Enge 1215 is a completely useless class, but Prof Twyman made it more tolerable. I liked going to class and it seems like she really cares about the students. There was so much busywork in the class, which took lots of time, but it was a relatively easy A.

Can't blame twyman because this class just sucks and isn't fun. Almost all busy work and none of it besides matlab and makerspace felt like learning engineering that was useful to me. (and even those were dragged out into different boring writing) This class is just annoying and you have to get through it
Catherine Twyman is a great professor. She is very helpful, nice, and cares about her students. If you just do all the work, you will get an A in 1225.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Definitely Prof. Twyman is lecture heavy, so it does get boring, but I will say she makes this class easy to run through the semester. She's nice and lenient so have a word with her about your absences or late work if you have a reason.

The only time attendance was mandatory was when a group project was due within a week. But if you couldn't make it you could email her and she would understand. She made learning MATLAB really easy so I would recommend her if you are new to coding. The lectures are boring but all ENGE 1215 classes get the same homework and she grades nicely.

Twyman herself was pretty chill - fast email responses, grants extension requests before the due date, easy to get an A as long as you do the work. Half of the assignments were group work so as long as your group gets their work done you should be fine. If not, she's pretty good about making sure everyone is doing their part.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Twyman is great! She's amazing with extensions(if you ask she will give you one)and is really good at responding to emails on time.If you have a good group this class is a breeze but if you don't like what I did she likes to step in and whip the group into shape if that doesn't work she will always recognize the work you individually put in.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took this class in Fall 2022, and the class was easy because of my group. There were solely engineering students in the Fall, so the majority of the class had that good work ethic. Twyman tries to engage the class and seems like she cares about what the is teaching. Extremely understanding when projects don't go as expected. Just talk to her.

The class was pretty easy, but it depends on the group you get assigned. If everyone in your group does their work, the class will be a breeze. She reads straight from the board which is kind of boring, but overall a fine class.
The class is incredibly boring and she tends to drag out lectures but other than that she's fine. She cares about her students and is receptive to their needs but the class sucks.

More writing than my ENGL1105 class. Not difficult, but a lot. As long as your groupmates do not all skip class and do no work, it should be very manageable to get an A if you follow the rubrics. As a professor, she was good but not anything special.

Although ENGE 1215 can be great or awful depending on your assigned group, Professor Twyman was very supportive the entire semester. She is very easy to approach and gives good feedback on your work. You will have to put in work and attend class, but it's an easy A with at least a half decent group.

Prof. Twyman was just an okay professor. Attendance was mandatory, but there wasn't much content taught in class. Often you would show up just for her to say that it was a work day. Pretty much the only useful part of the class was the MATLAB unit. As far as personality, she was polite and understanding of any issues you may have.

Professor Twyman's class is definitely more difficult than the other professors which was my only issue with the class. We got more assignments and lower grades on projects than other 1215 students, however, the class is fine. If you stay on top of the work you'll get an A. I would take the class again no problem, and I learned a lot of matlab

She did her job but thats about it. There's a fun segment at the beginning then just power point slides guiding the class that she puts out before hand. Attendance was not mandatory and I recommend not going because the walk is far and the curriculum is useless just help your group and youll be fine.

Very chill class with Professor Twyman, the course is essentially just group projects and papers will a little bit of matlab sprinkled in, and in the latter half of the course most of the class time is you and your team's own time to work on your project, so the homework in this class is very manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Twyman was one of the best professors I've ever had! She is very caring towards her students, and as long as you put in the effort you will do well!

Professor Twyman really cares about the success of each student in her classes. The group I was assigned for the class didn't do their fair share of work, however, after some emailing, she became aware of the issue and accommodated me for the problem. She is very willing to help students.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: I would recommend professor Twyman. She is really forgiving and gave me a couple extensions. It is a lot of group work, and the lecture can be boring but its an easy A if you do the work.

Prof. Twyman was a very nice person, just not a great teacher. There are many group projects, and too many papers as well. It seemed more like busywork than actually learning engineering. Going to class wasn't very helpful most of the time. Just pray for a good team and look at the rubric when doing assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is a very nice lady who does assign a good bit of work. I do not know why people are complaining because the work she assigns does not take that long, it is more busy work to understand fundamentals.

Easily the worst professor I had. She lacks confidence in her own ability to teach, and never gives a proper answer to the questions that are asked to her. She brings up her personal life at the beginning of class too much (nobody cares, move on), and she gives us paper, after paper. It's more of an English class at this point.

Twyman was an OK professor, but I had her for her first semester teaching. For most assignments, she was unclear on what she wanted so I had to ask for clarification on most things. Her advice was not always helpful to the assignment itself, but her TAs explained things well. She was however a very nice lady and would try her best to aid students

Without a doubt the easiest class I've taken in my life. No more than an hour of work a week, save for the one big assignment of the class. Basically a free A. Dr. Courtney is courteous to students, and clearly cares about his pupils. Would highly recommend his instruction.
he uses chatgpt to create his quizzes and tests (pick the longest answer), I didn't study for the final exam and got a 90% bc it so obvious he only uses chat

Quiz every other class..Professor throws tantrums when laptops are being used in class, and has a strict ai policy. His lectures are very boring and when he doesn't get any response from students he gets mad and makes everyone turn in a piece of paper about topic.

This professor is extremely rude and constantly defies students. His attitude makes the class miserable, and his lectures are boring and unhelpful. The only positives are that he's organized and offers extra credit. He's incredibly rigid and not at all supportive. Would not recommend.

I took this class online and it was my easiest one all semester. Just 3-5 assignments due every friday and no exams or work otherwise. It's also asynchronous so I never had class. Offers lots of extra credit, I did every assignment and got an A+.

Such a boring class. Please get a new professor! He acts like a middle school girl, makes passive-aggressive comments, & is not professional at all. I dreaded the days I had this class cause I already knew he was going to be problematic. No one pays attention & everyone hates him. Before class, we all would complain about him & hope he didn't come.

My least favorite class I have taken so far. Sitting through this class was horrible, I was falling asleep. His lectures are so boring, he just reads off the slides. Going to class is pointless, there's no way I would've gone if he didn't take attendance. He also makes very weird comments to the students...there is no mutual respect.
Good professor, class was super easy and all you ever had to do was show up and you'd do fine. Don't wait till the last minute on the customer interviews though.

The only way to do poorly in this class is to not do the work. Professor Courtney is my favorite teacher that I have had so far. I was always tired and class was in the evening but his lectures were actually interesting and kept me engaged. There are some big assignment towards the end but as long as you actually do them you should get an A.
The class was super easy but also super boring, I was fighting to stay awake. There was virtually no homework until the late semester.
He is very passionate about what he does and cares about his students. The class is very easy and it is not hard at all to get an A.

If you participate, you should make an A. The class isn't very interesting, but you will learn a lot about the entrepreneurial process. The hardest assignment is customer interviews, don't wait until the last minute. You get 3 free absences to use when you feel necessary. There are probably better courses if this isn't required for your major.

Very much a participation-based class. He makes sure you're engaged in the lectures, gives out bonus points (extra credit) for participating. There's only a few chapter quizzes but they're take-home. Quite a few projects that require effort (most of your grade.) The final exam is 5% of grade. Graded attendance (can miss 7 classes, will drop 3.)

Professor Courtney is a nice guy, he cares about his students i think but there is a lot of homework and classwork and some of the guidelines are not specific. But overall the class is easy to do well in and he gives a lot of bonus points if you participate, but its also a super boring class.

Just very annoying. If you go to class and do the assignments you can get a good grade. Most assignments aren't very complicated but are annoying. He will sometimes stack several assignments due on the same date. He's kind of passive aggressive.
So boring. Actually so boring. Such an easy class, but it is so incredibly boring. Attendance is mandatory. So boring.
If I could swear I would. I hate this man with a burning passion. Mf has zero empathy. He does not care about you. You are a number on a chair to him.

Yes there is work, but if you stay on top of it the class is not hard. Must go to class, but TONS of extra credit by participating. Following the program schedule helped stay on top of work. Lectures could be long, but it is overall a good class and easy if you do the work. Final doesn't count for much if you have a good grade already.

Boring lectures but bearable. Pathways credit, but you could probably find a better one. I was doing well in the class for basically the whole semester (with an A-), but towards the end of the semester a bunch of big assignments get stacked on you and it's totally different from the beginning and tanked my grade. Final was annoying and hard.
i loved her but she was not a good teacher. take her if you want a good laugh in class tho. i learned nothing that was helpful for the test and was teaching myself everything
Watch the lecture videos and do the Aleks practice before the exam, take the optional chem class and you'll do fine.
Enthusiastic professor with many examples to connect topics to a digestible form. She's very funny and cares about her students. Go to her review sessions the day before each test.

She's really enthusiastic, and even though it was an 8 a.m. class, her energy made it better. Since she studied chem at Tech, she gets how tough the course is. Gen chem is hard no matter the professor, so good time management and asking for help from TAs, professors, or peers really helps.

Amazing professor that makes classes genuinely enjoyable to attend even at 8am. Classes fly by and you don't even realize how much you are actually learning. For the tests just run through the practice test over and over again and you will be fine. If her class fits in your schedule, could not recommend it enough, even if it doesn't, make it fit.

She prioritized being funny over actually teaching the material, and most of the time her humor is that of a millennial mom's Facebook feed. If there weren't iClickers for mandatory attendance, I would learn more from just skipping class and teaching myself. Chem is already tough, but Candace makes you question if hell is better than her class.
Terrible and slow lectures. Quirky millennial. I would not look both ways when crossing the roads on the way to class.
Hilarious professor.  Every class was entertaining.  Explained things well, and review sessions really helped.
Love Prof Wall! Makes chemistry make sense, at least in my brain. And as much as I hated the ALEKS, it was helpful in the sense that it is exactly like the tests. Do the homework and you'll be fine
She moved pretty fast through her lectures. Besides this she was a fantastic teacher.

All of the learning done is on ALEKS. Tests are extremely hard as there are multiple subquestions per question, no partial credit, and every question, regardless of how long, is free-response. When I asked Professor Wall for guidance, she accused me of using AI, diagnosed me with test anxiety, and told me I was not working hard enough.

shes not as bad as most of the reviews say, she does go off topic alot and talks about her kids a lot which is kind of annoying. She explains it decently well in class but it will take a lot of work outside of class as well, mid tbh

She is so rude and thinks cursing at you makes her seem hip and young. It took her 45 minutes for a FIVE WORDED SLIDE. Waste of my time, money, energy, and ears. Not to mention that the test is just ALEKS. Chem is hard, but she makes it hell and like you literally question if actual hell is better.

Pretty rude and sarcastic when you ask her questions. Goes off topic a lot and doesn't teach you anything that will actually be on the test. Seriously moody and yells at students on test days. Tries too hard to be cool and funny but is just lowkey mean

Avoid this professor. She cares more about being "fun" and "quirky" rather than actually teaching the subject material. The only way you learn is through the Aleks platform, also where the tests are which are graded toughly.

She's terrible. She doesn't teach half the time your only way to learn is aleks and other professors review sessions. A lot of stuff she speeds through bc "you should already know this" If you didn't take AP chem in high school choose anyone else. She's rude half the time and talks down to if you ask her questions and is not professional at all.

Candace Wall is someone who I thought I'd never encounter in my life, but looking back on life decisions, I can proudly say I am glad I did. She is funny but gets down right to the point when need be. Most of these other reviews are factual; she cusses, talks about her kids, and goofs off with fellow professor Alec Wagner. She is a good professor.
She is super hilarious and we always get out at least 30 minutes early. Tests are pretty hard BUT if you study using ALEKS a lot before hand than its not bad.

Lectures in this class were all over the place, with the instructor trying to be funny rather than teach. The ALEKS online program was the real teacher. I would not recommend Candace as an instructor as you will be teaching yourself and rolling your eyes in class.
Best professor ever. Chemistry is hard but she made it easy. Highly recommend to take her.

Candace is an engaging professor in her lectures, but often will go on unrelated tangents. She uses clickers for attendance. Easy to approach in office hours to ask questions, she appreciates it and notices. Office hours are a great way to be successful in her classes, be prepared with questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: She'll give you stress, and if you've never had a teacher who cusses, be prepared, because she does it a lot. She has big mood swings and talks about her kids often, and you'll even see them in class sometimes. You can honestly teach yourself by watching her videos; they're clear and easy to follow. It's a pretty easy class,

She has got to be one of the best professors I have ever met. She made me love chemistry. The lectures are your best friend, sometimes she does extra credit i-clickers which are a blessing. Also, try your best with the studio quizzes, they help your grade tremendously and they really assist with understanding the materal.
Honestly I love chem because of her. She has got to be one of the best professors I have ever met.

Dr. Wall is an amazing professor! She makes chemistry really enjoyable, her lectures are very entertaining and informative too! She teaches the content well, provides support, and does great with SSD accommodations. Would definitely take another class with her again.

She is very nice and her class is not too difficult if you participate. A lot of the learning comes from ALEKS and you will need to pay attention, She can sometimes get very far off topic during her lectures.

Candace is a good professor but tries to incorrectly apply many concepts to real life. All of the professors for chem teach the same material, and Candace caters to those who need to pass / C, rather than those looking for an A. Talk to her after class or exams.

I have nothing against Candace, she is good, but not great if you want an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is so funny and makes class more entertaining than any other professor. Yes, she doesn't teach a lot of content each class but that's because its chem 1035's first test material spread out over a whole semester. She explains concepts in practical ways and lets class out early. I signed up for chem 1035 with her. I would recommend her.
AVOID AVOID AVOID AVOID. If you are someone who likes dumb/annoying humor and no learning in class and doing ABSOLUTELY EVERYTHING ON YOUR OWN then I guess you have found ur dream teacher.

ABSOLUTE. NIGHTMARE. She spends more time giving anecdotes about her 5 year old daughter than anything else. Be prepared to do nothing the first 20 minutes of class and let out after doing all of 2 practice problems (about >5 minutes each for her to go over on the board). I am not paying all this money just to go home more confused than I arrived.
Very funny and finds new ways to explain complicated concepts
She was smart and lectures are intriguing.  She's really funny

Prof. Wall barely taught any of the material, so I spent an immense amount of time learning, not even studying, outside of class. She would often go off on tangents that were completely unrelated to the lecture. Even though she posted her lecture slides, they were unfinished and sentences would abruptly end without being finished. Avoid her class.
I AM THE SYSTEM

All chem exams across professors are identical so the subject regardless is just hard. But Candace makes it super engaging (I had an 8 AM). She does a good job of explaining things and is SO FUNNY! Study throughout the semester and not just a week before each exam and do the practice tests given to u. HW is a lot and can be annoying but beneficial

Candace is a great professor even for an 8am class. If you can get her that's great but in the end, all the professors assign the same homework and the tests are common time and it is sent out by the Chemistry department.

Candace is extremely funny and her lectures are never boring. She does a great job comparing and contrasting chemistry topics to help you better understand the content in the class. She is also very caring and understanding! She is one of the best professors I have had so far.

Lectures are very helpful and explains topics well. Her student helpers are very useful during activities to receive help from. She does really care about her students and makes sure that everyone has a good chance of passing the class.
Love Candace. Study up!
She nearly hit me with her car one day, but she's chill.

This is for oceanography, GEOS 3034. Lectures were a bit boring but Candace is lively enough that I didn't fall asleep. Tests were all multiple choice, and were a little tough just because there were many topics covered. In-class assignments most days. She cares about students and treats you like adults, just show up to class and you'll pass

Great professor! Was nervous to take gen chem but she really simplifies concepts. Practice exams and questions are KEY for this course. Also she has recorded lectures I missed a few classes and it was no big deal. She is very engaging.

Candace is a super caring and very chill professor, but her teaching style might not be for everyone because she uses a lot of simple analogies within each chapter. She is extremely helpful and provide help during her office hours. Its important to go to her lectures (iclickers) and utilize the practice exams they offer!! Would def take her again!

Personally I cant function at night (tests are 8pm) and my tests scores reflected that, but made sure to always do the ALEKS hw, studio quizes, and clicker questions - and thats the only reason I passed the class. Also go to office hours to do ALEKS bc it's confusing and the TA will explain in a way that made it stick in my head for all the tests

candace is awesome! her lectures are so funny, but her teaching style isn't for everyone. the ALEKs homework assignments are insane, takes me about 5 hours to finish every weekly assignment. the tests (especially test 2) are ridiculously difficult, so make sure you are more than prepared for the tests.

Candace is wonderful; if you struggle with chemistry concepts, she is an incredible lecturer and is motivated by helping others. I really enjoyed the two classes I took with her and cannot recommend her enough.
I love Candace! She is so hilarious but also really cares for her students and wants them to succeed.

She is very funny, and engaging with her lectures, but the homework is crazy. I have to do hours every night just to keep up, none of it is hard per se but it's extremely time-consuming. The class overall is good though, there are test review sessions with the TAs before every test, however, she doesn't give any practice tests, or publish lectures.

big love for candace. i signed up for her class next semester because she's so awesome. her lectures are always so entertaining, and she manages to make chemistry interesting. also, the TAs and LAs are very accessible and helpful. if you do all of her aleks assignments (and get 90%-100% on them) you can afford to fail the tests and pass the class!
Hard class but she really cared for us as people. I found going to class very fun because of the way she taught. Only thing is for her to explain concepts more.

Professor Wall has a relaxed personality. Sadly, her lectures aren't the same. They were long and the two 1014 classes she has are at night. She acted more like our friends than professor. Videos, related to the lectures, would be between 4-14 minutes compared to the hour and some lectures that cover the same thing. ALEKS is your best friend!!!!

Don't take this class if you can't put in the work. This was a good class but it had a lot of homework. Almost all assignments are on ALEKS. But if you need help with ALEKS assignments I highly recommend watching Roxi Hulet on YouTube, she explains almost all the ALEKS topics you need to get done way better than the ALEKS explanations.

I loved this class. It was HARD but Dr.Wall made the 8am so much more enjoyable! She is truly a caring prof. and will try to make the content as easy a she can, but be ready to work. Especially if Chem is not really your thing this class will be difficult. Overall, she has been my favorite professor and i'm so glad I got to be in her class.

Quirky for sure, but gets the chemistry concepts across in a way that's easy to understand. She cares a lot about her students. iClickers matter for attendance but she usually tells you the right answer
Cares about her students. Quirky millenial vibes for sure. Loved her

I love Candace. She is by far one of my favorite professors thus far at Tech. She's funny, and super down to Earth. The course content wasn't difficult but she made sure to break it down so even a 5 year old could understand it. She never made anyone feel bad either if they had questions during lecture, despite the large class. Cool experiments too

Alright teacher, just don't take this class as at 8 in the morning. She had the duality of being both personable and humorous, while also coming off as the weird kid in high school. Good lecturer, and could convey chemistry concepts well.

Dr. Wall is great! This is my second time taking the class after having to withdraw from chem the previous semester with another professor. She truly values all of her students with respect and supports them no matter what. She is great about accommodating SSD students. She makes the class fun and educational. Please take her if given a chance!

You can tell that she has a lot of empathy for her students. She did a really great job using analogies in her lectures and kept them engaging with sotrries or comparissons. Candace was also super great when helping with SSD accommodations. She is a great teacher and I would definitely recommend her to anyone looking to take 1014 or 1035

Candace was an amazing professor. Gen Chem is hard in general and Candace made the class engaging and easy to follow. Practice Test are similar to the actual test so make sure to do them at least once as I generally got 10 points higher on the actual test than the practice test.
Candace is funny but beware that she can fail you cause you learn nothing but by yourself.

I loved this class.  All the notes were posted before the lessons and completed notes were posted after.  Each class was engaging and there are so many opportunities to get help.  Just make sure to do all the homework because you are going to want full credit in those sections in case you do poorly on a test.
All hail Candace

Candace is a cool person do not get me wrong. However, the class is driven by ALEKS, and can be a lot of work if not done with time. Since the class was ALEKS-heavy, she did not teach that much because you had to learn from the program. Also she is very laidback but the class has many distractions like her bringing in her kids. She's cool peoples.
Candace's lectures are always amazing, shell take time out of class to make sure everyone's doing ok. I had her for 1014 my first semester and I'm happy she was the professor.

Candace is extremely nice. However, she requires attendance to her lectures where you learn absolutely nothing. You have to teach yourself all of the material for the class and complete an excessive amount of ALEKS modules.

She cares about the students in Chem 1014. However, ALEKS is heavily used, I personally do not like, nor learn well using ALEKS. Now, as long as you can finish the ALEK and the reflections you can pass. For example I have done poor on my tests, I got a 48 on this last test. If I get a 50 on my final, I still pass with a 87. Just do the work.
Really engaging professor! Some of the classes were unnecessary, but the information was relayed.

You can tell that she really cares about the students and how they do in the course. Has a great pulse on how the class is feeling each day and has funny and engaging lectures. Was very thoughtful and knowledgeable about accommodation requests. 3 or 4 iclicker questions are like once a week. Definitely would take her course again!

She was super nice and sweet. The tests were simple since if you do enough ALEKS questions, you'll know the answers to all of the test questions. She sometimes does not teach enough, but if you go for office hours and ask, you'll understand easily.
Very good, explains things well and is very funny. A lot of work tho
Very gud teechr
An absolute baller
Honestly one of the most amazing professors I have ever had. Despite the large class size, she manages to make you feel included and makes you feel as though she truly wants you to succeed

While her teaching style was unique, to say the least, her continuous support and empathy for everyone's wellbeing seemed similar to that of a skit. When approached individually, her mannerisms changed, and she was no longer that friendly and over-supportive mentor that she pretended to be.

My second semester with Candace. Dude, she is a gem. Best teacher I've had in my entire life, which might sound like a big claim to make but it's true. There's a lot of online homeworks, she takes iClickers, and tests can be difficult but it's all extremely reasonable and she's very generous with drops. Super accommodating and kind.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Please take Candace! My high school chem experience was so awful and Candace literally redeemed chem for me. She has so many opportunities to get help and breaks down concepts so well. She is SO funny and so kind. The more you engage with chem, the more you get out of her class because of how much you learn from her. She is absolutely the best!

She is a great teacher that is super kind. However, if you are the kind of person that needs lots of structure in the class this might not be the best one for you. She has set problems but there are lots of distractions during class that would make it difficult for you.

Dr. Wall once stayed an hour after our lecture ended to help other students FROM DIFFERENT CLASSES because they were struggling. She genuinely cares about her students, and is absolutely hilarious. Please attend class and do all of the practice problems. she is an excellent teacher and a pleasure to study under.

Easy class if you've taken chemistry in high school but still expect to put some work in to get the grade you want. Candace managed to make a 5 pm lecture not totally boring to the point where you didn't feel bad about showing up. That's an accomplishment.

Best professor in the whole school, hands down. She's resourceful, instructive, and hilarious. She transforms a usually tedious class into a literal sitcom. By the end of the year, you'll want her to teach all of your classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is funny, and her tricks for memorizing certain topics are VERY helpful. She gives iClicker quizzes almost every class so make sure to attend! She moves fast in lectures, so YouTube and her pre-recorded videos helped. Overall, chemistry sucks, but her class was bearable. From what Ive heard from other people, she is the best professor for 1035
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: 1014 was a struggle. I learned more from ALEKS than I did from class. The test were hard because they are all free-response. Just stay on top of your ALEKS because it is a big portion of your grade and your test questions are from the modules you complete. Candace is really funny, understanding, and cares about us more than our grades.

Candace is definitely the best teacher ive had at Tech. Her lectures were the highlight of my day. She makes the class so fun. Her notes are clear and she explains the content very well. I was scared for this class because its a weed out course for engineers, but I ended with a 96 because of her. She is incredible, I highly recommend her.

I couldn't have asked for a better professor to help me through a soul-crushing semester of Chem. I struggle with Chemistry a lot, but Candace made it exciting, funny, and digestible. She goes pretty fast through her lectures, so I would suggest watching the recorded ones before class. She expects a lot of her students because she cares.

You will not find a professor at Tech who cares about students more than Candace. She cares about the wellbeing of her students more than their grades. Truly the most amazing teacher I have ever had in my entire life. She is extremely funny, and her lectures are very easy to follow. It's not necessarily an easy class, but it's very enjoyable.
Really enjoyed her class and is really helpful.

Candance obviously cares about her students, however, this class does not prepare you for general chemistry at all. If you can, don't take it. Its really not worth it. I feel like I didn't learn anything the whole semester. Attendance isn't mandatory but she does a lot of Iclicker questions and you will fail if you don't go.

Candance is literally my favorite professor. The way she teaches makes it easier to understand what is needed to be able to get good grades on the chemistry exams. Word of advice to get an A in the class is to make sure to do a lot of practice problems from the book, and you can see those on the connect assignments. Get her if you get the chance.

I LOVE Candace, I wish I could take her again this upcoming semester but her classes were full. She is a fantastic teacher, I highly recommend and respect her. Unfortunately, I had a bad habit of skipping class and it caused me to get behind and I had to withdrawal to save my grade so show up! But she is absolutely amazing.
She understands what we as students go through and isnt cold hearted. She does her best to accommodate if a different learning style works best for you. Shes also pretty chill.

She makes a lot of interesting jokes during her lectures. A very charismatic individual, she will definitely lighten up the mood after a long, tiring day. As a General Engineering student, her being the last teacher of my day for Mondays and Wednesdays out of the 6 classes I have, is such a nice way to destress from the workload I am buried in.

Candace is so funny she made me laugh a lot. If you are the type of student who only pays attention to non-boring teachers she is the one for you. I bombed the first test but she made me like chemistry.

Candace is the best. She has a BIG personality(lots of jokes and comments) but it's not for everyone. For me, it made the class bearable and I enjoyed going to class and talking to her. But many don't like her because of the same reason. This class is hard and requires a LOT of practice to do well, but if you want an engaging prof, that's her.
terrible teacher and incredibly heartless
Genuinely the worst class Ive ever taken, but Candace makes it somewhat bearable.
She was really nice and good at chem. Made some easy mistakes that we had to tell her about. Otherwise, she's all you need to pass 1035.

Candace is so friendly and really cares about her students. She seems to understand the stress of the engineering workload. The only thing I didn't like was that her lectures were often very low energy.
By far the best chem 1035 teacher. Rumor has it she makes the tests. Excellent lecture notes. when she says do the textbook problems do the textbook problems

Candace was a perfect professor for my first college level chemistry class. She is super funny and care-free which allowed for a comfortable fun environment. Not only are her classes and lectures entertaining but they all include great problem solving examples and ways to do your best on the challenging Chem 1035 tests.

Candace was such a great professor. She was super funny and really understanding. She also gave so many resources on Canvas and understood that not everyone is the same type of learner. The class was definitely hard, but she made it a lot better.

She is the best professor I had this semester. She cares about her students and wants us to understand the material. Very clear cut content and is always there to review concepts. Attendance is not mandatory but super helpful, and her tests are just as expected. No surprises. She's also very engaging and funny!
Amazing teacher. I despise chemistry but Candace made the class amazing. Had to take it for credit, but seriously considered taking more chem later just to have her again. 11/10 would take again.

Not the professor's fault chemistry is hard. She seemed to care about her students and was very willing to help. Genuinely nice woman, chemistry is just hard for most people, especially when it is online. A little goofy and sarcastic in zoom, and can get off topic easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Candace is a really great professor for CHEM 1014. I'm planning on taking CHEM 1035 with her next semester. She's hilarious and she understands students very well. Overall a great and lively class!
She is great teacher.

The most amazing professor one could hope for. CHEM 1035 is standardized across the department but Candace makes her own notes that are much more conducive to learning. Her class gets demonstrations that others don't which really helps us apply the knowledge. I gave it "the usual" I had an easy time but others needed more effort. Candace will help.

She is by far the best professor I have had. She makes lectures fun and I don't feel like falling asleep as she's very hands on rather than just reading from the ppt. She's extremely caring and sweet with all of her students and very good at teaching the curriculum. She works out each problem step-by-step making sure you understand it fully.

Candace Wall is very candid and relatable. She often provides insights about how the lecture content relates to actual lab work. She is funny and explains things well, and her analogies make the content easier to remember and understand. She holds review sessions during her office hours and provides supplemental video lectures to aid studying.

Candace was such a great professor, and a great person in general. She definitely has a loud personality, which some may not enjoy, but, in my opinion, it made the class a lot more fun to attend. However, you will need to put in the work for this class. Dont slack on the homework/clicker questions no matter how easy the class may seem.

Candace was my favorite prof this semester. She's hilarious and a former VT student so she knows what it's like being in our shoes. The class itself, however, is torture. Study a ton, get help when you need it, and go to class and you should get a passing grade.

All chemistry 1035 professors follow the same curriculum and assign the same homework, quizzes, and tests. Candace almost always gives answers to the quizzes and has easily accessible office hours. She is hilarious and I actually wanted to go to class just because I never wanted to miss one of her lectures. Never a boring class, super helpful too.

Great teacher and great person overall. She teaches the content well and has office hours once or twice a week at late hours as to not conflict with any other teachers' office hours, and usually she will go through one of the online assignments with the class to help everyone understand how to do it. Definitely recommend Candace Wall for CHEM 1035

Candace is funny and does offer lots of opportunities to meet with her outside of class. Her Tuesday night help sessions can be good for homework. I found her funny in class, but she can be unapproachable when talking to her individually. She definitely had students she liked more than others. If youre on her good side, youll have no trouble.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I LOVED class with Candace. Normally I hate chemistry, but she's so entertaining and makes things ridiculously simple to understand, even the most adamant chem hater will love chem. If you can't decided on a chem prof, take Candace, you'll thank me later. Make sure you keep up with your studies tho. Tests will try to trick you!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: candace is the best professor ever. she is funny and extremely understanding and an amazing teacher. after I started going to her office hours I doubled my test grade. She is great

She was super understanding and very relatable to first-year freshmen. She understood how stressful this class could be, so she made it as easy to understand as possible. She had one of the highest grades in the chemistry tests out of all chem professors. I highly recommend taking her, as I am taking her again for CHEM 1045.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Candace is the funniest professor I've had thus far. She understands how stressful school can be and the challenges that come along with the course. Because of that, she is always invested in helping students, but you must be putting in work outside of class. Attempting practice problems before going to office hours is the key to success.

There are 6 "quizzes" throughout the semester that are longer than some of my exams. However, prof drops a good amount of homework grades so there's a good amount of flexibility. I'd still recommend taking in person.
It was an okay class but I feel like the professor made it way harder than it needed to be. She over complicates the most simplest topics ever
Class is slight

If you take your notes and apply them to the homeworks right after, you will do fine. People mentioned her tests have questions that were mentioned once in the videos, this is true, but you are allowed a cheat sheet. She provides a reading worksheet for you to focus on things that are "important" for the quiz. Emailed her once and she was helpful.

Really confused about all the negative reviews. If you watch her lecture videos and fill out the reading notes she gives you it's not hard at all. She gives you a cheat sheet for quizzes. It is math heavy but it's not hard concepts. The quizzes are directly based on the weekly assignments and reading, so just do the work.

The singular good thing about this class is that the canvas is organized. I would advise absolutely no one to take this class and to take the in person professor instead. The content and lectures of this class are insufferable to experience. It is an unreasonably time consuming class and I suggest you take it if you want to waste your time.

Watching video lectures with optional blank note templates and completing quizzes/tests. Was not easy. Some quiz questions were too specific to remember, as if you had to have memorized the video. The videos were hard to get through. Final was harder than expected. It's a passable class with work. Fine professor, mid class.

This is one of those courses where you really need to buckle down to do well, at least with her class. Her canvas is very organized and has office hours if your lost. But I just hate having so many quizzes (aka exams) and so little time to do them.

For those saying that this class is hard, it's not. You just lock in finish the lectures which are boring and just study a little bit you should be fine.

You are going to put in some work, but this is college, this course isn't that bad :)

I'm taking her online class right now and it's not too bad. There is quite a bit of homework and quizzes, but her lecture videos really prepare you for them. You'll need to get the textbook since 20% of the quiz questions come from it. However, she provides a reading sheet that includes potential questions that may appear on the quizzes.

This class structure is just brutal. Tons of mind numbing online lectures and many online quizzes which account for almost 60% of your total grade. If your not good at test taking and being under the pressure of the clock, don't take this class.
awful do not take, so boring, mind numbing
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her canvas is super organized and really well put together. Her lecture videos are good for the most part, except sometimes it seems the stuff on the quizzes don't perfectly aligned. Plus since its asynchronous, you really need to be organized, otherwise you will struggle.
