reviews.comment: Unclear in what he is looking for in his assignments. Critical of writing style if you have not literally jumped into his brain to extract what he is looking for! Will give you a bad grade if you do not conform to his politics, which he does not hide at all. Don't expect response in emails or your in-person questions to be answered sufficiently.
Avoid this class at all costs. Grades strictly for no reason even if you've done all the work needed.

I know Nelson gets a bad rap on here, but if you really do care about what you are studying with him, you will love it. There is a lot of reading and writing, but I LOVED the books he assigned. I took multiple courses with him and received an A in every single one because I asked for feedback and tried to improve my writing every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hands down worst prof I've had at VT. I had him for a topics class on Russian Nationalism and it was clear that Nelson had no idea wtf he was talking about. His exams were unnecessarily difficult and impossible to study for. His paper format is weird. Avoid him at all costs. He's an absolute quack, no idea why VT still employs this man.

I mean everything that everyone else has said is true. Doesnt accept any absence verification, wont respond to emails containing them. Never had a professor like that my whole time at Tech. Teaches outdated junk in his classes too which is sad because Im interested in China relations. So bad literally what is he doing teaching if he is so uncaring?
i'm a straight A student, however, prof nelson is by far the laziest prof ive had while at tech; puts in grades super late and gives out low grades without any feedback; avoid his classes!

DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASSES. He rambles for the entire class. The books are useless. His grading is not outlined. If you don't write in his way, your grade suffers. He has no regard for absences. Makes it hard for you to get a participation grade in class. The list goes on.

Stay away.
Scott Nelson has zero regard for anything or anyone but himself. If papers aren't written in HIS style, your grade will suffer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Scott Nelson has been the worst professor. First, he completely lacks empathy for mental health, family issues, and general sickness. His syllabus said we can't miss one single class or it will have detrimental consequences on out grades. " He has a strict no-technology policy and his lectures are useless for his weekly papers. Avoid Scott Nelson.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: His online course provided few lectures, none recorded. We were assigned 3 books and given 3-4 discussion posts a week. Material was strictly from these books with no actual hands on lecturing. Exams are easy but he's a harsh grader. Not the learning experience I would've liked.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nelson taught the class weirdly. We were given 3 books and every book had an exam. Every week, we had to write 5 discussion posts on the assigned chapters. He did not give any lectures. Our understanding of the material came from peers and the book. He graded difficultly with the discussion posts, but the exams were easy.

rambles on in lectures. very theoretical. talks super softly. did not like his teaching style at all. super boring. doesn't engage with the class, just goes off on tangents and talks for 75 mins. nice guy though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: just dont take Dr Nelson class

Dr. Nelson is a great professor. He cares deeply about his students and gives lots of helpful feedback when grading papers and projects. His class is a little difficult and you definitely need to do the readings, but he really knows his stuff and leads great discussions in class. I can't recommend him enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I didn't appreciate his teaching style and I feel like I didn't learn anything from his lectures. In my opinion, the TA's did all the teaching but after you take the quizzes so it wasn't ever helpful prior to taking the quizzes and there is a lot of reading per week.

He rambles on during lectures so even though he goes over material, he talks more about his interpretation of the readings rather than helping you understanding the material. So attendance may or may not end up helping you. The readings for homework are always like 100+ pages and if you don't take notes, it's easy to forget everything you read.

Though in my major, Scott was the worst teacher I had at tech.  He's more of a liberal maniac than a professor.  He never once allowed us to think for ourselves and rambled on for hours about how we should live our lives to curse the Bush administration.  I'll never forget his hate mongering speech on the last day of one of his classes. Fire him.

Great professor!! I loved the class... he was very helpful and really wanted to hear what the students thought. It was a lot of reading and writing but it was definitely a great class to end my IS major!
Not great. Goes way too fast.

lectures are awful...he rambles on and on for 50 minutes twice a week and you come away not really learning anything...i learned a lot from the textbooks but lectures were worthless. two midterm exams and final werent too bad...they got easier as the semester progressed and he curves them
Rambles way too much. Tests are way too difficult.

He's a good professor and he know's his stuff.  BUT, as other's have mentioned, he is a little full of himself.  I enjoyed the class and did alright, but received several disparaging remarks on my papers; none of which were very constructive.  If you don't agree with his poltics, you're fighting an uphill battle.  So, stay as neutral as you can.

Took three classes from Scott, Political Theory, Global Econ, and International Affairs. I would say he's probably the best professor I had at Tech, engaging, highly intelligent, and very personable. Even if you hated politics, this man would make them interesting. His teachings have forever impacted the way I see the US in the world.
Great teacher, but he's kind of difficult to understand! It's a lot of reading, and his tests are killer.

Very enjoyable to listen to. Good at animating the subject. A lot of ppl complained about the tests being too hard, but those ppl are just lazy. I made a high A on all of the tests. Only negative is he can be a little difficult (dismissive) to deal with
He's very intelligent, but very pompous and self-righteous during the lecture, in which he often rambles about nothing for long periods of time. NOT a good teacher.

He's obviously a very intelligent man and knows what he's talking about which made him interesting to listen to, but his tests were ridiculously abstract and random in comparison to the material.  Recitation had little to nothing to do with lecture.
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments
Way too much work for a one-credit course. He seemed scary at first based on the impression he gave off from the syllabus but fine once you got to be around him more.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Orler was an unfortunate professor to get for a "weed-out class". He consistently had issues with technology, was corrected on lectures by students, rarely ever did the in-class experiments other Chem teachers had set out, and was not incredibly engaging with the material. He seems like a nice person, but wow. Lectures were rarely helpful.
Lectures were sloppy, better off learning on your own
He needs to retire.

Dr. Orler was bad with technology, which was detrimental to his lectures. He had tech issues every lecture that cost us 5+ min of class, which made us behind all the other profs. He's not a bad guy, but he definitely wasn't good at teaching. If you want to do well, study the textbook. My relatively okay grade had nothing to do with him.

Prof. Orler is nice when you talk to him, but not a good professor. He simply does not know how to operate PowerPoint and can be seen having other chemistry professors or his TA helping him. His lectures are also very boring. You can pass CHEM 1035 by studying off the materials provided, but other professors are better.
Teacher unaware of how to use technology, teaching takes a long time, I believe he could be good if he stuck to writing on the chalk board.

Professor Orler is a nice guy but I would avoid having him as a professor, at least for Chem1035. There is a 60% chance every lecture that he will have a technology issue which leads to material being left out. His explanations don't really make sense and I often find myself learning through the ALEKS assignments more than in class.
I'm sorry for anyone who has already or has to have this professor at any point in time.

This is an incredibly difficult course and there's not much that can be done about it. 5 'executive' lab reports graded by TAs. The schedule was definitely rough and the experiments themselves could use improvements. However, there were many office hours times and they were definitely necessary. He does care, but the class is simply that hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You need to be prepared for how much time this class will take and accept that early on. Each lab report will take between 15-24 HOURS to complete, and there are 6 of them. This lab is doable and can be enjoyable if you accept that it will be a lot of work. Start the reports EARLY and get help if you need it ASAP. Professor is actually very nice.
worst professor of all time

I sat in the front of the class, dead center and was still incredibly confused despite asking lots of questions. I also spent 4+ hours a week, every week doing homework for the class. If you have never taken chemistry he is not the professor for you, and you better pray that you have a good studio lecturer if you can't get out of taking him.

Genuinely one of the worst professors I have ever seen. He teaches chem 1035 and I learned nothing. He came to class unprepared and could never teach us any of the material. The teacher struggled to the point where students had to complete the problems for him. I'm not sure how he's a teacher but never take him. I would give lower than a 0/10.

This is the most poorly planned class I have ever taken. I was unable to access all of the prelab assignments due to outdated software that somehow is not updated. The lab reports are long and tedious. The lectures taught me nothing. Get ready to be writing a lot of lab reports for very little credit!

Dr. Olson was one of the sweetest professors that I have had. You can tell that she really cares for everyone and wants students to do well. She is so caring and I really hope that I can have her as a professor again.

She genuinely is such an amazing professor! This class has quite a bit of reading but if this class sounds appealing to you the reading are pretty chill to read and you learn a lot through them. There a small quizzes fairly often but it open note so as long as you are prepared it should be a easy A. Truly recommend her so so much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Olson is a good professor and great person. She is very caring, kind, and always checks in on her students to make sure that they are doing okay. Easily one of the best professors at Virginia Tech. The class is fairly easy and the quizzes are open note. Recommend taking this class.

Dr. Olson is such a great professor and I enjoyed her class so much! There is a lot to read, but I suggest working your way through the lecture slides and that will make class and the quizzes easier. She is very caring and treats the students with so much respect. Overall, take this class!

Amazing class structure and professor. She checks in constantly and cares about everyone. There are readings before every class and biweekly quizzes, but the class is discussion and participation-based. As long as you engage, you'll pass. 10/10 recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: i absolutely love her and this class was lovely. in class we just learn and mostly chat about the topic of the day/week and assignments are individual chosen and worked on at your own pace. this is amazing but remember not to get lost in the soft due dates! the class is the best when you bond with the people sitting around you.

She is knowledgeable, passionate, and easy-going. Her lectures are easy to follow and don't require much of the reading to be done. She also understands that most people don't do the readings and gives hints a lot. Its a discussion based class so be prepared to talk.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is by far one of the best professors at Virginia Tech. She gets to know all of her students beyond just their names and is genuinely caring. The class is a fair amount of work, but she is very reasonable with grading, and the material is really interesting, so most people shouldn't have a problem with it. I could not recommend this class more.

I really like this professor. She has clear expectations and genuinely cares for her students. You can tell she's passionate about her job and what she teaches. It's easy to build a good relationship with her, and if you answer questions in class, you will easily earn an A. I would 100% take another class of hers
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: In my personal opinion, Dr. Olson is one of the best professors here at Virginia Tech. She is beyond caring, and will go out of her way to make sure her students are thriving. Her knowledge of the subjects covered in class is impressive to say the least. Overall, an incredible professor, if you're thinking about taking a class with her, 100% do it.

Dr. Olson is one of the most understanding professors you will ever have. She understands if you need a mental health day. The class is heavy on discussions in person. The assignments are weekly, with one big final project at the end of the semester. Definitely suggest taking this class with Dr. Olson if you can!
She is a really nice Professor and she makes sure you actually learn and helps you out a lot so you dont fail

Dr Ortez was a fantastic professor whose exams were laughably easy. Attendence is required and have in class assignments almost every class. However, he's a very nice guy with good lectures and teaches the content well through the in-class assignments, and again, the exams are veryyy easy.

Cold calls because he knows that no one pays attention. You have a class activity every lecture, so attendance is mandatory. I would literally rather scrub the Centros toilet than be in this class ever again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Nice enough guy and I learned about in class but he was not very student-friendly.  I will SUGGEST 3 hour podcasts or 3 readings, and then give pop quizzes or make students stand up and present on them the next class. Made us come to class during finals week after all other finals to present because he didn't plan enough presentation days.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment:
Not the worst class I've ever had. Quizzes are random.
He will post things that are "recommended" reading then next class period act like it was required, usually these were 3 hour business startup videos.  Also tried to make class mandatory in finals week. This was his first year teaching I think, so it may just be an adjustment year.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I would leave negative stars if I could. For the love of everything that is good do not take his class. The class itself would be wonderful if it wasn't run by someone who cares more about his class then his students. I hope you don't make many spelling mistakes, because it'll cost you 30% of your grade. Literally.

worst professor in the vt cs department in my opinion. his lectures are so out of date and his office hours were never helpful. whenever me or my group tried to talk to him about hw or projects, he would give vague answers and directions that he would often double back on. do not take class with him if possible.
Don't take him!

Dr. Balci is very blunt and strict, but he knows what he's talking about and I learned a lot from his class. As long as you are particular about the assignment details and you show that you're invested in the class, it should be a relatively easy course and it shouldn't be difficult getting an A. Very helpful in office hours too.
Do not take him, there is a reason why most people advise not to take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very disrespectful and rude.  Ask a wrong question and get made fun of in front of the class. Interrupted a student's presentation to ask him "Where did you go to primary school", his content is outdated anyways its a mostly worthless class. You'll probably get an A but gain little value

Dr. Balci is a smart man and I believe he is a hard worker. As a professor, I don't have too many good things to say about him. His attitude towards students is aggravating and it turns students off from asking questions/engaging in lecture. The course itself is extremely outdated, and the assignments are extremely time-consuming.
Don't dare make a mistake in this class or ask a question, because he will ridicule you. Worst professor i have ever had.

Dr. Balci was funny and lenient--in our semester he got rid of all due dates to "test our maturity" and ended up getting rid of the last project since so many were behind. I'm not sure if he's still doing this since we failed his "test" so bad, but it was nice for us at least. This was also probably the most enjoyable CS class I've taken at VT.

Highly recommend not taking any class with Balci. The material in this course involves a time consuming amount of copying and pasting code from his tutorials. He does not know how to communicate with students in a respectful manner. He is disrespectful and if you go to him for help, he will either be rude or entirely unhelpful. AVOID this professor
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
I took both 3714 and 3754 this past semester. In no way is it an easy, it requires time. However, if you dedicate the proper amount of time (12 hours per project) you will get an easy A in the class. 

Something I found helpful was his generous office hours, as long as he is in his office he will help you (usually 9-5 M-F) 

Highly recommend

Professor. Balci greatly changed his course from when he taught it a few years prior. He gave extensions on every project, and the TAs graded assignments very leniently so if you miss a UI component you'll only lose a few points. Roughly 55% of the Spring Semester's class got an A as their final grade.

Balci has been a better professor given his bad reputation. He was lenient this semester, giving us lots of extensions. 

You will learn how to use Swift but the apps he has us make can be pretty repetitive and you do the same time-consuming things over and over (like manually parsing APIs). 

Each assignment takes 8-14 hours which was a lot.

I truly believe Balci is over hated. The mobile development course was not that hard to get an A if you follow and do all of the tutorials. Time management is crucial. Although the class is time consuming, in our last 3 assignments we were given generous time extensions. He can be a bit harsh sometimes but overall I learned a lot from the class.

Professor is downright horrendous! I had the unfortunate opportunity of taking this class for an elective and I must say, I would rather try and survive 12 rounds with prime Mike Tyson than to take this class again. He's an extremely harsh grader and his attendance rules are obscene.

Balci is probably the rudest professor I've encountered at VT. Don't even think of asking a question or you will be ostracized in front of the class. It's a shame because the class has the potential to be interesting, but he does not lecture except for making you copy and paste his code. I would take the class again if he's not teaching it.

This class is awful. The workload is atrocious. Assignments are back to back with each assignment taking 2 to 3 times the estimated time to complete. Assignment specifications are vague. The amount of work for this course is unreasonable and the course design is frustrating. Expect no help from Balci when working on the assignments.

The lectures are inadequate. The coursework is confusing, repetitive, and outdated.

You're given code with little explanation. Any questions you have aren't answered well and the professor shames you for asking.

The course is listed as 3 credits, but expect to spend 40 hours a week working on the assignments.

Absolutely terrible professor. I visited office hours for two problems, he hounded me about the tutorials for the first problem, and the second problem he did not help me with. He just refused to help me with my problem and told me to leave even though there was nobody else waiting during office hours. He is the most pretentious professor here.
Balci rants about Elon Musk and wastes your time every class day. Only take if you want to be stressed out about a class with NO late submissions and reducing your grade if you miss class.

Honestly one of the most disrespectful professors I have ever had. He does NOT care about your grade or you as a student. For every project, you have to copy and paste his code and then manipulate it to work for your assignment. This class is not an easy A and about every student I have talked to hates his class, even the TAs don't like him. CS3754

Quite mediocre. Many spots, but not much substance. It's easy to pass, if you are able to study on your own. Quite humoral, changes its mind. It looks like he doesn't really know deeply what he is talking about.

I took iOS with Balci. He knows his stuff very well and his tests are easy but he will screw u up on the final proj (25%). You will be graded solely on whether he likes ur app or not. Worst of all, he changes his mind every day on what he told you to do. I had 105% (+extra credit) average and ended up with a C because he didn't like my final app

This prof relates his material well.  If you pay attention in class, he'll outline the tests pretty much word-for-word.  Exams are made up exactly from quiz problems.  His course taught me a lot of "buzz words" that while not being particularly useful, have assisted in making me look better in job interviews.  Talks lots about the DoD.
Amazing woman who you can learn a lot from. Super easy going and understanding as long as you are respectful.

Cannot recommend enough. She is the most caring, funny, and kind professor. Go to her office hours and establish a relationship with her, you will not regret it. She cares deeply about each of her students and if you demonstrate you care about her class, you will excel. She loves teaching and what she teaches. Possibly best teacher I've ever had.

SPES 2244 - Dr. Ozzie is so sweet and loves getting to know her students. Anyone who likes to cook should take this class; it is so much fun! The second exam is a bit difficult but if you study you can still get an A in the class. Only 5 assignments all semester and it is easy to do well if you care. Looking forward to taking more of her classes!
I had 2 one hour lectures a week + a two-hour cooking lab; she is so funny and fun to be around. Great teacher and a great TA's. TAKE (spes2244) for pathways and a fun time.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Ozzie was one if the few professors that made me feel like a person and not just a number. She would comment on my assignments very personally and everything she said was with encouragement. I could tell she really wanted her students to succeed. Not only is Dr. Ozzie a great professor but also an all-around great person with a huge heart.

Professor Ozzie is my favorite professor at Tech. If you're interested in global food security, her classes are a must. Great lectures, but she only grades on 4 big projects (25% each). two of them are easy, but her two tests are quite difficult. In order to get an A on them, you have to memorize every PowerPoint slide and then some.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Bob is a really great lecturer and as long as you attend class you will get a good grade as many test questions are pulled from lectures. There are not many assignments which can be tedious but are not very difficult. Bob does his best to make the lectures interesting even if you don't care for the material and it is definitely worth attending.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bob's lectures are very refined and only include what he feels is necessary and is very knowledgeable about what he lectures. There is no point of taking notes in class as the slides are content heavy and exam questions are usually based off what he said in class (he does post slides). Some of the assignments were annoying though. Loved his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bob = awesome. He talks a lot during lectures. Very knowledgeable about topics and inspiring. Lecture tip -- dont bother trying to take notes, he goes too fast, focus because his tests are ALWAYS modeled off stuff he says. If you dont go to class tests can be tough but if you go to class and think critically about questions ur set. Really good prof

Professor Oliver is an amazing lecturer. His lectures are very engaging for everyone and I found them interesting even though I wouldn't consider myself interested in hum geo. The tests are all online and open note. It is very easy with few assignments and a very interesting class for anyone overall. A great choice for an easy credit.
Bob is a total G absolutely love him. He's very passionate about what he teaches as well as his students. Overall just a genuinely good guy and professor.

I enjoyed Bob's lectures; he does a good job including material relevant to all majors. As long as you keep track of the other assignments because he doesn't always mention them in the lecture, you will be good! All assignments and tests are online btw
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class for pathways credit. Very easy to do well without attending class as long as you complete all the assignments on time. There are not too many assignments anyway. He posts all the lecture slides on canvas as well. Very interesting class!
Excellent lecturer, assignments can sometimes be annoying but are not really rigorous. Tests are very easy, as long as you turn assignments in on time then you will be good.

I loved this class and prof. Oliver. He makes his lectures entertaining and easy to follow. You may not enjoy the class if you aren't interested in the topic(obviously) but if you're into geography this class and prof. Oliver are great. He very obviously knows the subject in and out and he cares for his students very much.

Bob is great, although sometimes his lectures turn into TedTalks and you are unsure if you should be taking notes haha. The tests are open note and take home so as long as you go to his lectures and pay attention they will be a breeze. The assignments are few and far between and rather enjoyable to complete as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is very knowledgable and enjoyable to hang around.
Dr. Oliver was very nice and accommodating, made class enjoyable and could keep the students attention.

Dr. Oliver is an amazing professor. He's relatable, funny, and a great professor to have if you're a first year. He's a storyteller and ties it into his lectures and that makes it so interesting and gravitating. He's got a beautiful energy and uses his intelligence and his life experiences to enlighten his learners and is passionate about it too!

Oliver is one of the best lecturers I've had. He has a way of turning a tedious topic into something exciting for everyone. The biggest problem with him is the homework. The homework is only loosely related to the lectures and requires far too many outside sources. While I would not take him again, he is still very good.

This class was one of my least favorite classes I have taken at Virginia Tech. Bob is very disrespectful to his students and makes it very obvious he doesn't care about our success. Lectures are very boring, assignments are super long, but the tests are pretty easy. Don't take a class with him unless you want to be miserable all semester.

Often goes off-topic during lectures and is very funny. The class itself is extremely interesting and he posts the lecture slides online. Tests are a bit hard with the majority of the grade being long, short answer questions. There were a few assignments that were lengthy but mostly homework is posting on a discussion board about the lecture.

One of my favorite professors, he was so engaging and made sure to get to know students despite it being a big lecture. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I would recommend attending regularly because it will benefit you on the tests. Overall, the class was fun and Bob is hilarious!

Summer course had 40-50 minute monotone lectures a week with sometime over 50 pages of reading. The lectures are uploaded to canvas so you can't find information through transcript like Youtube. Made me fall asleep after working my summer internship. Tests were just cherry picking all the readings and lectures. Majority of test questions are essay.

One of the best professors I have had at tech. He was so caring and made every lecture interesting. His tests were all online and he made all the questions based on his PowerPoints which he gives you. The class is extremely interesting so it wasn't hard to go to class and pay attention. He is always there to help and is an amazing person overall
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bob is one of the kindest people at Virginia Tech, and his lectures are attention-grabbing. You'll also learn how to use UrbanFootprint, which is a big plus, but the most memorable part of the class is the man himself. He clearly loves the material he is teaching, and makes you care too.

Bob is the best professor I have had at Tech. He does a great job of making his material fun and easy to understand. As long as you come to class and take good notes, you shouldn't have any problems. I would recommend Bob to anyone looking to take a class in GEOG.
I took his intro to human geography online it was awesome, the best asynchronous class I have taken. I am taking his class in sustainable urbanization next semester and can't wait.

I really enjoyed this class, and I would definitely take it again if I could! The course material is very interesting. Homework and studying is not too bad if you pay attention during the lectures and read the PowerPoint slides. Bob is an amazing professor and a really nice guy. He clearly shows that he cares a lot about his students.

Dr. Oliver is so funny and keeps this class interesting! I had an in-person lecture and I am so glad I signed up for his class. You have to take notes and pay attention to do well but there is no textbook. The class is somewhat discussion based with little assignments plus you have 3-4 bigger assignments and 3-4 exams.
the tests kick your ass but he's a great teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He went through powerpoints too fast and didn't teach any material but he joked around all class. He didn't tell us there was gonna be a test until a few days before and then said "my tests are REALLY hard so don't think you can just get an A." Yet he taught us nothing. I dropped the class cuz I didn't need the course/credit. Overall not the best.
Honestly one of the best professors here. So funny, and tells great stories. Makes lectures really interesting. Tests are super hard though, short answer and essay questions
This class was really easy. He posts all the slides online before the tests but if you want to get an A take notes on what he says in class and do all the readings.

Great professor!! Made intro to human geography super interesting. Lectures were very easy to follow and kept you listening. Made jokes throughout his lectures and relates to students. No textbook but in order to do well on tests you have to do the assigned readings. If you have the opportunity, have him as your professor!!!!!!

Bob definitely knew what he was teaching and works hard to make his lectures interesting. He takes random attendance using TopHat, but you want to go to class anyways because a lot of the time he includes pictures from his powerpoint on a test and asks you to write what was discussed.
Dr. Bob made this class so interesting and spoke on important issues with a refreshingly respectful and insightful perspective.

Take Bob for your intro class, you won't regret it!  His lectures are entertaining and he is hilarious and fun.  His tests consist of anything from his lectures so just write down the important slides to make your own study guide. Assignments aren't hard, show up to class for the random participation grades.
Bob was a great teacher but you also have to work hard for the grade. He is an outgoing and friendly professor.

Bob may possibly be one of my favorite professors at Tech. Although his class was definitely not an easy A, and his exams were tough - he's very personable and tries to be friends with his students. Also, his lectures are really interesting. Introduce yourself and he'll remember you.

He's fantastic. Very funny guy. He's lectures are pretty interesting for the most part. He gave a lecture on the geography of graffiti, which was really awesome. He tries to make geography an interesting subject.

Awesome teacher! everything is easy with the class. You need to study for his exams though, they are pretty tough. you have to examine every slide he gives you because he will ask the most miscellaneous questions from them. Also, attend class because he likes to draw some questions from class.

I took this class because I thought it sounded interesting: "Geography of North America". Turned out to be a HISTORY class since that's all he taught us. He's a pretty nice guy but a tough grader. I wish I had not signed up for this class because it was very uninteresting.
Very cool teacher. Super nice. Very entertaining and does a lot of in class activities so you can meet your classmates.

Great teacher, he does talk fast but pay attention and take good notes. Very personable and will help you if you ask. Some how knows all 60 students names in 2 months. Make sure to study for his tests though. They can kick your ass! (fill in the blank, short essay, multiple choice)
emebo is the goat

CLASS STRUCTURE: Intro random topic start of the week, code basic programs for topic by Friday.
STRATEGY: Go to office hours! TAs know their stuff and will help. Hard to learn the material as quick as they want, so you NEED help. Classwork/HW are bulk of the grade, so don't slack.

Professor is very caring and will help with anything. NO late work.

CS 2114 uses a flipped classroom (all lectures are videos from Margaret Ellis that you watch out of class) so your professor isn't that important. In classes, however, he will go through the weekly coding challenges and give you tips on them. Got a B+ since I did all my projects late, but overall, he's a very passionate and friendly professor.

I had an 8 am session with him, I would say he's the chillest professor I have ever encountered. I remember I missed the midterm due to overslept (if you missed the midterm, you failed the class), he gave me a second chance of taking the exam without hesitation. Coolest guy. I'm going to have him next semester, I'm really looking forward to it
he's a G. your professor doesn't actually matter for this class but i think he's cool.
Enjoyed the class. He's just chill.
Very good professor. Very chill and laid back guy. He'll help you if you ask him for it.

The class itself is pretty interesting since it touches on a variety of different CS-related topics. The HW is pretty easy (mostly just completion points except for the 1st one) and the exams are pretty easy too. However, the Piazza was almost never monitored by Emebo or the TA, which kinda sucked when you had questions on the homework

UNFAIR GREADER! The teaching assistant has the preference of who he wants to give an A instead of who deserves an A. Awful experience with the lecture. Only the first couple of weeks have seen Dr. Barry, instead, there was a post-doc as a lecturer with a huge language barrier.  350 words could not express my hurt and angry feelings at all!!!!!!!!!!

Deceptive promises of high grades are made and broken, discouraging course withdrawals. Lecture quality is abysmal, limited to monotonous PowerPoint reading, and student emails are ignored. Overall, a highly unsatisfactory experience.

reviews.comment: Hardest of the vibrations professors. Avoid.

Dr. Rao is one of my favorite professors at Virginia Tech. I took ISE4984: Special Study on Metal Additive Manufacturing with him. He was extremely passionate about the subject and such a nice guy. The coursework this year was very easy.

I've had Dr. Rao for 2 classes. I enjoyed having him as a professor for both classes. There was a lot of unnecessary drama caused by a slim majority of the class that made the experience not as enjoyable towards the end. He wants you to succeed and gives everything necessary for that to happen. Ended up dropping 3 of 7 exams.

reviews.comment: Dr. Rao is the goat. I wont accept any slander towards him. Dropped 3 out of 7 exams for everyone.

reviews.comment:
There's a lot of drama in this class, and as a student, it's quite concerning. I'm not here to judge Dr. Rao, I want to address the class structure. Students aren't well prepared for tests. Tests average is very low,need ofcurve

He was also pretty funny and starts every lecture with a star wars quote.

She reads off the slides and class is boring. No one can understand her. There are lots of McGraw hill assignments, but they are super easy. If I actually wanted to learn something, I would've wanted another professor. She gives a lot of extra credit, because she knows her students don't pay attention.

This girl only reads off of the slides, which makes going to class pretty annoying Attendance for most days is mandatory but you have a few attendance/in class assignment drops. Unfortunately her class is madatory for HNFE students but other than that if you can avoid her I would.

Dr. Parker simply read off the slides, going to class was pointless but mandatory for extra credit and certain assignments. I didn't pay attention to lectures because you can teach yourself the material which is easy, and get a good grade. Taking her class isn't avoidable for some majors, its an easy class but unbearable to listen to the lectures.

The class overall was not too difficult, but she did not do a good job teaching it. The lectures consisted of her reading directly off the slideshows and not actually teaching. Assignments were very time consuming and often were very tedious, and I basically had to teach myself all the course material outside of class because she was not helpful.
dr. parker read directly off the slides. you could've taught yourself the material. she gives so much extra credit so you don't have to worry about a low grade.

Her lectures were so incredibly boring, but her class overall was easy. She reads the slides word for word the entire lecture. There is a lot of homework but it's very easy and tests were exactly like the study guide. Overall, I would take her if you need an easy A just be prepared for the boring lectures.
All she does is read a slide show word for word for an hour. I could've not gone to class and taught myself and gotten the same grade

This class was very easy, I am just not a fan of her teaching style. Lectures are very boring because she just reads through the slides word for word the majority of class time. There are also in-class assignments pretty much every class. Attendance is mandatory for the in-class assignments and if you attend most classes- you get extra credit.

It is hard to fail this class because she gives out a lot of extra credit. Very assignment heavy but it isn't too bad because it bumps up your grade. Tests are easy if you study. She pretty much reads off slides the whole class so I tune her out. Overall just mid as a teacher but it's an easy course.

Dr. Parker is genuinely a pretty nice person. However, she needs to work on her teaching style students don't benefit from professors just reading off a slide. Her extra credit opportunities are however very nice.

Dr. Parker is a genuinely sweet person, but her lecture style could use work. She reads verbatim off of the lecture slides which is annoying because it's the exact same material that has already been read/quizzed on. There are only two exams so I highly recommend doing her study guides. They set you up well for exams + count for extra credit.

reviews.comment: Her lectures consist of her reading directly off the slides, so they're useless, but attendance is extra credit and class activities require attendance. Lots of extra credit opportunities, but also a lot of worksheets and assignments that are super time consuming. The study guides are good and tests are easy, just a ton of long homework assignments

she is okay professor and the class is not hard. attendance is somewhat mandatory with there being in class activities. its not hard just kind of a waste of time because she is literally reading the slides word for word

Half the class is cheating on exams and HW and he doesn't do anything about it. I feel bad getting a lower grade than my peers who got a higher grade than me by using AI on exams. Other than that..ok overall...wouldn't take this course if there was any other option.

reviews.comment: if you can get out of taking this class I recommend you do he doesnt like teaching this class and it shows

He is not a good teacher and doesn't like teaching the class. Prepare to teach yourself attendance wasn't mandatory. He gets mad if not enough people show up to class and gives pop quizzes. The material itself is not hard Hes a bad grader and doesnt have things graded from the start of the semester He is impossible to reach outside of class
Good Professor. A bit old-fashioned in using a chalkboard. Have to do the minimal amount of work to get a good grade.

Yeah hes a good guy and is funny but ultimately is bad at teaching. Just be prepared to have to teach yourself alot of stuff. Hes very vague when going over new material and moves through things very quickly. Usually doesnt give great answers when answering questions and gives lots of homework and the tests can bring your grade down alot.

Okay prof for geometry for design. Biggest note is that it is IMPOSSIBLE to reach him. He doesn't respond to emails and was never in his office when I went by. Only way to reach him is in class or during office hours. Was on the verge of sending him smoke signals or a carrier pigeon because he was so hard to reach.

I took this as my math credit for architecture and the class did not have much to do with it he also used chatgpt to show how it relates because he himself didn't know. I understand that this lecture is more calc heavy, but it seemed like we only did calc and no geometry. He also just gives practice problems the whole class instead of teaching.
Solid professor go to office hours if you have never taken calculus before

Professor Parija only goes through practice problems in class. You are expected to teach yourself. He takes off points for minor mistakes and doesn't give out any extra credit. You are better off taking the course online.

He atleast cares about his students, however his class is a flipped classroom so you never really learn much, and he takes lots of points off of your exam for very small mistakes. If your new to calculus, avoid this professor. Better off learning online than going to lectures. Also lots of homework.

Parija is very poor at teaching for someone who struggles with Calc. Like other reviews, he does teach like you already know calculus, and never explains topics in class, just does practice problems. His exams are meant to make you fail, and no curve is given. Your better off learning calculus online then in his class.

If you are seeing calculus for the first time; the way his class is structured you will not pass.He has a flipped classroom in which all the lectures where you learn topics are online.Meanwhile, class is just him doing example problems the entire time.The video lectures not it, this whole course is taught under the assumption you have taken calc 1
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Loved Mr. P (aka Bossman), he was very funny, and I didn't have faith in him in the beginning, but he sure shocked me, and once I started studying I did well and was very happy with Mr. P. Thanks again Bossman

Dr. P, AKA Boss, was my favorite professor in my first semester of college. He was humorous, relatable, and made the class enjoyable (to me at least). If you're taking calculus for the first time, go to class, ask questions, and go to office hours. He teaches this class as if every student has calculus experience. Lastly, He is spotty with emails.

MATH 1225 (Calc 1) is a very difficult course, hence the 4 difficulty rating. Mr. P was a good teacher, he really outlined how to think about certain concepts or problems clearly. If you want to do well in this course, you need to work on practice problems and study outside of class multiple hours a week. You'll thank yourself later.

Absolute GOAT professor, Super easy grader. Easy A if u turn ur stuff in on time. Attendance is "Mandatory" but i barely showed up to class and barely lost any points. 3 Essays make up a majority of your grade, all of which are graded to an A average and you can revise them. Rest of the grade is freebies.
Cool person and crack some jokes in class, but only one thing, too much writing homework and all your grade is based on your homework.

Prof Patton is a super understanding guy. I showed up to probably less than half of the classes and was still 0.1% away from an A in the class. Just read the rubrics and do the papers. They are super easy and he is an easy grader too.
Was super chill about due dates, I literally forgot to turn in a paper and he let me turn it in late without any penalty. If you follow the prompts you'll get A's.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: For ENGL-1106 he was honestly pretty good. He didn't assign ridiculously high word counts and gave pretty obvious hints to get good grades on papers. As long as you read through the rubrics above all else you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very engaging lectures, easy homework, good reading list. Definitely a good teacher and an easy A
Really awkward humor that'll make you laugh! Super easy class if you just do what he tells you to do.
He's an awesome teacher!  I'd definately recommend him if you are looking for a teacher who knows his stuff and gives only a manageable amount of work to do.

Hilarious. Patton is very verbose and is constantly makes witty references during lecture. Class is not mandatory, but helpful. For essay topics, he gives students a fair amount of freedom to write about what they please. He goes over all the logistics and requirements for essays in class. He also has a stellar comb over-beard combo! 100% Epic Win!

Cancells a lot of class. If he forgot to get lunch he would probably cancell class to do so. Just write the essays and you can revise one l8tr and you will do ok. Very boring though. No work other than 3 essays.
Very easy class; one can get a B without doing almost any work. Just write the three essays and participate in the group presentation.  That is all of the work for the semester.

He is a very understanding teacher about topics. Lets you revise your essays and the presentations are not difficult and the group presentation can be fun if you want it to be. I wanted him as my professor for 1106 because 1105 was a good class but he filled up.

Thinks he's funny i.e. if he doesnt give you back your papers on time you can "throw small sharp objects at him". History nerd. Cancels class and you get out early most of the time. Just requires you to do the basics. Not all that fun, but easy. Doesn't take attendance either (even though its supposed to be a part of your grade?)

Having Professor Qiao was a frustrating experience for fluids. His lectures were uninteresting apart from a few jokes and stories he would weave in. It was hard to read his handwriting and he would often mumble during lectures. Barely went over useful practice problems in class so you were on your own to figure out HWs. Brutal tests. Avoid!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Qiao was a decent professor, but his class was very hard. His handwriting is really difficult to read and lectures a little hard to understand. His exams are a lot more difficult than practice. He also weights questions weirdly, you can lose a lot of points for messing up one number even with carry thru points. Canvas grade is not accurate.

Fluid Dynamics was not easy. Select lectures were posted online so you had to go to class to get the notes. The homework was not bad, and the tests resembled processes used during the homework, the tests are still hard. He says he won't curve but if you show up, do the homework, and talk to him he will help you if you need help.

Took fluids with Dr. Qiao. He is a great, old school professor with vast knowledge of the subject. He gave great lectures, but did not post most of them online so you have to go to class to learn the material. Usually had one hw assignment per week with problems from the textbook. Exams were challenging, but doable if you could do the hw
I took Qiao's class for Fluids. He is good lecturer who makes complex topics funny and interesting.

I felt that the lectures and homeworks did not adequately prepare me for the heavily weighted tests. The conceptual part of the exams and graphing were barely covered, so most of the class lost many points on the tests. It is nice that homework is a completion grade and the workshops ended up being extra credit, but I would not take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pedro is a great professor, as long as you have someone answering his questions during the lectures. He tries to make class interactive by asking questions about the material, but if no one answers, he just sits there and then goes back 5 slides to cover material that he just spent 20 minutes covering. Just answer his questions & you'll be fine.

Pedro is caring, and is knowledgable and enthusiastic about econ, but his lectures just aren't very good. In 3 classes per week, there were very little moments of actual content that we needed to know for assignments and exams. 
Overall, the class isn't very difficult and if you go to every lecture and the TA office hours you will get a good grade

Dr. Quieroz is a kind and knowledgeable professor. But, his lectures can be tough to follow as he tends to go in circles on certain topics. The majority of the class is lectures. There are a few class exercises throughout the semester that act as class participation. Comes to class, complete assignments, and attend TA office hours to do well.

he is a kind person but the worst teacher. it was easier to self teach than listen to lecture because he went around in circles and only read off slides. tests were really hard because he made them himself and does not give out study guides. exams will make or break your grade becde

Dr Vertino is a nice, but is not good at teaching.  His tests are worded poorly, and some of the questions are stuff we never learned.  He only reads off the slides.  Over half of the class doesn't do well on tests, and he doesn't really help you learn.
I would give a lower rating of possible, 1 star is being too generous. Please save yourself the money, the time, and your own well-being and avoid him.

His tests are usually on different material than the certifications. He also gave extra credit assignments, but then cut how much it was worth in half. Overall if you can avoid his class I highly recommend doing so.

If you are approaching your freshman year at Virginia Tech let me do you the biggest favor ever. Do NOT take this class. Nottingham is an extremely condescending professor that does not want his students to succeed. If you like listening to hour long lectures of someone that sounds unsatisfied with life then take this class. Worst class ever at VT.

Homework is assigned through his online system. Lectures are pre-recorded and poorly done. Scoring 100s on the homework was tough, but doable. The quizzes and tests contain types of problems that the homework and lectures don't, and they have a ridiculous time limit. Everything is graded automatically. No partial credit and no curve. Avoid.

Good and accommodating teacher overall.
I looked on this website and didn't change out, you should

Nottingham did not exhibit any respect towards students. He said attendance wasn't mandatory so I skipped his class and got Chegg to use on the HW. Worst professor I've ever had, do not take this class under any circumstances

He doesn't communicate with his students. He refuses to respond to emails unless they have to do with scheduling. Rude in class, there is a lot of homework that is assigned that does not even remotely prepare you for the ungodly difficult tests and quizzes. This is my most hated class I have ever taken, I don't understand how he is still a prof. here when he does such a mediocre job at teaching. I beg of you DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS.

taking this class online over the summer.  his lectures are dull and does an awful job of explaining his process to the class.  makes many mistakes during lectures.  his online quizzestests do not allow you to go back to a question once answered and he does not provide feedback (what questions you missed). however course is doable with effort.

Everything about the class sucks. He is not the best lecturer, goes really fast, and doesn't give you all the notes and examples that you need to be successful. His GA grades homework extremely difficulty and is the only class where I've ever been hurt by a homework grade. Whether I pass or not remains to be seen, but if you can, dont take him.

Nottingham is the worst professor I have ever had in my life. I am hoping that one day someone from the BIT department reads this and realizes that he needs to be removed. If you do get stuck in his class and cannot get out, make sure you go to every class and study his PowerPoints and the textbook for tests. The class is unnecessarily hard.

Absolute worst professor I have ever had. Ever. He refused to help and got annoyed when a question was asked, and if he answered it at all, he answered it with a serious attitude. DO NOT TAKE IT ONLINE. Take it in person with someone else. (Life saved, you're welcome).

By far one of the worst teachers at this school. He does not understand how to explain the material in simpler terms. His tests and quizzes are impossible. I went to his office hours and he still could not explain the material well to me 1 on 1. People with other teachers do not even attend class and they have a better grade than I do

Without a doubt one of the worst professors I have had during my academic career at VT. Very smart person but he just doesn't know how to teach. Not very helpful either. I get a distinct feeling that he almost wants his students to do poorly in his class.

He really knows what he is talking about. However he cannot deliver the material to the class. He is very rude and get upsets when students don't know the answer to a type of problem he hasn't even explained how to do.
Grades harsh, has pop quizzes at 8am. Takes 50 points off if homework isn't turned in when class starts (even if you're 10 minutes late). Basically don't miss class and you'll be ok.

Tough teacher. Tended to breeze through material as if we were all upper-level stat majors. Pretty unhelpful outside of class. I don't doubt his knowledge of the subject matter, but it was taught very poorly.
jiji
He may have good grasp of subject but couldn't deliver it to the class.
He gives the toughest tests!!

His class is very boring, he has an extremely mono tone voice and there is a lot of dead time in his lecture. He is the worst teacher I have ever had.

Amazing teacher! If you go to class you will understand things so much better. Doing the Hawkes assignments is defintely annoying but I really liked that we had to do them because they are a grade booster and force you to learn the information.  It's not an easy class but he's a great teacher and you can do well if you put forth a little effort.
No Comments

If you want to feel like an idiot just raise your hand in his class...One day someone asked a question and his exact words: "Thats just common sense...any other questions?".  I do enjoy however that although hes smart, he'll still use the word "Aks" instead of "Ask"  ..the ghettoness showing through

i got an A in BIT 2405 and then when i got nottingham for 2406 i barely pulled off a C. he's smart but he doesnt take the time to explain things well, and doesnt understand why everyone else isnt as smart as he is. i went to his office at least 5 times and never once got any actual help you could tell he was annoyed that i was even asking a questio
She is a very sweet person and honestly doesn't deserve the bad reviews. Her lectures are kinda boring and its kinda annoying that class is mandatory but its not a hard class if you show up.

Doesn't explain the topics well then spams I-Clicker questions which are worth the majority of your grade. She gives no time to setup before spamming i-clickers and then goes on 15 minute tangents about thailand. She refuses to adjust grades no matter what.

The worst professor ive ever had. She will not adjust grades and just pulls up her copy pasted email about how her grading policy is designed to be flexible in case of issues instead of actually resolving issues. She also may leave class for 3 weeks with almost no notice leaving TAs to do her job.

reviews.comment: Very good professor for Econ 2005, she made the class material easy to understand and fun
Her class isnt that hard, but she can be confusing sometimes.

She is very enthusiastic. 8am class was tough so try for another section. IClicker heavy so make sure you go to this class and answer your iclicker because it is an easy grade boost. Exams are all take-home. Go to class and try to pay attention. Lots of material so review often and people leaving bad scores clearly skip class & have no notes

She does not deserve the bad reviews on rate my professor. She clearly enjoys her job which makes class more enjoyable. There are a lot of in class assignments and iClickers, but she drops the two lowest for each category which is really nice. She also gives a lot of extra credit in fun ways that make the lessons fun and memorable.

Dr. T is a good teacher. She made class engaging with her experiments, life stories, and enthusiasm. Although the iClicker can be challenging, she will reward you with a score of 100 if you maintain a score above 75%. The HW is VERY SIMILAR to the tests, so use them to study, and I can assure you that the exams will be a breeze.

A lot of your grade depends on ICLICKER QUESTIONS that she never taught us and gives us little to no time to answer. Iclicker always crashes during that class so you miss half of the questions and don't even end up getting credit. Attendance is basically required as it is part of ur grade.

Genuinely the worst class I have been in, she assigns these f-ass assignments which don't show up in canvas and like 50 I clicker questions.
Plays k-pop demon hunters at 8 am to “wake people up”. This is genuinely even more worse than the class itself. If you have to take this class just don't do the 8 am.
annoying class
