reviews.comment: I know she has a lot of negative reviews but I think she was a good professor. As long as you show up to class to do the iClickers and do the homework you're set. I recommend you take her class in a smaller class size.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She gets a bad rep on RMP, but honestly, not bad for ECON 2005, for an 8 am class, she brought the energy and made it possible for us to succeed.

She was alright. Attendance isn't mandatory but there's so many in class things, so it basically is unless you want a bad grade. Her tests were somewhat difficult and we didn't have a whole lot of time to answer in class things. Not a bunch of assignments so you really gotta do good on what you're given. Anyways I'd take it again but def lock in
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I entered this year worried as I saw her low score on this website. Genuinely don't be fooled.  But Yes, she does a lot of i-clickers and pop quizzes, but they are very easy, trivial at times. The tests can be a bit difficult but never feel impossible. Her lectures and notes are amazing and easy to follow. Spends a lot of time helping students.

Dr. T is not a bad person, but she's not the best professor. I really struggled in her class due to the difficulty of the exams. I think the content should've been broken down in a simpler format to be understood to a better degree. Go to class even though she says you can miss a few days, the Iclicker is so important to your grade.
She gives no time to do in class problems and will screw you over on assignments and access to the textbook causing your cumulative grade to plumet, this class feels like treading water

A lot of your grade depends on iclicker assignments that she never taught us and gives us little to no time to answer. Iclicker always crashes during that class so you miss half of the questions and she says she can't fix it or give you the credit.

She was an amazing teacher! She does have in class participation questions, however, they're very helpful to actually learning the content. Weekly homework was long, but it was posted in advance and very manageable. Exams are difficult , so be prepared, but they're open note(as of Fall 2024). An awesome class and I feel like I actually learned!!

I loved this class and Dr. T. She is very positive and truly wants to see her students succeed. She gives good examples and explains topics well. You will be successful if you show up and take notes. iClicker is used often during class. There was a lot of extra credit given out for exams and the final exam.
She gets too much hate. Just go to class, and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Attendance really matters to your grade, which was hard for me with a 9 am, but missing any class tanked my grade. The homework is honestly pretty easy, and she gives you lecture notes in class, so follow along with those and make your own notes in the margins and the homework will be fine. The tests are sometimes strangely difficult, so look out.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I don't get why this professor has such a low rating when she was great! I had her for Macro (Econ 2006) and the class wasn't too difficult as long as you paid attention to lectures. Make sure to come to all classes as a good portion of your grade will determined on I-clickers and the pop quizzes!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is very passionate and cares about her students, but make sure to study a lot for the tests. Overall, the homework was manageable as long as you went to class and took notes.

she gives more i-clicker questions in her lecture compared to actual teaching. In one of her lectures she gave 10 i-clicker questions in the first 7 minutes and mind you this was during a hurricane when most students were delayed.  i-clickers made up around 22% of the grade.

Dr T was a good person but not the greatest professor. Her explanations constantly made things more confusing then it should've and raced through the material. Taught myself more through the textbook more then her office hours

That class isn't too difficult but you do have to come to class at least 75% of the time to get a good participation grade. She gives some extra credit points but not alot. I ended with an 89.9% and she refused to round it up even though I came to all the classes and her office hours. All the tests are online.

class noteven that bad fr jus gotta lock in and TRY to attend every lecture as it will benefit you in the long run considering the participation on the iclickers. Try to do the econlab before she starts going over the chapter in class as you'll have a better understanding for the iclickers/thinkpairshare. She got bad reviews but honestly it not bad
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. T is a very nice person and does care about her students don't get me wrong but the class, however, is just awful. She will tell you at the beginning of the year that class is not mandatory, and it is not, if you want your grade to tank. She has daily iClicker questions with multiple per class, often left for the last 5 minutes of the period.

This professor is genuinely so awful. she makes it a goal to see her students fail the class as she has no empathy and bombards you with pop quizzes, iclicker every class, and genuinely replies to no emails. she does not put homework due dates on canvas, and refuses to boost grades at the end of the semester even by .5. DO NOT.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Attendance is mandatory through roughly 7 iClicker questions every class. She does not post the Homework on Canvas so it is easy to forget to do it. The pop quizzes (Think Pair Shares) have a large sway in your grade and vary in difficulty.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr.T was a great professor! Attendance is mandatory, but you can miss some. I clicker everyday and "pop" quizzes which were in class and easy. You could get a 75% on the clicker questions and receive a 100% in the grade book. Also LOTS of extra credit which helps a lot. Not sure why she got bad reviews, she is a great person and professor.

This is BY FAR the worst professor I have ever had! She barrages us with I clicker questions every class, gives random pop quizzes, has a ZERO email policy, doesn't post when things are due on Canvas, and tests you on material in class BEFORE teaching it. There is NEGATIVE leniency and the only material she posts are BLANK notes. AVOID HER PLEASE!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very clear lectures. Makes it easy to understand.

Dr. T is a nice person but a terrible teacher. She is hard to understand and focuses heavily on graded McQs in class. She doesn't teach the curriculum well and then tests you on it in the same class. I recommend doing the homework a week before it is due, as this class was mainly self-taught. The only positive reviews are lying to you.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you have the option to take a different professor for this course please do. This class is extremely attendance and iclicker heavy. There are several iclicker questions a day and "think pair share" assignments given at random. These are basically like pop quiz assignments that are graded (and can be very tricky). Exams also are difficult
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: probably the worst class ive taken at tech

Dr.T is an amazing professor and doesn't deserve the lower scores. Why she has such low scores is because attendance is very important for the class. If you show up to class and actively participate in the Iclicker polls and TPS the grades should be free points. Her exams are all online and can be taken anywhere.
If your looking to learn a lot about econ she is not the professor but to easily get by and get credit is easy. If you go to every class and do IClicker you will pass easily.

I don't know what happened between her previous classes and my class to make her worse than she seemed, but don't let those past reviews fool you; she was actually pretty good! Homework was (mostly) covered by lectures, and tests are almost exactly like the homework and are both remote and open note. iclickers were very fast though. Overall great!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Do not let the ratings fool you; she's great. If you show up to class and pay attention, you will succeed. Dr. T is a very good teacher. She explains everything thoroughly and provides more than enough material and advice to do well on the tests. She also gives a lot of extra credit!

I know her ratings are scary but she isn't a bad teacher. SHOW UP TO CLASS. Very Iclicker heavy, you'll want to get most answers right. There is no making up any lost points on Iclicker even if you have a valid excuse for missing class. However, she gives an incredible amount of extra credit (mostly the day after a test so fr show up to class)

I was very surprised to see Dr.T had bad reviews. I thoroughly enjoyed her class! She works hard to make it relatable and engaging. Yes, attendance is mandatory, and she gives tons of iclickers, but she also does extra credit just for attending. She does lots of drops on iclicker and TPS grades so that you can miss some classes.

She moves fast at times and a lot of the in-class questions can be a bit confusing. I'm just starting to learn econ though and I've been able to grasp it pretty well with her. Take good notes and go to every class you can and you'll be fine. My main gripe is how she is not flexible with grading to any extent so follow deadlines religiously.

Just do well on the MyEconLab (platform she uses for hw and tests) which you can literally complete wherever you want - Yes, even the tests. You can take them in your bed. Just get A's on the hw. There is free tutoring available in Pamplin. Go to the tutoring with any problems you're struggling with on your homework and they'll help you out.

If you have the choice DO NOT TAKE Econ 2005 with Dr. T. She talks about nothing all class then the homework asks questions we never went over. You basically have to teach it to yourself, which sucks because you are paying to BE taught.

Absolutely horrible in every conceivable way, no exaggerating.  Good luck if you're stuck taking her.  It looks like she had terrible reviews at her previous university job too.  Why did Tech even hire her if it was clear she was terrible?
Attendance is absolutely mandatory in this class. I missed

Dr. T was a ridiculously tough grader. I was 0.01% away from the next letter grade and she REFUSED to round it up because she said it was unethical. Anyways, if that didn't tell u that she is not very understanding, then maybe the fact that grades are based on you having to show up to EVERY CLASS can give you a good idea of her teaching style, BAD.

This class is what your high school professors meant when they say "it won't fly in college."  Literally missing a single class session could tank your grade in the course.  She does a good job making each session interactive, but the iClicker and TPS go towards your grade.  DO NOT SLACK OFF.  The exams are unfathomably difficult if you do.

This class was very heavy on iclickers and other iclicker quizzes called TPS, but she was very lenient towards drops and extra credit. She made the class very fun and interacted with her class. She does call on random people but will accept "pass" if you don't want to answer.

The class wasn't good. iClicker questions and TPS made attendance mandatory.  iClicker and TPS are worth 10 and 14 percent of your grade respectively, so if you miss a class or are having some technological problems then you're out of luck. There was one day where the Wi-Fi wasn't working and accessing iClicker was impossible, but she didn't care.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: AWFUL. The "think pair shares" and iclicker polls are an awful teaching "method" that benefits nobody. Half the time, my iclickers wouldn't even send through due to service issues in the lecture hall. Both hurt my grade tremendously. Just do not take her for econ 2005 for the love of god
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You have to go to class because of iClicker, and have the time it doesn't even work. You are mostly graded on the Midterms throughout the semester, and you have a limited amount of time to do them. The class is so big that you can't even talk to her. She goes through the material fast and you don't have the time to process it.

She is not terrible at explaining the material, however she moves VERY quickly and gives only 2 minutes to answer iClicker questions. Her tests are timed so you only get an hour for 24 questions & she scolded the class for having a very low class average for the tests. She is very rude and not understanding when a student has issues of any kind.

Attendance and quizzes were both via iClicker, but it had massive technological problems; each class, around 100 students were unable to log into iClicker. This was brought up many times, but she never cared enough to change it or actually help the students. She does not care if you are struggling in the course, she only wants to finish her lecture
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I've ever had in 4 years of college. Save yourself and don't take her!

Just take my brotherly advice, do not take her. She makes the class tough for students for no absolute reason. She's rude and grumpy usually during the morning classes. She also couldn't bump me up to an A- with .1% which is inhumane.

I found that a lot of time needs to be spent out of class in order for material to make sense in class. So many iclickers that made no sense, and they're graded. And "thick pair shares" during class that also were bad. But she started giving us random extra credit though towards the end of the semester which brought my grade up a lot (B- to B+).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. T is a good professor if you pay attention to and participate in lectures. Missing class really sets you back here because a large chunk of your grade is in class problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. T is not very understanding of out of class issues like sickness, accommodations and sports leave. Attendance to her lectures are mandatory with iClickers and TPS(which is a good portion of your grade). Content taught in lectures can easily be learned through the online textbook and hw problems, which might be better then her lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. T always moved fast with her lectures but if you look over your notes after class you shouldn't have any issues. You always need to show up to class between think pair shares and iclickers though. Overall the class wasn't too bad, but you need to have linear curves and know how to calculate point of intersections. Test questions similar to HW.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: WORST PROFESSOR EVER! she doesn't care about her students at all.

This is my first time writing a bad review,EVER. This is not the kind of professor you would ever want, especially for beginning level courses. Her iclicker makes you attend every class, doesn't really explain the material, and does random things called TPS which is good portion of your grade. Also if failing class by 1 point, she will NOT CURVE

This class made me cry all semester. Was taught way too fast, did not explain things well, unreachable outside of class, ICLICKER/ TPS HEAVY and sometimes the wifi cut out so RIP trying to answer/get credit + little time to answer, this "participation" ruined hopes of passing even tho i went to class. not even an 100 on my final will save me :(

Class was taught too quickly, lectures often a week before an exam would be the next chapter. Attendance is mandatory and expect religious use of iClicker. "Think pair shares" once a week, so sit next to someone smart. Weekly homework is pretty easy but time consuming. Limited time on the tests.

Dr. T is the worst professor I have had at Tech. She is difficult to understand, always wears a mask which makes it even harder. She is not a nice person either. Do not take Dr. T if you have her switch out.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Very manageable class if you are willing to try.
Attendance mandated by iClicker, 75%+ accuracy = 100% on participation
Exams are online, open note via Pearson, VERY similar to the required weekly homework questions, got an A on every exam just by reading and taking notes on the textbook. 
Dr. T is super sweet and offers extra cred readily :)

He is not a nice man. He laughed at my grade even though I only had it because of the impossible quizzes he gives. He doesn't teach from the course plan and if he did it wouldn't matter because he can't teach. I thought I would be able to make it through his class with the help of friends and tutors but I was wrong. He is the WORST. Beware.

A nice, intelligent person, but a horrible teacher. I Spent about 15 additional hours a week trying to teach the material to myself. He gives impossible 3 question quizzes that will lower your overall grade by about 10 points, so even if you do really well on the tests you won't have a good grade. Easily the worst teacher I've ever had.

The only reason I got a B- is because I got tutored from him on my own and help from other teachers. His lectures are confusing and don't match the examples that will be on the exams. I would recommend getting another teacher for this course if you can. He is okay one-on-one and is a nice person, but I wouldn't want him for a teacher ever again.

Professor Quinn is very intelligent but is not very clear in any sense. The first day of class he said you have the same chance of doing well whether you come to class or not. It came off as him being lazy. He may be a good teacher if you already know some ap calc but not if you dont.

Second year with teacher. Although his difficulty completing his own problems without student corrections is frustrating at times, I have to admit that he tries and has gotten a lot better. Prepares examples prior to class more now. Nice teacher, but you don't ask your adorable puppy to teach you integrals.

Second year having professor teaching math (Calculus II,Multi. Var.) and I still regret it. Forgets about quizzes so starts them late. Makes mistakes that have to be corrected by other class students. Often does not prepare examples and has to pause to catch up with himself. In Calc. II could not explain how to solve problems we gave him.

This is my second semester with Professor Quinn. Last semester I had him for 1206 and he was bad then, but now he's even worse. He does example problems that even HE does not understand and he makes mistakes with literally every example he does. He is a very very nice man and his intentions are good, but he is not cut out to be a calculus teacher.
He just did example problems that no one understood. I had to withdraw

Quinn is not a teacher. I went to two of his lectures, syllabus day and the lecture following that. I walked out in the middle of the second when he messed up his own simple problem. Later I saw him attempt to explain something in the math emporium but fail horribly. 1206C as a course can be quite difficult with a terrible teacher.
Boring and complicated sums up everything.

I had the hardest time following his lectures. Most of the time he didn't know what he was doing or couldn't explain himself. I had to have my math major or engineering friends help me with the work, and even they couldn't figure out the way he did the problems. I wouldn't recommend taking his class unless you're proficient in teaching yourself.

The only thing this guy has goin for him is the fact that he looks like Tim Conway. There were countless times when he told the class he didn't know what he was doin and he can't take simple derivatives or integrals.

Professor Quinn is a very intelligent person with a great understanding of Calculus.  He does many example problems and sometimes are hard to follow.  He is a very friendly person and a decent teacher.  The class is mainly online and there is no reason you should not get an A in this class.  You can take the tests 5 times at the Math Emporium.

He's a really nice person. His teaching abilities, however, are a different story. He tries at least. His tests are online and you have a week to take them. You can take practice tests as many times as you want and you can take the real test 5 times and keep the highest score. If you don't get a 100 then it's your fault.
No Comments

Professor Reilly is very personable and nice. He has a decent amount of tests in Retail Mgt but it's all based on lecture material so just go to class and you'll be fine. He likes to occasionally do engaging group work activities which can be fun. I really enjoy him as a professor, even though it is very lecture heavy. I would take his class again!

I have Professor Reilly for 2 classes this semester and he is very sweet. He's easy to build a relationship with and he wants to make things easy for his students. He has a bad rep because he doesn't give a lot of direction with assignments however, if you show up to class, you'll be totally fine. I'm taking him again next semester and i'm excited!

By far my least favorite professor at Virginia Tech. Disrespectful and unwilling to help you in your assignments. Unfortunately, switching sections wasn't an option since no other professor taught this course this semester. Avoid at all costs.

I went out of my way to choose him in 3 classes. His classes are very old school, printed out essays and attendance sheets, which I liked a lot. very useful. Just show up, act like you're participating, and he'll like you. He's genuinely a very nice guy and has nothing but good intentions

One of the nicest professors I have had, always smiling and willing to help. He cares about how you do in his class and provides plenty of examples to succeed in his class. This is very group project based all year, but they are not difficult and he explains how to do each step very clearly, then is an easy grader. Tests are very straightforward.

I cannot stress HOW TERRIBLE of a professor he is.... Many of the exams were pushed back and there was often confusion on when the actual date was. The exams were very hard and didn't really relate to the material we were being taught during lectures. And lectures were another thing.... he read off slides in the most BORING manner know to person..

He is extremely rude and disrespectful to students. He could care less about how any student does in his class, especially females. He has no clue how to work Canvas or anything on a computer. Attendance was mandatory, which is fine besides the fact that he yells and cusses at students in class. He also grades so harshly.

The guy is a dinosaur. It is very easy to miss or do assignments incorrectly because he doesn't explain them in class, doesn't know how to use canvas, and doesn't check his email ever. You could be in the ER, and he still wouldn't excuse you. By far the worst teacher I've had at Virginia tech.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Writes illegibly on the whiteboard to get kids to "pay more attention." Lecture is all rants and swearing. The project rubrics are terrible and due dates and several requirements were modified without any advance notice. 40% dropped. I saw people at the final I didn't even remember were in the class because they stopped going so long ago.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take his class I would answer a question becasue he said he wanted students to participate and then he would take advantage of that moment to embarrass me infront of the class. I felt that I was singled out on multiple occasions and felt that the male students who asked similar questions if not the same question were praised.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Good guy. But, his grading is pretty harsh. You think you get a concept and then bomb it on the test. All I can say is PRACTICE, practice practice your problems. Do NOT take this class if you cant put in the time or work; hes not joking around when he says that. Build a good relationship with him and youre gonna be ok.
Hard class. uses excel for everything in this class. although it is hard he really wants you to do good. he's funny and nice.

He was very condescending towards most students. Got frustrated very easily when we asked the most basic things or if we misunderstood his confusing directions. Also, his exams take an unreasonable amount of time to complete. Project heavy, but the project instructions aren't always concise. Rants during lectures. Pick someone else if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The material of this class is hard but Reilly really does try to help you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Take this class online over the summer if you can! It was definitely a good bit of work but only because he gives two case studies and they were pretty long. Analysis had to be 8-12 pages and he gave you a sample set up which was nice. Definitely send your paper to him before submitting, you'll get a better grade. Exam questions are all on quizlet!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: It's obvious that he really enjoys teaching the subject; he does have an accent, so if you aren't paying full attention all the time, it can be a bit hard to understand what he's saying. Otherwise, class was pretty interesting, quizzes are open note and online, and the labs/projects aren't bad as long as you give yourself enough time to finish.

I found this class to be very entertaining. Santosh keeps the lectures interesting and walks everyone through the in class questions. The homework can take longer towards the end of the class as the projects get bigger, but are not difficult to complete as long as you start earlier in the week. TAs have plenty of office hours if you do need help.

Santoshe is such a sweet guy and you can tell he cares about his students. pretty easy class for the lecture side, a few online tests but everything is open notes. there are quizzes at the end of every class but he gives the answers as long as you are in class.
I took GEOG2084 with Dr. Rijal and he was incredibly kind and respectful. I emailed him a couple times asking for help or giving feedback, and he always was very patient and treated me respectfully.

Santosh is a very nice guy. His class can be a little difficult, but luckily the quizzes and tests are open note. His lectures are sometimes hard to follow, but he will always emphasize the major points to know. The labs (remote sensing) were all relatively easy.
Very nice guy, easy to follow lectures

Professor Rogers was truly amazing. He was great at presenting his material, and his class was very laid back. I hand-wrote notes and still had plenty of time to get all the notes down and be able to write examples that he gave us. One of my favorite profs, take him if you can!! The only grades are tests, so make sure to study in advance

Class is set up in small group discussions, reading roles, quizzes, and short group projects for each reading. The class is definitely not tough, especially because there is a guide posted before each quiz. The readings are actually very interesting, and Dr. Rogers is very funny! He is a fair grader as well
hes a cool guy, when he talks its interesting but sometimes he goes off topic or doesnt fully explain the concept of what hes talking about

A great professor! 5 tests, one gets dropped. Lots of extra credit, up to 10 points. Lots of study session, tests are straightforward, information is posted and given in lecture. He's a great teacher, very easy to understand. If you pay attention the class is really easy. Would recommend to anyone.
Cares about the subject, just have to pay attention and you'll do good enough. Only grades are tests, so you should probably study.

Teacher is amazing- super caring and knowledgeable. Attendance not mandatory, however, if you skip class you won't pass. If you aren't a good test taker this class will be a lot harder (Hense why I got a B) there are some activities, extra credit, all I got 100s on but it wasn't enough for an A. Final words: Take his class and you will learn a lot

Dr. Rogers is very nice and likes to engage with students out of class. His tests were lecture slide heavy, so the best thing to do is to study those. Make sure you go to class because he will tell you what is important. He is very accessible outside of class and offers extra credit. Lowest test is dropped which provides a nice buffer.

Great professor! Lectures were clear and straightforward, with helpful study guides and practice questions. There were simple in-class activities to boost your grade, three exams, and a few short writings. Overall, the class was relatively easy and very engaging.

Dr. Ross is the definition of an ideal professor. He is so wonderful and truly cares about the students. He connects everything you care about to the topics talked about in class, including Lebron James... but be prepared to talk a lot about Terror Management Theory. You get to select the topics you want to learn about throughout the semester.

Ross is super knowledgeable and explains things in a way that is easy to understand. He does tend to go on tangents but they're interesting. Attendance is not mandatory but there are occasional in-class assignments which you can't make up unless there are extraneous circumstances.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you get the chance to take his class, please do! Exams are easy if you study. Lectures are clear and you can tell he loves what he's teaching. He gives clear examples to help understand the topics. He gives assignments outside of class which directly correlate to what we're learning. Overall, this class was so insightful, fun, and stress free!

Dr. West is a great guy. He may not grade your stuff immediately, but he is more than willing to help you and take time out of his day. People saying he is dim or disrespectful clearly didn't treat him with respect. If you show up to lectures, try your hardest, and participate in class, he'll take the time to know you by name and help you out.

Dr. West is one of my favorite teachers of all time. If you hear anything negative from anyone, kindly remove them from your life. Also, someone's rating said, "lights were dim". Genuinely how is that a critique? That person is a chud, but I digress. He is so knowledgeable and he wants you to succeed. I would ride into battle for this man.

West is good, can be a little hard on you. But he means well. If you try he'll help. Trying doesn't mean, not doing any studying and just going to office hours for help. You need to come with work already started, done or with a lot of question.

Lectures are hard to follow. Tried to go to office hours and he was very disrespectful, really made it feel like I was bothering him by actually showing up to his office hours. Piled on the most work I've ever had for a class the week of graduation. Do not take mech design 2 with him if you are a graduating senior.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Many assignments delayed after professor didn't post assignment when he said he would. Lights were dim, and many lectures were difficult to follow. Did a good job answering questions, and projects were rewarding when they could be understood.

He has a lot of experience teaching Mech Design 2 and being in the field. He explains the material clearly and has many physical examples to illustrate how things work etc. His lectures are fast-paced and jump around to different PDFs (hard to get used to initially). Very cool content. Homeworks aren't horrible, tests are on fundamentals. 8.5/10
If "this could've been an email" was a class.

Dr. Rowell always treated the entire class as if we were a bunch of kindergarteners. Whenever someone would ask her a question, she would answer with so much attitude and act as if we were wasting her time. She would always show up to class in pajamas, looking like she just woke up from an intense nap.

She treats everyone like high schoolers and doesn't show respect like she expects us to show her. She doesn't feel professional in the way a college professor should, the way she lectures and teaches feels almost insulting to the student to listen to.

Treats every student like they are five years old and with no respect. She will tell grown adults to not be on their phone, even if its for 5 seconds and not distracting anyone else but her. She stops lectures if someone makes the slightest noise or movement that quite literally only distracts her. Thankfully this will be shut down next year.

She was honestly so bad in how she treated her students that she's probably the reason every LLC is closing. I hope she enjoys teaching kindergarteners because that should be her next job with how she talked to us.

Took her for COS 1015 and 1016. She treats all of the students like middle schoolers. Like will literally shush us mid-class. Isn't very put-together for class ever, and doesn't leave feedback on important projects like the research project. This LLC class is way more work than any of the others, and attendance is required.
On everyone's soul the best teacher at VT.

Temperance would pause class to call out people for things that did not matter at all. She was generally passive aggressive when speaking to her individually. The work was easy, but I got nothing out of it, on top of her lectures very long, generaic, and boring, but fortunately there was no final nor anything I had to pay for.
treats full grown adults like children. felt like i was in elementary school again because of this class. makes complete sense this is getting shut down because of how bad she is.

The coursework for the class was easy, but felt extremely pointless especially for being a one credit class. Her lectures drag on for the full class time, and the mandatory attendance points made it impossible to leave early. She would call people out for things that truly did not matter and was generally passive aggressive when speaking to her.
They are shutting down this LLC for a reason. DO NOT TAKE THIS. This class will have you not look both ways before stepping out into the street.

No matter what you do, I beg of you to avoid this professor like the plague. The majority of the work given feels like a complete waste of time. She treats us like kindergartens and not actual young adults. I feel like I'm walking on eggshells in that classroom and other classmates I know feel the same way. Do. Not. Do. It. Please. Thank you.

I would rather live in the CORPS of Cadets with my head shaven as a freshman for all four years than take this class. I'm jealous of everyone who will be unable to take this now that the class is no longer available.
It is SO BAD, i wanna give you a zero, but that's not possible, so I give you a one

reviews.comment: Everyone complaining about having to walk to NCB does not know that the Orion class has been scheduled in that building since before 2019, & the curriculum for the intro class doesn't change because Orion requires scientific foundations, and not everybody will be on the same level of development.
Treated us like children. Did not learn a single thing. Did not enjoy my time at New Res because of the COS credit. Live somewhere else.
The 5/5 ratings were clearly done by her or her friends. Not a good time in her class. Would rather have a C in every class than have her again.
Never again! I would rather live in Slusher, on the 12th floor, with a broken elevator all year, than live in New Res with her.

Actually insufferable as a teacher. She treats her students like children and never takes accountability when SHE makes a mistake.  The only good thing about her class and LLC is living in New Res.  The class itself is easy it's just a lot of unnecessary busy work plus mandatory attendance. If you're taking this class good luck!!
NEVER TAKE THE ORION LLC. Worst professor to man kind. Disrespectful. Rude. Belittled Students. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH DR. TEMPERANCE ROWELL. I am saving you

Never again. She does not like me for no reason. She is rude to anyone who does not worship her. Brags about going to Harvard, yet she teaches a VERY pointless class. Never, ever, had as much disrespect from her compared to anyone. Hate it. I would rather fail linear and have to take it all four years than be stuck with her for one month. ;(

Worst class ever. Im super busy with other work, and this class felt like a waste of time. We spent 1 hour discussing how to talk, and then we had to write 10 paragraphs about how we will talk. It's a waste of time, and I hate it. If you're thinking of staying in New Residence East, don't! It's not worth this class. Try Hoge, Pritch., lit anything

I hated my time in her class. She treated us like children and there was an obvious lack of respect. If it weren't for nice dorms id tell people not to join her LLC. Everything in this class felt like pointless busywork. She was very condescending which made it hard to enjoy taking her class. Everyone dislikes her and I feel like it's very valid.
People like to hate. She's really not bad. We just have class at like dinner time, so I think a lot of us get hangry.

AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS. SHE WOULD GO TO LENGTHS TO MAKE SURE THAT YOU SUFFER IN HER CLASS AND WILL TREAT YOU LIKE KINDERGARTNERS. She holds grudges against students, and god forbid if you get into her badbooks SHE WOULD DO EVERYTHING TO MAKE SURE YOU HAVE AN AWFUL TIME. SHE SHOULD'NT BE A TEACHER HERE.

As someone who has been a student with Dr. Rowell for four years, I can safely say that she has improved A LOT. She really values our feedback, and has altered her courses using it to become easier and more enjoyable for us. For example, PCs used to have a weekly class, but she started offering optional classes because our feedback asked for it.

The only useful thing in this class is the research poster and the dorms. She will not give you an attendance grade if you are on your phone during a lecture. Assignments all seem unnecessary and she'll make us write 5 sentences of blabber for a question that could be answered in one sentence.

You have an attendance grade that gets docked over everything and the "research project" is determined for you and very few are rewarding and most are time consuming and frustrating. There is extra credit available to cushion grade. This class has so much more to offer for incoming STEM majors but currently it's a waste of time.

The class is worth it for the dorm and community and that's it. I learned nothing I did not already know. Dr. Rowell treats her students like babies by making us "put our phones in our backpacks," and calls people out for having a earbud in, things like that. There is a lack of respect. If you are sick you have to prove it through the dean. Easy A.

Honestly, taking the class is definitely worth it for the dorms and the community of people that have the same interests as you. It is an easy A, but with that being said I learned absolutely nothing that I did not know before. Dr. Rowell kind of treats us like children by taking away are phones. Definitely more like a high school class.

Stay away from taking her class please. She has no patience & rude. She thinks she can talk to adults like were kids. Class is overall a waste of time & you have to walk 20 minutes in the dark. Also, most of the time she shows up LATE to her own class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is not a good teacher at all! She treats students who are literal adults like kids. She makes us turn in our phones and micromanages her staff and students. She is bad at responding to emails even though she tells you to email her. Please do NOT be a part of this LLC. 25 people dropped her class after the first semester. DISGRACE!

This class was quite the experience, but for all the wrong reasons. Firstly, the class itself is painfully boring and is way too time consuming for a ONE CREDIT class. Secondly, Temperance forgets we're adults and makes us put our phones in a group designed bin like we're children. Lastly, you have to walk 20 minutes in the dark to class. PATHETIC!
i just think that the class was a waste of time. Especially if you have to walk all the way to NCB in the pitch black.
She thinks she is much more interesting than she is which leads to painfully boring classes.

She treats us like babies sometimes and makes us put our phones in a bin in the middle of the table. The class is pointless, but it is worth it for being in dorms with A/C and a suite-style room and bathroom. There are meetings every week (which is a 20 minute walk from my dorm) and the class is very pointless.

I understand this is a science llc but there are too many problems that I've gone through and will not be staying next year. The class is 20 minutes away from the dorm building, the teacher is unnecessarily rough, and it's not worth going through all this work for a 1 credit class. I'd rather take 3 1 one-credit labs than this class.
Don't take her class. She is contradictory, spitefully calls out students in front of the whole class, and has a negative attitude about teaching.
Don't work with her. She often gives contradictory instructions, calls individual students out in front of the whole class, and generally appears to have a negative attitude about having to teach.

She rarely responded to emails within a good timeframe, one time it took two weeks to respond to a small question I asked, and the question had been answered long before she got back to me. The way she talks gives a feeling of being fake kind, like someone who claims to be interested in you but really only cares about themselves

If she's still a part of Orion, don't sign up. She expects so much from you but doesn't give the same energy back. If you email her at all, don't expect a reply. It's a one-credit course, yet she acts like it's the only class that matters. She doesn't tell you about things you're required to attend until the last minute.

She has a horrible attitude toward everyone. She acts like her class is top priority when it is a 1 credit class, where the lectures are common sense. She has horrible communication, but whenever there is miscommunication, she blames it on her students. She never checks her email and nobody is ever able to find her. Awful person overall.

The professor is not a nice person, don't read the good reviews on here. Although the class is easy, she will make you dislike her and the whole organization. Too much work for a 1 credit class. She fusses too much, takes her anger out on you, and treats you like a child in class. I would not take her if I didn't have to. DON'T join Orion...

Although this is an easy class, Temperance makes it almost awful. She's condescending to everyone, assigns so much work for a one credit class and makes the class and LLC seems and be so much more important than it really is. The actual class material is so repetitive and things you already know like "how to read a paper." DON'T TAKE HER.

It was a very easy class, especially for those that did their homework or did the extra credit instead. The Lectures could have been simplified or given out ahead of class, but besides the lecture itself, the assignments were simple and easy to complete and if you showed her respect, she would give you the same courtesy.
The only bad thing about this class were the people that didn't care about the class, that made it super annoying.

reviews.comment: She was always super nice and had a great attitude during lecture

reviews.comment: It wasn't that bad, as long as you stayed on top of things and asked for help if you needed it then you were good.
I liked the way the class was formatted

reviews.comment: She was extremely helpful, and a really down to earth person if you just got to know her.

She always had stuff written out and ready, she had the entire schedule for classes to come ready weeks before. Did she ask for a lot of work for just a one credit class, sometimes. If you take her class, go to her office hours, she is very easy to talk to and is always willing to help you out. I would definitely recommend this class to anyone.

reviews.comment: She has a bad attitude during class, she assigns a ridiculous amount of work for a 1 credit class, and I felt that the class was mostly a waste of my time.

Easy class but I didn't find anything helpful about it. She didn't seem prepared and wasn't easy to talk to. Condescending to students and was overall difficult. Got an A in the class for participation and the easy assignments but just not worth my time.

She says "um" a lot in class which is indicative of her unpreparedness to enlighten a new generation of aspiring scientists into the life of academia. I found her class very uninspiring and almost ended up dropping out of STEM overall.

reviews.comment: Absolutely abysmal course management, every complaint I see here seems to be the same and I promise they are all true. I just want to get a C and never deal with this class again. AVOID taking this professor at all costs.

Nice professor, but poor course structure and unclear project expectations. The autograder enforces poorly defined requirements with limited attempts to decode its errors. Attendance is strict with mandatory pop quizzes, sometimes covering multiple lectures with little prep time.

The grading in this class is completely abismal. Be prepared to use autograder for a class that spans an entire semester and run into many many issues with it. Terribly organized, and terribly taught.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: "When it rains, it pours." Sook Shin 04 14 2026 43248
ECE 3574 is a course made from the depths of hell. Uses autograder for a course-long project where everyone has completely different implementations.

One of those professors who seems more concerned about her class being tough than about the success of the students. Unhelpful, puts up high barriers for little to no reason (ie. 5 autograder attempts hardlocked), and difficult-to-understand lectures.

Great lecturer and is nice in the office hours, but definitely has communication issues with her TAs. As such, she has little idea what's going on with the homework assignments. Rubrics for projects are unclear and don't mention things worth up to 10% of the final grade. I don't regret taking her, but wouldn't recommend either.
Highly recommend! She is so caring and super understanding of student situations

Dr. Rice was an amazing professor. She is very forgiving and knows that her class isn't always a student top priority. There are group projects in this class and some in class assignments (the dates are in the syllabus). While attendance isn't mandatory, it is helpful to be in class for those things. She isn't a hard grader and loose on deadlines.
Super sweet and gives great feedback. Gives grace periods for just about every assignment
This the one of the best teachers at VT.

very unprepared. all of her assignments are hard to comprehend and some of the assignments will say due on a specific date, but when you go into the assignment it will say submit first part on Monday (if the assignment was due on Wednesday) or you will get a 0 for this assignment. SO MANY ASSIGNMENTS! do not take this course with her.

Unger is an easy A. As long as you put in a few hours of work on the projects and show up to class you will be successful. The lectures are very boring and not engaging, but participation is graded. She may ask questions to the class about them, but you don't have to do the readings. I had her for 1105 and 1106 and she is a very lenient grader.

it was quite disappointing. There was minimal teaching, mostly just articles to read that felt disconnected from the assignments. The material was unstructured, making expectations unclear. Projects were explained once and never revisited, leading to confusion. Classes were canceled randomly, and when they did happen, they felt unproductive.

She is only a grad student however I thought her assignments were straightforward and easy. Her feedback was pretty good and she is VERY lenient with her late policy and grading policy. Anyone would be lucky to have her and it's pretty much a free A if you put in the few hours it takes for each project.

reviews.comment: Julia Unger is just not a great teacher (she's a grad student). She didn't ever give useful feedback. Her "lectures" were just her asking us to read something, and then asking us useless questions. One time she explained a project differently on Canvas than in the Lecture, and I had to restart a 1600-word paper. This was right before finals too.
His class wasn't difficult but attendance was the only graded thing and the lectures are mind numbing. Prepare for guest lecturers upon guest lecturers. Easy A and nice enough person but be warned.
He was a very chill professor. Honestly, it was a good introduction to CMDA and it is a pretty easy class with a minimal workload.

Prof. Ufferman is an excellent lecturer and has an engaging course. The topics in this course are difficult but his homework and notes that he provides really help you learn the material. He is accessible for office hours and wants you to succeed in the course. Highly recommend him for 3605 or 2006, since I took both of those with him.

It was an intro to CMDA class, majority of the grade was just attendance. They graded on very few assignments, but they were assignments ones where you just follow along in class and submit. Kinda boring, but easy.

reviews.comment: Interesting and relaxed professor, very respectful towards students, has interesting guest lecturers, and is easy to access.
Excellent professor and academic advisor.  Laid back and uses good examples and proofs

Very good professor! Good lectures, the homework problems were similar to the lectures, and the test problems were similar to the homework. Pay attention, take notes, and do the homework. He made the class easy.

I really enjoyed the concepts of this class, and Prof. Ufferman only made the class better through how he explained the lectures. He made sure the class was participatory by doing in-class coding, which helped show how some of the more complicated subjects worked. There's one homework a week which does take a while, but they are very rewarding.

The tests are very easy to handle. He let us work in groups on classwork. Lectures are clear and well organized, but compared to a typical MATH2214 (Diff Eq) class, he sometimes skirts around the main point with extra proofs or "guess and check" the differential solution. Homework is short and easy to manage.
A great teacher, explained Combinatorics very well. Very helpful with questions about the homework and was willing to not count some questions that were deemed poorly worded.

I went into class not knowing a damn thing about whatever Combinatorics was, and not sure whether I should care. Ufferman's surprisingly deep voice taught me so much about probability, calculating with factorials, and how to solve that one problem about the salesman who travels a lot. I am an alumni, and he was one of the best professors I had.

Nice guy. Homework is optional, but quizzes at the beginning of class are taken directly from the homework (and the quizzes are open homework). Quizzes happen about half the classes, homework is average length. Pretty relaxed, dry sense of humor. Uses lots of examples to explain and gives practice tests. Good prof

His lectures are often circuitous and confusing, and some of the material he covers isn't in the textbook - not a good combination.  "Get ready to read" will make LibArts students laugh - although he doesn't assign reading, I find myself referencing the book more often than usual just to do the homework.
Ufferman was a wonderful teacher who presented the material clearly and also gave several of examples to aid in our learning. He is extremely helpful in office hours as well.

Overall pretty good professor. make sure you go to class and you should be just fine. He does collect homework though so if that's one of your pet-peves than I would consider taking another professor. I'll give him a B
He is super amazing I recommend!!

You have a quiz sue before every class, but get 5 tries for it so it's easy to get a 100. The quizzes aren't bad because they balance out the test scores. There is a bunch of extra credit available. Some concepts were difficult to understand. Will talk fast sometimes, but explains concepts well and always available and happy to answer questions.

Claimed on the syllabus that there would be online lectures if we couldn't make it to class, but he never posted them. The powerpoint slides also left out some major concepts, so if you couldn't make it to class you were out of luck. He also changed the grading policy at the last second, causing my A- to be dropped to a B-.

He is pretty funny and makes class really fun too. The material is not that hard if you actually go to class. Some slides can be condensed, but thats just his teaching style. He really values feedback and gives a lot of extra credit towards the end.

Prof. Uyeda genuinely wanted the best for his students. Last 2 exams were online. The exams were a bit challenging but not too bad, I always just studied the night before. No real homework, just easy A participation quizzes. TONS of extra credit at the end. Pretty chill guy and his lectures are funny. Would for sure recommend for evol bio.

Josef is a class act and makes what could easily be a boring topic, so fun to engage with. He is funny and you can tell he is very knowledgeable about what he teaches. So glad I got to take him and would do so again in a heartbeat. Evolutionary biology is not necessarily easy and you will have to put in time for his class but its worth it.

NEUR 2464 is a really interesting class! Overall, the class was pretty easy with many individual and group assignments that could be completed during class time. If you're doing an ABB minor or looking for a pathways, I highly recommend!

Take Dr. Unroe for Neuroscience in Society!! The class was super interesting, and a great easy class to take as a neuroscience major. All of the assignments are pretty easy, and aren't too time consuming. The only thing about Dr. Unroe is he isn't the best at responding to emails, but he's super accessible in his office hours.

he's super nice and very accommodating. this class is super interesting and every topic felt like a fun google deep dive that i'd go on then want someone to talk to about it. lots of group discussion and work but everything is very analytical so not much creativity needed(which is something i love not being required to use) high recommend!

This class was amazing and very easy. The assignments are not that difficult and good grades are given as long as you follow the directions. The bigger projects that are assigned are given lots of class time to be worked on. He is very lenient when it comes to missing in class work as well and will give chances to make it up
I didn't learn very much from the class but the material was interesting. The class was really easy.

This class is super interesting and has one simple assignment per class. There are a lot of group activities and three book clubs with an assigned group. Overall, I really liked this course and Dr. Unroe was great.
Relies heavily on TAs and doesn't teach much. The class is easy but you won't learn much from it.

Great lectures, interesting topics, very flexible. There is a decent amount of assignments, which I think is perfect because almost every big class I have taken here at Tech only has about 3-8 assignments due to the TA's not being able to grade hundreds of assignments. Highly reccomend for pathway or if you're interested in Neur.
Gives a lot of after class reflections but there super easy. He is a fun professor and is very cool. Book clubs are an easy 100.

make sure you go to class. 
you'll tank me later.
Go to class!
Take time to go to class-it matters
great teacher

She does pop quizzes to force students to go to her class because no one would show up otherwise, her grading system was never made clear. And she will not answer questions.

If you don't care about learning much and just want to pass take her. HWs are awfully long, but you need to complete and understand them in order to pass the tests (Tests are similar to HWs). Her lectures are super boring, reads from slides.

reviews.comment: Average professor. Teaches the material and answers questions. The reason why she is getting a 2 instead of a 3 is because one question on her test was unfair because it was not covered in class or on the homework, but other than that, her tests are fair. They are difficult though.

Dr. Untaroiu is entirely incompetent. Avoid her at all costs. I would have learned more about fluid dynamics watching a youtube video of water flowing out of a garden hose. She talks over every question. Has unreasonable grade breakdown. Sits on a single useless PP slide for 20 minutes at a time. Laughs at you. Can't figure out how to upload
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Mr. Uren is a great teacher that brought back my love for English. I hated it in high school and now I love it again. Really great teacher who likes to joke around.

I really liked Mr. Uren. At the beginning I was really intimidated by him because I thought he would be mean but he is not if you have a question he will gladly answer it. He would really prepare us before we had to write an essay by going over what he wants, with weekly reviews, grammar lessons, and peer editing groups. He is also pretty hot.

I think he is an extremely good professor.  I personally an a bad writer, but I manage to keep an A so far. He is willing to talk to you one on one to improve your paper. He even gives you feedbacks on your paper before you turn it in. Just do what you are supposed to do.  Show him that you care, then he'll care for you too.

Not an easy A, but you will become a better writer. If you go to class and you are willing to meet with him to work on your papers, you will do well.  He genuinely cares about helping students improve their writing. Also he is a cool guy to talk to, very real and down to earth, and will open up about random stuff in his life.
Grades extremely hard on papers, no tests though. Quizzes are really difficult as well. Talks about his life and personal stuff, all the time.

I did all of my assignments on time and asked questions when I needed to, of which he was always available to help. I ended up making the grade I wanted, which is more than I can say for the people who did very little and just want to complain now. I sort of liked the class discussions.
Rambles on all the time and gives several useless assignments.

Whatever people, I don't care what they're saying, only thing matters is that I saw Mr. Uren after class one day win a local break dancing contest. He did a Flex Klex and then a double Flex Klex. I've always wanted a break dancing teacher . . . his class is pretty aight too.
Rambles alot in class. Really nice guy though... Seemed like we hade an essay due every two weeks
Does sometimes ramble during class. However, places emphasis on self-reliance and is compassionate and helpful.
Rambless a lot, to waste class time. This class is super boring!

He's a super chill guy, and his lectures are pretty good. Although Calc 2 is a known hard subject, it didn't feel too bad. I dare say he is one of the top 3 math professors/teachers I have ever had. Super laid-back and an understandable guy.

GOAT. A lot of the class is super controlled so he doesn't have a choice on a lot of the homeworks or the online quizzes, but his lectures are always super well thought out and he does a really good job of breaking down the why behind a lot of the concepts. Office hours were always very very helpful and is very approachable with questions.

Despite calc 2 being way harder than anything in high school, Varun made this class very manageable and was extremely helpful during office hours. He even would even encourage us to argue with him over our test grades and give back points. Best professor I've had in stem, his only flaw was that he was too smart and occasionally went slightly fast.
Brilliant professor. Really understands his subject and cares about helping you learn. Take his class if you want to learn from the best

stellar. very good lectures, and answers all questions clearly. lowk teaches at a fast pace at first but not that bad. very helpful during office hours, and please go to office hours. very nice grader when it comes to hard written homework (9) and tests (3+final). several opportunities for extra credit and bonus points. calc2 is not easy.

reviews.comment: Very Good at Teaching Calc, and presented many opportunities for extra credit, which though difficult, I would recommend doing as it truly helps in getting a incredibly strong understanding of the content. Go to office hours, tehy will help tremendously, especially for the homework. 10/10, chose him again next semester for Linear Algebra.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 1226 is a tough course but Varun's a great professor, he explains topics really well and gave extra credit. Go to office hours if you have any questions on homework!

He really explains the fundamental theory behind the math. He is pretty funny. Tests are easy, only because the HWs are so hard it makes you learn the subject inside and out just to complete them. He also goes off topic every once in a while into quantum physics. He always gives extensions on HW for any reason. Very lenient on grading HW and Tests

Varun is one of, if not the best 1226 professors. He is extremely knowledgeable in the content and explains the material so well. He offers extra credit bonus questions on the written homework's, and grades easier than other 1226 professors.

Very chill professor that knows a lot about the content and will be able to clearly answer any questions. The homeworks he gives can be challenging but also fun because they will relate to tests and real world problems that I thought were cool. He also explained things in a way that lets you visualize it which I appreciated.

Varun was definitely one of the better professors for Calc 1 amongst VT's less than stellar math department. He did a good job explaining topics and would even go further to explain why things worked or how they connected to other content (that part wasn't necessary to learn, but it was still cool). I would definitely take him for another classes

Professor Vu is an outstanding instructor. I really enjoyed her class and learned a great deal. Would highly recommend her for anyone taking 3134-just don't expect an easy A though, it's still analytics!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good teacher. Cares a lot about her students learning.
Amazing professor who truly cares about her students. Gives ample resources for success. Go to class and you will do good.

Professor Vu is one of the best professors in the Finance department. She really cares about her students; she makes sure to take feedback about exams and her teaching methods. She is always there to help during and even out of class. The material is supposed to be tough, but she gives plenty of practice problems and study guides. Go to class!

Prof. Vu is very passionate and deeply cares about her students' success. The class is tough itself, so paying attention and putting in effort are important. The homework load is reasonable, and she provides many practical examples with clear explanations. She is a super kind and approachable professor who is always willing to meet with students.

I personally did not have a pleasant experience with Professor Vu. The course was already hard, granted but I felt like she didn't go over the material in a way that students could understand it easily. It may just be me. 

Attendance was mandatory, and class was very lecture heavy. Be ready to sit through a lot of slides.

If you have to take this class, definitely take it with her. She genuinely cares so much about her students. Even though all sections cover the same material, she breaks it down in a way that actually makes it understandable. It's already a tough class, but as long as you put in the effort, she will help you get through it.

Dr. Vu is a great professor. As a student you can tell she genuinely cares and wants you to learn from her class. If you ask her a question she always answers it without making you feel dumb. The course is difficult its self but she made a passing grade feel achievable.If you have to take FIN 3134 take it with her.

Good professor, and explains things clearly. She is very willing to answer any questions you may have. You can tell she cares a lot about her students. Tries to give as many points possible on exams to make sure you receive a good grade and do well in her class. Replies in timely manner to emails. No mandatory textbook, but she did take attendance.

Ms. Lael is a nice person but her lectures frequently seemed very opinionated. The material also seemed all over the place all the time and a little bit pointless. You have to attend class to get full credit for the discussion boards which I hated. She would open them during class and give us a bit of time to complete. Exams are pretty easy

Victoria is a nice instructor, and her class is not difficult at all. The only thing I wish is that she spent less time on announcements at the beginning of class/rants on unrelated content and spent more time on genuine class material. Go to class and stay engaged and it will be fine!

She is nice, but her lectures seem pointless at times. She gives you many assignments that are worth a small amount of points, so it often feels like it's all busy work. One thing I really liked about this class was the service learning portion, I had a great experience. There is a textbook but you do not need it, none of the exams cover it.

I have taken two classes with Victoria, I would not recommend. I will say her classes are not hard at all, however, they are incredibility hard to sit through. She is nice but very unorganized and hard to listen to. Test are easy, but not really related to the course material.

There are random attendance checks, but you get three misses. Class is lecture focused with lots of videos during class that have small group discussions after. Professor Lael definitely seems nice but I was a bit intimidated by her. There were no exams just projects, but they were all managable
Super liberal and feel like the class only talks about the negative views of disabled people. Could do a better job in teaching and making lectures more positive

Don't be fooled by my A, she was BAD. So unorganized, exams were barely based on class content, rather they were on the quizzes and reading. I took this class as a sophomore but I can't imagine taking it my first semester of freshman year with her. Don't bother asking her anything, her responses feel belittling and discouraging, ask the TA(s).

This professor was disorganized, occasionally passive aggressive, and overall, not an effective teacher. This class and the content are easy but be prepared to be tested on unrelated material. If you have the option to take a different professor I would
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I'm taking this freshman year for my first semester and it was bad. She was very unorganised and not very respectful/warm to her students who obviously were just showing interest and confusion in class. Assignments for this class felt busy and we were usually graded unfairly because she failed to instruct us clearly. DONT take the 8 am.

Ms. Lael is incredibly unorganized & very opinionated, which is evident in her teaching. She is very condescending/judgmental in conversation during office hours & lecture, making her quite unapproachable. I wouldn't recommend taking this course with her, as she lectures about being understanding while she herself isn't.
