Doesn't answer questions fully, skims across subjects without stopping to take any questions, and expects everyone to have previous knowledge of electrical circuits. If you're in ME, you might have to take this guy because he's the only one that teaches the class, so good luck.

The tests are graded with a very clear rubric for credit/partial credit which seems great in theory but the graders deviate from it at will and then refuse to explain their reasoning for it. There aren't many labs but they can be time intensive and again, grading is erratic at best- I received grades from a 65 to a 99 with the same quality of work.

He is entirely incompetent as a teacher. His lectures are almost impossible to follow and typically vastly overcomplicate what should be simple topics. Tests are typically harder than the homework and are graded very harshly. Small errors such as dropping a sign or writing a number wrong will cost you up to 10 points on a problem.

One day he literally did the same example over and over (no difference in the way he did it). Also the content we were learning was like three weeks ahead of what we were being quizzed and tested on. For homework, there were worksheets with diagrams and they didn't match the canvas quiz, so you just had to guess what he was actually asking.

Your grade in this class depends entirely what TA grades your work. Some give generous partial credit and some give almost none which in his class is the difference between a 30% and a 70%. Yong Xu himself is a terrible lecturer and takes no responsibility for his TA's actions, telling students to bring concerns to TAs.

Xus tests are reasonable and based on what he covers so if you put in the time, you can get at least a C or B. I recommend him over the other ECE professors because he actually teaches and is fair. I took this with Lu and failed because Lu did not teach the material on his tests, but did fine in Xus class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Unclear is the word for this professor, he told us that we would be unable to even ball park our grade before the last day I decide to withdraw or not. Unclear and unable to understand his lectures. Exams and quizzes are you know it or you fail it. I've had worst professors at teaching, but at least I knew where I stoof in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: I'm not actually sure what Xu is doing with my grade. He has released the final and said that HE doesn't know what our grade is. If you can, take this class with anyone else but Xu. The final exam is much harder than anything I've ever seen. It's like cooking a pizza and just throwing EVERYTHING at the plate and hoping it works.
Extremely confusing, the only way you will learn is if you use the textbook. Half the class is expected to have to take it again.
Too much to write for a 350 character limit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Genuinley one of the worst experiences I've had in ECE, may God help us all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Xuan is by far the worst professor I have ever had at VT. Sign up for his class if you like incoherent, rambling lectures, threatening emails to your advisor if you skip class, and assignments graded months late. Little to no guidance on the homeworks, no real rubric used. I can't believe I have to spend tuition money for this.

Expects you to read the textbook, but then has unhelpful lectures. It's like he knows he doesn't actually teach in class so he tells you to read the book. Also doesn't hold office hours. Refuses to drop a homework. Grades slowly and harshly. "Midterm" is really a near impossible HW. Content itself is very interesting though, so get Jones instead
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Grades in DIP was arbitrary and harsh. The rubrics for assignments were empty and you get points off for not including things that he doesn't even ask for in the description. When you bring it up to him he gets snarky. "This is a tough course". No. We're ECE students. We know what a tough course looks like. This is not that. This is just unfair.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Consistently avoided lecturing to send instead students into discussion rooms where minimal material was learned. Emphasized attending class where he would spend most of the time rambling about adjacent topics and not teaching the actual material that was supposed to be discussed. He took what should have been an interesting course and ruined it.

Great person! Lectures are extremely boring and slow paced in my opinion. Exams are way harder than the HW and quizzes. Very caring, understanding and willing to help. She won't ever turn down a chance to help.

Class is really tough, but she is very knowledgable. I like how she gives us physical copies of the lecture slides and gives us practice tests. She is really nice and is very passionate on the subject. Highly recommend her.

This is a hard class, but Professor Xu makes the class really interesting. Her tests are hard, but she gives practice exams that prepare you well. The only issue was her final was stupidly difficult, but she adjusts grades at the end of the semester if necessary. Overall, would recommend taking her for corporate.

Class felt like a bunch of busy work in my opinion. I don't feel like I learned very much at all, although its easy if that's what you're looking for. Can't say I spent more than an hour or two a week on this class.

Very, very important to take good notes on her virtual lectures. Takes random stuff from them to put on tests. Very heavy on “group” projects, but they aren't difficult. Sometimes the lectures are interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Asynchronous class that requires group projects and tests on certain days. I felt like this kind of defeated the point of taking asynchronous classes because you do not have a lot of flexibility like with most other online classes I have taken

Exams are timed and set for one particular day and once you move on to the next question, you cannot go back. Lots of group papers. The software we had to use was also just so slow. Overall, for this being a 1000-level course, the assignments took me longer to complete than some of my assignments for my 4000-level classes.
Best professor ever!!! He is so funny and passionate about his work.

He is an amazing english teacher. He is very positive and caring. You can tell how passionate he is about english. He creates a very welcoming environment for his students. He is understanding when it comes to mental and physical health and will give you an extension if needed. I wish I could take another class with him.

Most chill english class ever. Due dates arent strict at all, he will give you an extension if you just ask for it. He doesnt really care about attendance and is really passionate about his work. He also is so funny, I think his class is the most I've ever laughed with a professor.
VERY good english teacher! Love his teaching and work!
Very chill about attendance. Due dates arent strict at all, will give you an extension if you just ask for it. Super passionate about his work. Also just a silly guy

He is by far one of the best professors I've ever had! Before him I hated English classes and now I love them. He is very flexible and make your success his top priority! He always made sure we understood assignments and gave us extra time on projects if we needed it. Such a happy and positive professor and I wish I could take more classes with him

Dr.Yang was by far the best professor I've had, her lectures are detailed and she makes sure everyone understands the material before moving on, which is helpful. There are lots of homework assignments but they aren't super long and really prepare you for the test. Highly recommend, if you show up and do the work you'll easily do well in the class.
She might just the best professor ever. Rejoice if you have her. If any of the reviews on here received a not so ideal grade, just know that it was Calc 2 / Calc 1's problem and not hers.

Dr. Yang is a great professor all around. She has good lectures and assigns a decent amount of homework, but it is always very helpful. Her exams are mid-high in difficulty but does curve if the class is doing bad (the final is the easiest among the four). Always posts lecture notes that are very detailed as  well. Also gives easy extra credit.
Loved this professor, very caring and made the material understandable. Would take her again if I could.

Had her for Calc II. Compared to other professors, her assignments are more rigorous. However, she is very kind and overall I would recommend her! She will work with you and help you if you are struggling! Overall lovely human!
Dr. Yang is an amazing professor who is very personable, makes sure everyone understands the material, and gives study guides for tests.

Dr. Yang was the best teacher I've had so far at tech. She explained everything in a simple way and was always more then willing to answer any questions you had inside of class or at office hours. She is fantastic and I hope to be able to take my future math classes with her.

I had Dr.Yang for MATH 1214 and 1225. She was always ready to help in and out of class. She has office hours multiple times a week to help with homework and other class assignments (definitely go to her office hours, you'll learn a lot). I highly recommend her, especially if you're taking Calculus for the first time, she's awesome!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall, she has been one of my favorite professors here at Virginia Tech, and she teaches math very well. She is easy to understand, accessible outside of class through office hours, and she gives extra credit papers, which help to some extent on the tests. If you have the chance to take her class, do it, you won't regret it.

She's very caring, the lectures were really good because she'd go into details like you're clueless which worked very fine for me. The homeworks she gives are basically what the test looks like. Very great and cares for her students.

Dr. Yang is an amazing professor. I had her for MATH 1224 and MATH 1225, and both classes were a great experience. She cares about her students and is always very prepared for class. She gives full and very useful lectures that tie in all units together well and teaches at good pace. If you show up to class and seed help, you will do well.
Kevin is the goat

Professor Young is super awesome. He cares about you and what he teaches. If you pay attention, you'll learn and do well. Take it in the fall and not the spring because the lab in the fall has much better weather conditions than the spring.
Great Teacher.

Arguably the best professor I've had at tech. He keeps everything completely straightforward and no-nonsense. Homework is honest and exams are reflective of what was done in class. The class is just difficult enough to feel engaging but not overbearing, and you still learn a lot of material. Labs were tedious but fun. Perfect course in my book.

Never had a more professional and hardworking professor in my life. He did a fantastic job teaching our class this past semester explaining every topic thoroughly and finishing all classes on-time or early. As long as you pay attention in class you should have no real problems on tests/homeworks. AMAZING professor.
cool guy

In short, take this guy. He is a great professor. I had him for CEE Measurements. He let's you know what will be on the tests. If you memorize all the notes, you should get an A on all the tests, except test 1 (statistics) had some trick questions. The labs were time consuming (Topography lab), and it didn't help that my lab group wasn't very good.

Professor Young is great guy and is very easy to get along with. I had him for CEE 2814, and I chose to take his land development class next semester, if that says anything. The workload for his courses with labs is primarily in the lab. He assigned 4 HW assignments all semester because he recognizes this. Great professor: Very smart.
Great teacher, the class is pretty easy as long as you do your homework and go to class for the in class quizzes.
Very fun, engaging, and knowledgeable person. Very strict on grading criteria (I ended with a 93.86% and the A was 94%), does not round up, but does give some extra credit opportunities.

I think he is the only professor who is able to teach this class with 600+ students well. He is very supportive of all his students, and his lectures are interesting with activities to help you understand concepts in unique ways. Tests are pretty much the same as the homework. Otherwise, go to class, take notes, and the class will be an easy A.
The goat, I got free food and that all that matters.
This guys a beast
Holy GOAT of all time

Wooten seems really nice, but I regretted going to every single class because it was always some activity. Like one time he sprayed like half a can of axe body spray to demonstrate negative externalities. They were fun, but they didn't help me learn anything.

Really engaging professor, who knows his stuff. He can turn any class into a funny yikyak story. Beware that in 600-person lectures, you are just a number unless you choose to meet regularly for office hours. My exam didn't work one time for more than half the exam, and he told me there was nothing he could do and to take the 50% as my drop.

This professor truly cares about his students and makes the lecture very interesting and fun through games and experiments he uses. All the exams were online, so they weren't too hard. He also drops your lowest score, exam score, and some other assignments to help improve your grade.
Made class very fun and interesting to go to. Gave lots of extra credit too. Highly recommend.

Professor Wooten is a very good econ professor. If you just listen in his classes, take notes, and understand the concepts you'll be fine. He also offers extra credit multiple times in the semester through games that he plays in class. He was a very fun professor and thoroughly new the material he was teaching.

first semester at tech and prof. wooten is genuinely the best professor to ease you into college. great lectures, iclicker extra credit, supportive TAs, and plenty of office hour help. he's hilarious and gives frequent extra credit—just attend class since exams include in-class material. online exams, no camera

WONDERFUL professor! Always positive and upbeat, and he brings great energy to a class of almost 600 students. Lots of extra credit opportunities in class as well as interactive lessons. Homework is pretty easy if you pay attention, and exams are open note. Attendance is not mandatory, but there is extra credit for iClicker questions.

genuinely SO funny and he's very passionate about teaching econ in a way that makes it easy to understand. def easy to want to skip class but I wouldn't recommend it - you learn a lot more from being there and also you get so much extra credit just from showing up and staying till the end. just do your work and okay on the exams and you'll be fine!
Super great teacher, if you do all the homework (they are easy), show up for the extra credit, and do okay at the tests, failing will be impossible.

Dr. Wooten made the class really fun and engaging with the activities he introduces during lectures, often being hilarious. One example was that he chose a couple students to get doused with Axe to demonstrate supply and demand. Homework was worth a lot and tests were fairly simple, overall a great professor who made Econ really easy!

Honestly Dr. Wooten is great, even though I'm getting a C in the class, it was just from myself not doing an assignment or two with the addition of getting a 40 or more on my first 3 exams. But overall Dr. Wooten is funny and very kind, his office hours are easy to go to.

Professor Wooten is very funny and makes his lectures actually fun to attend. He gives extra credit for participating through iClicker questions in every class that count towards your grade. Honestly one of the best teachers I've had and I actually enjoyed going to class.

Dr. Wooten is one of the best professors I've had at Tech. Genuinely cares about the students and makes the class interactive through engaging activities in class. Attendance is mandatory but the class is definitely not a bore. Highly recommend taking good notes and volunteering in class. Tests are open note so no need to stress, you will be fine.

Professor Wooten is very funny and makes his lectures actually fun to attend. Technically, attendance is not recorded, but there are iClicker questions in every class that count towards your grade. The class is easy as long as you pay attention.
Every class was easy to pay attention and was entertaining. As long as you listen in class, you basically get an A. The topics are actually interesting too.
do your weekly assignments and the tests use the exact same questions, classes are fun he lectures but with energy and teaches well.

He makes class really entertaining and he is really funny. I wouldn't say attendance is mandatory, but he does use iclicker to ask questions and that turns into extra credit at the end. The assignments in class are literally just MyLab and the exams. He also drops one exam at the end.

I LOVE THIS PROFESSOR. Passionate and caring and actually listens to feedback!! Always trying to improve his teaching style. Very engaging and does fun activities to help you learn/remember. I found the content to be easy when I took good notes. The tests are very similar to lesson recaps. Great guy, very nice, I highly recommend taking his class.

Decently easy class so long as you show up to the lectures as much as you can, pay attention at said lectures, and actually do the pre-lesson readings. Do the three of these and your chances of succeeding in the course with good grades are going to be higher than your peers who choose not to.

Organized and passionate professor, but I feel like he goes a bit fast at times. Has some homework but it's not too much. Tests aren't necessarily easy, but he does drop one and offer potential extra credit. Grading is reasonable but you will have to put some work in for an A.

Amazing teacher! His lectures were super engaging but he gave a lot of iclicker questions so attendance is super important and is a big chunk of your grade. His exams are pretty tough but are online and open notes so if you study you can do well. He is always available outside of class if you need extra help
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Wooten is smart, caring, and absurdly attractive—like, demand-curve-breaking hot. He truly wants students to succeed, but you have to pay attention; his class isn't a free market. Content is rich, jokes are sharp, and learning feels worth the opportunity cost. 10/10, would enroll (and stare) again.
Definitely one of the best professors I'll ever have. He made this class really interesting and I enjoyed being there, and learned a lot.

Professor Wooten is a professor who truly cares for his students. He does his best to make class entertaining and often succeeds in that. He is also very accessible outside of class - if you are struggling, go to office hours and he will explain everything! Overall a great professor who truly loves Economics.

Hardest part of this class were the exams. You have 45 minutes to do 20ish questions and with all of the math that goes into some problems it's really stressful. Have to attend class because somedays he does so many clickers questions your clicker grade could drop 10 points by just missing one class.

He's a fine professor but I wouldn't say he is overly respectful to his students. He also wastes a lot of class time and makes off-putting comments. I didn't enjoy coming to class, no one pays attention. The material is easy but sometimes the tests can be difficult. I would say the class is definitely passable but you probably won't get an A.

Wooten changed his ECON 2005 class structure this year, and it seems like it has gotten significantly harder. Expect not too much HW outside of class, but the tests are tough, and you need to go to office hours and the guided study group to succeed. Easy to pass, hard to get an A in.
overall a great teacher, attendance does matter,test are online

Dr. Wooten was my first professor that I really clicked with. He is really caring and has a lot of personality. One thing I will say is his classroom is flipped so reading the textbook is essential. Homeworks are very forgiving too.

He is a good professor I guess, but slide show learning sucks. He also sometimes throws tantrums and wastes class time if a few people are "disrupting the class" (the class is over 500 people and nobody notices). He also made me think I hated microeconomics until I took ECON 3104. However, I will say his grade weighting is good and it is a free A.

Dr. Wooten is a great professor. For ECON2005, make sure you do all the work. Packbacks missed start to add up, and end up being a heavy part of your grade. But he keeps the class entertaining, provides help when you need it, and personally reaches out to students when they're struggling.

Amazing guy. Biggest tip is go to office hours because he is one of the best resources for everything from class to advising. Do all the pre lesson preps on time and redo the recaps until you get it perfect and you will have wiggle room for bad test grades. Super interactive class and he always remembers your name. One of the best teachers at VT

All the tests are online, he drops the lowest exam, and even has fun activities during class and gives extra credit. As long as you attend class and answer pack back questions, do the weekly my lab assignment, and do well on the tests (which aren't hard if you focus in class), you'll get an easy A. He really cares about his students, amazing guy.
Great professor, gives good lectures and can do well in the class pretty easily if you pay attention and do the homework.

Wooten handles a large class well. His lectures are clear, and he's readily available for help with a topic. He's super friendly and encouraging. His grading is very generous (drops lowest exam score). Weekly homework, but exams are open note and online, exactly like homework.

Dr. Wooten is a great professor who obviously knows his stuff and loves economics. Attendance is graded, but you can miss some classes before it affects your grade. Tests are online, open textbook, without any sort of lockdown browser. 

He drops the lowest exam and some homeworks too, so it isn't too hard of a class.
really funny made the class really engaging, and he cares about the students learning how well we grasp the concepts! he is one of my fav teachers i had this semester

He tends to act like he is above the class. He makes you feel dumb if you don't understand. Attendance is set up so you can miss classes, but even when you're there he tricks you on the iClickers; either way you struggle for points. Missing just ONE class that he decided is worth 20x usual points made my final grade A a B+. He's fun but belittling

Notes are way too fast. His advice is get them from a classmate, but you kinda can't when everyone is missing them. Hard to study material since notes weren't posted. Also strangely seems to find joy in tricking the class during iClickers. Tests are just like homework and online. He seems fun and passionate but perhaps a tiny bit obnoxious as well.

Wooten was an amazing professor! He was very knowledgeable and kept students engaged in class with activities and group participation for extra credit. Graded fairly and provided good study materials for exams and the final.
I took Econ 2005 as a pathway and he made it a fun and enjoyable experience. Super engaging lectures and overall great guy

Enjoys economics and tries to share that with the class. Has you pay for Pearson to do hw assignments and for a discussion board app. Class is mandatory for iclicker. Dings you for not listening to the pre-lesson podcasts. Repeats himself during lectures enough that he doesn't cover all the material on the hw, making them feel tedious and annoying.

He has humor, the class isn't hard, it's interactive. But it kills me because he talks the whole time during iClicker questions. He says "I'll stop talking to let y'all focus" then doesn't stop. He stands in front of the questions so you can't read it all. He says "You have 30sec left to answer" then closes the question without warning after 15sec.

Professor Wooten is THE BEST! Hands down my favorite professor at Virginia Tech. Super caring, makes microeconomics fun to learn and is always willing to help out if you show up to office hours. You can tell he loves to teach and get students engaged. I wish he taught microeconomics as well, I would've chose him as my professor in a heartbeat.
Pay attention to lecture and do the pre-lesson preps, also the exams are heavily based on the recap assignments.

He's literally so cool and so supportive. All you really have to for this class is show up and do the MyLab homework, there were never any like big projects or papers. It's a really good time and was one of my favorite classes

He does want you to succeed and clearly cares about students, however uses questionable examples in class (he uses ADA parking spots as examples of market inefficiency), refuses to accommodate part-time jobs, and locks homework on weekends to force students to "get out and explore town". Also assigns very expensive online-only textbooks($180+min).
Very nice and decent teacher but treats students like they are stupid and cant understand basics concepts. Very obnoxious.

Super nice and he wants you to succeed. Made lectures pretty interesting and is overall a great professor. Only thing is iClicker attendance for every class, so you'll have to actually go to get credit.

Attendence is mandatory if you want to get iclicker credit. Overall easy class only complaint about him is that when you ask a simple question to him over email that needs like a one sentence response he just says come to office hours.
Best professor I ever had. Very caring and a great person. Classes are very entertaining.

Overall great fun guy who keeps the class entertaining. Uses iClicker based on his lectures, you need to go to class because it is a huge chunk of your grade. The tests can be somewhat difficult as you only have 45 minutes. Homework consists of myEconlab assignments and discussion posts on Packback. Wooten wants everyone to succeed in his class.
The goat of all goats. Favorite professor at VT so far. Cares about what he teaches, has extremely engaging lectures, and makes Microeconomics easy.
Best Professor I've ever had, he seems really passionate about what he teaches and explains everything well in a way that is easy to understand.

I LOVED wooten.I took econ 2005 my freshman year fall semester and by far my favorite professor. i reccomend him to all my friends that now take him in the spring. i know i am only a freshman but i can tell he will have been one of my favorite college professors ever.
literally the best professor everrrr!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Wooten was a fantastic professor. Good amount of extra credit throughout the semester and had loads of fun games or activities in class that kept me engaged. Exams were very easy with just a little bit of studying. Take Wooten.
Dr. Wooten is great during office hours and cares about his students. Attendance is mandatory because there are a lot of in-class activities. Really enjoyable class!

It is very very very very easy to fall asleep during lectures. iClickers during every lecture were the absolute worst thing ever but it doesn't impact your grade too much. Wooten is a pretty nice guy but he does yap quite a lot. Exams were open note which helped a lot.

I loved this professor. In a class full of like 300 people, everyone pays attention because his lectures are incredibly fun to listen to. Attendance is a huge part of your grade, so go to class. Be sure to take notes (they are super easy) because tests are open notes and you will want them. 

Do the "Getting Started" extra credit!

I always looked forward to Wooten's class because of how much I liked him as a professor. His lectures were always entertaining because he tries to apply modern clips and concepts to class. His class is very organized and consists of MyEconLabs and Packbacks weekly. Exams were online which was convenient.

His Lectures were very interesting, and his attendance was based on iClicker questions which is worth 9% of the grade. Missing class can be the difference between a 50% iClicker grade or a 100% iClicker grade, so try not to miss class.

Dr. Wooten was a seriously great professor, you could tell he really cared about teaching the class and really enjoyed it. He made the lectures really fun to be in. The class isn't too bad as long as you attend lectures and do the homework, the tests reflect the assignment and the notes pretty well.

Dr. Wooten was an amazing professor. This was my first time taking Econ so I struggled a bit at first but once I went to his office hours, he was amazing help. He explained it in simple terms and related it to real life scenarios. He didn't make me feel dumb once. He is passionate in what he teaches and not judgemental at all. Take him if you can!!
Very, very passionate about the subject, and it shows in his lectures. Tries his best to make it fun. Do the MyEconLab assignments and generally pay attention in class and you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Wooten is very passionate about economics, he knows his stuff, provides some online resources for help. His lectures are fairly easy to follow, but he doesn't post any lecture slides on canvas. He expects you to spend money for a guided notes packet. He goes off topic a lot and wastes a handful of classes for silly stuff, otherwise thumbs up.

Super funny guy who makes lectures really easy to understand, and he's extremely passionate about the student's success. Make sure to buy the course pack as it helps with note-taking. His tests are basically the MyEconLab questions and he's really generous about points for iClickers. You'll pass with a good grade if you just do the HW and iClickers

I really enjoyed him as a professor, his lectures are fun and engaging. The tests are taken online and open notes, so it's almost impossible not to get an A in his class, which is great coming from someone who has no interest in economics, but he still made it super fun to learn.

Without a doubt probably my favorite professor I had for the semester. His lectures were engaging and informational. You can tell he was passionate about what he was teaching. Highly recommend him if you ever get the chance to get him as a professor.

Dr. Wootens class was definitely the most difficult class I took this semester but also one of the most enjoyable. He always finds a way to relate what we're learning about to pop culture and even events in our lives. The tests are definitely what knocked my grade but other than that the class is not difficult.

HE'S AWESOME! Very engaging lectures. Didn't know a thing about econ before this class and he made me genuinely interested in minoring in econ. If you have the chance to take this class with him, you 100% should. I am in a 600 person lecture but he has guided notes that are so helpful and make it easy to pay attention so you can fill in your notes

Dr. Wooten's class was engaging. Although I don't enjoy economics, I liked his lectures. He incorporates pop culture and humor in a way that makes complex topics accessible. There are several assignments (discussion boards, iClicker questions, homeworks, exams), but they make it easy to earn an A and several of your lowest grades will be dropped.
10/10 would for sure

Good professor but gave me a zero on an exam when I was at a funeral and gave me another zero when my test website crashed (emailed in advance for the funeral and took videos and pictures when the website crashed).

Dr.Wooten is a great person & as a professor he wants you to get a good grade & will work with you for you to get a good grade. There are 20-30 question my econ lab homework assignments due 1-2x a week, and each homework assignment will take 1-3 hours. After dong horribly on the first two tests, I have still maintained a B and now bringing it up.

Wooten is SUCH a good professor. I had him for Econ 2005 and I actually learned from his lectures. There was a good chunk of homework, but it was easy to finish these assignments on time. His tests were just like what was on the homework, and he was very caring and thoughtful when he reaches out after tests. I cannot recommend him enough!!

Absolutely amazing professor. Really gets his students engaged in the content he teaches. I've never had a professor make a 540-person class feel like 20-30 people. He provides countless external resources to helps students outside of class. On top of being a great teach, Dr.Wooten is also just a great guy to talk to.
Jadrian Wooten was my favorite professor last semester, he was funny and made all of the lectures very fun and easy to listen and pay attention to.
His tests are all online which overall makes the class easier but his lectures are very informative and he provides plenty of online resources if you fall behind.

Professor Wooten is great. You can tell that he likes talking through certain lessons and even has clips to show us in class about the content. I personally had a harder time grasping many of the topics we learned, but I think it's because I am trying to think about the content a specific way. He made the process easier with help and application.
Just a solid guy. I found even when I messed up on an assignment he was easily accessible outside of class and gave me second chances. Pay attention and you will do well.
Dr. Wooten is very engaging, interesting to listen to. Participation through iClicker and attendance is required. Homework and exams are very similar. Beware of short time frame given for tests.

350 words isn't enough, in summary don't do it. Miss class for an emergency? Too bad you will do poorly on I-clickers and won't get credit, lectures relate very little to the tests. Care about GPA? You don't wanna take this section. If you do ask him about the opportunity cost of paying $20 for a course pack + the other 3 things he makes you buy.

I spent probably $200 on this course which was frustrating but he's a great professor. Very passionate about the subject and lectures were engaging. You have to go to class to answer Iclicker questions, you can do the assignments at your own pace. I finished the homework over a month before the semester ended. Exams were easy if you do the work.
Dr. Wooten's lectures are very engaging and well thought out. It is worth getting the course pack for this class. Overall good class

jadrian knows his stuff. very engaging and wants you to succeed. also very funny. for the tests, go back to the myeconlabs and redo the problems. go to class and participate in iclicker. you'll sweep by with an easy a. expect to talk about wings and beer quite a bit. do expect to drop a couple dollars on buying iclicker, myeconlab, coursepack etc.
Great teacher overall. material is hard, but if you go in for extra help it makes a huge difference. Go to class, if you do not you'll fall behind and miss the in-class points. Super funny guy.

Professor Wooten knows what he is teaching about, and gives a lot of flexibility for missing class and office hours. He really wants you to succeed if you want to put in the work. Make sure you don't skip a ton of class because iClicker points can be hard to catch up on, and do Packback questions as quickly as possible. Study the math for exams!

Dr. Wooten is one of the best professors I've had.  He clearly explains things in his lectures and he's always available during his office hours to clarify difficult concepts.  He cares about the success of his students and is very knowledgeable and passionate about economics so I would highly recommend him.

Dr Wooten is great. I loved and enjoyed his class. If I had actually gone to class it would be an easy A. He uses Iclicker every class. His lectures are enjoyable and time goes by fast. Be prepared to pay for and do Packback discussions and read a chapter every week, and myecon lab assignment(s) on Pearson. The tests are easy if you do the hw.

Dr. Wooten is the best professor I have had so far! His lectures are both engaging and funny. He explains concepts in a clear way. As long as you show up in class and do the iClicker questions his grading is pretty easy. He very obviously cares a lot about his class and about economics. I would take another class with him in a heartbeat.

Considering this is Wooten's first semester here at VT, I was scared. Turns out, he is an AMAZING teacher. He WILL keep you engaged in his lecture even though it's 500+ students. His homework is not difficult, but it's based a lot on the textbook, and Wooten doesn't teach from the textbook during lectures which were slightly annoying. Great prof!

Truly cares about u, and can easily get to know him. My largest class, but the teacher I was closest to. Go to the econ tutoring center/office hours to do ur homework. He's super passionate ab econ and will want u to major/minor. Short tests, know the material well. Ur lowest test is dropped! He is extremely friendly and embodies a great teacher!!!

A nice guy but was horrible at explaining concepts and material. Often he would not go over the information/concepts we needed to know for the homework assigned and does stuff in class that wastes A LOT of time. Overall though- it's an easy class if you have a little common sense and attend class to answer the massive amount of iClicker questions.

Take Dr. Wooten for Econ 2005! I had him in his first semester at Tech and this class was a blast. Wooten's lectures are a mix of him cracking funny jokes but also relevant course material. He incorporates relatable examples to understand the concepts more. Stay on top of the homework as there's weekly problems on MyEconLab and discussion posts.

Prof Wooten is an amazing professor, he is clearly knowledgeable and cares about his subject. He goes out of his way to reward people who make the effort. His class is fun, although the homework is super boring. He also requires at least 3 packsack discussion posts per week. Even so, I will always and forever recommend him to anyone taking econ.

He is a very cool guy, very funny and passionate about what he does. Personality wise, he is entertaining. However, the amount of work he gives is INSANE. Giving us homework on finals week just is not cool man.

GO TO LECTURE. Not only do iClicker points matter, but it's difficult to understand the concepts without going as lecture slides aren't released online. Super respectful and fun professor, remembered my name despite having a large class. Will help you if you need/ask. Packbacks are tedious & annoying but can be an easy grade as long as you do them.

Wooten is the most passionate teacher I've had all semester. I was not excited about taking Econ, but he made the class a lot more bearable. You can tell that he knows exactly what he's going to do and say for every class. The structure is clear and you'd have to be stupid to not know when something is due. GO TO CLASS, IClicker is mandatory.

He is very heavy on econlabs and packback posts. They are time consuming, however, they are not to bad. I love his lectures, they are great, he is hilarious. I am not very good on tests, so that part is a struggle for me. Econ tests are timed, his are 45 minutes. He is a good teacher, goodluck.

His online class was basically payback and econlab, but it took me a while to understand econ and would email me a lot and I didnt like it. When i got an A on the exam, he gave me a nice email. I do not understand the hype of this professor because everyone likes him.

very passionate about what he teaches. lectures are confusing and fast but he record all of them and posts them on canvas so its nice to review. SO MUCH EXTRA CREDIT there's an extra credit quiz after each class which helps with the exams, also extra credit pre and post survey. all of his exams were out of 100 with around 15 extra credit points
Professor Yang is a great professor. Don't let the other reviews discourage you from taking any of his classes. As long as you study the notes and take the quizzes you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Yang is a great teacher. He explains things very well. He does not try to trick you on his exams. His exams are fair. Every question can be found in the lecture slides. He also uses some of the quiz questions on the exam. I wouldn't say that the textbook is necessary. The final is not cumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: pick him if you have no other choice
he and all the students may better off if he chooses other professions. don't waste your time with him.

Dr. Yang is not a bad professor. He is very nice but he is known to put people asleep.   His exams are about 50 questions and there are 3; one of which will be dropped. The final is a huge portion of the grade too. There are no other grades. The questions on the exams are vague. I'd say go with another professor for this class.
I took his 4000 level Econ class and I learned a lot and it was enjoyable despite being challenging at times.
After the first 3 weeks I never went to class and did great. Homework is easy and so are the exams (Lowest exam grade is dropped)

Not exactly the greatest professor at teaching because he has an accent and always wears a mask so sometimes it is hard to hear him and he mumbles as well. He seems to have a lot of health issues, so he cancels class a lot, so basically don't go to class. He definitely tries his best but its understandable as he is sick. Exams are online so easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Spend time outside of class understanding the content and you should be good.

Dr. Yang is a great professor and I would recommend taking ECON 4084 if you need an econ elective. His class is very manageable though the grading is heavily exam-based the midterm is worth 40% the final is worth 50% and homework makes up the remaining 10%. The exams have no trick questions and everything tested you've already seen in class.

homework is 5% of the grade, the rest is tests. However, tests are online. Don't go to class, it is a waste of your time, and you can't hear him at all. He seems sweet, but he is not meant to be teaching cause you can hear everything else except him! It's an easy class with little work to do, but if you actually want to learn, don't take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: easiest class i've ever taken. tests on canvas are open everything and class is pointless because questions on the test are posted to canvas. impossible to understand if you're there too but easy.
Professor was super good. He was smart, and an enjoyable class. His class was optional which was nice not requiring attendance. Would take him again.
Barely works aside from slides and cant speak
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class. Attendance is not mandatory and he posts all of the lectures on Canvas. Most people don't come to class because of this but he is a really sweet guy with interesting stories when you listen to him.

I see why other people rated him so low, he's not very clear when he teaches and doesn't speak up. His grading criteria is actually really nice. We have homework that's 10%, three midterms that are each 25% (he drops the lowest), and the final that is 40%. I would say take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: literally the best class ive taken. so easy to work with and caring
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Please do not take this professor. His lectures are almost unlistenable, you can barely understand him and explains it in the worst way possible. He basically gives you the answers to the midterm and the final has some questions on it that he never goes over how to solve them. Those are also the only two grades by the way.

Awful teacher and awful class. The answer keys posted by the professor are incorrect and unedited. 37 of the 40 exam questions were on the practice problems with answer key attached. This class is a joke.

During class he just reads slides and is extremely hard to understand, also wastes class time telling us to wear masks when everyone is already wearing them. Don't even need to bother going to class, just read the textbooks bc all the test questions are out of there

He emphasizes covid and masks for 10mins every class. Can't really understand sometimes. Basically just lectures over the powerpoint than gives rigorous test. pretty common. If you have another option take it, if not you'll survive with a little effort. Better you than me I'm done with this lol.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Gets exam questions from the textbook company which means he can't release questions or answers so you have no clue what you get wrong on the exams. The class is pretty hard as it is if economics isn't your strong suit so to not be able to see what you got wrong on top of that just makes the class worse. Also holds onto exam grades for a week.
took for economics of race. easy class. 2 tests and a presentation. Professor held maybe 3 zooms the whole semester.

He was able to teach simple concepts but as the course progressed he had a hardtime explaining more complex ones. Hsiao and Soysal taught me a bit and I prefer them MUCH over Zeng. Both of those professors explain what is occuring within computer memory and whatnot when teaching. Not him. The cirriculum is already messed up, having him is worse.
Very nice professor, he makes sure all the required information is available. Would take again.

This class was pretty easy as an introduction to programming. Dr. Zeng uses a lot of examples in his lectures, which I think were helpful. The issues I had with the class was across the professors who teach it: poorly defined project expectations and constraints.

Professor Zeng seemed like he wanted us to do well but as the course went on, if you do not have coding experience you will struggle. The way the course was structured, it was hard to connect his lectures to the C++ assignments done for HW. Other people did not have a hard time so long as they had coding experience.

Love professor Zan! So understanding if you need an extension just let her know a few days before. She wants you to talk in class, could be uncomfortable for some. Some of the project instructions were confusing, but just ask her to clarify. Little bit of busywork, but it's expected. Cool projects, I genuinely enjoyed writing in this class.

I had her for a winter semester and the class was very easy. There were a few longer writing assignments with clear expectations that were graded very fairly. I put a few hours of work in per week and otherwise got to enjoy my winter as normal.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: This is one of the nicest teachers I have had. Very lenient with deadlines, gives multiple chances to earn extra credit, and has fun class periods where you watch stuff like Bojack or IASIP. The class is also super chill, and nothing was hard to write. Really recommend this class if you are looking for an easier English class.

BEST TEACHER EVER. She wants you to succeed. Attendance isn't mandatory but it is better to show up. You do get participation grades, so missing class isn't worth it. The teacher is so nice and caring you will genuinely want to go to class.
Best professor ever!! So nice and caring. Her lectures and workshops are very helpful. Highly recommend for english.

Prof. Zan is so amazing to have as your professor. She should be the number one option when picking your english 1105 professor. Very understanding and nice, she lets you turn things in a bit late sometimes but don't take advantage of it. I felt so relaxed and secure taking her class where as before I was always stressed about my next writing.

If you're taking ENGL 1105, take this professor. Super lenient on deadlines, attendance is "mandatory", but I skipped 5 or so classes and still have an A. Just do the work sometime 1 week after its due and you'll be good. Super easy grader and lectures are semi interesting. She knows that she is just an English class, if that makes sense.

I had Jenna for ENGL1105 and took her again for 1106 because she was so great. I had never been great at writing, and Jenna made her class environment so welcoming that I was not afraid of writing papers anymore. Her lectures were amazing and I learned a lot about the writing process. She also give lots of good feedback!!

I had her for EGN 1106, and she was great. She is genuinely a great professor and person. She is always willing to talk and help if you have questions. She is also very understanding of issues regarding to a student missing class or needing assignment extensions. I highly recommend her :)

Genuinely my favorite professor, she is so understanding of extending deadlines and grades easily. Don't skip every class, and at least try on your papers and you'll get an A for sure. Her lectures I found pretty interesting, especially for an entry level english. She's clearly smart, qualified, & so willing to help. Funny and the nicest person.

Amazing teacher and would definitely take her class again if I had the option. Very sweet and grades very fairly, but also cares about her students writing and progress. Easy to talk to about anything. A+ teacher

I literally LOVE her. if you want to pass English her class is the place to be. She is amazing and gives great feedback. I would recommend her till the day I die her class was the best class I had at Virginia tech so far. 

this is coming from a rising sophomore

Professor Zan is my favorite professor so far here. She is incredibly kind and understanding. Attendance is not mandatory for her, but a lot of assignments are done in class, so I would recommend going. Her instructions are always so clear and she grades like an angel. She obviously cares about her students. LOVE HER!!!!
Great teacher the work is east to do and there’s never an overwhelming amount of work to do outside of class. She grades very easily and is very understanding.

She is the most amazing woman, seriously if you get the chance to have her as a professor you are lucky. The absolute best English class I have ever taken, she is so understanding and gives incredible feedback. You will not regret taking this class, even at 8am.

Guys, if you want to pass English, trust me and take this class. She is a great teacher. I usually procrastinate when I do English, but now I always want to finish English first. She is not a hard grader at all, and she tries to see the good part of everything. Obviously, it is English and sometimes it is going to be boring, but take her!!!

Professor Sowder is incredibly kind and entertaining! The class is a good mix of lectures and activities. There are open notes quizzes that are super easy as long as you have taken good notes. There is a podcast project at the end of the semester, but you have time to work on it in class
HE IS THE BEST!!! seriously like feels like your best friend. love mr sowder.
Love this guy.
Dude probably wouldn't give MLK's "I have a dream" speech a 90. Easy class just critique heavy.

Professor Sowder is incredibly kind and genuinely cares about his students. He wants you not only to do your best, but to build communication skills you'll use long after the class ends. Take him if you can!
So sweet and kind! He made the class super fun, just show up and take the notes. All quizzes are open note, so super easy.
This class is so fun and you learn a lot!!!

Prof. Sowder was one of my favorite professors! He is super funny and makes the class really engaging. He gives great feedback and the class has 3 open book exams, a couple group projects, and 2 presentations. The class is awesome and actually helps you work on public speaking and teamwork skills. He has in class participation for attendance.
best professor at tech. great guy.
great dude, one of my favorite teachers i have had at tech. tries to get to know everyone
GOAT. GOAT. GOAT

Professor Sowder is probably one of the best teachers at tech. He created such a comfortable environment for all students. I had 3 big assignments, 2 of them were in groups. He gives you time in class to work and is always available if you need help. Definitely take any class you can with Professor Sowder.

I took Sowder's class my sophomore year as a CS major to fill a COMM requirement. I'm graduating next semester and he's still my favorite prof at VT. I was kinda dreading the class at the start but it ended up being my favorite class I've taken here--he's just such a funny and caring guy and if you have the chance to take his class you 100% should.

Love this professor. He's got this Santa Claus vibe, super chill and grandfatherly. I highly recommend taking his class. He's so understanding and knows how to make everyone feel comfortable. He's definitely not a harsh grader and you can tell he genuinely wants his students to succeed. I would only retake this class for him not going to lie.

great professor, prob one of the best i've had at vt. he's very intentional and makes the classroom a fun and interactive space. he took the time to learn our names and get to know us too. he explains the content really well and relates it back to us. make sure to go to class to take notes. he grades on quizzes, journals, and a final group project.

Mr. Sowder is an amazing professor that takes the time to get to know all his students individually! His assignments and projects are very reasonable and he takes the time to go over topics and requirements in depth. He is also very understanding and open to feedback. If you put in good effort and participate in class often, you will do fine!

Mr. Sowder is simply a great guy who wants his students to succeed. Class is heavy group work, but what would you expect with teamwork in the title? All quizzes are open-note based on the lecture, so take notes from the slides AND what he is saying. Attendance is also required for a grade (def grade booster) but he understands most circumstances.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Mr. Sowder is always willing to help his students if they need help, and creates an environment of mutual respect. Some of his assignments can be tough, and sometimes he can be a tough grader, but if he can tell you're trying and giving a good effort he is a very generous grader.

Dr. Sowder is a caring man. He often mentions his family and it's precious. He has great values and loves his students. Despite him thinking he's just an old man who is lame I think he's cool for having so many hobbies/interests and that he's a cool dad-from what it sounds like. He's the prof you'll definitely remember post-grad and maybe forever.
Sowder is a great professor. He is clear about what he expect on each assignment and is genuine and friendly with everyone.

He's an awesome guy, keeps it real, and makes the classroom a fun environment to be a part of. When he started off the semester by saying he hopes we'd all be friends by the end, I was skeptical. However, there was a good sense of community by the end, just like he'd said.

Professor Sowder genuinely cares about his students. He makes sure that everyone gets good feedback on everything they do, and makes sure that it is quick. Very easy to reach outside of class. Helps students with their own individual needs and helps them with whatever they present to him.
Such a fun, amazing, personable professor. Definitely enjoyed Comm Skills a lot and learned a lot about communicating and became a better writer for sure.

I had Sowder freshman year, and he's still one of my favorite professors I've had at Tech. He gives great feedback, and he is really there to help you. If he can tell that you're trying and putting in effort, he is a generous grader. I have recommended him as a prof to friends and they've loved him too. 10/10 would recommend his class

Prof. Sowder is a great teacher who will put in hours to help you succeed. Have had him two semester and is my favorite teacher. Not too much work just enough. A couple papers, quizzes and speeches. Very fun class and very lively. Best Comm teacher available.
Professor Sowder was the best one ive had. Hes really easy to connect with and you can tell he genuinely cares about you & your success. take his class if you can! super interesting & fun.

I loved Professor Sowder! My class was hybrid but we went in person almost every class. You are required to get a textbook but you will do fine on the quizzes if you don't read the actual book as he goes over almost everything in his lectures. There were a few quizzes, a few papers, and one group project. He is an amazing professor, take his class!

Absolutely love him! He loves to connect with his students, take extra time to get to know him and for him to get to know you and you will love him too! I use him as a reference for job applications now. The class isn't difficult but it is not easy. If I had any other professor I do not think I would have done as well. Take his classes!!

This class feels a lot like high school. he is a good professor, but his quizzes are always hard because he doesn't cover a lot of the material in class in depth enough for his quizzes. He gets off topic often and does not always know how to control a loud class.

Professor Sowder reads a lot from the textbook. His lectures are pretty basic, and his class kind of feels like high school. He randomly is a tough grader sometimes but sometimes isn't. Prepare to write a lot of papers and do a lot of speeches. This class felt easy and pointless, but I ended up getting an average grade. Did not like it.
He was very nice but also lectures were extremely boring.

Seems like a pretty cool guy but his teaching style is flawed. Saying "get ready to read" and "tough grader" is an understatement. For the participation assignments, you would read on average 20 pages and answer usually 3 SAQs (+ group work) that he would want a couple paragraphs each for. Grading takes longer than usual, and he's way too picky.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are pretty long, and he requires a ton of reading. He gives 13 assignments throughout the whole semester, which are just completion grades. Don't skip class, otherwise you won't get the assignments (not posted online). Other than that he gave one midterm which was open notes and then you have to write a 5 page final paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took a chance on him because he's new, he's just not a good teacher, seems like a nice guy. Treats his intro gen ed class like a 3000 level sociology course. Exams were pretty tough, and worth most of your grade. Be prepared to write a 5 page paper on top of that. Take this class online with a known teacher (unless its your major).
barely went to class and got an a

Has a slight accent and talks in a fairly monotone voice and sometimes mumble, but his slides are very effective. You can learn most of the content just by looking at his lecture slides. He gives out a fair amount of extra credit and no homework, just exams and quizzes.

Can be hard to understand sometimes, but the slides are good for trying to learn the material outside of class. You get one cheat sheet for exams and the final will replace all your exams if you get a higher score than the original exams.
very easy class, good at teaching, barely any homework, can use cheat sheet during exams, highly recommend.
Professor Zhang is super chill hands out lots of extra credit and he is super accommodating about exams. And he cares alot about his students. I would defiantly recommend taking him!

Good professor. Will curve grades if the class average is low. Also, he allows for cheat sheets during class. The material itself is kind of hard, but he makes it known that you can ask any question and he or the TAs will give you any answer you need.

The best professor for a math class I have ever had. The labs and practice exams make learning the content easy and engaging. He allows a handmade formula sheet and your grade on the Final replaces your exam grades if you do better. Due to his awesome lectures and study material, I was able to go from a D to an A+ over the semester.

As long as you kept up in class (paid attention) this class was easy - the final was really hard though. He has a monotoned voice but is very knowledgeable and explains the material well. The lectures are recorded, so you can watch at 2x speed if that's what you're into.

Teacher gives countless resources. All exams have study guides with questions similar to test questions. Exams are 70% of the grade but your final exam score replaces the score of all exams you scored lower on. The class is very difficult but if you use all the resources provided like piazza, lectures, study guides, etc than you are good. Open Note
Hard to understand. A mess up in one exam will drop your grade by a significant amount so study hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Textbook "not needed" but the hw all comes from the book. Uses only piazza- he and the TAs won't respond if you email. Tests are easy- they use problems you cover in class and questions on excel formulas (Q: "how to find ABC" --> A: =SUM(XYZ)). Final > midterms --> final replaces score. Final < midterms --> score doesn't change.
Nice guy who cares about his students learning however it can be difficult to understand him and the organization of the class is slightly odd.

Super nice professor and wants you to do well, just VERY test heavy. One mess up on a test will keep your grade low. The material is pretty difficult, but he does his best to help his students and gives weekly quizzes that relate to the exams. Also can bring 1 cheat sheet to each exam which is nice

If you know how to code or not; this class would teach you concepts you would learn and use later in life (not just in ChemE). Do not let the grade reflect on how much you studied! It teaches you how to think outside the box! Again, the professor teaches slowly for a reason (also makes mistakes intentionally: I assume). 

You're Welcome.
Very respected and easy going professor. Knows what he is talking about and if you care or pay attention, you will learn.
He makes his TAs grade everything and puts in little effort towards communicating with his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Acar is a really great professor, I took her for ME3624. Her lectures are great and she wants her students to excel in the class. Her homeworks are not bad, and tests require you to understand the concept. She is really willing to help and quickly responds to emails.
Pros: She is cool and fun, and always there to help. Don't skip her office hours and you'll be good. I've learned a lot in her class. Cons: The final test is HARD.
ME5984 is a great class. Dr. Acar is very knowledgeable about optimization, lectures are organized and interactive. Enjoyed her class,she is smart and easy going.

Overall, it was an interesting class. Professor is quite mathematical and her teaching style is different, but effective. Homework problems were usually hard, but she was extremely helpful during office hours. She is a nice and approachable person.
Great Professor!
Another 5 star rating for Dr. Geller. Had him for AChem and now Instrumental, and phenomenal professor in both. Great lectures, funny, quirky, and nice.
Amazing professor. Great lectures. I felt like I was missing out if I missed a lecture. Explains everything so clearly.

GREAT professor. Was there with the TAs even though he didn't have to. Gave great pre-lab lectures oversimplifying everything in a clear way. All the pre/post labs were set up to help us understand everything we did in the right order. Definitely recommend. (I believe this was his first semester teaching Majors Achem lab and he did fantastic.)
he is so awesome and funny

I took Chem 2164 which is Analytical Chem lab for majors. Despite it being his first year teaching the majors lab, he did very well and made the lab not completely insufferable which I had heard the course used to be. He is a very good and truly caring professor who loves to help and provide feedback as much as possible. Lab manual is used ($$$).
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Even with the class being a lecture, he explains the material extremely well so that it is easy to understand. He puts effort into his slides and tries to make the class as fun as possible. I would highly recommend Geller if your able to.
Geller da goat. Very funny in class, kept lectures engaging. Would totally recommend to anyone taking chem 1035.

Geller put clear effort into all of his slideshows and lectures, as well as any materials and communication outside of the lecture hall, ensuring that if you were interested in passing, you had more than enough resources to be prepared. He clearly loves his job and it makes his teaching that much better.

Dr. Geller is an amazing professor. I always enjoyed his lectures and he made Gen Chem 1 a fun class to go to. I also liked how he was a bit ahead of the curriculum, so we knew what to do for the preparation assignments. By far, the best CHEM 1035 professor.

Geller was a really good teacher and made sure we understood why things worked, rather than just telling us that they did. Attendance is taken with iClickers and your lowest few grades are dropped, so you can skip a few without penalty. He makes lectures fun though with his animations. Very engaging class.

Dr. Geller is the best prof I've had and I'm sad he can't be my prof for chem 1036 as well. If you have to take chem, take it with Geller. Chem can be hard but he provides so many notes (department made notes, and adds in his own slides). He will answer any question you have and is available in office hours. He is also very talented at powerpoint.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Geller made lectures really engaging and was accessible. He is big on making sure that you know enough to do well on tests and keeping lectures within the scope of Chem 1035. He clearly puts a lot of effort into his slideshows and is invested in making sure you learn well. The class is also relatively easy if you have prior chem experience.

Dr. Geller was a fantastic prof. He brought a lot of energy to a mundane topic like chem. He goes out of his way to try and set his students up for success. One thing in particular that he would do is create his own slides from a set of premade slides to help clarify difficult topics.

Dr. Geller is a very entertaining professor who tries to keep his students engaged throughout the whole lecture using his custom animated slides that thoroughly explain concepts.  The class is not too hard as long as you pay attention.

General Chemistry is a difficult class but Dr. Geller is great at explaining complicated topics and he keeps the class engaged with his presentations. He has helpful office hours and study sessions. Dr. Geller is great about answering questions and keeping the class updated.

Professor Geller was an amazing teacher. The slides he used were custom made and he put in lots of effort to not only have the slides be detailed, but also entertaining. He is very funny and respectful. It's impressive that he tried to learn everyone's name in the massive lecture hall and would give words of encouragement. The class is hard though.

Geller was an amazing lecturer and always showed up to the lectures prepared with detialed slides that were more in depth than other professors. He responded quickly to email and made a point to learn everyone in the huge lecture halls name. You can tell his extensive knowledge on his subject and made Chemistry fun to go to. He genuinely cared.

Dr. Geller is the best, friendliest professor I've had in college so far. He's very personable and easy to contact. Geller is the man, makes lectures very entertaining to go to and has a good sense of humor. He does a fantastic job of explaining some complicated topics. An amazing professor. Exams are open note so if you pay attention and take good notes you can do well
The absolute GOAT.

love professor poff. he talks a lot, which makes for amazing lectures. super dad like and genuinely cares about his students and the school. there's a semester long project with a presentation at the end, but it's easy and fun if you have a good group. would retake him over and over again.

reviews.comment: He is so nice and really cares about every student! I love him

Professor Poff is honestly my favorite professor at Virginia Tech. He cares so much about his students lives and their learning. He makes going to class enjoyable. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he has pop quizzes that you can't retake. A textbook is required, but it is free.

Professor Poff is amazing in every aspect. He genuinely cares about students and the topics he teaches. Attendance is not mandatory but you don't want to miss the pop quizzes! (They're easy) There are also group projects throughout the semester (same group of people).

reviews.comment: MGT 4094: Professor Poff is a very kind, enthusiastic guy. He truly cares about his students, and is always willing to help. The class is informative with presentations and guest speakers. I learned a lot in this class. Highly recommend!

A great professor in an otherwise boring class. MGT 1064 wasn't a class I learned anything in, but I thoroughly appreciated Professor Poff's attitude, flexibility, and care for individuals.

reviews.comment: Professor Poff is always very real with his students, describing content in real-world situations. I learned so much from him and would recommend that any potential student take his class in particular.

Really loved taking MGT-1104 with Professor Poff! I feel like he taught the class very well and he made the content easy to understand. He is very caring and makes his grading criteria very clear. Took class for Innovate llc. Very easy class. If you actually care about entrepreneurship Prof. Poff is a great person who will actually help you succeed. Lots of connection opportunities. One of the best Profs at Tech. Poff has tons of real world experience and helps students to enjoy in learning about business. A genuine great person inside and outside of the classroom. Ron Poff is a legend of Pamplin. His lectures are engaging and his projects are fun. Professor Poff has a wealth of real world experience in business and loves to share it with his students. Great proffesor, Definitely recommend.

Professor Poff is a great guy and great professor. He genuinely cares about students and goes out of his way to remember small details which shows that he cares. His lectures are easy to understand and interesting to listen to. Pop quizzes for attendance are taken, but there are also extra credit opportunities. Group project heavy.

Attendance isn't mandatory but I would definitely recommend it because Poff gives pop quizzes from time to time. He makes class fun and genuinely cares about how his students are doing. Amazing professor. He really cares about his students. Lots of group projects. Class is really easy as long as you study. Attendance isn't mandatory but there are pop quizzes. Honestly a great guy. He makes a lot of great conversation and is genuinely trying to help if you talk to him. Only thing is he's always mentioning his divorce but it's funny.
Hes so sweet I love him

This was a required class for my LLC. I loved the class ad thought it was a nice break from the monotony of stem classes.  If you know anything about economics at all you'll have an easy time .
Such a caring professor. Pop Quizzes so attendance is mandatory i guess but super easy. Open note tests, there are 3 tests total and a group project.

Genuinely nice person, makes class engaging. Free textbook which is pretty much the whole course. Pop quizzes occasionally. Three exams and group project makes up most of grade. Open note tests. Some unclear instructions and expectations.
GREATEST OF ALL TIME!!

Great prof

reviews.comment: Professor Poff has been amazing, and nothing but helpful, the class itself is decently tough, but as long as you pay attention you can pass easily.

Great professor, I would definitely take his class again. He does have random pop quizzes almost every week so I would still go to class but attendance isn't really mandatory just always email him if you cant make it. He is very understanding.

Professor Poff is one of the most caring professors at Virginia Tech. He actively encourages his students to participate in class, and is always available in office hours to discuss anything. reviews.comment: he's an awesome professor. he really cares about his students and is understanding with family emergencies and other situations of that sort. he's super helpful and holds lots of office hours. 10/10 recommend poff.

Not only one of the best professors, but one of the best people on campus. super fun and very approachable. Foundations of Entrepreneurship was super easy, you don't need to show up if you don't want, just make sure you do the EXEC work, but you should still try to be there cause Poff is awesome

I have taken both courses offered by Professor Poff and I am not exaggerating when I say this man knows and understands his craft AND values your time. Professor Poff is the nicest man at VT. He truly cares about his students even with the outside of class issues. Best professor at VT
One of the best professors at Virginia Tech. A clear professor, really cares for his students. Sometimes his previous semester's students visit, showing how great of a professor he is!

This class was really cool. I had to work hard but I learned a lot. I'm a native speaker so I like that she doesn't dumb down her Spanish. I want to take more classes from her.

Dr. Walker is a very nice and approachable professor. I felt welcomed in her class. She's very helpful and knowledgeable about what she teaches. The class can be difficult at times but it's nothing unmanageable. I would definitely take her again !!
