reviews.comment: Worst professor just talking empty things

Dr Gill is one of the nicest professors I have ever had in PSCI. While he runs a lecture-heavy class, you do not have to do the readings to stay up in the class. Exams are taken synchronously. He does take attendance, but participation does not matter. He is very passionate about his work and wants students to understand and enjoy the material.

Great professor, you can tell he's incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about the subject, he encourages participation and I learned a lot from the lectures. Homework is very light and he provides study guides so exams are very easy to study for. Come to class, take notes, and read the discussions/readings before exams and you'll do well!

one of my favorite professors i've had!

attendance does matter because the lectures are very integral to the material, but the lectures are quite enjoyable, very participatory and ideologically challenging in an informative way.  

i would definitely take a course from Dr Gill again!

Dr. Gill is one someone who has deep experience and passion for everything he talks about in his lectures.  His classes are very participatory and the tests are super easy as long as you pay attention in class.

Great energy in class and clearly very passionate and involved about what he teaches. Young professor and really works to relate the subject material to students. Take notes on lectures as all exams are open note and you will do well. Great professor.
Professor Bilgic is a great professor. He gives good feedback and grades fairly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Class consists 2 short video lectures a week, with an one assignment about the lectures each week. Main grades are one midterm paper, and one final paper. Class is very straightforward and easy. Professor Bilgic is kind and knows what he is talking about. Would recommend to everyone for an easy pathway 2.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor

Professor Bestami is an amazing professor who genuinely cares about his students and the subject matter. His lectures are easy to understand, and his passion for history is inspiring. I highly recommend taking his class.
Great class and the textbook is really easy to access and read. The assignments are all based off of it and easy to find the information from it. He is very nice and gives good feedback on your work.

Everything he talks about in class can easily be found in the textbook, and gives a thorough, clear study guide before exams. While attendance is not mandatory, it's good to attend classes because he goes in depth on a lot of topics and it's easier to understand when he explains it. He's not a harsh grader and wants his students to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easy class, but incredibly boring lectures. In class quizzes but they're for attendance. Weekly quizzes, take home midterms and finals, and one big project.

Lectures are super long and can get boring, but it's definitely an interesting class. Assignments are online, with one quiz per week on readings. Attendance is not mandatory, but Professor Binev encourages students to attend class to earn points for in-class quizzes based on lectures. Overall, he's great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's the best. Very easy class.

He's alright. I tried not to fall asleep every time I was in his class. It's not horrible; in class attendance quizzes, a weekly quiz, a midterm, 1 project, final. Everything is online outside of class though. It definitely wasn't my favorite class, but bearable. I'd only recommend this course if it is required, not for an elective/pathway.

Really easy class, just read the book or get a good summary of it for the quizzes. You usually get one quiz a week and if you did the reading they are not very hard. Their is a lot of reading each week, a bit much for an intro class, however, the class being easy makes up for it. One midterm, one final. Really nice professor.

Not a fan. Took my second semester sophomore year in a freshman lecture. All my other classes were 3000 level and yet he made this class needlessly difficult, making it my worst grade. Harsh grader who gives no feedback, singles out students who arrive a couple minutes late, and the lecture content does not seem to come up in any assignment.

Great Professor, and great guy. There is a lot of reading for this class, but his discussions are of the best I have ever been a part of. About 40-50 pages of reading between each class, but worth it to be involved in the class.

If you love regurgitating obscure definitions and HATE critical thinking, this is your guy. His tests are either extremely easy or unbelievably difficult with poorly phrased questions. His lectures are also extremely boring, as he teaches his students to remember terms and not concepts. He seems nice but needs to rethink his entire teaching style.

Dr. Binev is very well educated and you really tell he cares a lot about what he teaches. Attendance was not mandatory, but I would definitely recommend going to class as much as possible because he has in class questions that are graded for participation credit. Overall, not a super hard class; all quizzes and exams are open note.

Lots of textbook readings which is to be expected for a PSCI course, but still feels a bit excessive. For an intro class it feels harder than it should be but overall isn't awful. I will say he is very easy to reach outside of class and his office hours are very helpful. Midterm and final are LONG and many quiz and exam questions are confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: all quizzes and tests are take-home but there is an annoying amount of reading that you have to do. not super heavy on notes and there are a couple graded questions during class similar to iclicker. his class kinda made me fall asleep though tbh because he would basically talk the whole 1hr 15min

Pretty cool guy, his lectures are slightly mind-numbing but overall the class isn't hard. The class itself is graded on very few things and rely heavily on exam scores. There is a take-home assignment that wasn't too hard, and he has in class questions that can boost your grade as long as you show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Binev was a pretty good professor overall. He's really smart and is very into what he does. He really wants everyone to pass, just go see him in office hours. I will say this class is VERY reading heavy -  anywhere from 10-40 pages depending on the week. Take good notes as well, you can use them on at least the final.

Dr. Binev is an amazing professor! PSCI 1024 might not be the easiest class you ever take, but Dr. Binev is more than willing to give any help when needed. It's clear that if you put in the work, he genuinely wants you to succeed. Dr. Binev is all and all a really likeable and fun person, and I really enjoyed his class.

Dr. Binev was a really nice and helpful professor. I was struggling initially in his class, but once when I visited his office hours, he helped me tremendously. As long as you read the readings, do the discussion posts, and go to his office hours when you need help, you will do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: It's a lot of reading, but it's a poli sci class so that's to be expected. Professor Binev's lectures can be boring, but he's funny. You have to do at least 8 discussion posts during the course, but that isn't too bad as long as you don't procrastinate. Quizzes are open-notes. The final and midterm were all online and you could take them wherever.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Respected

reviews.comment: Lectures were so boring, I was falling asleep every class. We had biweekly discussion posts and weekly quizzes to help our grades, but we rarely got feedback on them. The midterm and final are SOOOOO long which was a bummer. You have to go to office hours to find out your grade. Did not like this class at all.

Harsh grader, overall quizzes aren't too bad. Weekly quizzes are given with 10-15 questions based on the textbook readings. Be ready to read 20-30 pages from the textbook before each class. The overall class is difficult but should be good if pay close attention to lectures. Discussion posts will be a big part of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is honestly the hardest Political Science class I have taken at Virginia Tech. His quiz/test questions are so confusing and could have multiple right answers. Also, be prepared to read roughly 30 text-book pages a class. I would recommend taking this class with another teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super Nice, would recommend going into his office hours and getting to know him a bit as he is really helpful. Lots of reading but nothing super bad, quizzes would get annoying, but they are quick and you can still get an A without doing well on the quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Binev is an exceptional professor who I couldn't recommend more. This class was mostly a seminar class and he encourages participation and critical thinking on the subject matter. Most of the work is reading and coming to class with something to say

Dr. Binev is a relatively tough grade for an introductory course. This course is quiz heavy so make sure you do the readings. The questions on the quizzes can be confusing/similar at times, which were usually the ones I got wrong. Lectures were straightforward but boring at times. Overall, fine professor but be ready to not get 100s on assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Super informative class, you definitely get out what you put in. Easy A but still can learn a lot from the class/

This might be my least favorite class I've ever taken. He ruined my interest in going into play-by-play. There is way more homework than necessary and it's all busy work. He doesn't give any feedback at all. He expects you to be perfect but doesn't even hold class or get to know his students. If you are a woman, avoid this class.

The class is one of the best classes I've had at VT.  Bill is funny in class and he cares about us which shows. The lecture notes are all posted after each class which is awesome if you miss.  Also, there's a class YouTube channel where you can watch lectures and review before quizzes.  I loved the class and learned a lot about sports media.

Bill is an annoying guy, he rants about how he doesn't care about whether or not you make a mistake, thats your fault and he won't take makeups or redos. Then I asked him to change the amount of points on a quiz to help my grade, then he says he needs to think about the people who did bad, like pick one man. He is annoying and acts like hes cool.

No need to go to class since he posts all the notes. Quizzes are extremely easy and you have a bunch of time to take them and they are open note. Make sure to not miss anything, Bill has a no tolerance policy on late work. Bill is a relaxed teacher who is just really interested in the topic. Great guy. Super easy. Easy 100 little effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He was a good professor, but I didn't love his personality. He made a questionable comment on the first day of class that didn't sit right with me. I would take his class again as he is really insightful in his field of study, however, he should probably stick to discussing his field of study.
Because of his real-world experience, he makes the class interesting. I love him so much and hope to take more classes with him in the future.

Bill doesn't want to go to class just as much as you don't, even though sports media is amazing. I LOVE this man. He pointed me in the direction of things to get me more involved as an SMA major and I'm very thankful. Easy class, super fun lectures, really cool assignments.

Love Professor Bloomfield. My first ever class was with him, and he set an unbeatable standard despite it being his first-year teaching. He cares so much about his students, and it shows. Literally all you have to do is participate and you'll become one of his favorites. Quizzes/Tests are open note. Rarely any HW. Take FOB with him!

I would 100% take Professor Bloomfield's classes again. He is a great professor who genuinely cares about each student inside and outside the classroom. He truly wants to see every student succeed and gives his all in doing everything to help this happen. He is inspiring and caring in his everyday life and it is shown in his teaching style.

He is amazing, would 100% take him again!! It is a bit textbook heavy when it comes to knowing the chapters but they are an easy read. He is very caring, if you are struggling with anything that might affect your performance in class or with class work definitely talk to him.

Lax late work policy, very willing to help with road bumps during the (copious) group projects, very focused on preparing you for the professional world (sometimes at the minor expense of actual course material.) Open book tests and exams where printed notes are allowed.

Overall, very energetic and valuable.

I feel like I could have taken this class without a professor and I would be in the same spot that I am in right now. He just talks in quotes and doesn't really help/teach but the TA's are goated for actually helping. Everything is so vague to recreate the "real world" but I am not paying 12k a semester for vague directions.

Bluey is a good professor who does his best to make sure that his students learn the material. There have been some times where it was confusing, but he always asks for feedback when it does happen and usually works out in the end. Great guy, good person, and  very understanding.

Professor Bluey isn't the best, however he takes the SPOT survey very seriously and does his best to improve every year. I have had three classes with him and gets more manageable as he learns and adjusts. He listens to students, provides good feedback, and request feedback in return. Very easy course, just pick a good team and be a good sport.
very knowledgeable professor that knows the material and wants to see his students learn.
Nice guy but was unorganized had confusing assignments.

Prof Bluey is a nice and genuine guy but really lacks teaching skills. The class as a whole has a very poor structure and will leave you constantly confused. The semester project has a very unclear rubric and is graded poorly with bad feedback. The processes needed for the project are also barely touched on in class. Avoid if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very nice guy. He is very passionate about writing and is a great teacher. Always ask for help if you need it because he WILL help you if you ask. Gives a good amount of time for papers and is overall one of my favorite Writing teachers. Would definitely take his class again.
very good teacher!!!

Really nice guy, super funny. If he gets excited about something, he's like a crazy person on stage. Sometimes he lost me because you can tell he's so smart, but it was still fun to listen to. Very helpful on papers.

Careers in MGT class is honestly a joke, it just making a resume and completing like 3 other assignments, but Bluey is an awesome guy and really cares about his students. If your able to get him make sure to connect with him, he can help you out later

He takes two weeks at minimum to respond to emails, often he never replies. The tests were weird and he doesn't give any way to prepare for them other than studying notes. The group projects are really time consuming, but he does adjust grades based off peer reviews which is good. You have to read the textbook and cases throughly.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: He brings in a lot of great guest speakers from government, business, and more. The few assignments we do are really meaningful such as the Resume and Elevator Pitch assignment.

I took MGT 1104 with Bluey as a hybrid class. I really liked how he let his students choose if they wanted to come to class or attend via zoom. He doesn't always give the best instructions for his projects but it was manageable and he seems to care a lot about his student

Bluey is not a bad teacher, and he is definitely passionate about his teaching. Sometimes his directions for projects are a bit unclear, but in terms of tests he gives you all of the resources you need to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: bluey is great. he's a super nice guy but his lectures are a little dull. he covers everything you need to know for exams and gives extra study materials. definitely be prepared for group projects. really can't go wrong taking his class.

Great professor, lectures can feel like they take a while but they cover everything you'll see on the test so it's best to listen up. Group projects are the constant throughout this class so if everyone does their part they're very easy. Tests are straight forward so if you study you'll do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Bluey is an amazing teacher! Gave lots of good opportunities for good grades and as long as you go to class and pay attention you will do well. He gives you whats going to be on tests and helps a lot with group projects making sure you get the grade you deserve!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Great professor who has a lot of professional experience in the business world and wants his students to succeed. The tests are large word bank and are not difficult as long as you understand the vocabulary. There is a food cart project where you do not pick your group so that comes down to luck but the project itself is not that difficult.

Thought about pros the entire semester and literally thought of none other than the fact that you can zone out and think about what you ate for breakfast that morning -borderline impossible exams -confusing beyond belief -doesnt understand people in the absolute slightest -footnotes for the hw are longer than the hw problems
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Grading on tests can be unclear. Go to office hours to fight for points back for tests, almost every time you can get at least a point. Must go to class and take notes to understand, but the professor cares about students and presents his notes in a well fashioned manor. I would say he is prepared to teach each class

Prof. Black is really underrated. He gets a bad wrap often because he is very specific about how he wants things presented and likes things a certain way (e.g. he expects graphs on hws to be drafted with a straightedge). However, he's animated & responsive & really cares about his students 'getting' each major concept
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: This professor is to be AVOIDED at all costs . He is an extremely tough grader, who will pose questions to mechanical engineers that are difficult for third year electrical engineers to solve. Furthermore, he is unprofessional, rude, condescending, and unaccommodating to extenuating circumstances, he will punish you for things outside your control.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Dr. Bloomer's class a lot. She is a kind individual and her assignments pushed me creatively. I enjoyed most of the assignments. The only downside is that she can be a bit nit picky about what she wants you to say on the tests, but I still got an A+.
Really nice and caring women, definitely really cares about what she is teaching. 3-4 major quizzes and homework every night. A lot of writing... should be expected??
She was fantastic. Be prepared for a substantial amount of writing homework.

If you are interested in creative writing or want an easy pathway, do not take this class. You will genuinely receive no actual feedback on your work, besides if it didn't meet the laundry list of format guidelines she gave you. On top of that, she is the rudest, most condescending teacher I have ever had the misfortune of experiencing.

No clear grading whatsoever, zeros on assignments I completed correctly. You are expected to turn around assignments so quickly that the fun and creative aspect comes out of it, and it feels like a chore. I took this class because I love writing but it kind of ruined it for me and made me dread doing it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She cares a lot about each of her students since her classes are relatively small. There is a lot of writing, but the instructions are always clear and it comes out of a place of what you want to write about, not assigned readings. The class was engaging and super manageable if you go to class. She's willing to meet with you to help when you need.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ridiculous approach to a Creative Writing course. Poems were graded absurdly; font size 13 instead of 12? 10-20% off. Capitalize a word or include a period? Same story. This led to many in my class failing homeworks despite having no issues whatsoever with the content of the poems. Clearly doesn't care about the course's content or students' work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Favorite professor I've met throughout my time at Tech by far. Incredibly caring and feels like she wants you to succeed. Discussions can go off topic from time to time, but they are always incredibly interesting. A fairly decent amount of HW, finish when assigned to you and you'll be fine. Im a physics major and she made me genuinely love writing.

Bloomer is such an amazing professor and truly cares about her students. There were 3 quizzes throughout the semester. There is a good bit of homework and writing, but this is a writing class so it makes sense. The homework does require you to be creative, but it is not hard. She is extremely flexible with her students and wants to work with them.

She makes her political views known every chance she gets. It's almost like she pushes you to believe what she believes. She puts down others if they don't agree. Homework is a lot and is due the next class. I was already burnt out by week 5 because of how much I had to write, which ruined the creative writing aspect. Don't recommend taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Bloomer is very kind and was overall a good professor. But if you're not a big writer, I wouldn't recommend her. Her homework assignments are so frequent and lengthy to the point where you write not to be creative but just to get the assignment done. Not my favorite professor but not the worst.

Professor Bloomer is your typical white woman English teacher. She assigns three homework assignments that are so frequent and demanding to the point where you don't even feel creative when you write because the required length is either really long or you're just burnt out from the sheer amount of homework. I would recommend a different prof.

The professor is very kind and cares for her students deeply. I wished this class had more structure and a thorough schedule. Assignments were kind of confusing, directions are never posted on Canvas, so you just have to remember what she said in class by mouth. Assignments are graded very late, so you don't know what you truly have in the class.

Bloomer is very understanding and clearly a very experienced professor in English. Her lectures are very interesting and actually worth listening to but her journal homework is quite time consuming; every lecture is followed by a one-paged single-spaced assignment due by next lecture on topics that is sometimes too complex to write about

This professor fakes her kindness. You can easily tell who she likes and doesn't like in the class, and grades assignments accordingly. Even if you're a hardworking student, it won't matter if she doesn't like you. There are plenty of other good professors for 1105, and I strongly recommend you consider taking the course with one of them instead.

Bloomer is INCREDIBLE! Her lectures are interesting, her assignments are fun, and she feels like another school mom. She wants everyone to succeed and is very good at teaching Creative Writing. In fact, the class was practically made for her. She doesn't believe in exams, but her quizzes can be tough. Memorize her journal structures!!
She cares about her students. She is cool and quirky. Classes are pretty entertaining. She is very accommodating and will be very understanding if you tell her what is going on in your life.

Ms. Bloomer was easily the best English teacher I've ever had. She is a very passionate teacher, and she will always make sure you feel welcome in her class. Homework in Creative Writing took some time and creativity to complete, but never felt unfair and oftentimes felt like a break from my other work. Take notes on key course concepts!

Caring professor who wants to help and know her students in the best way. Write small one page journals on a topic, but show effort and they're very easy. Go to class for participation and in-class writing credit. Time-consuming papers, but show your effort and she'll hold your hand until the deadline. Follow her directions, can be a tough grader.

Professor Bloomer is a super caring professor who wants to see her students succeed. I really enjoyed her class and her lectures are amazing. The only thing I would say is that she can be hard to reach because she doesn't reply to her emails, but other than that, she is a solid choice of a professor.

Dr. Bloomer is the best English/writing professor i have EVER had. She helps you every step of the way with long papers and makes it fun! Instructions are always clear. She is very personal with everyone in the class and gets to know you personally. Attendance is not counted towards your grade but attendance is important for success in the class.

I genuinely enjoyed Bloomer as a professor and person. She truly cares about students wellbeing, assigns interesting projects, and gives great feedback and TONS of extra credit opportunities. Beware, this class is very time and homework intensive. If you're looking for an easy ENGL 1106 prof you might want to reconsider taking Bloomer.

This class was overall really interesting. I'm not much of a writer but the lectures were clear and very helpful and there was a lot of support no matter what level of writing you're at. The professor is really caring and inclusive which creates a nice learning environment.

For Creative Writing, if you actually enjoy writing poetry and prose, take her class because shes a great professor who is passionate about writing and gives great feedback. However, if youre taking the class for an elective and have a lot on your plate, she gives a LOT of homework and the assignments are pretty lengthy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Pretty easy class. There's a journal assignment every class which is usually about a page-page and a half - single spaced. A few quizzes that are open notes. Prof is super sweet and caring about her students, and she is VERY understanding. If you need help, definitely reach out to her and she will accommodate you in any way necessary.

Bloomer was absolutely amazing! She treats you like you're her own child and genuinely cares about all her students. She takes the time to get to know you and is always willing to give feedback. She also gives out extra credit like crazy and is very specific on what you need to do for her papers. It would be really hard to get a low grade.
She is my favorite teacher here at tech! I would highly recommend for anyone to take any of her classes.

Professor Bloomer is probably my least favorite professor so far. She treats eng 1106 as a creative writing class and she loves to go on unnecessary tangents. She also loves to bring up her political views. If you're her teachers pet, you can miss class and will always be able to get credit on assignments you missed. Her class was so annoying to me
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She makes this class much more difficult and annoying than it should be. Her outlines for work are very broad, and she never gives set deadlines for assignments. She talks about useless things during lecture time, and makes her political views known in an obnoxious way.

Bloomer is absolutely amazing! She really kindled my love of writing and keeps in touch with students who reach out to her even after the class has ended. I really enjoyed her class, so much that I added Creative Writing as a secondary major! I 100% recommend Bloomer at all costs, especially for Introduction to Creative Writing! (:

I like Bloomer but she is too into group bonding instead of English. She's also a little annoying and I have to pretend to be a democrat for a whole semester. I took AP Lang and AP Lit in high school so I am genuinely bored in this class. It's not a walk in the park so show up and do the homework but if you do that you'll get an A.
Very good human being and genuinely cares about her students. Grading criteria was unclear and there was WAY too much work though
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Bloomer really is a great prof. She actually cares about you as a person and as a student. She gives a good bit of homework, but it isn't hard. Just do the work. Quizzes are kinda weird, but they won't affect your grade much. Overall, Bloomer is probably the best prof I had my freshman year and would definitely retake if I had the chance.

Bloomer is the best English teacher I have ever had. She makes the course material interesting and innovative. She pushes you to do your best but keeps you interested in the material. Expect a lot of writing. She assigns extra credit that apply the the papers you write to help you get the grade you want if you are not an excellent writer.
Good.

I used to be very into writing, but I haven't done much of that at all in the last few years. This class revived my love of writing, and I chalk it up to Bloomer's teaching. She's absolutely lovely, she gives fantastic prompts, she is always willing to help, and she gives great feedback. Amazing professor and human being.
Mrs. Bloomer is a great teacher. The course material is interesting and unlike your typical English class. She is always available outside of class in order to help you out one-on-one.

Ms. Bloomer gives helpful feedback, and she obviously cares a great deal about her students; she's always willing to meet with you to discuss your work. There are a lot of written assignments, but that's to be expected in a creative writing course.

Great Teacher.  Little bit more writing then average class but manageable.  Very clear concise directions and will always meet with you if you need help. Discussions and readings always keep it interesting.
A feminist. Everything in the class has to relate to gender which gets old quick. She spends forever on the two papers you have to write, making them take longer than they should.

If you are someone who cannot stand ignorance or hypocrisy then do not take this class. She tells you to think differently and she wants us to challenge ourselves and yet everything that we talk about is always due to gender and if you bring up anything challenging her ideas it will be shot down.Emancipate yourself from mental slavery- the great BM
Good teacher, a lot of writing.
great class, great teacher....I dont usually like english, but elizabeths class was great- interesting and fun. Lots of writing, but she grades very easily and gives tons of extra credit

Elisabeth is so much fun!  She keeps class entertaining and focused.  I will really miss her next semester and although this class was very work intesive, it was also rewarding.  I always looked forward to going.  I hope I can take more of Elisabeth's classes in the future.
Class was interesting most of the time, and she is very understanding. She makes the writing assignments as painless as possible

Very good teacher, class discussions are always interesting. Writing assignments are very demanding but this class will make you a better writer. Lots of extra credit oppurtunity. A very fun class to be in.
She was quite demanding with her courseload, but not unreasonable. Her grading isn't overly harsh as long as you do the work like she asks.

gives lots of extra credit, which is about the only good thing about her class.  she says she's open to everyone's opinions, but then puts down those she doesn't agree with, acts like she has all of this godly knowledge to impart upon us lowly children.  i will never take another class from her

She was very encouraging. She really made the classroom environment a safe haven to speak out. However, I did not like that she seemed critical of views that opposed her own. She also was somewhat stubborn about admitting mistakes. She seemed somewhat biased toward or against certain students.

Lissa keeps the discussions fun and upbeat and ALWAYS provides strong feedback on writing projects.  She is always able to focus the class on the task at hand, but in an interesting and thought provoking way.  The class projects were helpful to writers by focusing on the starting point for writers.
Wonderful teacher!! Cares about students and puts forth the extra effort for them!! She cares about what she does and makes class definately worth your while. All around a good person.

Mr. Bliss is an overall good professor. However, he claims that grades don't matter in the beginning of the year and you would expect to get an easy A. He is not a very good communicator when it comes to grades or assignments and therefore will probably screw you over.

You need a thick skin if you take Bliss. If you're "sensitive" you won't like him. He makes jokes, and some kids think he's attacking them. He's not, he's just demonstrative. I believe this class made me a better writer. He grades papers hard, but go to his office and have him look at a draft before it's due. Treat the draft like your final though.

i wasn't a fan of him or his class at first, and even considered dropping the class; but i stuck it out and i'm really glad i did.  his methods are different, but he genuinely cares about his students, both as students and individuals, and he has amazing stories to tell and lessons to teach. he sucks at remembering names, but nobody's perfect.

he's extremely judgmental and condescending.  some of the conversations in class are interesting, but completely irrelevant to the topic.  he won't bother to learn your name unless he REALLY likes you...but even if he doesn't know your name, he thoroughly enjoys singling you out and embarrassing you.

He is the coolest teacher I have ever had.  This is the easiest class ever and Michael Bliss makes it even easier. Everyone should take him. He should be the only english teacher in Virginia Tech and his classes should be 1000 people.

Michael Bliss is a great guy, but never on topic. Grades easy for students he likes, but he'll like you as long as you aren't a jerk and come to class. He asks alot of questions; some have to do with class but most dont! If you respectfully give your opinion when he asks questions and ask some of your own from time to time he'll respect you.

getting help from Bliss is pointless. his brilliant idea of clarifying what he means by his writing assignments is to have you reread his prompts. as if you had somehow not thought to do that before writing the paper. he puts no effort into grading your work. his ability to be a competent professor leaves much to the imagination.
Class is fun. Off the subject all the time, but I enjoy listening to crazy stories, rather than doing work.
Definately an interesting class, rarely on topic, but he's a nice a guy and I enjoyed the class.
bliss is a loser and is probably one of the worst teachers that i have ever had. avoid this professor at all costs

1106 is absolutely heinous with this man.  Bliss is completely filled with****.  Don't believe anything he says.  The only thing that is good about this class is that it was so ridiculously easy.  Even though he says attendance is mandatory, its really not because he won't remember your name.
Bliss is a great teacher.  He makes class interesting and I enjoy going every day.  He makes fun of students in a nonharmful way which is always good for a few laughs

bliss is a fun teacher, we rarely discussed the books we read, most discussions were on the happenings in the world, he hasn't watched TV in over 10 yrs he hates football and hates smoking,, he's very entertaining and if you read the quizzes are nothard i don't think i missed a class b/c ienjoyed it
Cannot stand that class.

I seriously loved this class. Britt was so encouraging and knowledgeable about his subject. He was my last in-person professor in college and I'm glad he was. Highly recommend his classes to anyone interested in learning more about the bible
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: The class isn't too hard. He grades easy, but the topics we go over are a bit confusing and boring at times.

He is one of the WORST teachers I have ever had at Tech. His class is so boring you want to die and he does not even stay on the topics that were planned on the syllabus. His exams and quizzes are extremely difficult and he can't seem to figure out why..he makes the class more difficult then it needs to be and should be for a 100 level class.

Claire really cares about her students and wants to see them all succeed. She's a nice lady and seems to have a lot of experience, but when it comes to the lectures, she kind of just spends the entire class reading off of the daily agenda (for that day's class and the next). Also make sure to follow her instructions to a T to receive full credit.

rly good class, anyone who says she is a hard grader is lying cus she tells you exactly what you need to get a good grade and has insanely clear guidelines/instructions. offers a lot of extra credit, lacks enthusiasm at times, can get pretty boring, shes very sweet and cares alot, if youre struggling or are confused jus talk to her, very helpful

She can be a little repetitive but she is just trying to make you aware of what to do. The calendar is very helpful, textbook is just a small notebook, it's only like $30. Comm 1015 / 1016 in the same textbook. Can be a "tough grader" but you have many opportunities to pass, everything is laid out in the rubric. Be kind to Claire.

She talks about her calendar every day for like 80% of the class and just goes over the same things every time. She is a hard grader on random criteria she makes up. She is extremely boring, The class isn't hard but she is so boring and a hard grader if you can take someone else do it.
Run and dont look back
Class is like watching paint dry. She is super nice, but will tell you you aren't gonna get a good grade before you even do an assignment. Hardest grader I've had so far, avoid her at all costs.

Class is very boring, half the lecture is about future class which makes it hard to pay attention. Will take off many points for small mistakes and following her guidelines wont help your grade at all.
over explains everything, homework assignments sneak up on you, super nice but hard grader, you can tell she really cares about her students
The hardest grading instructor I've ever had, very nice but avoid if possible

Amazing Professor—she makes all her assignments easy to understand and provides plenty of examples and outlines. She also offers lots of extra help opportunities; you just need to take the initiative to seek them out. Overall quality professor and quality course would take again.

Class is mandatory, and she drags on everything she says. Sitting through this class is painful, and no one pays attention. It is easy to get a good grade, but I would absolutely recommend taking this class with a different professor.

Claire is super sweet, but you absolutely HAVE TO GO TO CLASS. She gives 3 absences that you won't be penalized for, but other than that go to class. tbh I would have done significantly better if I hadn't taken it at 9am, but oh well! that's on me.

Claire is a kind and caring professor. I found that this class was incredibly simple for anyone with any background in English and writing at all. Claire has a tendency to oversimplify instructions for assignments, which makes class time drag on and feels so tedious.
Claire is lowkey a chiller beast in the classroom.

Claire is very kind and truly wants the best for all of her students. She can be a tough grader at times but she gives you many opportunities to go to office hours and the writing center for extra credit. The writing assignments aren't too difficult, she gives a pretty strict rubric to follow. She does use participation assignments so go to class.

Claire is an easy-going professor. As long as you put in the effort and communicate with her about any questions or concerns, you'll be just fine. She listens to any changes that want to be made and often makes the changes that students want. She looks to benefit the students to make sure they have an enjoyable, welcoming, atmosphere.
Overall good teacher, majority of the grade is made up of varying writing assignments
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Talk to her, go to office hours, build a relationship. She is there to help you and cares so much but you need to reach out and ask for the help.

Everyone deserves for Claire to be a part of their life at some point. She is an unwavering source of brightness and a terrific instructor. She has a tendency to oversimplify things like the calendar/certain expectations for assignments, which can make the class time feel like a waste, but overall, she is very helpful in teaching Communications.
Nice, good in office hours, works with you if you have a late assingment.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: THE ACTUAL GOAT! One of the best teachers I have ever had, no joke. Inspirational lectures that make you actually want to do well. Dynamics is hard, don't get me wrong, but he gives generous curves and extra credit opportunities, so your grade will be fine if you work hard. Try your best to get this guy, you won't regret it!
Best professor I have taken in my time at tech.

Incredible professor. His tests are challenging because there is no partial credit for the MCQ part which makes up over half the exams but he posts all the answers from the textbook in video form. Goes fast during class but class was fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This dude is the man. I had the 4:00-5:15 lecture, I tried to fall asleep one day and physically couldn't. Jeffy boy has mastered the craft of being an educator. I adore the little tangents he would go on. When you take Bolton, your not just learning statics/dynamics, you are getting full on life lessons. I just cant believe "ITS OVER!!!"

Difficult class, very high standards, but excellent teaching. So many resources on his canvas page (recorded lectures, practice problems, released exams), he genuinely cares that the students understand the material and become competent engineers. Take him!

I really enjoyed having Bolton as a teacher. I would definitely recommend going to office hours!! I didn't, and I really regret it. You HAVE to pay attention in class. He genuinely wants his students to do well and is so willing to help. TRY TO GET BOLTON!!

Best prof I've had. Highly recommend. Provides so many practice problems, records, lectures, records solutions to all the practice problems. Really cares about his students. Amount of dedication he puts for the course is amazing. Tests are curved, and puts MCQ questions right from test 1, as the final is full MCQ. For those who know, ITS OVER!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was so entertaining and caring. He offers SO MUCH online support with both recorded lectures from the semester and individual videos for every page and example in the notes. Exams all got a pretty strong curve because they are difficult but he helped me do so much better than I would've hoped to in this class. Overall just so friendly!

GOAT! Professor Bolton is one of the best teachers I have ever had in my life. The problems he goes over in class are in depth, and actually the ones you will see on the homework. The whole class is super fair. It is a hard subject to understand, but his lectures and his way of teaching make you want to attend class and learn. He is an amazing guy.

Professor Bolton was an AMAZING teacher. I had him for Statics and he taught everything in a way that made me actually understood the material. He provides so many extra resources, posts all lecture recordings, and multiple really good practice exams. He even does a review session for the final. Assigns lots of homework though.

Jeff Bolton has been my favorite professor here at Virginia tech. His tests are fair and he makes every topic much easier to understand than any statics professor i've heard of. If you can, choose Bolton over anyone else.
Bolton is awesome highly recommend taking his class

His clear explanations and sense of humor made the class enjoyable. The short YouTube videos for every concept really helped me grasp tough material. It's still a very hard and fast class, but he made it much more approachable. He goes really fast, so really go to the videos to do the problems again for yourslef outside of class.

Easily one of the best teachers/professors I have ever had. His lectures are straight out of a movie -- they are so animated, it's hard not to pay attention. He made statics, a difficult subject, easy to learn, and in an engaging way. Also, his grading is very fair, and he even gives a variety of extra credit opportunities.

Bolton is an awesome professor and awesome guy. He gives extra credit on all his tests and curves them if the average is low. He is very caring for all his students and wants to help you succeed. There are multiple opportunities to increase your grade and his office hours are very helpful. If you ask him, he will bump up your grade from a minus

His lectures are so animated, it's easy to listen. He makes education fun, and he makes statics easy to understand. He provides MULTIPLE practice tests before every exam, and he grades very fairly. He is like one of those inspirational teacher characters from a movie - it really doesn't get any better than him.

Had him for both Statics and Dynamics, came back to say that Dr.Bolton is the best prof at VT.  Course is well structured, very accessible resources, reasonable tests, engaging lectures, and he cares about students.  Bolton constantly works to improve his course and it shows.  He is a huge inspiration and deserves a raise.

One of the best experiences I have had at VT was his dynamics class. He just energizes you to want to do well. His homeworks and exams are hard, but he provides hints and is very helpful during office hours. He also wrote the textbook so it's super easy to follow along with it. The most organized professor ever. IT'S OVER!!!!!!

Dr. Bolton is truly one of the best professors I have had at VT. He provides an immense number of resources, like recorded lectures, detailed homework solutions, helpful office hours, and ample notes. He is very organized and always describes the most common mistakes on problems. I 100% recommend him for Statics. He also curved exams, if needed.

Dr. Bolton is the most passionate professor I've had. His lectures are engaging and fun. Though the tests were incredibly long and difficult (most students didn't finish) Dr. Bolton will curve if the average is low. He cares about his student's grades a lot and is very reasonable.

Best professor at VT. He genuinely cares for his students and helps them succeed. He's always available outside of class. A hilarious storyteller with amazing energy. made statics my most fun class of the semester. Go to class, do the homework, ask questions when you need and you should do great.

Dr.Bolton is everything a good professor should be, and probably my favorite at VT.  Hilarious and engaging lectures, and made Statics so easy to understand.  He deserves an award or something for how awesome of a professor he is, I also loved his stories.  Notes and Canvas page are super organized, and he goes above and beyond.  IT'S OVER!!!

IT'S OVER! Dr. Bolton is the best professor I've had at VT. He genuinely cares about his students, listens to feedback, and clearly explains concepts. He thoroughly goes through examples and has plenty of extra resources if you're struggling in the class. He's enthusiastic about the subject and makes lecture entertaining with his clever personality

Professor Bolton is one of the best teachers I have had, he is very enthusiastic and makes the lectures worth attending although it is not mandatory as he records all of them. He teaches the material by doing problems in class and working through them with the students and checking for understanding. He wants his students to do very well.
Best professor at Virginia Tech, genuinely wants to help you

I am so happy I took Professor Bolton for my summer Dynamics class. In his syllabus, emails, and lectures he hints at tips for success and common student pitfalls. I found the exams to be very similar to in class examples and homework. He also curved some of my class' exams by a decent amount.

Dr. Bolton is one of the best teachers I have ever had. He teaches with so much enthusiasm and is hilarious during lectures. He also does a ton of examples in class. He gives 2-3 challenging online homework assignments per week, but you will be set if you go to office hours, as he is always willing to help. He wants his students to succeed.

Dr. Bolton is a great professor. He is exciting during the lectures and keeps the students engaged. For a class like dynamics this was definitely necessary. I recommend Dr. Bolton to anyone who tends to drift off or become bored during class because he makes that very difficult. Truly cares and wants students to succeed.

Extremely clear when teaching and helpful with answering questions. Biggest thing is he teaches with an insane amount of examples which is the bulk of all exams. Also, he posts videos of all lectures and practice problems you will ever need to be prepared.

Got to be hands-down one of the best teachers at Tech. Statics is one of the essential classes for engineering basics, so I think it's very important to learn it solidly. While his class is hard, you'll come out of it really knowing your stuff. Office hours are the best, he's willing and able to answer any questions you have even just over email.

Amazing. His lectures are great and focus on example problems which prepares you very well for exams. His exams are very fair and often have the highest averages of all the statics sections. Very fair professor and genuinely listens to student feedback. Ignore his historically low GPA averages, those are from when he taught as a grad student.

Bolton was a great professor for statics. He's a funny professor that keeps you engaged in the lectures. You can also skip class and just watch the lectures at home because he posts them. He has little videos you can watch if you get lost at a certain point and his tests were fairly easy compared to the HW. He does assign 2-3 assignments a week

Dr. Bolton does everything an ideal professor should do. He posts tons of extra videos on Canvas going over every concept more in-depth. His lectures cover a lot of example problems and he's entertaining. Tests were pretty fair, if you go to class and do the homework you'll be fine.

Bolton is an amazing professor. He's very passionate about what he teaches, and his loud, energetic voice will always keep you engaged during his lectures. He does everything that an ideal professor should do, and he's a really entertaining person.

Amazing teacher, Bolton's students understand the material better than any other class. His lectures are fast paced and super dense with information, but he is really good at what he does and very passionate for students success.

Dr Bolton is one of the best professors I have met throughout my college career. He actually wants his students to learn and achieve success in Statics. He is also very accessible outside of class. But, he also gives out a lot of homework problems because he believes that practice makes perfect. Overall, a fantastic professor to have for statics.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Bolton is insanely smart and genuinely cares about his students and their grades. He will spend extra time to make sure everyone understands a concept, and the way he teaches works. He does not take attendance, but statics is not a class you can miss, if you go to class you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Bolton is incredibly passionate and well-spoken. But Statics is extremely difficult and you need to put in a lot of time to do well. He posts notes, hw, and test solutions in video format on Canvas which helped me a ton. Theyre very thorough. No curves, but his class averages are higher than others. Gives lots of hw. I would 100% have him again

Had him a second time this semester and Professor Bolton continues to be excellent. Super enthusiastic, engaging, and knowledgeable. He often relates back to his time as a student and is truly motivational. He made me want to succeed at Dynamics. Great lectures in terms of content as well - tons of examples and good with questions and explanations.

I loved his lectures. They were mostly practice problems but he explained everything so clearly. He is so passionate about mechanics and will make that clear to you the first day. He sometimes rambles about random things but it is kind of nice. Lots of homework. His tests were straightforward and he gave a good amount of partial credit.
I would highly recommend Dr. Bolton. He is an excellent lecturer. The test averages were kind of low but if you study you'll do fine.

Bolton is honestly such a good lecturer. He is clearly passionate about Statics and wants you to learn. He does a really good job of relating to the students and is clear about what should be on tests. Yes, the course is hard, but not impossible. Office hours are extremely useful.

Bolton is an excellent professor. He is clearly super passionate about mechanics and brings that enthusiasm every day, and he really makes you want to learn the material. He goes a little fast sometimes but the plus side is you're never bored in class. The examples and lectures lined up well with tests and homeworks. I enjoyed his stories too.

Bolton has a great personality, is nice and no foreign accent. That's about it. Roughly 4-5 hours of homework per week on top of other homework you have. Curves are small. Average for Test 2 was 65 for all of his classes, curved it to a 69 overall. Yell talks. Lectures are just example problems for an hour and a half straight at 2x speed. RIP GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think Bolton is highly over rated. You may learn the material, but it's not worth it if you work your tail off and only get a D. Averages for tests were below 55, and he wouldn't give a concrete answer on what to expect with a grade curve. We should revert to grade school principles, where we don't need a curve to pass a course.

Professor Bolton actually cares about what students have to say and will actively change his class according to complaints and requests. You will learn in his class.

ONLY TAKE THIS PROFESSOR IF YOU ARE OK WITH FAILING.  His motto is that he doesnt really give a crap if you fail as long as you learn the material.  The test average for every test he gives will be right around a 60 including the final. I dont see how they allow him to be a teacher with his absolute ruthless grading
By far one of the best and most clear teachers, Very energetic too.  But he has no sympathy when it comes to grading.  last test average was about a 30 and he only added 15 points.
I have never had a professor who cares so much about his students!  Great professor.

Wonderful teacher. Dynamics will always difficult, but Prof. Bolton does everything he can to help you out. He goes over the assigned homework problems every class and answers any questions. He gives example problems along with every lecture, which helps a ton. He is consistent and a fair grader. I would definitely recommend him.

Best instructor ive ever had from the esm department period, I got an A in his statics class and have enrolled to take dynamics with him; if you can get this guy as your teacher DO IT! He's seriously up there with Prof. Chang.
Rude and dismissive. Class projects did not meet the expectation that the class would be about STEM education, and instead were all elementary-level "engineering" projects. Would not take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have had so far in my educational journey at Tech! Definetly would take this course again, and  was one of if not the only class that I was excited to go to. Not attending class may result in 0s on assignments but he is very flexible with grades and late work. He is very nice and I would 110% recommend taking his class!

Mr. Bowen is a very cool teacher. He responded to emails in a timely manner which made it easy to for me to commuincate with him about assignments. He's pretty laid back and is flexible with deadlines as long as work is done and you show an intrest in the course by showing up.
Professor Bowen is an amazing professor, as well as person. He was able to make me WANT to go to class rather than have to go. His projects are fun and grading is lenient.

Outside of lectures, she is extremely accessible and supportive. She welcomes questions during class and is always willing to clarify points that may be confusing. During office hours, she is patient, attentive, and genuinely interested in helping students improve.

An outstanding math professor who genuinely cares about student learning and success. From the very beginning of the semester, it is clear that she is deeply invested in helping students understand the material rather than simply getting through the syllabus.
Best teacher in the world wallah 67

This professor is inadequate, unresponsable, rude to students, and is never prepared for class. I have spent all my days studyng, and I still failed all my tests due to lack of support.
He has told me I don't work hard enough and that I need to "pull myself together" and repeatedly insulted my math skills. 1/5, but I'd give him a 0 if I could.

This teacher seemed unprepared for almost every class. He didn't have access to the online homework he assigned, so he couldn't answer any questions about it. He once posted the key for the practice test less than 24 hours before the test instead of 7 days. He also didn't return any paper homework until after the 2nd test (there's only 3 tests).

Everyone in the class is friends because this teacher is one of the worst teachers known to humankind. However if you actually need to pass classes and you do not want points taken off because of a minor mistake, or it is not correct according to him but the rest of the world suggests otherwise then do not choose this class. Also your GPA will die

reviews.comment: This professor made it abundantly clear he was not prepared to teach Calculus day one, and I honestly hoped that would only be day one since it is his job. On the contrary, his "teaching" style made it feel like he hasn't been prepared for a single class. Two tests into the semester and I still never got any feedback from my first homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Throughout all of my years of school I thought that I had seen it all in terms of bad teaching. However, I did not even consider that my instructor could just not teach at all. Although he usually shows up to class he is hard to follow and inconsistent in his teaching. If you get this professor either drop out and run or get ready to hire a tutor.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Bouhafara takes first place on the worst professor I've ever had. His lectures are very difficult to understand and unexplainable. He takes an eternity to grade written homework's, which are essential to our sucess. He has decided to not show up to class three times now with no prior announcement. He has made it clear he could care less about us.

We have been multiple lectures behind other calc 2 professors. There have been two classes where he never showed. He teaches without explaining. NEVER returns homework grades. "I will post a review and answer keys", no he won't unless its two hours before the test. His advice when many fail a test is "you need to pull yourselves together".
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was extremely difficult and the teacher did not explain the content properly. He went through problems in class that did not help you to learn how to do it and the tests were very difficult. In order to even have a chance at passing this class, you have to study a lot on your own time and learn through other sources/teachers.

Medhi first words to my class were "I am not supposed to teach this class" after being in his class I can confidently say that he is indeed not supposed to teach Calc 2, He does the problems without explaining what he is doing, written homework will not be given back, and the only thing he has to say when the test average is 40% is "study more".
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Bouhafara was mediocre at best, even though his class was completely online. He gives out a lot of homework with unnecessary proofs, but for the most part it prepared me for the tests. He would have office hours every day and the few times I did go, he explained the material pretty well. Very slow at grading. Nothing special, but did his part.

Only ended with a C because I bombed the final. Nice professor but a tough grader. Food cart project is the majority of your grade and takes up the whole semester, you're basically screwed if you get a bad group.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Sweetest professor I have had. She truly wants you not only to pass but to understand what you're learning and do great. I had an accident towards the end of the semester and had medical issues, she worked with me during the summer to make up missed work. She's just the best and I truly enjoyed her class even before this. You are the best (ly) :)

I loved Charity, she has many amazing stories from being in business and explains everything thoroughly. She can be a really tough grader and rarely gives 100s though, so work hard on projects. Tests are open textbook, but you should defintiely still study and beware of pop quizzes. just read the textbook and double check rubrics and shes amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: You will be placed in a group for projects that you will keep for the rest of the class. Pray you get a good group or you'll end up doing everything alone. Tell her about your group, she will do nothing. I got 90's for doing everything and she gave the rest of my group 80's for doing NOTHING. Many people had this issue.
Explain concepts clearly and willing to answer any questions. His lectures made an otherwise boring subject pretty interesting. Practice tests are similar to the actual tests.
Does a good job of making a boring class somewhat fun

Super sweet prof. Taught really well, tried to best to make sure everyone understood, and did cool demos with fire. Very basic class -- its just high school chem again. Pay attention in lecture and DO THE PRACTICE TESTS and its beyond free.

Dr. Bowen is one of the nicest and most willing professors ive ever had. Chem was extremely difficult for me, but if you put in the work and get help when needed, it's not that bad. He was very helpful every time I went to office hours

Prof. Bowen was good at explaining the lectures and the iClicker problems. But the lectures can be difficult or boring at times due to how the department makes the decisions instead of the professor. Overall, he was friendly and I had a good experience in his class.

Dr. Bowen was a cool guy, but he often rushed through the content super-fast, not checking for understanding often. Since CHEM 1035 is a huge lecture hall style class, this is not easy to do, but the TA is super helpful so make sure to utilize them. Office hours are less than helpful and you're better off studying in a small group or on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was genuinely so helpful and always made sure we understood the material before moving on. The class itself isn't too hard but the professor definitely makes or breaks the course

Bowen is one of the better chemistry professors at VT. I failed the first test, the rest I got 70-80s on and worked hard and get my grade back up. Bowen is dependable and his explanations are great. DO THE PRACTICE TESTS + EXTRA WORKSHEETS. The tests are VERY similar to the practice exams. Iclickers + ALEKS are a free 100 for 25% of final grade.

Chem 1036 definitely a bit harder than 1035, and be aware the structure of the class is set up by the chem department not the professor. I often found myself lost in lectures and not able to follow along because they're not very engaging. Most people, including myself, are only going to succeed in these classes if you put in time outside of class.
Explains concepts decently well, class is pretty easy but its what you make of it. As long as your paying attention and learning during class you'll be fine.
He does a great job explaining things. You should be able to get an A if you actually try

Had to retake this class because I didnt take it seriously last semester and it didnt really click with last professsor. Bowen really made the class interactive and truly cares about teaching the material. Promoted office hours and wanted to always help. Made the class really easy and less boring
chem is hard to teach but I think he does a good job at making things clear, would take him over other chem 2 professors
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bowen was a joy to learn from. His lectures are direct, engaging, and meaningful. As long as you show up, do the iClickers, and study for tests, you will pass easily. He really cares about his craft and will make sure you actually learn something. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

The best professor for gen chem! Take him if you have the chance. His lectures are very engaging, and while they can be slow at times, I never found them boring. His demonstrations are also always fun to watch. And don't be fooled by the average grade, this class is very manageable to get an A if you actually try. Also, very helpful office hours!
Posted amazing videos for you to study with. Overall such a great professor
I love my boy Johnathan

this guy is genuinely amazing. he is so funny and good at explaining things that it makes you actually WANT to go to class even though this is just a gen ed. as long as you attend consistently and actually try out the practice problems during class, you don't really need to study for the tests, besides maybe taking the practice tests. take notes!

Man, I wish I had this prof for 1035. He breaks down materials really well. I costed through 1035 just through memorization. He really puts an emphasis on understanding the material which made it really easy to study and do homework.  The tests are meh. He also teaches tips and tricks on the test about thought process.

Bowen is such a nice professor. I can't talk about his tests being easy or hard, or if he gave a lot of homework, because every Chem 2 had the same homework and tests. However, his teaching style in class was awesome. He teaches exceptionally well and has uploaded videos to Canvas that you can use for review before exams.
It's a hard class but he breaks down material well.

Took a W but was on track to end with a C- for context. Teacher was super nice and always willing to help, chem just sucks at tech. Extremeeeeelllly difficult tests. Save yourself the headache and just take the class at NOVA and transfer in the credit.
Good professor and lecture but 75% of your grade is tests so choking on a mid-term kind of makes or breaks a grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had him for CHEM 1035 and 1036. He's always available for office hours and wants to help you. Even though chem is a weed out class he wants all of his students to succeed and gives everything all the resources possible to do so.

The course is hard with it being very based on tests. You have to pay attention in class or else you will be very behind. It moves very fast but the material isn't too bad if you just try and pay attention. He is a good teacher but does move fast sometimes and fails to explain very well all the time.
is the GOAT
Let me make up a test after I sprinted across campus and was a few minutes late. He's the goat

Go to his office hours, they are extremely helpful. He also posts super useful lecture videos on Canvas which helps a ton in revising for tests. Teaches chemistry in a very engaging way which keeps you interested. His iClicker questions are vey similar to test questions and he always holds iClicker review days before the test.

His lectures were pretty good, covered the material pretty well. Go to class, the iclicker attendance is 10% of the grade and it WILL cook you. The first 2 tests weren't bad but study hard for the last 2 and the final. Overall I'm just glad it's over.

1035 is difficult on purpose, especially the test. But, Professor Bowen does a great job teaching the material and providing resources to prepare for the tests. iClickers and homework make up 25% of the grade and are pretty easy to get at least 95% of. He posts his lecture videos on Canvas which make it easier to miss occasionally.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: genuinely the goat. passionate lectures and explains material in such a simple way. i had to take notes but not a lot. dont forget your iclicker. all you really have to worry about are four 30 question tests but just study and they're layups. didn't go to office hours often but he is very helpful when i did.

Dr. Bowen is my favorite professor this semester, he's funny and great at explaining concepts in a way that is easy to understand. His lectures are fast paced and interactive, and he offers a lot of help outside of class. I'll be taking a class with him next semester as well.

I would recommend Dr. Bowen over all the other profs. A ton of my friends took Chem 1035 and Bowen was the best out of all of them. Go to his office hours they actually really help, and a lot of other people go too so you won't be alone.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super fun and personable but still really efficient with lecture time. He made me look forward to lectures and always great to bring a question to in class/at office hours.

Dr. Bowen was a really nice teacher and the lessons were clear. IClicker questions/practice tests were usually similar to the actual tests. Lectures weren't particularly engaging, but paying attention and doing the practice problems made the class much easier.

I thought the professor explained things well and his online videos were helpful. GO TO CLASS. I thought the office hours were not very helpful. Also, he would try to shove information in the last 3 minutes of class when people started leaving and he got mad when people would begin to leave. Other than that, he was good at teaching the material.

Really good during office hours and tries to make sure that everyone has an opportunity to get their questions answered. Also really good at making sure there are a lot of material to help you review for exams and the online videos are clear and high quality. While he doesn't give extra credit, the grading and exams are super fair.

Prof Bowen was very engaging and funny. He was always excited to teach and taught the material in a way that students could remember it. He would give us plenty of in class practice and test prep resources so that we could do well on the exams. I highly recommend him for Chem.

Pretty chill professor. If this is you first semester, make sure to study for the tests. His lectures are pretty helpful, but you can also teach it to yourself if you need to. His video lectures are a great tool.

Dr. Bowen was a great teacher and he always kept class interesting. He has video lectures that were very helpful when I missed a class or did not understand a topic. I loved Dr. Bowen and if I was going to take CHEM 1036 I would refuse to take it with anyone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Bowen struggles with his computer everyday and its hilarious. Gives information in simple terms. Lots of little assignments.

Dr. Bowen is an amazing Chemistry professor. His slides are straight to the point and have no chaff pertaining to what you don't need for the course. His materials and teaching style are extremely structured and well organized, and it helps that he is also a good lecturer. 100% would take him again!

Great professor! Obviously it is chemistry so the material is difficult but he tries to make sure his students understand and offers a lot of extra help and office hours. Homeworks, iClickers, and studio quizzes are all pretty easy and work as a buffer in case you don't do great on tests so make sure to do them and do them well.
His lectures are amazing. He does a great job of explaining and going through the notes.

Professor Bowen made 1035 pretty manageable. Occasionally did fun experiments at the beginning of lecture to demonstrate the content or simply for entertainment which was pretty cool.

Attendance was mandatory because of the iclicker questions every lecture which count for a good portion of final grade. Do the homework and you'll be fine.

If you need to take Chem 1035 or 1036 take it with Professor Bowen. The class is going to be difficult regardless of your professor because Virginia Tech makes the curriculum not the professor. If you go to class and office hours there is no reason for you not to get a B or higher.

He utilizes iClickers for attendance, but at the end of the semester it's used as a grade booster. He is super knowledgeable and if you have any questions do NOT hesitate to go to his office hours. Chem 1035 is in a lecture hall so it is easy to space out but try not to. Max 5 homework assignments per week, manageable, but put the work in.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Bowen was an excellent teacher for the class, nobody knows who is it seems but he's definitely a solid pick for a chem 1035 prof. Solid lectures, not super engaging but as long as you pay attention you'll be fine.

Make sure to read the textbook, as it's the main method of learning for this class. Lectures are good for solidifying knowledge, not teaching it. Textbook is good, though, so it isn't a big deal.

Prof. Bowen knows alot about chemistry, is a good lecturer/instructor, and is always willing to help. Take advantage of resources and you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Provides office hours. He knows his Chem very well and explains things very well. Lots of homework. Overall a great teacher.
He has great lectures, so make sure you pay attention during class. Make sure to review the material outside of class.

He is a good guy and teaches with passion, but he teaches concepts in a more complex way than it should be taught. This is due to his passion for chemistry. If you are willing to put in the extra effort to understand his teaching style, go for it, he is an awesome professor. If you are taking this class to fulfil a pathway, take someone else.
All of the homework and assignments are through ALEKS, and he always got his test grades in faster than other professors.

Dr. Bowen is a good professor, lectures weren't hard to understand but he did start every lecture off with a review of the previous one which took up atleast 20-30 mins and then would rush through the new material. The workload for this class wasn't too bad and hw was for completion.

Professor Bowen is excellent. His class is manageable if you utilize his office hours and i-clickers. He is super honest about his exams and the difficulty of them. His averages are always above a C and honest hard work really pays off in his class. His genuine passion for chemistry really shows. He's a newer professor, but give him a chance.

Professor Bowen is a great teacher! If you pay attention during his lectures and meet with him outside of class if needed, the class becomes a lot more manageable. Putting in work outside of class is crucial to passing. He creates helpful connections that allow you to understand what you are learning. Overall- would take class with him again!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: While I think he's a nice professor, I have not been able to learn at all. I'm constantly lost and confused.
