For someone who is not math wired, he is great at explaining and teaching concepts.

He is pretty decent at teaching math. In my experience he invites questions and answers them pretty nicely. Lectures are not bad, one HW and one quiz per week and HW questions have unlimited attempts. You have to pay for pearson tho, which sucks. Friday attendance mandatory for graded assignments btw. Tests are not terrible but can be kind of tough

He goes super fast in the lectures and is hard to comprehend because of how fast he goes. He gives very few examples you'll have to do a lot of outside work to actually learn. He does not take attendance, however attendance is mandatory on Fridays. You'll have one long homework and one quiz every week.

The only reason I got a decent grade is because I took a similar class in high school. He's a very fast teacher and not great at answering questions. He told us if we needed help and couldn't come to office hours, to use ChatGPT, rather than answering questions in class. Overall not that bad if you pay attention and study a lot.

The only reason I got a decent grade in this class was because I took a similar class in high school. He's a very fast teacher and isn't great at answering questions. He told my section if we needed help and couldn't come to office hours to ask ChatGPT to help us, rather than answering questions in class. Overall not that bad if you pay attention.

I took him online. 1 homework assignment a week, 1 quiz a week that you can take twice, and one participation assignment due a week. It is all manageable if you just watch the lecture videos and properly take the notes. The content for this class is relatively easy to digest and he is really accessible in office hours. I had him for 1025 and then for 1026 online. The class is relatively easy and the tests aren't too bad either. The homework on Pearson can be a little challenging because they are harder than the lecture practice problems and cause you to have to think independently. He gave us assignments that were not yet taught, and the tests were very hard. Lectures were inconsistent with tests and very not explained.
He was rude in class to people who asked questions
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took him for 1025 and I liked him enough to take him for 1026. He is very friendly and willing to help out. There is one quiz and one homework assignment a week, along with a participation assignment. I go to his office hours for the participation and the homework is pretty easy. His tests aren't very hard but the questions are weighted heavy.

Wouldn't take this class again. I never felt prepared for tests regardless of performance on homework and quizzes. Had a B all year the last two tests tanked my grade. "We [the department] didn't mean to make the test that hard" but didn't curve any scores after everyone failed the test. Not great at elaborating on processes or answering questions.
Wasn't great at explaining or helping with any questions you had during lectures or the quizzes. Great spirit interesting lectures but not the best at actually teaching. Tests weren't too hard

good professor recommend for math. ask your question quick cuz he does move on but he doesnt mind staying on a subject to clear it up if you do ask. i would recommend him over most others. very good professor
Super nice guy but I am about to fail my 2nd class in a row with him the material is extremely difficult to understand as the lectures do not fully explain and online it is even worse Good Luck!

Mr. Caruso is a great professor, and most of the issues I had were Math department issues (i.e. class had to follow a strict schedule each week, HW on Tuesday and Quiz on Thursday), but it is clear that he is working on ways to improve his class while staying in the guidelines. Overall, he's clearly passionate and always happy to clarify.

I really liked his class. All Lecture notes were posted on canvas so even if you miss a class you can still catch up. He's very chill and the homework and quizzes were all online and all had multiple attempts. Very easy class and very good professor.

He is nice and understanding. When everyone got a question wrong on a test he curved it and admitted he didn't go over enough practice problems of that kind. The tests are very reasonable if you understand the material. I suggest going to the active learning days, it is a great time to ask questions if you don't want to go to office hours.

I really liked Peter! He was very detailed and caring. The class itself is hard, but he makes it digestible. I 100% recommend office hours. They are super helpful even if you understand what's going on because he will talk about the test or what type of questions to focus on. Overall will miss him next semester

Professor Caruso is amazing. During lectures he is extremely detailed and posts all of his notes completed online for our access. If you didn't take calc in hs like me, it will be difficult but he explains everything very well during lectures. !!Office hours on friday are taught by HIM- nobody goes so it's basically a 1 on 1 free tutor session!!
very cool and chill dude and explained things well. his examples in class were harder than test questions. he is very open to clarifying things during lectures which was nice. i would take him again.

Prof Caruso is awesome! He's a cool dude and explains math really really well. Homework's/quizzes are fairly hard but not bad at all. Tests were pretty easy, usually comprised of the more easier questions from each topic. He obviously cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Also, attendance isn't mandatory. But go to class, he's cool!

He is a very nice guy, and he is very easy to work with. He will really try to help you succeed in the course by giving a lot of resources. Professor Caruso is very nice and straight-forward in his lectures. However, I had taken calculus in high school so none of the material was new to me. If you are new to this type of math, I would imagine extra time would have to be put in as he goes through the notes rather quickly.

He's a very funny and kind guy but his teaching style just was not for me. Professor Caruso is a very nice guy but I think he needs a little more experience teaching. I am not a calculus or math person by any means but this class was rough. Professor Caruso is amazing and super down-to-earth. Cares about teaching but assumes that some things are common sense when they are not, so it is hard to follow his math sometimes. However, he is always open to questions. There are only 3 tests throughout the year, which can be difficult if you do bad on one of them.

He was fine I didn't think the class was too hard but I did have previous calculus experience. Setup was one homework due every tuesday, one quiz due every thursday (done outside of class). reviews.comment: This class seems soooo easy until the first exam. The exams are crazy hard, so make sure you pay attention in class and then review ALL notes before the exam. She makes it hard to focus in class because she talks so slowly, but you have to try and stay engaged. I've heard she is helpful during office hours but I personally have never gone.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is a pretty easy class for assignments, but her exams are rough. On the first exam, she gave us she asked us Which of the following was a header on this article you read? There were no obvious wrong answers and the article was 10 pages long. Lots of the questions are tricky. She curves the exams a good bit though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This class is a catfish. The material is easy, you will get 100's on all the homeworks and feel like you're breezing by. The exam questions will have 7 or 8 answer choices, and test you on the most irrelevant info that was mentioned one time. Exams were on lockdown w camera, and she doesn't release the questions after, so you cant study. AVOID!!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She tests computer ability with overly difficult paper tests. Even though it should be a fairly easy class, almost everyone struggles with her tests. Although a nice woman, her lectures are so boring that it is almost impossible to pay attention. If there are any other professors available, do yourself a favor and take them instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Honestly what a terrible class. She means well but with her monotone and lack of teaching skills, it's a pretty horrible experience. This class is teaching students how to use Excel and VBA. A lot of memorization, must pay attention during lectures, and I would suggest reading the book, too. Attendance isn't mandatory, but clicker q's. Good luck.

Definitely know what you're getting into before taking her. Doesn't take attendance and lectures are word for word off the power points.  TEST ARE 90%!! Remember that! She uses connect, but connect wont give you the right answer after it is graded, so who knows how to do that problem? She will get a substitute, and they will help you more than her.

Really nice lady and good lecturer, but the tests are impossibly hard. She puts practice problems up on scholar that are way easier than the exams and that don't cover all of the material we'll be tested on. She curves the tests and final grades, though

First off, intermediate 1 is not an easy class. Students come into this class expecting it to be easy but they have the wrong impression. You have to do all the examples she posts and study more than any other class. She really is a nice professor if you take the time to talk to her.

Took this class with her a couple years ago. She is honestly one of the best accounting teachers for intro classes. if you cant get past her weed out class then you should change your major. Put time into studying and you can get a B or higher. When i took it she had 9 different answer choices so you had to know what you're doing. Good teacher

I took 3115 in summer I.  Easterwood knew the course material, and I thought she covered it well. Some students aced the mult choice sections but she curved anyway.  Class goes fast in the summer.  You do have to work in order to pass. You won't do well if you blow off the homework. That's where you'll learn the topic.  I thought she was fair.

It is very unfortunate this woman is a professor at Virginia Tech. Her tests are extremely difficult, no matter how much time you put forth in studying. It seems like she wants her students to fail. With the plethora of complaints and horrible evaluations, this woman needs to lose her job!

do not take this class at Virginia Tech. This teacher makes the hardest test I have ever taken.  There are 60 questions on 6 chapters. Its ridiculous to expect people to understand that much material and then take a 2 hour test on it.  There is only 2 tests and a final so if you do bad on either youre screwed. take it somewhere else!
this class requires a lot of effort. if you work hard, you can get an a. if you dont actually try, you aren't going to do very well

awful awful awful. makes class way harder than it needs to be. you need a realllllly good TA in order to do well, if you dont have that, you're screwed. tests are meant to be tricky. only good thing is she curves final grades and tests if people do really bad.

Easterwood subbed for our class one day and we were going over homework problems and she had no idea how to do one.  She said "this is overly complicated" and skipped it, and then had one of those overly complicated problems on the test.  She is wack.  If you have a question don't waste your time emailing her, she won't reply.

Imagine listening to your grandmother lecture a class of 100+ students. She is THAT bad. The exams are very difficult, and she tries to trip you up. If you have squeezed by in the past then DONT take her. She makes sure that it is impossible to do so.

Entirely useless. Her exams are ridicolus. The only practice you get is during the homework because she won't give the answers to the practice sections in your book. Horrible public speaker, and constatnlyyy makes mistakes while attempting to teach problems in class. I'm sure she's a nice lady, but that does not make up for her lack of teaching.
Tests are kind of tricky and attendance is mandatory.  Need to put a lot of work into the class in order to get an A or B

Quite possibly the most worthless prefessor at Tech.  She NEEDS to lose her job.  She does not teach the class, you never meet her.  There are tons of ridiculus rules and all grades are final, no curves.  Most everyone understands this stuff, but the tests are full of trick and vague questions, many of which are never covered in class. She sucks.

This class is terrible.  Half of the TA's can't answer your questions about exams or homework. You never meet her even though she makes the tests and decides your grade.  There is no negotiation and rarely any curves.  The fact that someone who has never stepped into the classroom or discussed the material with you makes the test is ridiculous

i had a GA as my real teacher but Dr. easterwood makes the tests.don't take this class if u don't have 2.  the tests r literally impossible.she has every possible answer (like 10) for every question & also a none of the above. Good luck to all and definitely read the book! if you get a C you should be happy.  more than half of my class had dropped

slides presented in class are straight from the textbook, but the textbook is easier to understand.  i did better when i didn't go to class and read the book.  make sure you know how to do the homework, but the exams will still be difficult.

Quite put, this was the hardest class I have or ever will take in college.  She is a terrible terrible teacher.  Half of the time, she does not even know what she is even doing.  Her tests are impossible.  The average on the last test was a 57, and that wasn't even the hardest test, the final exam.  Please save your college career and dont take her
Her lectures are a total waste.   Take the class time to study on your own. Make sure you understand homework and quizes.(good for nstudying for exam)

Had a GA the whole time, which by the way was Edmonds, who was really cool, the only time I saw her was when I had to take an exam at another time due to scheduling, she was "thrilled" to help me out, so happy im done with accounting
tested computer ability with a paper test

I dont understand how this professor can be rated, she was the listed professor of my class but we had a TA the whole year. this is how it is for all the acis classes.  I NEVER once saw this women and she was the professor, and I didn't miss any classes.

i had her for both 2115 and 2116... she was extremely boring, however she's a really nice lady. she's always willing to help and answer questions. her tests are easy, but if you read the book its not too bad. i ended up with B's both semesters and never had to do too much work other than homework and the projects which were both easy.
I thought Easterwood was extremely boring! I wound up with a B in her class, but I went 50% of the time. It's much easier to stay home and read the book, but she collects homework every day.

AMAZING teacher!! Very easy to talk to!! Always willing to help!  The class isn't too bad if you go to class and pay attention and ask questions. You do not need to read the book.  You only need the book to complete your hw, which I highly recommend doing your hw.

GREAT PROFESSOR!!!! Although unclear at times, she is easy to talk to and get help from at office hours. I recommend her class to anyone who has to take Principals of Accounting, which is a tough course regardless of the teacher.
Teaching not always clr. Hesitant 2B undrstnding dring extenuating circumstances
No Comments

Prof. McIntosh is a caring guy. You can see he truly cares about what he is teaching. He is very open to feedback and will listen. As long as you show up to class and take advantage of the extra credit, you will be fine. Has a few in-class assignment days that are free points. Never bought the textbook, and never felt like I needed it. Great prof!

Very kind and considerate, he loves what he does in his class, but his lectures can be kind of boring. You're graded on 4 articles read, and 3 tests, no hw, and tests are pretty easy if you study for them. I also bought the textbook and never used it.
Quizzes and tests will be your grade. He is very nice and cares about his students
Great professor

No homework, just quizzes and tests, so very test heavy, amazing professor, super kind and helpful, went out of his way to meet and talk to students. I really enjoyed this class and I learned a lot, the only reason you'd do bad is if you don't put time and effort into learning, going to class, and trying your best. Would take again!

I don't get why some students here rate him poorly. He's very respectful and truly wants you to understand the material. He gives a LOT of extra credit tied to class topics and curves exams generously. If you just show up and try, you'll understand the material and do well.

He was passionate about lectures and cared about the students' learning. The only thing I disliked about the course was that it was fully exam and quiz based. We had about 5 quizzes and three exams. He does offer extra credit though which I really appreciated!
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Just go to class (or you don't need to if you're a self-learner). The thing is you gotta be interested in law if you want to love this class. Professor-wise, Prof McIntosh is sweet and supportive.

He's kind and honestly passionate about law. I think that we as students weren't able to get any interest in business law through the class at all though. It was hard for me to stay focused and learn from what he was saying. If you ask him for help he is always there to help though.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Boring class. Boring lectures.
Amazing professor and incredibly nice guy. This class is just a group project that is fun and you can be creative. Definitely recommend.
lowk goated class is jus a lot of work  look at the practice exams and u should be chillin tho
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Nicest guy ever but does not know how to teach.  His "lectures" was us watching him take 50 minutes to work on one practice problem.  Homeworks are weighted heavy, and partial credit is not given very much on exams, although one gets dropped at the end of the semester.  I would recommend working hard outside of class to succeed in this class.

Professor McDowell was one of the nicer professors I have had at VT. He was a bit difficult to learn from, but he got better as the semester went on (his first semester teaching separation processes). The TAs were a big help, as well as going to his office hours. The partial credit on exams was generous. The homework was tough to learn from.

Very sweet guy but cannot explain the material well. He knows the material very well but is bad at articulating it to students. He constantly makes mistakes during lecture and the practice tests have different material than the final. When I took this class, it was only his 2nd semester as an instructor, so take this review with a grain of salt.

Chi is very caring and offers a lot of extra credit. The class consists of mandatory lectures and open-note tests. Chi cares a lot about class participation, but is willing to give you extra credit for speaking. Overall, I found the class very easy to find success in.

Chi was the absolute best. He's so sweet and always gives us little pep talks like a kind grandpa or something. He gives out so much extra credit and he is super enthusiastic during his lectures to try to get people to participate and be engaged. Very little homework and it's pretty easy, exams are also open note. 100% recommend him, love this guy!

he is great take him!! he offers SO MUCH extra credit. Attendance is mandatory (codes), but there is so much extra credit that your grade will be fine. He is so passionate about teaching a such a nice guy. Exams are take at home & two attemps.

(MGT 2314) He clearly cares about the well being of all of his students and he is such a nice professor. He is very passionate about business and it shows. Exams are online and proctored. Attendance quizzes are super easy. Course material is also super easy. He also gives out a lot of extra credit. He's an amazing professor.

Super nice guy who really cares about his students and obviously loves what he does. The course material is easy already but he does a good job of presenting it which makes it even more easy. Attendance is pretty much mandatory if you want an A since there are in class quizzes each class but as long as you go you should get an 100 on all of these.
(HTM 2314) He is so passionate about his class and is genuinely so caring! Take it with Chi!

Amazing guy. So so sweet. Attendance is mandatory (you can skip a few) but the schedule for classwork is flexible. He is a very understanding teacher and so amazing and great. HIGHLY recommended. He is so kind and you can tell he really cares about the material. A lot of opportunities for in class extra credit.

Tseng is an amazing professor! He motivates students and believes that we can achieve our business goals (even become millionaires LOL). A kind, passionate, and excellent lecturer, his class fueled my passion for business. Best professor at Virginia Tech. I don't get why people say they can't understand him—you definitely can!
Attendance is mandatory and graded, but he gives sooo much extra credit. There's no reason not to pass. There's also a group project but it's very easy. He's so nice and funny.

He is very passionate about the material and a really nice guy. Gives out extra credit for everything! There is no reason not to do well in the class. Sometimes it was a little hard to understand him but that's not his fault. It's a very easy class and actually does teach you about entrepreneurship.

Dr. Tseng is a caring professor who is passionate about his area of expertise. I took him for MGT 2314. He gives lots of extra credit to reward participation, even if you are completely wrong. He is flexible and understanding with grading so long as you show that you care too. Attendance is graded and tests are proctored online.

Truly my fav professor ever! He cares so much about his students and the subject! He loves participation (even if you're completely wrong) and you can tell it really makes his day when you speak in class. Super easy class with lots of extra credit, but I say take it for him, even if you don't need it, as he made my day every time I saw him.

This class is easy and very manageable. The Prof. is very nice and gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. There is about 1 writing/reflection assignment per week, one group project which doesn't take long to complete, and a final exam.
Very easy course and nice professor

just an overall great guy that really tries to inspire his students to achieve great things. His class is very enjoyable, sure its easy... but that does not mean you dont learn anything. I learned a lot about entrepreneurship and left his class feeling super motivated. Take his class, he is a great professor and its a great class.

AMAZING. This was by far my favorite class. Professor Tseng is so wholesome and really just wants you to succeed. It is a VERY easy A though so if you are looking to truly LEARN the content then you have to put in the effort. He gives lots of extra credit and quizzes are retakeable so you should have no problem passing. I have an 103%. Great class.
Very enthusiastic and professional just very hard to understand him. His class is very easy so I have no problem. Seems to love being up there talking.

Easy class and easy grader, the professor is a great guy. However I would like to echo that the class is too simple. Lots of times there were a lot of assignments yet the work felt like busy work. There were a couple tools or things that I could put in my tool box for the future, but they were limited. If you want an easy course w/a great man, take

Hate to give him a bad review because he's such a nice caring person, but the class is just not great. It's an easy A, but I feel like I learned barely anything. The class provides you with the most basic elementary business information. A 10 min youtube video could teach you the same things.
the nicest guy ever, such an easy class. definitely take.

Grading uses 'badges' and 'boosts.' Platinum badges cover major assignments; missing one drops your grade half a score. Missing 2+ silver/gold also drops it. Boosts are required for an A. Heavy busy work, mandatory attendance. Communicates via Discord. Gives good feedback, but easy to fall behind—missing one week sent my grade from a B to a D

Not given grades, just checkmarks and x's. So much busy work. If you complete every single assignment you are given a B in the class. You must do extra credit to earn a reasonable grade. If you miss class you get so far behind. Will tell you to revise your work but will take over a month to look at your revisions.

I work like a dog day and night....A LOT of assignments, most are due before class & on the weekends. a lot of readings & TRUST DO THE EXTRA CREDIT. Tough grader and u need to fill out so many forms for when u turn in late work/miss class. Never miss class your grade WILL TANK! So many direction for the directions & assignments for the directions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Might honestly be the most busy work I have ever had for a class. Says you can't get an A by doing all the work you MUST complete the extra credit. Don't try to skip classes because the make up work is ridiculous. Her canvas page is a mess, please find any other prof.

The class is awful. Assignments have detailed, long rubrics that take time to understand, and grading is strict. Grades are based on "Boosts" and are always much after, she posts unit progress reports per unit, also late. There's a heavy workload in short class periods. If you prefer clear grading and lighter pacing, this IS NOT the best fit.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: She will make you work, but if you follow what you're supposed to do, it can be a rewarding class. She is also understanding of students' lives and will accommodate if you communicate.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: So much busy work, but really communicates with you.

Get ready to write in her class, because you do a lot of it. However, she gives you freedom on topics to write which made me more motivated to do her work. She is also very responsive when you contact her. The only issue I had was that she takes a while to grade your work.
Gives a ridiculous amount of busy work. So boring. Says she just wants you to "try your best" but is a tough grader. Pick someone else to be your professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: While she is a nice teacher, you will never know your grade until the end of the semester. She gives compliments as a grade until the end of the semester and never gives direct feedback on your writing/work. While the class is super easy if you show up, I found the grading very frustrating.

Ms.Taylor is a decent teacher and she is welcomes good communication. She facilitates absences well and is very willing to give extensions. This being said there's a lot of writing. Many papers, presentations, journals, portfolios, and outside class homework. It may use up a lot of your time especially towards the end of the year.
Insane work amount

Prof. Taylor was a good professor for ENGL 1105, I liked her because there was a lot of creative freedom in the class so you could write about anything which made it more interesting. I will say there are a bunch of assignments and busy work so you will have a good amount of homework. Only other negative thing is that she does take a while to grade
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very easy class if you just show up and do the work. She grades effort/completion and gives many many extra credit opportunities. The structure of her class is very engaging and unique.

After a thorough calculation; 33 papers, 78 pages, and 16,436 words is the work I have put into this general studies class. I wake up. I go to class. I write. I sleep. I wake up. I go to class. I write. I sleep. I wake up. I go to class. I write. I sleep. Then I get a C because I should have been writing instead of sleeping.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I had Ms. Taylor for the Fall 2023 semester, she was great! Very thoughtful and she was happy to help with any issue you had

She is an incredible professor, but she definitely gives WAY more work than other 1105 professors. She is very easy to get into contact with, is always working to be a better instructor, and will do whatever it takes to accommodate students. If looking for an easy A and not to be challenged as a writer, then I recommend choosing another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: I liked her as a teacher but the class is difficult
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: This is supposed to be a 1000 level class that everyone needs a credit for; ALL of my friends got an easy teacher, but Christina Taylor is not one of them. If you do all of the work (which is a lot) then you get an automatic 'B' in the class. You have to really work for even just a B+. Do yourself a favor and pick any other teacher

Looks like Ms. Taylor has taken a look at these reviews, as the class is no longer structured as a fantasy RPG. The workload is pretty reasonable, and although the grading does take some time, you're pretty likely to get an A if you put in the effort and show up to class.

Her class is literally the worst ever. She tricks you into her class by saying there are unlimited extra credit opportunities, but she gives you so much it is almost impossible to ever try for the extra credit. Her grading is very slow, and she just cannot understand the student's plight. This is possibly the worst class at tech.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors ive ever had. If you wanna feel like youre in third grade again, doing childish in class activities then bombarded by stupid busy work, this is the class for you. She also sets up her class as a fantasy role playing game theme which is really really annoying. I would advise to avoid
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: She's a lot more creative than other teachers and not boring. For essays she's really good at giving feedback and is super available when you need her to be. For essays she also has alternate assignments that you can complete with the same content but applied different. Her class is based like a player game, where you gain XP and thats your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Clark is not a very good professor. She rushes the lecture notes very fast, and she doesn't upload the notes to canvas so if you miss a class good luck with studying for the exams. The exams are also weighted 70% so if you do bad that's basically your whole grade. Take anyone else

Professor Clark is a good human being, who cares about her students. Her exams are challenging, even though they're open note, and she offers little to no extra credit. She does rely on her TA quite a bit. If you study and take good notes, you'll be fine. She offers a solid amount of resources as well
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Clark is a great professor. All assessments are open notes and open textbook, so is the final. Very understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Professor Clark. She clearly cares about her students and wants us to learn and succeed. She is also engaging and clearly is passionate about business.

She's a nice person, but terrible professor. Overall just disorganized, pointless projects and presentations. Always giving quizzes. The quizzes were open note, but half the questions aren't in the textbook and not covered during lectures.

MGT 1104 is an introductory class. She did not know what she was doing. Half of the assignments have no description, you are blindly completing them hoping she likes it. When you pick groups in the start, pick a good one. If your group doesn't show up to class, your grade goes down as well! Overall, terrible professor. Exams make no sense.

Inherently not difficult but made difficult by not explaining assignments and large projects well or changing the instructions midway through (being halfway done with an in person presentation when she decides to switch the instructions and make you re-do it). Be prepared for lots of quizzes, and group projects. It definitely could be worse though.
Great lecturer, very engaging and nice. Very reasonable grader, and class is easy if you put the bare minimum in.

Great dude. Easiest class I took, youdont even have to show up to class. There is very little homework and the quizzes and final are online with no camera. But he is very liberal. He said in class after Charlie got killed that he does not feel bad for his wife and tried telling the class he is a bad guy, despite being such a pure and religious man.

He is a great professor. I took this class for pathways so the workload was a little more compared to other pathways but if you're looking to get into PPE or if you like the subject you MUST CHOOSE HIM. He is a fun guy, hilarious, super knowledgeable, friendly and approachable, and a really easy grader. I loved the class and would highly recommend.

Very interesting lectures, very clear and fair grading, homework is not too heavy, very understanding and nice teacher. Does a good job at completing the carriculum and keeping interest/attention of students

Best professor I've had by far. Every class was super interesting and he makes an effort to encourage you so participating isn't difficult. He's super caring and understanding, you can tell he really wants you to succeed. Some of the readings are long but they're not difficult at all. I can't recommend this class more he's awesome.

Phil 2304 was a fun pathway to take, Claudio is a fun guy who just enjoys talking and hearing his students. There are daily readings and some can be long but overall not a hard class, go to class participate, and enjoy not being in a difficult major-specific course.

This is a very discussion based class, however, if you don't want to participate in class there are discussion boards on canvas and you will get participation credit. All tests were online and pretty easy. There is a lot of reading but it isn't difficult. He is really nice and wants to see students succeed and is open to help in anyway possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This might just be me, but I did not like this professor as much as everyone else does. The class is centered around a bunch of nonsense, no questions will ever be answered, he will always go around questions by saying some stupid reply. Basically, he loves it when nobody answers a question with a legitimate response or voices their opinion.

I really enjoyed this class and the professor is super nice. There is a lot of reading, but that is for any philosophy class. This class focused on global problems and was easy to follow along. As long as you do the readings and the homework (creating a question) it is hard to fail the class. D'Amato is truly a great teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. D'Amato was seriously one of the best professors I've had at VT. You can tell he's really enthusiastic about teaching in the way he talks. He's super caring and is easy to reach out to outside of class. Overall, I had a great experience in global ethics.
Participation is graded so participate. Tests are online and easy. I recommend doing the summaries and film reviews for the final. They took time but were overall easy.

This wonderful guy is basically what you'd get if you combined Chris Farley and Chidi from the Good Place. Super kind, very funny, great lectures. Make sure you buy his textbooks, you're gonna be reading a chapter of somethin every day. He makes class fun to participate in, and is very kind grading-wise. Very laid back and will answer any question.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Looked forward to this class everyday, shame it's only twice a week. Some of the readings gave me a mild aneurysm trying to comprehend but that's the only con. Super funny and nice guy willing to help and answer questions, and assignments aren't bad. Plus, he legit changed my world views. Can't reccomend him and the class enough.

Great professor who delivers quality lectures that are easy to understand and genuinely interesting. He is also always willing to help and offers multiple options for graded assignments that allow for students to have much more autonomy in choosing how the class unfolds for them.

Lectures are great!Tests are open note - you HAVE to take good notes and really indulge yourself in the assigned readings. The readings can range from 10-30 pages but as long as you are interested in the topics (and most topics in global ethics are super interesting)Definitely take any class with him, I cannot recommend him enough!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: (Class taken was 1984B Sports Philosophy S23) HE IS AMAZING!! Great professor who clearly knows his stuff. His slides were super engaging and was great at explaining complicated topics and how they related to sports. Really good at fostering class discussion (discussion-heavy class). Would take again over and over!

You can tell on the first day that he is a great teacher and cares very much. You have to do 1 outline per class, which does take a lot of time, but is graded pretty easily. In class, there is a lecture then there is a discussion section. You also get to choose a lot of your assignments as well. Take this class!!!

A wonderful professor to have as a freshman and an overall great teacher. Outlines get annoying, but they are graded lightly and are interesting at times. Get ready to talk in class, it is fun, but also part of the grade. Very funny man, and very open to different opinions.

Honestly one of the best teachers I've ever had. His lectures were incredible and I learned so much; they were engaging and the material was super interesting to think/talk about. Generous grader and fun discussions too. He is great at encouraging participation and being receptive to student's ideas. Easily my favorite pathways course I took.

Dr. D'Amato is a very lively person and you can tell that he is passionate about the topic. I would not recommend this class if you're looking for an easy pathways class, however this class gives you a better knowledge about the world you live in. There is a hefty amount of reading and outlines, so I will warn you with that.

in phil2304 currently. hes super awesome and you can really tell he genuinely cares about his students and tries to get along with everyone and get to know them. hes really funny and makes me look forward to every class. there is reading every night but it is manageable and the required outlines aren't difficult

A ton of work. If you are taking this class as an elective or to fill a pathway do not. take a different professor. The outlines are so long and you have 2-4 outlines per week either on long readings or movies not even in English. Not sure why he has good ratings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Claudio is an amazing professor. His lectures were very interesting and he made them fun. Recitation attendance on Friday is required. The exams can be kinda tricky, so ask your TA for help with material during recitation. I wish he taught more classes!

Best professor, I learned so much despite the class being so easy. This is how every college class should be. The ratings speak for themselves. The lectures are so engaging and interesting, honestly having to go to recitation was the worst part. Homework is once a class and not too hard or too much work. Great class, great professor

Greatest teacher I've ever had. You have to put in the work and will have outlines due twice a week but they only take about an hour. He is extremely help and so are his TA's. It's really hard to get below a B+ in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class is an easy A, however be ready to read twice a week and fill out short outlines. The tests are super straightforward and the TAs really help with feedback and preparing with study guides. This class covers really interesting topics and if you like listening and discussing I recommend it! The professor is super cool as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is awesome! He is hilarious and very knowledgeable. He is a professor that cares to actually be approachable. For Phil, you basically do select readings before class, write notes in outline form, and submit it before class. In class, he goes over the reading and expands on it. Recitation w/ TA is but theyre fun! Exams are easy and open notes!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Claudio is the absolute best professor at VT. Ive never been more interested in a class and his talent for teaching just makes it easier. You do a lot of reading but it only helps your understanding. Exams are really easy if you do all of the outlines. Favorite class Ive ever taken, and one of my favorite instructors ever.

Morality & Justice with Dr. C was easily one of my favorite classes of all time. The application of philosophy to real world issues helps tremendously with formulating an argument for your position. Occasional writing on exams, but nothing insanely long. I recommend that everyone take this class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved having Dr. C, and I would definitely take a class with him again. He's a great professor who loves teaching philosophy and ethics. During discussions, he'll engage with you and help you refine your ideas. He's very understanding and supportive and knows how to make class fun and entertaining. I highly recommend.
Was a very pleasant professor and really cared about his students. I enjoyed talking one on one or listening during lectures.
If you pay attention to the lectures and use the notes she gives you, you will get an A on the homework. She is nice, the lectures are easy to follow, and she cares about your understanding/success.

She was a nice teacher. Very quick to respond to emails. She posts video tutorials for literally every skill you will need. All in-class is extra credit. She does have a super deductive late penalty; so don't be late. Attendance wasn't required so I skipped out whenever we didn't have to turn anything in.

She is nice and is a good professor but her grading is ridiculous Docking 10% if it's not done (9:31–10:45 AM) and then 20% off for anything submitted within 24 hours of the start of class (10:45 AM to 9:30 AM the next day) is not realistic. That “24-hour” policy makes zero sense...you can submit the same day and still lose 20%... could've been 5/5
Unrealistic grading standarts and not enough help.
Homeworks were easy, lots of group work that counts for a lot of the grade, but criteria is clear. Tests are somewhat difficult too

I've never cared to write a professor review, but she was amazing. Go to class and pay attention—the homework is doable. If you're stuck, she posts videos that will help a lot. In-class work is extra credit. She's super helpful and even helped me explore Land Dev and connect me with a company that led to an internship. Best professor I've ever had

Claire is SO nice. Her class was pretty easy especially if you just pay attention to lectures. She is good at answering questions and she cares about her students a lot. Wants to get to know everyone and always made me feel welcomed and happy. I hope ti take a class with her again.

Claire's sustainable land development class has a good mix of hands-on activities, guest speakers, field trips, and readings. All of the work felt like it was valuable while I was doing it and I felt like I learned a lot in this course.
Claire White is the best teacher ive had at tech

All the work is on the computer and you must print out assignments during the first couple of months. Pretty easy class since she gives pdfs on what to do and which tools to incorporate. Offers extra credit through participation in class, a very loose grader, and work is easy to follow.

Super boring class, and her personality does nothing to make up for it. Doesn't actually teach any of the information on the exams, so you basically have to teach yourself if you want to get a good grade in the class. Would definitely avoid if you have any options for her class.

Intelligent professor whose class is more interactive and hands-on than traditional textbook approach - the problem? Vague information, lack of reading, and no concrete material to study with. Exams are difficult because of this and homework is unrealistically graded to high expectations.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: CAD is a fun class, and isn't meant to be stressful by any means. Homeworks were lengthy but they were posted minimum 2-3 weeks before the deadline. No tests (just weekly quizzes), and no final. Also the last 3 classes she gave extra credit if you showed up and participated.

As a disclaimer, I took ENGL 2604 (critical reading) with Professor Craig. I loved his selection of books for the class. You do have to purchase all hard copies of the reading material, but no textbook. There are pop quizzes once a week in class, but he drops a few. Exams are easy if you read the books. If you do your reading, you will succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Craig was great, and as someone who hates reading and writing, he made the class fairly enjoyable. There's a decent amount of reading for homework, but he won't make you participate. When I had him last fall, we had to write and perform a play at the end of the semester, so if you have stage fright, you might want to choose another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class had very few assignments, which became a double-edged sword in grading. Still, he gave plenty of time to complete said assignments and accepted late work for full credit if it was turned in within a reasonable time. He allows up to five absences before taking points off your grade. Just show up and pay attention to the lecture to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: As someone who had never thought about taking a creative writing class I was hopeful going into this class, but after I was sick and missed a couple of classes (which I emailed and explained to him about) I was given a rude comment in person that threw off the vibe of him for the rest of the semester. Had a genuinely negative experience.

He is so sweet and funny! He really cares about his students and the content you cover. You can miss 5 classes without it affecting your grade. You have 2 main projects and that's pretty much your grade. Took for a pathway but would take any of his classes again!

He's really fun and down-to-earth. This is a super easy class if you already love creative writing. You have to write a story/poem and share it with the class for critiques. Lots of participation. The mandatory readings are pretty short and fun. I didn't read some of them and it was fine. His feedback is amazing and there's barely any lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Craig makes the class interesting for students. Undoubtedly the least boring class I've ever taken. If you're taking Eng. 1105, take Dr. Craig because there was not one moment where I was stressed about his class because he makes it interesting. He's very laidback, so if something comes up where you can't meet a deadline, he's willing to help.

I love Dr. Craig. He created a very fun and warm classroom environment. He was one of the only professors I had where I actually was excited to go to class and was engaged. He knew everyone's names, and he gave out genuinely interesting short stories and poems to read. He actually lets you get creative with your writing as well. Great guy and class

The class is very easy and straightforward. Dr. Craig is a great professor; he seems actually to be interested in teaching his students, and you can tell by his energy in the classroom. There are only a couple of assignments between three major papers and a presentation that make up your grade. Easy grader, as long as you put effort into your work.

Dr. Craig is a great teacher. He is caring and often gives time in class to work on each project. There are very few assignments throughout the semester, so making sure you do fine on each of them is important. Work isn't particularly hard and really reminds me of high school writing assignments. The cartoon research project was the best!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Prof Craig in Fall 2021, his first semester at tech. The class is either reading short stories or workshopping other works. I had fun, and Craig really seemed to care. It was also fun to be guinea pigs for his class. Each class, we had to take home and edit two pieces which was fun but ended up being pretty tedious by the end of the sem.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Craig was my favorite prof by far, and I don't even like writing. He provided a great environment. This was the only class I had all year where the professor knew all of our names, and all the students knew each others names as well, you will not go unnoticed in this class. He also gave great feedback on our writings, I learned a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. Craig gave great, helpful feedback. We had two major writing assignments and you had a decent amount of time to work on both, but it was important to turn them in on time. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Clements is such an awesome professor. This class was such a breeze, you have a few one-page papers that are very simple. It is really fun learning about these people and Dr. Clements as you'll find is an interesting character.

Love Sherwood! I've had him for 4 classes. He is a great professor and is eager to teach his students. If you try, then you'll be fine in his classes. Definitely wants you to understand the material and is happy to help when needed. Just go to class and take notes cause that material will be on the tests. He's a cool guy to talk to about RE to.

I've had Sherwood for 5 different classes. One of the best professors. Pay attention to his lectures. Although attendance isn't required, go to class in order to take the right notes and pass tests. reviews.comment: Best professor! Great lectures and super fun and cares about you learning. Just go and take good notes!

Sherwood was an absolutely amazing professor. His classes will go a long way in helping students decide which direction to go towards.

I'm in design and econ rn. Quite honestly, the two midterms have been bad in terms of structure. There is always somewhat of a confusion as to what is being taught, or what needs to be studied for these midterms?!?

The professor teaches using idiosyncrasies he has acquired over many years. Dr. Clark is a great professor, his lectures are very engaging.  He is the goat for Design and Econ, and from what I have heard is a stark comparison to the other Prof... He is entertaining and lectures are easy to follow but pls pls pls pls do exercises because people are so lost in class.

Good professor, bad class. Clark really makes sure nobody fails his class. The actual material makes no sense but his lectures are interesting, even if unhelpful for the exam. Good professor. Lots of work in groups. Get a good team and you will be fine.

reviews.comment: Tough but fair professor. Very Engaging and it was a wonderful class
Funny and engaging lectures. The tests were pretty hard, so remember to study. Super lenient, and very reasonable person.

Clark's lectures were great. I was signed up for the in-person class but lecture recordings were put on Canvas so I would just watch them later. The homework was pretty difficult compared to the tests. Tests are mostly based off of the lectures and slides.

There is a nice curve added to the class but I overestimated how much it would help.

Dr. Clark isn't a bad a bad professor, I just didn't like his class. His lectures make sense, but he doesn't do many examples, so you'll have to teach yourself a lot of the material to do the homework. He is a very slow grader. He cares about his students and does everything he can to make sure no one fails so I wouldn't mind taking him again.

Professor Clark is truly a top tier professor. He is a great lecturer and genuinely cares about his students. He actively wants people to pass and has been known to give large curves. He does a great job of explaining the material and is easy to understand. My only issue is that he never does practice or example problems in class.

Clark gives students a lot of resources to do well. Has office hours almost every day if you ever need help. Had a C+ test average and ended with an A- because of busted curves. He's nice-strict if that makes sense. The class seems super hard, and it is, but stick with it and you'll be rewarded with massive curves at the end.

Materials Science is a tough class to teach but Clark does a pretty good job at presenting all of the material. He records all of his lectures and attendance is not mandatory. His exams are pretty hard and the homework but he does a lot to help your grade. I haven't gotten higher than a C- on any of my exams and will finish with an A- in the class.
All these 5's are cap. This was easily the hardest class I've ever taken in my entire life. You are goanna be in for a rough semester

The lectures were fun and interactive, Professor Clark knew what he was talking about and obviously loves the material. He also really wants you to succeed and offers a lot of opportunities to improve your grade. My bad grade is definitely mostly my own fault lol. Biggest complaint was the disconnect between lectures/tests and homework.

Clark makes it obvious that he considers BC students as dumber than his other sections. He often refers to math as having to do 'nerd stuff' and that he 'knows' we're not interested in it, and uses MDsolids constantly in class instead of actually spending the time explaining how to do problems.
ME 3024 is a lot of work, which will be the case no matter who teaches it. Clark is your best option as the other professor is really bad.

Dr. Clark is easily one of the best people to have on your side in Engineering at VT in terms of having a professor that wants you to succeed. That being said, you need to put in the effort and want to succeed yourself. A very caring professor who will help you get far just by listening to his lectures.

Clark teaches his class like he genuinely wants you to pass. Extra credit, while a lot of work, is plentiful and he grades tests with partial credit making them less scary. If you have any questions you can email him at most times and get a speedy response. Oh, and he lets you use an equation sheet on the tests. Hard class, but less with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Clark is a great professor who makes class less stressful. The slides are more conceptual while the gifts (quizzes and exams) can be very quantitative, but you can learn most of the calculations from the textbook. The content is decently hard, but Clark gives so many free point opportunities, you can still do well even if you fail a few tests.

Clark is an amazing teacher to have for MSE! I had been taking the class virtually at first but my grade was dropping quick so I opted for in person classes. He is laid back and loves what he does! Just make sure you do the wiley homework and you're set

Clark was a great professor! MSE wasn't really my favorite class. I only really enjoyed the Mechanical Properties chapter since I'm a Mechanical Engineer. Make sure you study harder than you think you need to for the gifts (quizzes and tests). It takes a lot of memorization, but the gifts were open note which was very helpful.

reviews.comment: Never thought it was possible to enjoy your early morning class, especially over Zoom until I took this class.

He is a great professor however the class covers a lot of unnecessary material. The online hw can be easily found on Chegg. The exams are the hardest part about his class. Try to make your own and study before exams. Dw you'll never use that material later on in life.

MSE2034 - Gives semi-hard tests, he teaches the theory/idea but all assignments are based off of the untaught math that you can find in the online textbook. He cares about the material and usually keeps class interesting. Not harsh by any means, and he will often push back due dates for assignments, especially if multiple people email him.

MSE2034 is a very rushed course, but having Clark made it much better. He records all of his lectures so that you never have to go to class and you can watch live at home or rewatch them later as you study for the tests. His tests are very tough and the averages are low. I made it through the course with a B+, so don't get discouraged.

Dr. Clark is a really good professor. MSE wasn't my favorite class because it's a lot of memorization and chemistry stuff, but Dr. Clark's lectures are clear and to the point, and he makes the material interesting. He's really helpful in office hours and definitely seems to care about students succeeding. The "gifts" (tests) are pretty hard though.

Dr Clark is a wonderful and hilarious professor, he makes the class tolerable. Show up, do some work, and you can make it through to the more interesting ME classes

ME2024 is a broken course, and that's not really Clark's fault. He's a great guy that tries his damnedest for his students, but the course material sucks. He is the best option for this course. graded by weekly quizzes, final test, and final project. group projects every other class. he says out of pocket stuff to all the girls in class, will ignore you if you are a boy lol. super unprofessional and made me uncomfortable a lot
Definitely recommend this class. I learned so much. He's a great professor and very kind. He never responded to any of my emails though, which was frustrating. But no other complaints.
Really funny guy and teaches IP law in a consumable way. The class is intentionally structured to be easy but you can learn a lot if you put in the effort. Treat him well!!!

Professor Cockrum is one of the most understanding and friendly professors I have ever had. He treats everyone with respect and like adults. He has great lectures and is funny too! Easy class but I learned a lot!

Enjoyable and humorous professor and made the very dense world of IP law a lot easier to digest. Really great professor. He just knows his material, but also talks to us like adults, not just students. Understands when stuff happens in life and wants us to succeed in his classroom.

Even though I never went to class, I still managed a 100 on every exam including the final paper. I'd still recommend class because the content can be interesting. This professor is super generous and kind and allows open-note Internet exams. I thoroughly enjoyed this class. Easy A for sure.
