Attendance is mandatory, but it won't really affect your grade as much. Class is based on writing projects so no exams!! There kind of is a lot of homework, but it is manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Colleen was a talented teacher who strove to help her students achieve the best grade they could get. She was always prepared for class and provided numerous examples of how the papers should look. She gave me feedback on each paper and answered all of my questions to the fullest; still, GO TO THE WRITING CENTER!

Professor Correll was a caring teacher who wanted her students to succeed in her class. She explains what the expectations are for each paper with an example so that students know how theirs should look and read. She can be a tough grader, so utilize her examples, the writing center, and herself for improvements in your papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good class :)
This class is the best first year English course as long as you do your work and show up to class then you will get an A.

Professor Correll is the best writing teacher. She is a very light grader who makes assignments fun and interesting. She is overall a great person and is very supportive towards her students. 100% recommend taking her if you get the chance!

I would recommend Mrs. Correll to anyone, she has by far been my favorite professor so far. This class was based on music which made it very interesting and fun to write about. Mrs. Correll is such a sweet lady and made writing so fun. She makes music playlists for her classes with songs you pick out and lets you leave class early.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: There are 4 major assignments that your grade is based on, as long as you do the work you can easily get an A. The assignments are based around music which made it so easy to write. Sometimes guidelines can be a little unclear, but on the first day she tells the students make a snapchat group chat so you always have someone to ask for help.

Professor Correll was super chill. If you come to class and do the work you'll pass this class. We had 3 essays and they were pretty easy to get a good grade on as long as you followed the rubric. She gives a lot of great feedback and is approachable! Overall she's a great teacher!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Correll is an outstanding teacher who really cares about her students. I took her 2 semesters in a row. All you have to do to get a good grade is meet with her to receive advice on your papers and she'll even edit them for you if you ask. The class is a bit boring, however, if you put in the time and effort you'll end up with a high A.

She's a good teacher. Explains the project in detail and what specifications she looks for in the final draft. However, she gives drafts completion for almost every class. She grades well and there is a good opportunity for extra credit.

I kept getting extremely low grades even though I spent a lot of time on my papers. It made me feel like I could do nothing to improve my grade but to see it getting lower and lower. If you are not a native English user, do not take this course except you are very confident in your writing skills, it . would kill your GPA.

Overall caring and passionate English teacher. Her class is loaded with homework but definitely easy A's. She gives good feedback on assignments and papers but is a tough grader on formal assignments. Her 1105 project was fun/interesting because our project was based on our choice of a music video. Very reasonable professor

Very good lecturer who does a great job keeping the class entertained. Attendance is not mandatory but you should go as he does an amazing job explaining the material and is also just a really funny guy. Super nice and easy to talk to and is accessible outside of class.

This was my favorite class I took fall semester. Craig's lectures are very informative and interesting. He is also a very funny proffessor and was very flexible about just about everything to do with the class. While there aren't many grades for the course, all the assignments were easy and straight forward as long as you go to class.

You can't go wrong with Craig. He does an amazing job of appealing to both the met majors and other folks in the class.The exams do cover a good amount of content, so it can help to take notes during class.

very kind and funny teacher, i loved hearing him talk. the content can be a lot to grasp at times but not very difficult. definitely go to class, take notes and pay attention, he remembers the faces of those who come to class regularly.

I absolutely love this man! He's one of the best teachers I've ever had. Take this class even if it's not for credit--he can teach any hard topic and make it easy. Truly one of the best professors at VT.
Craig teaches a great intro to met. class! Very interactive and goofy. Three in-person tests, but are usually curved a bit. As long as you attend the lectures and take good notes you will be set

Best professor in college so far. Maybe I'm biased because I love meteorology. His lectures are very fun and interesting, and you may hear the phrases "sexy weather" and "mathematically" 6 times in each lecture. Easy class if you show up or ask questions if you don't understand. Major curves on the tests.
He explains things so they are easy to understand. Will stay behind to answer your questions after class if you have any.
Beer enthusiast Craig Ramseyer. That's it. That's the entire review.

This course is taught every fall. Dr. Ramseyer is very trustworthy, energetic, and you can tell that he really cares about the material he teaches. He wants to help you do very well, because this is can be a complex meteorology course. The final exam is not cumulative, and he curves every exam; you have 3 total exams.
Makes learning fun, Relates well with kids, Loves craft beer; Just an absolute dawg when it comes to clouds.

Intro to Met. with Dr. Ramseyer was one of my favorite classes. He is such a nice guy and loves to tell funny stories about his life during lectures. He teaches the class very well and posts the lecture slides online. There are 3 tests including the final and the final isn't cumulative. Tests aren't hard if you study the material and no homework.
Dude is honestly hilarious. Explains things in an easy-to-understand way and definitely cares about students. He also talks about beer a lot too. 5/5, would take a million times over again.
Great professor and will bring up beer once in every lecture.

Craig is hands down one of the best professors I have ever had in my entire education. He is fun to listen to, very personal and has a story that makes his lectures something to want to listen to. There aren't many assignments in this class so if you do the readings and study for the test, it's a fun and pretty easy class! Would 100% take it again!
ECE 3574 is a course made from the depths of hell. Uses autograder for a course-long project where everyone has completely different implementations.

Great professor, and not too difficult course material. The quizzes were not too hard and the final exam was very similar in structure to the quizzes, which made it relatively easy to prepare for. Students had the option to attend lectures virtually or in person, and the flexibility was nice.

Pretty good lecturer. Had reasonable expectations for a class that is usually taken alongside the senior capstone project. Class is a semester-long group project focused on learning about agile development. Grading was not harsh and quizzes and tests were relatively easy.

Dr. Letona is a top-tier professor. She speaks very fast, but posts the note PDFs prior to each lecture so you can follow along. The lectures alone don't prepare you for exams, but you don't necessarily have to do anything other than a few practice problem sets to score a B or higher. I would gladly take her again for any future math class.

Dr. Letona is the best math prof I've had. She is constantly refreshing you on old topics and connects previous material to the current. Tests are exactly like the homework, usually with the same questions with different numbers swapped in. She talks pretty fast but posts the notes ahead of time you can fill them in as you go. 100% recommend.
I had forgotten what it's like to have a good math professor before I took a section under Cristina. Her lectures are no-nonsense, organized, and professional.

A great professor, one who goes in depth on explaining the topics. Her pace can be fast at times but you are able to understand. Homework's and tests pretty straight forward/ easy. Just put in the effort and you will be just fine. Very friendly at office hours so go to them if you need help.

had her for diffeq, no 2214 course code to select. amazing teacher, made diffeq easy to follow. pre-made blank fill-in note files, extremely helpful (tablet/iPad or print them out). attend every lecture for the notes. one short, weekly hw, hw due before the test reviewed materials for that test. tests straightforward, like the notes and homework
She was very good at lecturing and her tests were pretty easy. She also had office hours every day in case you need help.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Her lectures were pretty good, but I will say she wasn't super direct with answering questions during office hours. Her tests are DEAD EASY compared to other classes- pretty much half the content for each unit wouldn't even be tested. If you're looking to get a good grade in the class, and not to learn multi inside + out, she would be a good choice

She did a great job explaining things, especially concepts that are hard to visualize. She gives out assignments frequently but she grades them fair and she uses well written outline notes with important formulae and other supporting material that is super helpful. Probably the best multi-professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She doesn't help students during her office hours. I am not sure how I am supposed to get help when she says that she already showed in class. Her homework are not that bad, but if you are a person who needs 1:1 help? She is not for you.

Good teacher who made me feel like I got a lot out of the class, while it was still pretty challenging. Makes you work for the grade. Note templates online. Probably best choice for multi. Helped make it visual for me so I could learn.

She is a solid teacher and she is pretty detailed in her lectures though my grade stunk in this class cause her tests were late at night. Her grade on the multiple choice on the final was better than average (compared to other classes) cause we did the old practice tests on the homework.

Her mentality is to assign a lot of work or else we won't study until the night before, such as two lengthy HW assignments and a webassign the week of a test. She goes very, very fast, and combined with her thick Peruvian accent I would not learn much in class, and most of the learning was done on my own. She is intense and quite intimidating.
She is a great professor she explains concepts really well and is always willing to help other students succeed in the class
She is nice and ridiculously smart, but sometimes her accent makes her difficult to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: One of the best math teachers I have ever had. She has the ability to make the most complex material so easy to comrehend. She really cares about her students and wants them to actually learn.

Dr. Crawford was an amazing chemistry teacher. His lectures were easy to follow and his chalk-board style made it easy to take notes. He was very helpful in office hours and the homework made the quizzes/tests easy to complete. Highly recommend.

Very knowledgeable in chemistry. You have to do the homework to really learn the material. He drops your lowest exam, which is super nice. His lectures are fascinating and engaging. You definitely need to study for the tests, though, or you'll fall behind. His office hours are very helpful. Just stay on top of the material and you'll do well.
Absolutely amazing professor. Cares about you and helping you pass the course.

Crawford is the best Professor ever. He's enthusiastic about the material and his lectures are so good that I actually got sad when class was cancelled for snow. He genuinely wants everyone to succeed and is super helpful when answering questions. The test are all very straightforward and is all stuff covered in class and by the hw.

Best professor ever. He is so incredibly smart, but so humble and respectful at the same time. He wants to see everyone succeed, and offers extra credit on every exam. Lectures are so good that you feel like you are missing out if you don't attend, and attend his office hours because they are so helpful!!
Goated professor. But beyond that, he is a great person and genuinely believes all can succeed.
Very good professor and cares about each student.

Professor Crawford is one of the best professors I have ever had. He truly cared about us learning and understanding the material, and was always willing to listen and help. He intentionally wrote on the board to slow down the pace of his lectures and made his grading scale vague in a good way. The class was difficult, but manageable thanks to him.

I had Crawford for Gen Chem for Majors 1 and he was amazing. Not only was he nice but taught the material in an easy to understand way. He had study guides for every test that exactly mirror what the actual test is like and if you do the homework you'll be prepared for the quizzes.

Dr. Crawford is an excellent, caring, and funny professor. He's a genius. His office hours are very helpful, as he designs them so that students can ask him to go over any questions they were uncertain of. That said, the homework and review guides he gave were a good reflection of the exams and he doesn't give trick questions, which was beneficial.

An amazing chem professor, the class was hard but the final replaces the lowest exam grade which helps a lot and brought me from a C+ to an A.  He clearly genuinely cares about his students and even in the large lecture makes an effort to engage and teach each individual.  Definitely take advantage of the test review sessions, they help a LOT.

AMAZING. professor. i left because i switched majors and didn't need the class. but overall he was amazing and a great speaker. he has so many cool demonstrations to show. sit in the front to watch them better. my fav was firing a potato cannon look up you might see some left over.

Best teacher I've ever had lmao legit just a perfect teacher fun guy that isn't overwhelming very good speaker answers questions well or tells you why he 'can't' answer a more advanced question (usually because of time)

Dr. Crawford was the professor who allowed me to realize how much I love chemistry. He is very kind and will explain things in many ways until his students understand. I would definitely take a class from him again.
Homework isn't graded, but many quiz and test questions are directly taken from the homework. Lectures are pretty vague, so a lot of textbook use is necessary to understand the topics.
Dr. Crawford teaches some pretty hard lessons but is an amazing professor at explaining them and gives an enormous amount of help within office hours and test review sessions.

Professor Crawford is awesome! I love love love love him. As a freshman, he was my best professor, and if I had the opportunity to take a class with him again, I would in a heartbeat. He goes out of his way to be helpful in any way possible, and as long as you make the efforts, a good grade is possible to come by. Crawford is a very smart guy!

Very knowledgeable on the subject.  His office hours are very helpful and he does many demos in class.  The homework questions are used on his tests.  The only down side is that he doesn't give enough time for his tests.  He does acknowledged it and curves.

Crawford is an awesome prof. He is always willing to help you & his office hrs are extremely helpful! I thought I would have a rough transition into chemistry since I took AP chem my junior year of high school, but he made it simple and enjoyable. If you do all your homework I guarantee you a B or higher in the class.

Dr. Crawford makes the transition from high school level courses to college an easy gap to bridge. He offers plenty of assistance beyond the lecture hall. Dr. Crawford's provides an awesome classroom style in such a large university.

Dr. Crawford is a great professor, but he shouldn't teaching 100+ students. In the lecture hall, he was not engaging and my attendance, personally, faltered. However, during office hours, in groups of 15-20, he was perfect. Engaging, crystal clear, and understanding. He's a great professor - I'm sorry he took almost failing chem for majors to find.
Excellent professor!! Capable of clarifying the difficult and challenging topic of quantum chemistry. Highly recommended his classes even if the subject material makes you shake in your boots.

One of the best teachers I've had here.  He is very friendly, and will help anyone who is having trouble understanding the material.  The second semester of Physical chemistry is a very tough class, but he makes it survivable and sometimes enjoyable.

Prof. Crawford really is awesome, he posts old exams before the exams, and he posts all the homework solutions (after you turn them in). He writes anything important on the board and makes things really understandable. He also does study sessions before every homework is due.
Dr Crawford is an excellent professor, very knowlegdable, and a great teacher.  He made the class fun and very interesting. I thought I would hate this class, but ended up loving it.
Very interesting lectures, but you need to be interested and engage in political science to really pick up the highlights of Dr. Thomas. She's nice but doesn't fool around.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class but make sure you do all assignments per the instructions. These professors are so caring and were great to have in the morning, get ready for free food!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: CT has amazing lectures. The course content was fascinating. If you stay engaged, you will do great on the tests!

Crazy that there are negative reviews here. This class is great. That's it. Greater teacher who loves teaching it. If you just go to class and do participation and take notes you will get a solid grade. It's a fun class to attend. Exams are not hard it's pretty much all multiple choice. Drops one exam and also allows multiple excused absences.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Thomas is very passionate about her 2054 class. Your final grade is made up of a quiz every class, attendance quizzes, and 75% are your 4 exams. She drops the lowest exam grade and 6 of the lowest quiz grades, but she hides your course grade until the evening of the withdrawal deadline.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: People who complain about her aren't there to learn. If you want to learn, Dr. Thomas is the professor for you.

She is an engaging prof who cares about you (will do exam reviews and answer questions). Course content is interesting and besides the fact that she hides your grade, I think she does a wonderful job. If you apply yourself you'll ace after class quizzes - her lecture slides are your biggest asset. Don't pay attention to all the negative reviews.

She's honestly kind of annoying. Entire class is based on lectures and readings with like three assignments throughout the year that completely determine your grade. Final is pretty easy as long as you take notes bc its open note.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good luck, future political science students. She has a bizarre grading schedule, and assignments are not due at regular times.  She can be a rigorous teacher, with harsh grading systems set in place that feel like they set students up for failure.  Be sure to study the syllabus; any errors on your part will have consequences.

Dr. Thomas is a good professor at heart, but her classes are super lecture-heavy. There is an attendance quiz every day, and you need to be in class for that, but she drops the lowest 6. The assignments are few and far between, and typically count for a large percentage of your grade (20% usually), but they are easy as long as you have notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is great and genuinely cares about students and what she teaches about. I think some of the harsher ratings are overdramatic. Be prepared for realism day lol.

Everyday she has attendence quizzes for a good portion of your grade. Rarely finishes lectures and you leave confused because she was rambling for the last 20 minutes of class. The exams are pretty hard and she will pull random questions from the lectures nobody was prepared for. Not awful but I would not take her again if I had the choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: As a conservative thinking student, do not take Dr. Thomas as a professor. You will be targeted and felt neglected. Her teaching assistants have the same views as her, and forgive me suck up to her ten fold. Dr. Thomas is a nice person, but when you listen to her lectures it's obvious what side she belongs to.

She ends every lecture like its the end of a coming to age movie, beside that the class is easy, just do your work. like everyone complains about the planner assignment but we have 2 WEEKS to complete it and 4 full classes for it where she offers help. lots of reading & you gotta take notes, she also hides your grade all semester. but she's chill.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There are lots of books needed for this course. I loved her lectures as they are very engaging and like she is telling a story, however, it is hard to tell what will and will not be on the exam. The exams also cover a lot of material, and you are unable to use notes on the exam. Study in advance, participate, and do well on the exams to pass.

The exams are pretty hard and are the bulk of your grade. She gets really into what she is talking about a lot and it is to the point where I would get frustrated since you can't tell what's gonna be on the exam and she does not clearly say what the exam will be on, simply just making it harder on students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Overall her teaching style should be modified to better comprehend a connection with the Students in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Thomas is probably the most passionate professor at VT. Great person, very caring, knowledgable and understanding. I love politics and history so this was my jam, her lecture is fascinating because it's like she's telling a story.I really enjoyed her class. Test is pretty difficult since a lot of material is covered so don't expect an easy pass

I wasn't a fan of Dr. Thomas, she is very negative and does not seem to care at all about students, and makes it clear she doesn't want to be there. Classes are long lectures, it is hard to stay focused on the material. If you do not do well on the exams, I wouldn't expect a great grade. While the exams aren't hard, they cover a lot of material.

Dr. Thomas is a great teacher who makes the course engaging, but it's very test-heavy. My only complaint is that she doesn't let you review quizzes or tests. The class is lecture heavy, anything on the slides is fair game on the exam so make sure to attend. Still, the tests are manageable if you attend and read the 3 books assigned.

I had Dr. Thomas for both 1034 and 2054. I think she is so much better for 2054 which isn't an unpopular opinion. In 2054 she shows a lot more passion and her lectures are actually very interesting. She is also a lot easier to reach for 2054 and even does review sessions the night before the exam which are so helpful! She also gave us donuts a lot!

This was a required intro class and very simple. I truly enjoyed Dr. Thomas' lectures; she is very knowledgeable about the material presented and truly passionate about it. Be sure to put the proper care into your literature review, and besides that, the class is very simple and you will likely end with above a 100.
Worst professor I've ever had by a long shot. She has an incredibly irritating personality. She made it clear to our class that she did not want to be there.

Dr. Thomas' class was fairly easy...if you go to class, you're basically guaranteed an A. Also had her for PSCI 2054, and the same was true. Attendance is graded, so you need to be there, but there is minimal homework and tests are pretty straightforward.

One of the worst professors at Virginia tech, she's extremely rude and disrespectful. Offering no help outside of class. The academic planner assignment is confusing for no reason and is graded extremely harshly. Attendance is mandatory despite her having the course on zoom as well and she yells for no reason. Would never take again

great professor and easy class. her lectures are intriguing, what she says during them is exactly how they'll be written on exams/quizzes, so be sure to take notes. very little homework, just a 5 minute quiz after every lecture. she's a lenient grader and will drop your lowest quizzes/test scores.

She makes the intro to PSCI class way more difficult than it needs to be. There are a few very large grades that you receive almost no help or guidance on.  She's not very nice and is very unapproachable. If I didn't have to take her classes going forward, I would not, but unfortunately I do not have a choice.

The reason for the large number of both 5 stars and 1 stars is simple: 1034 vs 2054. As someone who took both, Dr. Thomas herself is a great lecturer and overall good professor. But it's very clear she's a lot more passionate about her 2054 class than her 1034 one. She's very generous in 2054 grading-wise, dropping many quiz scores and one exam.

A simply wonderful professor that is full of knowledge and care for her students. The class is lecture heavy with many readings but the exams aren't too difficult unless you don't study. Dr. Thomas is passionate and cooperative. Drops one exam and at least six quizzes which is very gracious.

One of the worst professors ever. The epitome of "I hate my job so I am going to make your life harder." Assignments are due at noon, attendance is mandatory, she boasts about not giving students help, and your grade is made up of one assignment you get 0 help on. She approved of mine yet I still got a 60 due to TA grading. So unprofessional.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Thomas was a really good professor. She assigns books in her classes that I highly recommend reading if you want to fully understand what is going on. The exams are easy and there is almost no homework. There are no projects (at least in IS 2054) and her lectures are very entertaining if you find the topic interesting
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Thomas was one of the worst professors I have experienced here, although the class itself is not difficult. Forced to calculate your own grade, provides no help, gets annoyed when students ask for help, and complains. Don't bother emailing her with any questions, because she will take time out of her day to respond with check canvas.

She is an amazing lecturer who makes the material very interesting, I literally feel like I hang on to every word she says. She gives good feedback but isn't very friendly. The assignments are hard and not much instruction is given on them.

If you have her as an advisor, good luck. Every time I asked her for help she was short and made it seem like a chore. As a professor, her lectures are pretty boring and she gets frustrated and upset at small annoyances. The academic planner is a big grade, but actually has been helpful.

Horrible grader. Coming in as a freshman you will have to do an assignment worth a large portion of your grade with absolutely zero help. She constantly talks over other professors and students and does not let anyone get their point across. Would not recommend her for any incoming freshmans.

She gives absolutely no help to students, grades the academic planner very harshly (even though you do it two weeks into your fall semester, as a freshman), and yells A LOT.  Attendance is taken through "one-minute reflections". She talks over all of the other professors. I highly don't recommend.
So annoying to listen to at 9 am she literally yells for no reason. Her personality alone makes me want to change majors, also very passive aggressive I do not recommed.
Mean, rude, lacks mutual respect, does not care about students whatsoever.

This is the worst professor I've had at Virginia Tech. She taught me NOTHING. The planner you have to do in this class is enough not to take it. She pretty much gives you an assignment that's worth a large percentage of your grade and helps you NONE. She's straight up a figure it out yourself kinda professor. DO NOT RECOMMEND!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Knew I wanted to switch out of PSCI 2 weeks into this class. She's just annoying and loud. Bias during lecture & the slides had such small font they were impossible to read. She and the TA didn't grade based on the rubric. It's an FYE course too so you spend 3 weeks making a sticky note collage of every class you'll take... as fall freshmen.
I think she is a pretty good professor. She can be active a lot of times but she really does care for her students.

The grade you get in this course really depends on what you put into it. Go to the lectures, they're interesting and a lot of the important content isn't on the posted slides so it's important to hear it. Her exams aren't hard as long as you take detailed notes and review them well.

This is my first time taking a class with Dr. Thomas, and I am already planning to take another class of hers next semester. While she really cares about her students, she expects you to take the time in her class seriously. The class was relatively easy until the literature review section. START ON YOUR LIT REVIEW EARLY! You will regret it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She has very clear political biases in her lectures and information she teaches you. Very strong personality and beware she may laugh at a question you ask in front of everyone. Avoid her if you don't like one sided lectures.
Lots of lectures, lots of writing. Political bias in lectures. Avoid this professor if you do not like writing and reading. Attending class is a must if you want to pass the class.

If you like to hear rants instead of lectures and only one side of the political spectrum and get crucified when you disagree with her then this is the class for you! The only good thing about this class is that I could skip it. All the slides are posted on Canvas, but I recommend going to class for lectures on the 4 books you have to read.

Attendance isn't "mandatory" in the way where she does not care if you come to class but you NEED to come to class. All of the exams and quizzes are based directly off her lectures. The lectures are engaging and very interesting. I thoroughly enjoyed this class and would take it again if I could. Do well on the 3 exams so you can skip the final!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Thomas for IS 1034. Make sure you complete the big assignments and do well on the content exam because there is only 1! Also, don't procrastinate on your Literature Review, that is one tough paper to write. Overall the class is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very easy class, only a few big assignments and you have time to do them. The grading is easy too, never got under a 100% on any of the writings I had to submit. There's only one exam and it's almost directly off the notes. As long as you show up and take notes, you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Thomas's lectures, and her only test is open-note and taken at home. All of the other assignments are really simple and related to being a freshman in college, so just follow the guidelines and turn it in. There are in-class reflections, so it's a good idea to show up, but she won't dock your grade or punish you for not attending class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Idolized the Cuban healthcare system because it is communist. She made attempts to take the middle ground but ultimately sided with one ideology. Lectures were sometimes interesting but you were punished for missing them because of random pop quizzes. Exams were easy, but learned the hard way that you cannot return to questions after completion.
She is very passionate and moves quickly, do not skip IS 2054. Be sure to take notes on the lecture and on what she says off the presentation. If you do that, you will be fine.
Yells a lot, passive-aggressive emails. Made me switch majors.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Doesn't explain much and you should not take classes with her more than once.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She shapes the content of the course around topics that the students want to learn about, which is a good start to the polisci major. She is a very passionate lecturer, which makes the class a lot more interesting. Be prepared for the two hour content exam, it's awful, but as long as you go take notes (she posts slides on canvas) you will be fine.
