reviews.comment: Patton seems like a nice guy but his classes are the most boring thing ever. I honestly had trouble staying awake. He talks forever about things that were unrelated to our current essay. Showed up maybe 5 times and got an A.

Most of the class is just Prof. Patton discussing written communication. This doesn't sound that interesting, but I could honestly listen to him go on about it for hours. The classes are very easy to skip, as there are only 3 essays to write the whole semester. There's very little work unless you procrastinate, and his office hours are very helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Patton is a good professor, enjoyable English 1106 experience. The A isn't handed to you but there are opportunities to boost your grade with an essay rewrite and points for in class participation. Little to no busywork, interesting classes most of the time.
Really easy class but honestly most mundane and boring teacher. I would fall asleep almost ever class so I basically stopped showing up except for when I had to present and when we had peer editing.
I only did 1 of the three papers due in this class. I also did extremely poorly on the final presentation. I still got an A-
Really cares about you as a student and person and honestly best professor I've ever had.
Dr. Bruce is an excellent advisor and teacher. He really cares about all of his students, and I look forward to taking more classes with him.

Dr. Bruce is such a fun teacher and it's very clear that he cares about the material he is teaching. Was very open to feedback on the course and introduced an online chat option to ask questions (and receive your weekly participation points) without having to speak up. 11/10 recommend taking one of his classes

Professor Bruce is one of the most genuine professors I've ever had. Great sense of humor as well as a super easy course. Just show up and do what's assigned (which is like 30 minutes of work a week) and it's an easy A. He makes lectures interesting and he loves to incorporate Calvin and Hobbes into his slideshows.
Professor Bruce is a really awesome and fun professor.  Great as a professor for FYE class, didn't bore me, easy work, and very caring!  I would love to have him for FYE class again!
He assigns a lot of homework but it is very doable and he will not bore you.

I love Bruce! He is my academic advisor also and is caring, approachable, accessible, always willing to help with anything and everything, and truly wants everyone to do well. This class was super easy and chill. It's helpful as a first-semester freshman when trying to first navigate college.

This was my first year experience class and Bruce made my first semester of college was easier and he was very helpful. There are homework assignment every week but they are enjoyable and don't take long to complete. I am so glad I was able to be in his FYE class.

Dr. Bruce is super fun. He makes class incredibly easy and he seems to love his job. Instead of lecturing he has a conversation with the class so that you dont even realize you are learning. He wants to see you succeed and is super easy to talk to.

I took his first year seminar course and he is also my academic advisor. Dr. Bruce is awesome! He truly wants the best for his students and does everything in his power to help you succeed. Everything we did in class was geared to our interests and paths here at VT.

Dr. Bruce is one of my favorite professors. He is a great guy and has an even better sense of humor. He wants everyone to succeed and do well and gives really good advice. He's always available to answer questions of any kind. The class is really simple with just some short, basic assignments. I would take his class every semester if I could!!!

I thought that this class was going to be a joke, but it was actually VERY helpful with deciding a major and adjusting to college. Bruce is a great teacher and very caring about the success of a student. He is very approachable and extremely knowledgeable about majors. If you are Undecided I highly recommend taking this class! best thing I did.

He is such a great guy. This class really helped adjust to college first semester of freshman year. Would recommend all incoming freshman take this guy's class if they are in university studies. His class is usually fun and engaging. He is also a great academic advisor, take his class so you guarantee you get him as yours.

Really awesome guy. I had him for Pathways to Success and as my University Studies academic adviser. He is very knowledgeable about the school and is super easy to talk to if you have any questions. (And he really loves his dog!)

Professor Heaton is a nice guy, if you're genuinely interested in the content then you will find the class enjoyable and pretty easy. Grade is based off of 25 entrance tickets (participation) and 3 essays which were kind of annoying to write, but as long as you follow the guidelines you'll get a good grade on them.

Heaton does not grade any of your work or provide any feedback, his TA does all of it. 3 essays and 25 entrance tickets = your grade. He has a volume control issue that made me stop attending lectures once the 25 entrance were done. Lectures have virtually nothing to do with essays, only the readings. If you're not interested, don't take this class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you are genuinely interested in the content, it's an easy class. Heaton is very knowledgeable about Globalization and particularly Nigeria, as that is his field of study. There are readings with entrance tickets due at the beginning of every class, but they just have to be three sentences.

I thoroughly enjoyed my graduate class with Dr. Heaton. He was very laid back and easy-going.  I did not find him a particularly hard grader, and he showed that he cared for his students.  Our class got to see the administration side of history graduate school as well, which was interesting.  I would absolutely take another class with Dr. Heaton.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is incredibly amazing.  He is both interesting and helpful.  While he does assign lengthy reading assignment every night, he is an easy grader.  He also leads very interesting class discussions based on the readings.  Take a class with him before you graduate, or you will regret it!!
She's pretty laid back and she has fun assignments she has us do, though her lectures were a bit boring it was a very easy class

very sweet lady and very helpful. however, she talks forever and turns a 15 slide powerpoint into an hour and 15, kinda just rambles on and loses track of the lesson. hard to stay focused during her lectures

iClicker questions for attendance so you do have to go to class, but she knows what she is talking about, which helps. A few small group assignments, but not bad at all. Only two tests the whole semester. Most work is hands-on assignments, if anything, and I actually enjoyed them. She is super nice and will help you if you ask.

Her class is kinda pointless. The simulation is really useless and just so dumb. She changed the final to in person because canvas went down 2 months ago... and moved the final up 5 days. Kinda annoying and her lectures are super boring she just reads off the slides. I'd never go if there was not iclickers.
Lectures are boring. She is nice but class is pretty pointless. Overall wouldn't take her again.

Just lectures, but she knows what she's talking ab and she's nice. Tests are lockdown but genuinely easy if u just review the lectures. Had to pay for simulation program ($70), attendance required, she/her TAs take a long time to grade
mandatory attendance for a grade… her outfits always ate

There is iClicker for attendance, short essays, simulations, and 2 online exams that have Lockdown Browser with camera. I asked her for help once because my group members weren't participating and she basically told me to figure it out myself. I also didn't love how everything was due at 5 pm rather than 11:59 pm, but overall an easy class.

fine teacher, all she does is lecture. easy free participation points from iclicker every class and you get 4 excused absences. we had 2 group assignments during the fall sem. not a super tough grader, offered some extra credit opportunities too. I gave this class almost 0 hours a week and pulled a 93 easily, take this course fr

Did not really like her. Attendance is very much mandatory, will impact grade majorly. Done through i-clicker. Exams are lockdown and webcam. She doesn't really like students being correct, definitely thinks she's a marketing savant. Reads off slides for lectures and expensive software required.

One of the worst professors I've had. Talks so much and goes on horrible marketing tangents. Says she only works 9-5 so everything is due at 5 and not midnight. Doesn't respond to emails. Goofy homework and assignments and over $150 in textbooks/simulations. Easy class made more difficult for absolutely no reason

She is a pretty average teacher, nothing to make her a great teacher but nothing to make her a bad teacher. very middle of the road, the class is pretty easy, mainly because it is a marketing class and pretty straight forward.

MKTG 3164. Reads off lecture slides but uses iClicker with participation questions during class so you're forced to come to class despite iClicker barely working. You have to buy iClicker, hubspot, and stukent simulation software. Insane waste of money. Exams with lockdown browser and webcam and no notes but makes sure to include trick questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had professor Hillison for MKTG 3164 and she was great! There are a few group projects and an online simulation at the end of the semester. She provides good hands-on marketing projects that actually helped me understand what we were learning. Go to class because there are iClicker questions for attendance.

Most of the work/learning will be done outside of class, yet you will be forced to come to the "lectures" to listen to Prof.Hillison read off the PowerPoint slides. Attendance is taken via iClicker and will probably count you absent about a quarter of the time anyway. Group Projects and Homework assignments are straight-forward. Take it online.

I was super excited to take this class (Digital Marketing) but it isn't what I expected at all. Instead of taking this and stressing out just watch Youtube/get certified. Attendance is taken and she uses Respondus Lockdown with Webcam on exams. She's not responsive to emails and doesn't bother to help with assignments before stuff is due.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hart had structured notes to go along with every lecture, posts videos going over most of the notes, and the lectures themselves are easy to follow. 100% would take his class again

Professor Hart is genuinely one of the kindest and most interesting people I've met. He wants all his students to succeed, no matter their background, and will go above and beyond to prepare you for exams and finals. My favorite professor this semester — I hope I get the chance to work with him again!

Heath Hart is genuinely one of the most caring professors at Virginia Tech. His lectures set you up for success and provides study guides that are nearly identical to the tests. He does have some in-class assignments, so it is important to attend his lectures. He also posts video notes on canvas. Take him if you can!

Very nice and cares about his students. Attendance isn't mandatory but he sometimes has graded classwork + class is very helpful. Midterms aren't too bad as long as you study and the final is a coding project (any language you want). Sometimes he has trouble finding homework submissions thru email but just bring it up in class and he'll fix it.

One of the most helpful professors at VT. He makes you feel like part of the class and seems to genuinely care about his students. If you don't understand something he explains topics well without making you feel bad about asking the question.
Does not use Canvas for some reason which makes it hard to keep track of assignments. He is very inaccessible outside class as none of my emails got answered. Otherwise, he is a decent professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best Teacher Of All Time! Take him! GOATED!!

Professor Hart is the best math teacher I've had at Virginia Tech. His teaching style makes me feel like a valued part of the class. Compared to other college professors, he fosters a sense of inclusivity and connection. His teaching methods and personality are exceptional—both deserve a 5/5 rating.

Best math professor at VT.  He breaks things down into very easy to understand notes and examples, and explains them so well that I almost always get the concept immediately.  He made an otherwise difficult and daunting math class way easier and almost enjoyable lol - coming from someone who hates math.  Would highly recommend.
Probably the best college professor I've had so far. So open to answering questions and takes as much time as you need. Made a difficult class seem pretty easy.

His notes are very in-depth, and it is easy to understand the concepts from his lectures. The homework's that he assigns help a lot to prepare for the midterms. There were two coding projects, but they weren't that bad. He also takes his time to explain the topic to be learned. Would 100% recommend him.
My second time taking Prof. Hart for a class was, yet again, an amazing experience.  Very good professor.
Best professor I've had at VT. Only thing to note is not to take the class if you don't know how to code, as there were coding projects. If you know any CS they aren't bad.
Professor Hart explained Combinatorics from a Computer Science perspective, we even had coding projects. He gives partial credit when grading exams and homeworks.

Awesome Professor, 10/5. Very personable and approachable if necessary. Genuinely wants his students to learn the material well and succeed. Gives less WebWork than other teacher, and focuses more on written work. He has made his own teaching materials which are easy to understand, and the HW is based on them. Brought cookies to the final exam

Professor Hart is the kindest man you will ever meet. His lectures are so thoroughly explained and he truly cares about his students and their questions. His tests are exactly like the homeworks and in-class worksheets which he works through during class, which is why I recommend attending class. He is one of the best professors I've had by far.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Hart is so good at getting his students excited for mathematics. I have never had a professor I respect more, and I'm very excited to take his courses in the future. He respects every student individually, no matter your background.

If I can give him 10 out of 5, I will. So far, he is my favorite professor at Virginia Tech. this may be sounded biased, but if someone gives him other rates instead of 5, it shows that they are the problem, not him.
Best professor I've had at Tech.

This professor is by far the best professor I have had at Virginia Tech. He teaches his combinatorics class in more of a computer science way rather than a math way. He has coding projects which I liked. If you can choose him as a professor, I would.
If you have the chance to take him for a class you should! He's one of the few good math teachers at VT!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great prof! Only good math professor at VT.

Heath was an amazing professor, my favorite at Virginia Tech so far. His online lectures were very good and he was always more than eager to help during office hours. You can tell he genuinely cares about all of his students and wants everyone to succeed.

Favorite prof at Tech so far. He's a really generous grader and he offers office hours several days per week. Great at explaining the material and is always happy to clarify when you're confused. You NEED to do the optional homework to do well though.

Even with online classes, Hart was the best. His online videos were super explanatory and he held in-person classes to review the material. He was very understanding of his students and wanted to accommodate us. 10/10 would take this class again.

One of the best teachers I've had at Virginia Tech so far. Heath is a very caring guy will give you the best feedback and will answer literally any questions you have. He will mess up an example on the board from time to time but the best part about him isn't his lecturing but how he cares about his students.

Lecture notes are printed, he explains concepts very well but it gets confusing later on. Very good for the teaching side - super smart. The homeworks and everything were doable but I struggled on tests because it wasn't very similar to hw... of course where grading matters. Better than most the other teachers.
Engaging, easy to understand, can teach well with clear notes. Years better than the rest of the math dept.
Very helpful when answering questions, all around great professor, really good at teaching linear

Amazing professor! If you have the opportunity to take a class with him then DO IT! His notes are crystal clear, he is super helpful in class and during office hours, and he is very funny. Definitely the best professor I've had at Virginia Tech.

Great professor! Recitation attendance is 15% of the grade but wasn't super helpful for me.  His lectures are very clear and he always answers questions. The questions on quizzes and exams are taken from a pool of questions and he goes over every single one very clearly and there are practice questions online with a helpful forum. Recommended!!!
Relatively funny, but he remains on task and helps clarify every difficult concept with plenty of examples that relate directly to the quizzes.
EXCELLENT professor. He explains everything well, and if you need extra help, he make arrangements to meet with you and explain everything. Funny guy...he makes class interesting.
hes an awesome guy, a little bit of a hippie, didn't wear shoes one class. really happy guy who loves to help out his students.  ended up getting a higher grade in the class than i thought.

This guy is great! He's a wonderful teacher. If you ever need help with the class (if you haven't taken Calc, you might need help,) he is extremely helpful. Visit his office or talk to him after/before class. He does a great job with going over material enough for you to remember it for the tests, and his practice tests are a lot of help. Do them!

i was struggling because i'm not very good at drawing and don't have a good sense of space, but he's so helpful and i thought i was going to barely pass the class, but ended up with a B+! he's ridiculously funny!
hes a really good math teacher hes funny and very helpful
notes are clear and easy to follow -- funny sense of humor, makes the class more enjoyable
This guy does look like homer!!He is so funny and goofy!His class is easy cause u get the notes off blackboard and it is very easy to follow along.Take this class.Tests are not hard either.

very engaging teacher. he loves to make his students laugh and have a good time. very easy to understand his lessons and he is always available for help. closetest to a real life homer simpson as i'll ever meet.
Heath is a great teacher. He makes these math courses fun and interesting for sure!  He is helpful and always available.
No Comments

Heath is a great teacher who will go out of his way to help you out.  He is really fair & I did poorly on a few tests but ended up with an 88%.  If anything I'd go to class to laugh, he is crazy and so funny.  He makes alot of odd jokes and comments that make going worthwhile.

He's a really good teacher.  I don't think anyone dropped his course.  I did real poorly in his class throughout the year but he is really fair in grading i turned in like 5/12 hws and got an 86 hw average.  He gives you plenty of chances to pull your grade up.  On top of that he's a really good tea

Hiromi's teaching was confusing. Often, the project guidelines were not clear, which left myself and many of my peers confused on our assignments. Hiromi is a funny and great artist, just on the teaching side of things I was often left confused. Projects always continued outside of class, but class often ended early on critique or lecture days.

She is very funny and very sweet. Her projects are very fun, and she always pushes you to get out of your comfort zone. I went to one of her weekend mural paintings and bad a ton of fun doing it! She'll give you a good grade as long as you put effort into your work and show that you care.
Hiromi is okay, had her for principles of 2d. Class is easy but she can be annoying. Would recommend her though

Hiromi is the best! She's super fun, understanding, and an overall great professor. I took her Principles of 2D class and I learned a lot and felt welcome and safe in her class. She's easy to talk to and gives you a lot of opportunities to express yourself and put your twist on her assignments.
She has been my favorite teacher thus far. She is so sweet and accommodating but also so helpful when you need guidance. Her energy every class is what kept me going- she is incredible
not clear about assignments and not enough time to complete. funny but hard
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is a really great professor, she encourages you to go out of your comfort zone and draw inspiration from anywhere. Be present for critique days, it benefits everyone for being there. Critiques are by no means to shame you but to encourage. She is also really good at accommodating and she does her best to understand everyone's situation.

I really loved having Hiromi. She always gave great feed back on your work and would always take time to explain any questions about an assignment or new topic. I had a great time in class, but It may be more difficult for someone who has had no previous art experience.

Really fun teacher; cool too if you get to know her. Despite her playful attitude, she covers topics thoroughly and knows her stuff. Don't be afraid to finish work early even if it's "bad" because you'll get a lot of feedback and chances to improve.

Hirsh is easily the best educator I have ever had. This course is extremely challenging but fair. Do what he instructs in the syllabus and you will make it through. You can tell he really loves what he does and cares for his students well being.

Very tough but clear grader. Paying attention to his strict writing guidelines is a must, and he is more than willing to knock off points for simple mistakes. Gives feedback, though not always the most helpful or easy to understand. If you put in the work, you'll learn what you need to know.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Listen up folks Hirsh is the real deal I had him both for 2914 and 3914. He tells you exactly what he wants from you and what he does not in you papers. One learns quick in his class not to use Passive voice among other things. After that he is probably the toughest/fair grader I ever had. Just quote parts of Airplane (movie) and you will be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hirsh is a fantastic teacher, but a harsh grader. His Hist 2004 class is the true "weed out" class of the history department. His class will teach you almost every skill you need to write historical papers, and you'll use those skills for the rest of your history career. I wouldn't have wanted to learn those skills from anyone else.

Syllabus was a mess. Constant due date changes. Would throw out critical information without much explanation and criticizes you if you get the material wrong. Criticism aren't even thought-out.Lectures are just him rambling for an hour and a half. Heavily opinionated person, forces his view on writing and history upon you.
Hirsh grades without mercy. At least with me, he did not help much when I went to him for help. He also destroyed my love for history.
Nice guy open book tests

He's a decent lecturer. Loves corny jokes. His grading scale is questionable, though. No one in my section received an A... most people got B+'s or worse. He grades papers heavily on style - for example, you're only allowed to use a variation of "to be" twice per 400 words. Great feedback though, better than any teacher I've had.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very good professor, he did everything to set up students for success in his class. Also just a great and funny guy

This guy was amazing for Multi. He explained stuff so well and really put time into each lecture. He used Desmos and 3D graphing material in class to explain the difficult concepts and his tests were relatively easy as long as you do the practice tests. I definitely recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Hicks is good about rephrasing his questions until his students understand what he is asking. He is not afraid of long silences and will wait until someone has an answer. He is welcoming of answers that may be incorrect, and his teaching style revolves around participation and effort. The content taught in class will apply to your future.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Love this professor 10/10! Made math understandable and even offers to replace a midterm exam grade with the final exam grade at the end of the semester:) Offers lots of help and guidance and is very patient! He is just genuinely a very good professor props to him truly.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great math professor- quite rare here. Can't say much about his grading in particular because the class was standardized but I found it easy. He WILL know your name if you come to class. Would take a class with him again in a heartbeat.

I loved having Hilary as my studio professor -- she is VERY lecture heavy and will talk pretty much all of studio, but it is always very interesting and enlightening. She holds her students to a very high standard and gives good critiques. You will end spring semester set up very well and with very high quality work.

Hilary is never happy unless it is exactly what she wants... but she will never tell you exactly what she wants you to do and will sarcastically talk down to you if you fail to answer her how she wants you to. She is willing to embarrass you infront of everyone, tear your work up, and continue to tell you how you are not working hard enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hillary was my first year professor and she was super tough and hated almost all of our work we did. Never was satisfied, but you learn a lot from her class. Talks a little too much but says some good points.

Really interesting course because he taught it really well, would definitely recommend taking his classes. You HAVE to do the readings because there is pop quizzes but they're usually pretty interesting.
I had him for 2115 and it was a very interesting class. He is clearly passionate about the subject and I highly recommend taking any of his classes if you get the chance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Horn's biomedical ethics class and it was such a fantastic experience. He makes the classroom so comfortable for class participation which is a big part of the grade, and he is fun and caring. The course itself is so cool and interesting. I would 10000% recommend taking this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Horn. I think he was incredibly professional in facilitating discussions in class and made it easy to talk about the ethics of the cases. He is really easy to go to with questions as well. As long as you do the readings for the class it is quite fun (also if you like ethics I suppose).

Dr. Horn is an amazing professor. The class is very discussion-based, which is very enjoyable after sitting through boring lectures in other classes. You absolutely CANNOT get away with skipping the readings, as there are 12 POP quizzes based on the readings. Do the reading early and go to office hours if you are confused.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Horn was a blast. While there was reading assigned before every class, it was never something you couldn't read in about 30 minutes. He had 12 pop quizzes over the course of the semester, with two of those being dropped which were very easy as long as you at least skimmed the book. Lectures were enjoyable and he always started discussions.10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Horn is kind and understanding. His classes are often group discussions rather than trad. lectures. His classes are fun to attend and more informative than trad. lectures, too. There is a lot of reading required for his class, but you can often get away with skimming to get the basic concepts, so you can do discussions and pop quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you want to save yourself from hating your life, do not take this class. Hoek accused me of cheating on our first ever assignment in the class (2 points mind you), reported me to the honor court, and he didn't even have the guts to show up to the hearing. His lectures are boring, assignments typically aren't clear, and he rarely communicates.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Hoek's course is well structured and a great introductory philosophy course. His Canvas is well organized and his online lectures were super helpful (with great slide decks). He did a great job explaining very fundamental aspects of philosophy while including challenging readings and assignments. He's also very accessible via email.
Full of joy and whimsy. Everything is graded by TAs tho

the class is interesting and easy enough to digest. professor hoek makes it fun and he really is a capable and super smart person. whoever you get as your ta matters, as mine made recitation the best class I have had and they are the ones giving feedback on your assignments

Professor Hoek is a good lecturer and a kind person. The class is a combination of his lectures and TA-run recitations once a week. The homework assignments are easy and graded for completion. We didn't have exams, just short projects/papers. His material is engaging and he takes the time to go over topics until the class understands them.
The goat :pray emoji: :yawn emoji:

Cares a lot about his students and very reachable outside of class. Multiple times he would respond to my emails in less than 5 minutes. Dynamics is a hard class, and he doesn't necessarily make it easy. But if you do the homework and go to class you will be set.

It is 1-2 homeworks a week, with lectures consisting of mainly examples (some overlap with hw). His lectures are the best I have had at vt, his process and logic are thorough and he was able to answer every question presented concisely. Attend the review sessions for each exam. Difficult class but felt like I learned a lot. MCQ final.

He is a good professor who genuinely cares about his students. He provides helpful support with assignments and is flexible with his time. When many students didn't do well on the first test, he even offered an optional exam for 10 points of extra credit.

It is impossible to communicate anything with this professor. Often did not show up to office hours without notice, refused to answer any emails, no lecture notes, extremely fast passed, does not post lecture notes however the notes in class are extremely hard to read due to bad penmanship. Overall one of the worst professors I have had At VT.

His syllabus seems tough at the beginning of the semester but he doesnt really enforce some of the things he puts in. Office hours are TA operated but very good nonetheless. I dont think much studying is needed outside of class, the lectures are sufficient as long as you do the practice probs. But he didnt round my grade 0.5% for an A.. so 4 stars.

I hated this class and was barely getting by the entire semester, and then he curved the final and class grade crazy, and I went from a 69% to an 82% in the class. I would say take this class if you're feeling lucky and pray for a curve.

If you like a strict structured class, he is amazing! The class consisted of example problems from the textbook and the midterms were also from the textbook. He hates students being late to class and on their phones (he calls people out), but if you can get past that you always knew what to expect for exams. Holds review sessions for every exam!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He comes off as very strict the first few classes. The first day he said he would drop students if they skipped class, but he's pretty chill. The lectures are theory and a bunch of practice problems so its best not to miss them.

Pendar is great. Tests were fair and the final was easy. He gives review sessions before tests which are very helpful and his lectures help review the process for any question. It can be easy to get behind and the homework's are unforgiving if you don't know how to do a problem. But otherwise good class
Not perfect, but definitely cares about teaching. Makes the effort to improve his teaching style when things aren't working. Very transparent and gives review sessions for exams.

This professor should not be teaching. He does not respect the students time. His tests are very different from the homework he hands out, and are difficult. He will blame the students for performing poorly on tests.  If you look up the average grade, he tops the charts for most amount of F's in his courses. Avoid this professor at all cost.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Pendar is great. I learned a lot from him. He solves tons of sample problems in class and holds multiple review sessions before each test. Don't miss those. He is very serious about his job. If you enroll in Dynamics with him, expect rigorous work.

Pendar definitely has an interesting personality. He is tough and strict, but he is also fun and light hearted sometimes. If you are going to take a class with him, just be ready put in the work. As long as you do that, you will succeed in his class. I took both statics and dynamics with him. In my own opinion, I like him a lot.

Professor Pendar is undoubtedly one of the best professors at Virginia Tech. His lectures are exceptional, and he generously cares for his students. He actively engages with the class, solving many sample problems and encouraging students to participate. Holding extra online review sessions before each test was extremely helpful. He is GREAT.

Everybody that claims he is not that bad was not taking 17 credit hours. Expects you to dedicate hours of just practicing problems for "fun" with HW that are insanely difficult. Class average on the first test was a 40 and just simply blamed the students instead of acknowledging his failure as a teacher. Take Bolton if you can instead.

One of the greatest professors I've ever had at Virginia Tech. Extremely inspirational, and wants the students to succeed in his course. The Dynamics course is no joke, and you have to put in a lot of hours to understand the material. However, Pendar is one of the best to take the course with if you have the dedication Encourages great study habits

If you don't have a high grade for the first test it, isn't worth it. It is only going to get harder. You are better off waiting for a better professor (Roger Chang) or taking it over the summer at a community college.

Only cares about stroking his own ego.  Averages in the 60s. Has extra credit quizes worth nothing that are cherry picked to be impossible. Says everything is easy and obvious  Extremely dismissive and unhelpful. Assigns work over breaks due monday, wednesday, friday. Tough grader and says everyone is lazy. Will fail you if miss three classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly, this is the worst professor I have ever come across at Virginia Tech.  I used to think dynamics was extremely complex until I took it with a different professor. He consistently has test averages in the 50's and low 60's and refuses to curve. If you have this professor I pray for you, and if you have to take dynamics soon, get anyone else

Professor Pendar is one of the best profs in the ESM department. He is pretty strict in lecture, but he keeps everyone engaged. His lectures are mostly practice problems, and his exams have some questions taken out of his suggested practice problems. If you do all of the practice problems and go to office hours it should be pretty easy.

Many examples enhanced my learning. Despite his strictness, his engaging teaching style made it enjoyable. Exceptionally intelligent, he swiftly grasps how you think and identifies errors. He also curved the grades significantly at the end. Best professor I had at VT.

Professor Pendar is such an intelligent professor, however, he expects you to also maintain the knowledge that he's had for 30 years. He expects you to spend over 10 hours a day doing Dynamics, and quote "cut 2-3 hours out of your sleep schedule every day, so you can study more dynamics." The tests are graded harshly.

I thought Pendar was a really good statics professor. Many practice problems were done in class which helped develop a deeper understanding of the material. He was more strict at the beginning of the year but eventually became more relaxed. I found his teaching helpful and informative and I always felt prepared for homework assignments and exams.

This professor made a difficult class so much harder. There's tough homework assignments due every single class and lectures consist entirely of solving problems and he almost never teaches any concepts. When students inevitably do poorly on tests he blames us and tells us that we need to study more. As such this class is the bane of many students.
real funny dude and a pretty good guy all around but is evil when it comes to grading and he runs his classes far ahead of any of the other profs teaching the same class and makes his tests harder.

He's the finest professor I've had during my time at VT. His intellect and competence are truly remarkable. Nonetheless, he maintains a rigorous approach to his classes, and if you want an A, diligent effort, completion of all assignments, and attendance at office hours are essential. I appreciated the additional review sessions held before exams.

Dr. Pendar was a great teacher that cared about his students. Show up to class and the review sessions. The test questions are taken from his recommended practice, so complete it if you want to succeed! His office hours are also super helpful.

I had Dr Pendar for both Statics and Dynamics and currently I have Mechanics of Animal Locomotion with him. He is the best. You have to work hard in his classes, but at the end it is rewarding. He held lots of review sessions and office hours, and he was always willing to go through problems I was stuck on. I appreciated his willingness to help

Professor Pendar was very open to questions and made it a safe environment to learn without allowing people to mess around in class. Made it clear that he wanted us to succeed. He has an example based teaching style, where instead of doing regular notes. The review sessions before the tests were great.

Dr. Pendar would sometimes explain concepts very well, other times I was left a little confused. The homeworks are VERY time consuming and oftentimes quite difficult. Tests and final were slightly easier than homework problems but certainly required preparation to do well. Overall, Dr. Pendar did a good job at teaching a notoriously hard class.
Hard tests. Count as 80% of grade. Calls on students randomly to answer questions when no one participates, doesn't help anyone learn by doing that. Expects statics to be your life.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Had him online due to Corona, so all of his lectures were prerecorded and posted on YouTube. Personally it was hard to stay focused and watch over 100 lecture videos and would have preferred a live lecture. That being said, his lectures were informative and he gave lots of examples, but doesnt always work them out fully to the answer.

ESM2304 - Tests are prettymuch the practice problems he recommends prior to the test. DO ALL OF THEM to do well on tests. Lots of Wiley hw. Pop quizzes every 2-3 Fridays ROUGHLY. You gotta sit in the 1st 2 rows to hear anything he says (in NCB260). I had a B+ going into the final but the final was v hard cuz Corona so I got a 2/12 on final so a D+
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Pendar method of solving problems and the number of solved examples in class were really good. He was very funny and was able to get the class involved. He also made a lot of youtube videos after classes switched to online.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Statics requires you to learn to evaluate problems from different angles and think critically, and that cannot be taught in a lecture. You NEED to practice. That being said, Dr. Pendar does a really good job of explaining concepts and doing a variety of examples that cover what you need to know. Also, he gives a lot of partial credit.

My perfect learning style with no technology and all on paper. Worked great. I found his lectures very clear to understand. He was good at answering questions and presenting the material in different ways so that everyone could understand. Even though statics was sometimes confusing, I always got clear answers to my questions. Online class was okay
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Pendar explained the problems as he went through them. He made sure there were no questions and if there were, he made sure to answer them until we fully understood. Very clear teaching style. It helped me understand the material on a deeper level. Very good at explaining ideas and concepts. the optional practice problems before exams were helpful

Exams were from wiley but statics is just very hard and professor Pendar has high expectations from incoming students. He loves calling out students during class to participate in a problem and only solved 3/4 problems per class (cause we all need time to think about the problem). Did not learn a lot from him, also he gives a ton of hw in wiley.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I had Pendar for statics and dynamics and he is not a good teacher. He puts practice problems on the board and makes you do them without teaching anything. I had to teach myself practically everything. He also uses Wiley plus a lot which sucks, and is horrible with due dates. He assigns things before teaching them and then changes them last minute.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Overall, he's a great professor. His tests are tough, but fair and he picks them from a list of practice problems that he assigns you to study. He gives tons of partial credit on his tests and even curved our final grades by 4 points. I would give him 5 stars but the way he taught 3D equilibrium was very confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Clearly knows his stuff and at times is a decent lecturer, however this course is fundamentally flawed and if you dont know how to code beforehand you have to self teach yourself. Attendence is manditory ad the lectures are allmost pointless to attend.

If you know how to code beforehand, the class is incredibly tedious and frustrating. If you don't, the class is nearly impossible to pass. The lectures are difficult to follow unless you have that intuition going in, and a lot of the assignment requirements feel AI generated. Do yourself a favor and teach yourself C++ before taking this class.
Lectures were pointless, you have to self-teach yourself most for ECE 2514
Exams and assignments are pretty straightforward, if you know people who can always help you when needed. Overall he is a must take!

The course is already set up to where the work is the same for all students. The only difference is in lecture style between the professors. Professor Hsaio provided good similes to understand the CS topics. He does crack some dad jokes in the beginning of the year. I'd only make sure that you are locked for the midterms. Assignments aren't bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Currently taking his class (ECE 2514) and he is by far the most eloquent professor of the three, with engaging lectures and supplemental material outside of slideshows. Makes an effort to remember participating students' names and respects class time. Describes concepts with relevant analogies and precisely explains reasoning behind coding process.

Hsiao is a good professor and he explains the topics well in his lectures (there are quizzes in this course after every lecture). He is not as familiar with course changes since he is not the course director, so structure changes were hard to follow. In this class, the TAs are the people that you interact with the most when you need help.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He is very good in the material he teaches. Says corny jokes but is thorough in the lectures. Good professor!

He was a great professor.  Told corny jokes that most people didn't even chuckle at but he's at least trying to be entertaining.  He's a great lecturer on the material and brilliant and has been helpful in office hours.  Projects aren't too tough and homework isn't bad either.

He tells awful jokes to try to lighten the mood, but he is really smart so he doesn't understand when students can't grasp difficult concepts that he finds easy. Also if you can't submit the quizzes to scholar because scholar won't load it's your fault and he won't listen to you.

Her heart is in the right place, but I feel she needs to take a class on humility and how to be a professor. The material was hard, but the teaching was more challenging. Be prepared for attendance, and don't try any excuse. If your parents died in a crash and you missed class, she would not care. She would mark you as absent.

The only reason I did well in this class is because I took APs in high school that relate to content in this class. Her lectures are very boring. She reads directly off of slides and sometimes it seems like she doesn't know what she is talking about.
Is what you'd expect from a class like this. No crazy complaints.

I thought she was a fine professor. Attendance is mandatory and there are dozens of participation quizzes. She reads right off the slides so after the second week I just stopped listening in class and taught myself off the slides. And even then her slides were basically useless. I taught myself almost everything off the internet.

Dr.Hsu is really not the best teacher Her slides were unorganized and hard to follow and she lecture directly from the slides She grades attendance and has open book quizzes that saved me Not accessible outside the class and very difficult to work with If you can get another professor besides her do it Would drop this major before having her again

By far my favorite professor. She is so sweet and caring, and the content is not hard at all if you pay attention in class. Allowed cheat sheets on quizzes and exams. Quizzes were not hard, but midterm was harder. I would take Professor Huang for every class if possible, she's awesome. Highly recommend.
She is very nice, and just wants you to learn Tax. She gives a very generous curve on both her exams.

I got scared by her other reviews, but she's great. She allows one cheat sheet per quiz and exam, which is really helpful for reviewing the material. She also curves the exams exponentially, so the worse you do, the higher your curve is because she "wants you to enjoy tax". She's very passionate about tax and cares about how you do.
I would not take her again. EVER

Awful. very sweet as a person but sucks at teaching. There's a quiz for every chapter, 2 exams, 1 final project. Thought this class would be an easy A since its open notes but I can't even use the notes to solve quiz questions bc they're so tricky, she assumes we know everything about tax. Take it with somebody else if you can.
hes the Goat for themo, tough final tho
I had him for ME 2134, not 3304. Fantastic professor who cares about his students. Lots of homework but they help you prepare for the tests.

His lectures were very clear and helped with his weekly quizzes. Although a homework assignment was given after every class, they definitely helped towards understanding the material taught. The tests and final however can be very tricky, especially the multiple choice portions.

In class lectures are well put together and cover all topics relevant to homework quizzes and tests. There is homework after every class but it is typically 2-3 short problems and helps you stay on top of the class. Weekly quizzes are pretty easy but require a small amount of preparation. Biggest complaint is you don't get a formula sheet.

Hes a super good prof and a really nice guy. There is 2-3 hw problems that you have to do after every class which gets old but it helps me actually understand the material so I dont mind too much. Quizzes are kinda hard because you have to memorize stupid equations but hes an easy grader so its fine, although I would appreciate an eqn sheet.

He is overall a pretty good teacher, but his grading methods make getting a good grade nearly impossible. Has weekly quizzes that destroy your grade if you make one mistake since they're typically 2-3 problems (miss anything and you get a 50-66%). I fully understand our material yet I'm struggling for a B- solely because of the quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: best professor i've had here. genuinely cares about his students and has great lectures. makes class interesting and easy if you show up and pay attention.
Great guy and was very easy to learn from. The course itself does not have any grades besides exams unless you put in work for extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: such an amazing professor to listen to, although can be boring at times lowkey just push through. if you go to class you will be fine, however they do post the powerpoints on canvas, but not everything they go over is on the slides. theres 5 test, lowest gets dropped and 10 potential extra credit points

I loved this professor. Class was 5 tests total, one gets dropped. Lots of extra credit opportunity (up to 10 points). Tests were straightforward and easy if you study enough. Lecture was interesting and funny. Such a great class, I recommend it to anyone. Its nothing to be scared off!!

Super nice guy and always willing to talk with students. Class was somewhat difficult for me personally, but in general not that bad as long as you pay attention. There are no grades other than tests so you have to lock in for them.

He is such an interesting lecturer! No assignments. Your grade is entirely from 4 exams and the final. Your lowest exam grade gets dropped, including the final. Extra credit is offered. TAs also host many study sessions for each exam which is helpful.

Best professor I've had so far. His lectures are very thought out and he is an amazing teacher. He tells you what in the lecture will be on the exam. Notes are easy to take. Overall just a great guy. My advice is to take notes on google doc of what he says (even that's not on the slides) because sometimes he will use it on a quiz. Classes are long

Dr. Hoffman genuinely cares about his students. His lectures are easy to understand and he is often able to make the material unforgettable in class with his funny analogies and social experiments. The tests are heavily based on in-class content, so make sure to go to class. He also offers various forms of extra credit which is nice.

Hoffman was amazing during my freshman year. I'm taking another class with him next semester and can't wait because he was that good. Professor Cookie Pants will always have a special place in my heart
Awesome professor with engaging lectures that are directly related to the tests. Attend class, write notes, and study for the exams and you will have an easy A and more knowledge on psych!
He is a good professor. Show up to class. He is very helpful and knowledgeable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hoffman was an absolutely teacher and I would 100% recommend him to literally anyone whether you like psychology or not.  I will forever sing his praises because the atmosphere he treats is just so wonderful and not intimidating at all.

Very interesting professor, though sometimes the lectures do seem to drag on (not his fault). He cares about his students and his lectures are almost directly taken from the exam. Take good notes, pay attention in class (something I wish I did more of), and the class will be much simpler. The class is graded on four exams and EC, so pay attention
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is nice, and his lectures are easy to learn from. The only grades for this class are the exams, so you need to study. The material is mostly from his in-person lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super nice guy who cares about what we learn, open to questions and explains things very well. Big lecture class. Exams based mostly on in person lectures. Was able to skim textbook and notes night before the tests and score pretty well for how little I studied.

prof hoffman was super super nice. his notes were clear and he explained everything thoroughly. you can obviously tell he's a kind and caring person, super accessible if needed. people hate his happy personality too much

Dr. Hoffman was a good Professor. His lectures are straightforward. Grade is based on only four exams. Two of them will be on material that he teaches. He makes study guides before the exams definitely study them. I recommend making Quizlets based on them. If you go to lectures, study the study guide, and do the extra credit you should do well.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hoffman is a great professor, I wish he taught the whole course. The only reason I finished with an A was because I got 100's on both his exams, then was able to worse on Geller's. I advice you to take his portion of the class seriously so you don't have to deal with Geller (I skipped almost every geller lecture).
Genuinely great at teaching
Dr. Hoffman was a great teacher, I just wish he taught the whole semester. He had notes on the slides and explained them super well. Was willing to answer questions whenever.
I loved his teaching style. He was chill and always asked if anyone had questions. wish he taught the whole course. gives out study guides too

He's a super nice and chill guy. All info you need is on lecture slides, some is in textbooks but isn't too much to read. He does class discussions that only people in class get the info on, so attending class is important but not mandatory. No homework, no assignments, only tests for the course grades with extra credit.

Really great guy. Exams are all multiple choice and ridiculously easy. As long as you pay attention in class you should be able to get an A. Just look at the study guide before the exam, if there's a topic you don't recognize that means he's pulling it from the textbook. He has office hours and is ready to explain something to you if you needs it.
Hes super chill and funny. He always mentions how we loves his wife and just got married. His tests are also relatively easy  using material from his lecture notes.
Dr. Hoffman is incredibly caring. Although the class is gigantic, he makes communication feel open and personal. His lectures are interesting and not hard to follow.

Engaging lectures, presents material in a very manageable way. Tests are of a reasonable difficulty. 90%+ of material on the exams is presented via in-class lecture slides. The rest its found in the textbook, but very little reading is required to be successful.

I LOVED prof Hoffman!! He was engaging and you can tell he cares about what he teaches. The class is only graded by 4 exams and extra credit, but if you go to class, take notes, and study, the tests are easy. He provides a review sheet before exams that is super helpful. All test ? come from lectures or specific book sections he tells you to read.

reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hoffman's exams are very lecture based, and as long as you take basic notes on his slides, you will do fine on them. He has a great sense of humor and likes to break the monotony of his classes with micro conversations on his experiences in research or his new wife. Attendance is a must since he only posts complete slides at his lectures.

He was a super nice, genuine, and chill guy. Thought the content was relatively easy and he also makes it easy to follow along if you're ever stuck. The course only has tests with no assignments, and it is really important to attend lectures because most content comes from them.
Interesting class. Professor Hoffman is very caring. Four 50 multiple-choice exams are the only things graded.
He's amazing, his class would make me smile. He loves his wife!! His tests match his lectures.

Dr. Hoffman is a great professor, down to earth and respectable. His lectures were fairly easy to follow - this coming from someone who had never taken a psychology class before. The class is all lecture and note taking, exams being the only grades. A little effort and you should be able to pass the class. I'd say it's mainly memorizing.

Dr. Hoffman was a great professor for the first half of the semester. However all the information is from the slides and alot of the slides are blank and filled in during class lectures so going to class is important. Also the entire grade is based on 4 tests and some extra credit but memorizing is really important
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Didn't know what love languages were, but chill class.

Amazing professor and super interesting content! Would always take time to answer questions after class and definitely cares about his students. Class is fully exam based so I highly recommend doing the extra credit studies early on in case none are available when you need them!

Dr. Hoffman was great! This class consisted of 3 exams (non cumulative) and a final project. Exams weren't too hard but did include free response questions which sound more daunting than they are. He doesn't give study guides but holds a class to ask questions about test content which was super helpful. Textbook is optional but can be helpful.

Really amazing professor!!!! I had him for the first half of the semester and my grade was great! He is very clear about what will be on the exams and has great lectures! Definitely take him if you want to learn a lot and do well in the class!! Could not recommend more!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: LOVE LOVE LOVE, nothing but good things. He is such a good professor and would take him every semester if I could.

Kurt Hoffman was the best professor! His slides are lengthy but great for review. Memorization is key to the application-heavy-exams and the only grades are the 4 exams. Super caring man, wants to get to know and help his students and integrates personal stories that are relevant to the course. Love this man, would 100% take his course again!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He lectures are probably the only lectures on this campus that I was always engaged in. He gives great feedback and if you go to office hours and study you should have no problems.

Had Prof Hoffman for my first year psych class. He was very sweet and always helped with any questions. The only thing I would say is go to class because I always got something useful out of each one. There were guest speakers on occasion and it was helpful in learning different skills and tips on how to adjust to new college challenges.

this was just a pathways class so there wasnt really a lot of work. probably very helpful if you don't really know what you're doing in college with classes and stuff as well as career wise. a good intro to psyc

I loved Professor Hoffman! Super caring and sweet guy! His lectures were content-heavy but also long as you pay attention and review it, you should be fine on the exam. He's a professor that actually cares about his students and how well they're doing.

For Intro to Pysch, I loved Professor Hoffman's teaching style. His lectures were content-heavy but were just a review of the textbook so you can get away with not reading the textbook as long as you pay attention in class. Just know that PSYC 1004 has no homework or classwork grades, only tests of which there are 4 so make sure to study enough.

Great course. You need to go to lectures to do well on the exams but honestly they were fun and interesting to listen to. I skipped class for one whole unit but I still got an 80 by studying the review guide with ChatGPT and going to the TA's review sessions online.
The only grades are based on tests. He posts his slides before each class but he excludes some information from the slides to show during class.

Literally the sweetest professor ever. He cares so much about his students and wants everyone to succeed. His tests were straightforward for me because his lectures were really good. He was absolutely amazing.

Class was a little bit boring at times but overall just a really great guy. The only thing I didn't like is how the tests are the only part of the grade but he does give out extra credit opportunities.
Dr. Hoffman was clear about what will and wont be on tests, his lectures were mostly interesting and easy to take notes on. No complaints
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love him. Lectures very interesting. Man has an amazing life story too. Love him.

Great professor, taken many classes from him for psychology. tests are based on lectures almost word for word at times so watch them and youll get an easy A. interesting material always and very clear, great prof.

Had him for the first half of psych1004(2nd half was dr. scott geller). Kurt is really cool and is a very conversational lecturer. Grading is based on just four NONCUMULATIVE tests, but everything is in his lecture powerpoints and he tells you what in the book that he doesn't cover in class will be on the tests. Highly recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A good professor, a little boring and hard to engage with. Tests were clear, HEAVY memorization of textbook and lecture slides
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I love Hoffman. He was probably my favorite professor this semester. He is lecture heavy. You need to go to class in order to do good. He does reference some things from the textbook in the exams. His exams are mainly factual unlike Geller where his are mainly application.
great teacher, all the lectures are online so you don't even have to go to class, but he gives great lectures so i reccommend going anyways

Awesome Professor!! Tough class, due to the only grades you have come from the 4 exams you take. However, Dr. Hoffman made this class awesome and easy. Not to mention, very inspiring guy due to physical issues.

This professor is very easy to follow. He stops for any questions students may have and is dedicated to find an answer. He is very enthusiastic about psychology which creates a conducive learning experience. I suggest sitting closer to the front as he can be quiet sometimes. Great teacher!

Has great lectures and shows his interest for the material and makes it interesting for us. However, be careful there are only 4 exams that basically are your entire grade so screw one up and your done.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hoffman was amazing! His lectures were super interesting and he clearly cares about psychology! Exams were pretty straight forwards as long as you come to class and study the PowerPoints.
awesome dude, makes lecture engaging and clearly cares abt what he is teaching

Prof Hoffman is an great teacher and person. He discusses everything on the tests during class, and provides detailed notes and review sheets. As long as you pay attention in class and know the material on the review, you should get an A. Interesting lectures, and a truly inspirational professor.

Dr. Hoffman is truly an inspiration. He was born w/o both of his arms, & the way he does things is so impressive. I had him for the 1st half of the semester for intro to psych & never once used the book. This class is based on the 4 exam grades, so that can be good or bad. His lectures are so interesting, & you can tell he has such a kind heart.
awesome professor, obviously cares about what he is teaching, lectures are not boring at all, prepares you very well for tests, no assignments, only four tests

Professor Hoffman makes class engaging and intresting. If you attend class and study the lectures you'll do fine in the exams. About 80-90% of exam questions are taken from lecture slides given to you ahead of class!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Grade is only made up of 4 exams, but all material comes from lectures. Easy A if you come to class and take notes.
I found him very engaging! Showed a lot of personality in his lectures and was very funny. Made going to class so much better. Class is purely Exams but if you study slides you'll be fine
very very nice! truly cares about his students

Exams are 100% of your grade but the questions come directly from his power points and are very easy. No outside homework. Just show up, take notes, and study for the exams. If you miss class, you can get notes from the TA! (most of the notes are available on quizlet if you google Hoffman Introduction to Psychology)
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I would really recommend taking psychology of learning with this professor. His exams were extremely straightforward and the content was easy to grasp. There's a final paper and discussions here and there to boost your grade. Super nice guy

Dr. Hoffman is one of my favorite professors. I talked to him before switching to my Psychology major and his portion of PSYC 1004 was definitely my better half academically. He was always willing to zoom or chat over email about any questions relating to the material or psychology in general. Exam questions were straight from the notes. Great guy.

Professor Hoffman is a genuine soul, he actually provides feedback and is well-organised. His class consisted of weekly modules (2-3 lectures, 10-20 mins) which can sometimes get boring, but not the worse thing. Weekly discussion posts, 2 exams, 1 final (non-cumulative), optional quizzes, and 1 final project. Really nice guy.

Professor Hoffman is super detail-oriented, clear, and straightforward. Extremely funny, especially when he cries like a baby! Breaks all concepts down so a 5th grader could get it. Go to class, study hard, and you'll be fine.

Prof. Hoffman does a good job of breaking stuff down to an easily understood level. He's funny, and there were no surprises on his 50 multiple choice question tests. Intro Psychology is a relatively easy course, but he is a legitimately good professor.
Really understanding and genuine professor. Easy to talk to, understand, and just has a great attitude towards teaching -- would recommend for pretty much any psych class he teaches.
Really awesome guy. Lectures included test questions. If you go to class youll do good.
I loved him he was straightforward and tests weren't bad. Have a friend take the class with you.
Such an amazing professor! He is extremely nice and helpful.
He is an amazing teacher. He is not only helpful with questions related to class material, but any other questions he is more than willing to help with. He's so nice and funny during class.

Hoffman is amazing. He makes the scientific side of Psychology really interesting and explains things really well. If you study his powerpoints (which aren't difficult to understand or time-consuming) and the study guides, you'll get an A easily.

He knows his material. But I found his tests very difficult. Being that the class mainly based on tests, I found it very frustating when I would study for hours for his tests and only managed to get a C. I found his tests are the type of test where you think you did really well but then in actuality, you did average.
My favorite professor I have had since being at tech. He has the best sense of humor and teaches the material so well. He is so helpful and his tests are easy! Just go to class and you'll get an A.

Dr. Hoffman is amazing!  He's a great teacher and it makes you want to come to class.  He makes the material interesting and you want to learn more.  I had him for Intro. Psych...I advise you take this class!

Had him for Senior Seminar, Animal Behavior and Pysch of Learning.  Very fair Professor who is always willing to help understand the material.  The tests are not too difficult if you go to class and pay attention.  Makes the lectures more interesting than some others so I hear.  Overall he's the best to take for any class!
Real cool teacher.  Enjoy the time u have with him because if you have Geller, you'll see the difference.  Studying slides is all you need to ace his tests. I didnt even touch the book for him.
He is probably the best teacher at tech!! He is very helpful, understanding, and patient with his students.  One of the best class i have ever taken!

He is the most patient, understanding, helpful person I have ever come in contact with. I go to his office hours just to talk sometimes and he's totally cool about it. He's my advisor now and he always knows what he's doing, is willing to take his time to help you, and gives the best advice!!
One of the nicest teachers ever!! I recommend his class
Most of his lectures are very interesting.  Tests are very easy if you study the notes.  He's one of my favorite professors at Virginia Tech.  I highly recommend him.
Quite possibly my favorite professor at VT yet. He knew his stuff very well. Nobody should have a problem getting an A in this class if you're even somewhat committed.

Professor Hoffman is a very nice person that gives all the help you need for his class.  However, you won't need much help, because the material is very easy, and he posts everything you need to know online.
One of the best at Tech. Easy to relate to and funny.
The best teacher I have ever had.If you need a writing intensive, take his class.

I had the pleasure of taking 3 of Kurt's classes his first year at VT.  His extensive knowledge in psych, straight forward teaching style, kindness, and concern for his students made him my favorite professor. It was a privelege to be his student.
Wonderful individual, who is genuinely concerned about students doing well in his classes, and is passionate about his job; he takes it very seriously and I'm lucky to have had him as an instructor.
Go to his office hours; they are decent.

I took choice and behavior with mr chan. He is awesome in his office hours and his class is really ez. Tests are pretty ez too, just study the homework and practice tests. He also grades pretty easily. Ignore the other reviews, this guy is a good choice.

Goes by Tommy Chan. Lectures seem aimless and confusing more than anything, he often goes on tangents. Nice guy nonetheless, no ill intent and understanding. Assigned homework every two weeks, they aren't hard just get them done. He gives practice exams that are exactly like the actual exam. The final has the same exact questions but in one exam.

Really cares about students
gets really into tangents, and can be hard to follow; some people like this because he thoroughly covers topics: had trouble learning in his class/teaching style
really likes his allusions and life lessons: no drinking before exams, no top of the stairs, etc.
memorable, inspirational, and enjoyed having as professor
Great professor. I'd say the only real issue you'll have with him is his thick accent, but its not bad once you get used to it.

Dr. Hudait is great. I will say though, make sure you don't make a stupid mistake anywhere on an exam, as sometimes you don't get any credit past that mistake which costed me close to 10% of my class grade. Overall, Hudait is by far the best at tech for physical electronics though. His lectures are always fun too.

Professor Hudait is so funny and I enjoyed attending his lectures. He covers the material thoroughly and well, and you can tell he cares about helping us succeed. My only critique is that his lectures were hard to follow sometimes, but that could have just been because of the material. He is definitely the best professor for this class!

Hudait is a hilarious guy, but I had no idea what was going on in the class most of the time. This maybe have been the fault of the ECE 2214 curriculum and not his teaching style. He does genuinely care about the students and about teaching. His class had the highest average (by far) of all professors teaching ECE 2214 the semester I took it.
Dr. Hudait's class helped me find a job in semiconductor industry.
Dr. Hudait is easily one of best teachers at Tech. So inspirational, amazing, and well respected. Take his class and you won't be disappointed.

Professor Hudait is a great professor. He made MOSFETS easy to understand and taught us tricks to make it easier. He really cares about his students and will help them with any questions they have. He often talks about his time at Intel which is very interesting. He is the best possible ECE 2214 professor, take him at all costs.

I'm fortunate enough to have Hudait for both physical electronics and semi-conductor device foundations. He raised my understanding of micro-electronics to a deeper level and gave me sufficient assistant in studying and preparing for exams. Hudait is just the best on both teaching and grading, he gives at least a B for submitting everything.

Prof. Hudait is one of few profs who's passionate about teaching and one of few profs who understand the industry. He explains how and why concepts are important instead of just reading them out during lectures. His lectures are clear and easy to understand and would like to help you with any questions you have during office hours.

Dr. Hudait is one of the best professors u can get for any microelectronics class. He does care about if you understand the lecture and will help you with homework assignments in detail and giving tips on preparing for exams during office hours. He curves the grade a lot because he doesn't want to fail anyone and want most people to get A/A-.

He was a good teacher and. No homework, other than a short reading at the end of the unit with in class discussion. Attendance not mandatory but has an occasional in class question assignment at random thats 5 points, that I would recommend showing up for, easy points.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Moore is a really chill guy. 4/5 not because he did anything wrong, but just because I don't have anything really notable to say. It wasn't hard to study the material for tests since there's no textbook, which I really appreciated. Fun class.

Would definitely recommend taking biology of sex. Dr Moore is a fun and chill guy and teaches such a taboo topic in a fun and engaging way. No homework other than the occasional reading for a group discussion. Quizzes can be tricky but easy to study for with practice quizzes offered beforehand. You'll definitely learn something new in this class.

I loved Dr. Moore as a teacher and a person. He was really good at teaching specifically Biology of Sex because he took a taboo subject and made it not weird. His quizzes are fairly easy if you study and most Fridays are reserved for discussion papers that he gives you to read. You answer a question and you're good. Usually wraps class up early.

Moore is one of my all time favorite teachers I have taken at Virginia Tech. He is a very funny person and wants you to do well. His exams can be slightly tricky, however, if you come to class and take notes you will do fine. This is my second class with him and all of his notes are easy to understand and study.

Overall a really cool guy. In order to teach a class like Biology of Sex, you need to have a sense of humor, which he does. His lectures are very easy and he usually wraps up class 15 minutes early. If you study for the quizzes you'll get high grades. Very easy and entertaining course.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures are super engaging and fun to go to. Most of the time we ended class early which was really nice. Tests are hard though and knowing the vocabulary is very important. You don't need a textbook for this class and if you study the lectures and go to class you will pass. Definitely take this professor he is great!

He's a very chill and funny professor, answers any questions you may have, good lectures. I think it's important to go to lectures because of quizzes and most likely will get a good grade on the quizzes. He only has 6 quizzes all mc and one final exam at the end.
