reviews.comment: Avoid at all costs. He uses slideshows and just grazes over the material, rather than actually working through problems in a problem heavy class. If you ask a question prepare to be chastised for not knowing how to do everything. He expects everyone to know everything, despite poor teaching methods.

Yunyi isn't a terrible teacher. His lectures are very fast passed and it's really hard to wright it all down and understand him at the same time. He does not give a lot of homework and he grades somewhat sparingly. He can be mean at times. For instance WHILE we were taking an exam he told the whole class that he was disappointed in all of us.

Had him for multivar and linear bc I liked him. You have to concentrate to understand him but honestly you get just as much from his notes. Tests were easier than the homework and very true to the textbook so I always felt overprepared but the textbook is a study necessity. He even bumped my grade from a B+ to an A without me asking for some reason

a teacher not good at teaching. His lectures consist of students rigorously trying to copy down his notes while he goes over them super quick. Tests are fair and his test review is really helpful. Not very respectful to students. There are a ton of math teachers, just skip this guy.

Took linear algebra with Dr. Shen and it was pretty tough. All of his lectures are annotations from the textbook, which is helpful in the sense that you get a lot of notes, but you don't get a lot of visualization. So many students started skipping that he took off a point on the next test for every class you missed over two weeks. Pretty mediocre.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Shen is the most cold hearted professor Ive ever had. If you ask a question in class and if youre wrong no matter how close you are, he will make you feel like a nuisance for even asking. If you need an extension due to an emergency, wont let you make it up. Barely goes over questions in class and speaks quietly and too quick. Do not!

Avoid Shen like the plague. Shen is awful; instead of actually answering your questions he will crack an insulting joke and then not try to help you, but tell you we already did that and that you need to review notes, or tell you we dont need to know it. His office hours are useless. We are almost to thanksgiving and not a single HW is graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Shen made sure we understood the material (harshly graded HW and detailed notes) and made sure we didn't make minor mistakes which is why he would discuss the mistakes made by students. I have a pretty good foundation in math because of him. If you use the textbook and do the HW problems and WebAssigns honestly, you should be fine.

An okay lecturer with an accent that isn't too hard to understand. However, all his explanations and practice problems come straight from the textbook. Weekly homework isn't too much work. Can be funny sometimes but the class is really boring. 1225 is just a hard class regardless of who you have and you have to study a lot so good luck.

I think Dr. Shen may be the worst teacher or professor Ive had. Spends more time making fun of students wrong answers than actual teaching. He basically discourages asking any sort of questions because he will not hesitate to make you sound and feel stupid. What little teaching he does consists of writing examples on the board the whole time.
No words for how bad this professor is.
Gives unclear directions for projects. The lectures are pretty boring, but she really knows what she's talking about. A lot of work for a 2 credit class. Very strict about drawing techniques.

Paola is a great lecturer-- her material in "Art of Building" was interesting and inspiring, but she assigned far too much work for a 2-credit course. Practice sketching quickly before you have her, because she doesn't give nearly enough time for drawings that are supposed to be done in class.
Best Studio Teacher I've had at Tech. Very insightful teaching that makes you think in a different but good way. Would definitely recommend for Studio.

Managed to make a 2-credit "Art of Building" class feel more overwhelming than any of my 3-credit courses, drowning us in endless busywork. To top it off, she would send emails about showing up to her painfully dull 8 a.m. lectures, as if dragging ourselves out of bed to hear her monotone was the ultimate preparation for "the real world"
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Horribly rude, controlling, and disrespectful. Plays favorites - if she doesn't like you for whatever reason, you'll get a bad grade regardless of how good your work is. Students with bad work who barely tried got As just because she liked them. Hated by pretty much every student in the SoA.

She made 2 credit hour class art of building so much harder than my 3 credit hour classes. So much busy work. She also wrote pretentious emails about showing up to her super boring 8 am lectures because "in the real world as an architect you have to show up to work at 8 am"
loved the class

Mo is a super chill guy. He gave MANY extra credit opportunities and was pretty animated during classes. All tests were open note so I honestly didn't learn much but still got a good grade. Sometimes he went off on unnecessary and class-unrelated tangents which is why I didn't rate him super high. I'd still recommend him overall

Absolutely the best professor I've had the privilege of having! He teaches in a lecture style, but keeps it engaging, interesting, and most importantly, understandable. His assignments actually help you to better understand the coursework, and he often gives little extra credit questions in class to encourage showing up and participating.

Mo, as he likes to be called, knows what he's talking about (and if he doesn't he'll say so). His classes are engaging but be prepared to take fast notes on a lot of slides. Workload is pretty light but assignments are actually engaging. All you need is a pen and paper, and a computer for this class.

also he's pretty funny and down to earth.

Mo is AMAZING. He is probably the best professor I've ever had, and an even better person. The class is super easy, and all exams are open book. The class is a walk in the park if you take decent notes and keep on top of the homeworks. He really cares about students and takes feedback into consideration:) Definitely reccomend!

Mo is a great professor and an even greater person. He gives great feedback on all the writing assignments due and wants you to do good. The current class structure is based on 4 exams which are all open note and a 4-7 page research paper which is worked on for the last month of the class.

Hands down one of the best professors I have ever had. so down to earth and sweet and he genuinely cares about teaching his students. He will literally end class early if he feels most students are tired and overworked. He gives extensions on pretty much everything if you ask for it. EXTREMELY lenient professor. Can't say enough good things!

Mo is one of the best professors I've had at Virginia Tech. He's very understanding and knows how boring this class can be yet tries to make it as interesting as possible by cracking jokes and trying to keep his students engaged. His exams are open notes and he offers many assignments to bring your grade up.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Engaging professor and is accessible for help. Quizzes are attendance-based and are open-notes, open-book, typically based on lectures or homework problems. Clear grading criteria, but may be stressful as grades is based on a 100-point system, with bulk of them being from your tests and quizzes. Mistakes made on quizzes are hard to recover from.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Attendance was measured based on quiz you take in class which is disappointing annoying because you might not to score the quiz which would be like if I stayed in bed and didn't show up. no compassion couple students came to him after class because they had the wrong answer attendance quiz accidentally and he was like I'm sorry that happened

Highly highly highly recommend taking this class with Bowden! This is my second time taking this class and he made the content easier to understand. Yes, the classes are earlier in the morning than other classes but I highly recommend it. He responds to emails quickly. There are attendance quizzes every class but he only counts up to 20.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures can get boring (since it is math) but he does a great job at keeping your attention and explaining the material. Takes attendance via a 1 question quiz at the end of class. Homework is not graded but necessary to learn the material. Tests make up a majority of the grade but are open note. Do the homework, ask Q's and you'll do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Read so many good things about him but overall his class was meh. In most cases you have to keep doing extra book questions just to understand what you're supposed to do. He helps with the HW but I wouldn't retake this class with him.

Professor Bowden is one of the nicest professors I have met during my time here at VT. I took this course for a 2nd time, and would have done well if I had Prof Bowden the 1st time around. He is super easy going and always willing to help. Overall, I definitely recommend this class with him!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a great teacher and the workload was manageable. Exams were taken online at home and open note

Optional homework and optional class attendance. Doing the homework is important, however, as the test is heavily based on the problems he assigns. Very forgiving grading scale (no B-'s or A-'s). Best math teacher I've ever had in terms of explaining things clearly. Highly recommend.

Professor Bowden is always really energetic and excited to teach the class. His lectures are easy to follow. Homework and attendance are optional but recommended, and homework answers are posted on canvas. He has daily quizzes usually each class but they are super easy. He is accommodating and always available. He's a really good professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Bowden is a very generous professor and offered lots of extra credit opportunities. Watch the lectures, pay attention and follow the work, and do the homework problems in the textbook and you're solid to get a good grade on the exam. The class is based on a 100 points, and you only need a 90 to get an A and he offers the chance to get 105 points.

Professor Bowden's exams are fairly difficult and the homework was very essential to passing. He is very open to helping and is a good professor and knows his stuff. I would recommend him for this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Bowden was good at teaching, but I pretty much learned this class from the textbook. If you ask him a question he will just tell you to rewatch the lectures or read the textbook. A solid choice, but this class was very hard. However, I think this class was easier than BIT 2405.

He has quizzes that are just if you watch lectures and hw. Dont need book really but he says you should get it. Tests arent bad if you know how do hw and hes a nice guy and tries to help in what ever way he can .

Great Teacher, all his quizzes are from the homework. Takes his time to make sure everyone understands and office hours are basically homework time with him. Tests aren't terrible pretty straight forward and doesn't really have any trick questions.

Zeb is amazing. He will go out of his way to make sure you understand something if you are unsure. The material is v dry and I had to take it at 8am with some difficult classes directly after it so I just wasn't able to put much time into it. He came through at the end and automatically siced me with a full B even though I get a 79 in the course.

STAY AWAY!! The worst professor/class of my entire MBA. I honestly loathed this class. We are done with finals and half of our entire grade is still not in Web courses. This class has caused me so much unnecessary stress.

This class traumatized me. I had an issue with 1 assignment & she made me cry in her office. After that I didnt feel confident to participate. 1. make sure to finely comb through the instructions for assignments. 2 Very harsh grader. I had an A all semester & then 2 days before the semester is over I ended up with a C & failed out of my major.

Everything is assigned for you so don't expect to sit with your friends or work in group projects with them. There are no exams or final but the class is not easy so be prepared to work. She teaches everything step by step, but the info taught is very useful in your career. PARTICIPATION IS A MUST!!! you wont know the feedback until the end, sucks!

Greatest marketing professor I've had at Tech! She makes learning fun, interactive, and it's not a hard class. Posts on here are outdated. Seriously take her for Strategic Marketing. You have no exams, just 8 short online quizzes, and participation is easy and doable. You won't regret taking her class!

The worse teacher EVER. Class is unrealistically difficult and she thinks she is a know it all. This may have been the worse teacher I have ever had during my educational career. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!!!!

Valuable lecture time was spent discussing quantum mechanics and his research. He told us not to come to his office unless we wanted to hear about his research or talk about career stuff. Virtually all help that I received was from his GTA, who was absolutely fantastic (shoutout to my man Mehrzad). He brought candy to class a lot, which was cool.
He is hilarious and also very nice. He would regularly push back due dates when we had a lot of assignments, which was often.

Dr. Zhou is a fair pro who explains things clearly during lectures, but his lecture reflects his lack of experience in teaching. The lecture contents are a little hard to understand since they are copied from the textbook w/o simplification, and didn't show connections to the industry. Still good to take him but there's a better pro at VT for 2214.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I managed to get through the class with minimal effort - as long as you reference the actual articles she assigns when doing homework you should be fine. Refreshingly organized classes with thorough review lectures and good class discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Every week followed the same schedule. Very consistent.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Ni is so much fun! She teaches about religion in a way that is new and makes you think (including how robots and religion connect). Class is reading heavy and you have an assignment after almost every class but this is not hard to do especially since she gives you free skips and a class discussion before the assignment is due.

Overall, the study guides for the class are easy if you put in the time for the readings. However, her quizzes are literally impossible because she makes them extremely specific for a quiz that covers several readings that are each 20-30 pages long. She is also very critical during class if you don't know the answer to a question.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof NI is so nice!!! Easy A and an enjoyable class.
Kind of difficult to understand, but ultimately will teach all course material necessary, and will provide all the resources needed to succeed in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Extra credit on exams and homework. There is even a bonus homework that helps (gives around 3.5). The teacher can be difficult to understand, though. I would suggest attending class, or leaving it on in the background if you can. The content involves probabilities like poisson and binomial.

Actual class is not that bad if you avoid going to class. Not to be mean but her accent is so thick you can't understand what she is saying and her handwriting is also just as bad so you can't read what she is writing either. Best thing is to skip class and let ChatGPT teach you using the lecture slides and just show up on test day.

I didn't have a choice of professor for the class that I took this semester, but if you do definitely avoid Professor Zhang. Nothing against her personally but she is just not a good professor. She does not present the subject matter in a logical way and her grading makes no sense and canvas is never accurate. #FadeThat
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor has an extremely thick accent and it's better to look at the slides as she goes through them word for word slowly

Class is so free. She has a thick accent but you don't need to go to class, esp if u took AP stats. It's just the first half with more math. Homework, exams chill. Posts practice exams with key. Decent notes. Very clear on what is on exams. oh yeah you get cheat sheets too. Extra credit q's on exams. Bonus hw coding in R for 3.5%. Def take for cs.

She can barely speak English, I don't understand a word that she says unless I pay attention to every single word she says. It is like listening to a robot. Her grading is also not straightforward; she takes weeks to reply to an email and does not respond quickly.

I didn't even bother watching recorded lectures due to her accent, I just read through the slides. For the online section she used the meeting times as office hours so we didn't actually have any synchronous class. Easy A and homeworks aren't given too often--if you need a CS Stat elective, I'd use this class (the online version if possible).
I had to reschedule my final and she gave me the wrong one without telling me then asked if I could stay another 2 hours to take another final exam

Dr. Zhang's thick accent makes understanding her recorded lectures pointless. You will be required to learn the material on your own. That being said, doing so is not that difficult, and a basic understanding will get you through this course with no problem. Plenty of opportunity for extra credit as well.

If you're familiar with statistics, this class will be fine. If you aren't, don't let her class be your first time. She is nearly impossible to understand even if you're reading the words that she's saying (extremely heavy accent). Her slides are somewhat helpful and the homework isn't hard, but trying to take notes as she's talking is impossible.

She is basically impossible to understand which makes even the simplest concepts a nightmare to learn. It's so bad, she really does not teach at this point, it will be a self-taught class. Don't ever take this class online either, as all she does is provide links to previously recorded lectures from 2020 which are even harder to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is incredibly difficult to understand. Her accent makes learning in class nearly impossible, as well as her refusal to answer student's questions during class. If you have any other options for professors, take them. I would strongly, strongly recommend that you do NOT take ANY class "taught" by Professor Zhang.

Grading could be tough at times, but tests were pretty easy as long as you had the correct formulas going into them. Lectures very boring and hard to follow, although the lecture slides posted on Canvas were helpful. Tests also include bonus questions and there is bonus homework for extra credit.

Tough, inconsistent grader. I lost 10 points for being 1 number off where as another student lost 5 points for being 9 numbers off. The home works have no grading criteria, she is hard to understand. She makes countless spelling mistakes and errors, and changes notation often even in the same problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She posts lecture notes online (but after a while) so you should still go to class. She only replies to emails sometimes. Compared to other semesters, there isn't that much extra credit and you do have to study/do a bit of work for an A. The TA also grades the tests wrong so be sure to ask for more points. But you will always get a 100 on the HW.

She's an easy grader, I never watched lectures or did any work besides the few homeworks/studying for the test and it was a pretty easy A. However she struggles with technology and is unresponsive to all of the students' written and spoken questions during Zoom exams. In general it's hard to understand / communicate with her.
Pretty boring lectures and hard to pay attention. Her lecture slides are very helpful and homeworks/tests are pretty easy as long as you have the right formulas.

Lectures are very dry and hard to pay attention; you can learn most of the content from the textbook (free online, just google) or her lecture slides, or even Wikipedia. Homework is pretty easy plug-n-chug, and the tests are too. Last HW is for extra credit and the tests have extra credit questions so getting an A should be easy for most students.

The lectures can be hard to follow. Her accent makes it a bit difficult to understand and her notes are messy. There's not a lot of homework and it's pretty easy. As long as you do the HW, the tests should be manageable. She also gives extra credit on the tests (10 points), which will be a massive grade boost

Her accent was a bit difficult to understand at times but she posts her lecture notes. Homework also took some time to complete every other week. Plenty of extra credit throughout year to help ease your grade.
Makes class very easy and grades very graciously.

We have homework do every other week. It is quite long and can take a while. Professor Zhang is very sweet and accommodating to giving extensions and getting on Zoom to help. I didn't go to class because it was a bit difficult to pay attention and to understand her teaching. However she posts everything and has great R demos that are useful for HW.
It was hard to follow her lectures so I had to learn a lot of the materials outside of class but her exams are really easy.
Speak so fast when she was teaching

Not the best lecturer, but very accommodating outside of class. Expect to learn on your own time while doing homeworks. Exams are similar to practice exams/homework. She is a easy grader and gives partial credit. Lots of potential extra credit points on exams (20+ extra credit points per exam). Homework is graded more for completion than accuracy.

Easy grader and gives extra credit. However, she does not teach and instead expects students to learn themselves. She is available to answer questions and guide students but there are no lectures. If you want an easy A, take her. If you want to learn, take someone else.

This is a class to get engineers acquainted with statistics. She makes the tests very comparable to the homework. If you make any effort whatsoever, you will get an A. While I am ashamed to say I skipped class every day except test days, I got above a 100 on every test including the final.
She reads off of Powerpoint slides and is hard to understand
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Zietsman is an absolute gem. Her lectures are clear and concise and she is incredibly supportive outside the classroom, especially in office hours. This course requires that you spend time outside of class reviewing the material, but the understanding is well worth it. If you have the chance to take her section, I highly recommend it.

She is reminiscent of a high school teacher in the way she supports you more than a college professor usually does. she provides note outlines and the class notes for every class, and the HW is completion-based. I wish she posted practice exams, and her tone can often be perceived as demeaning.

Prof Zietsman is one of the few in the math department who willingly gives personalized feedback. She genuinely cares about your grade and will set up numerous quizzes and prep materials for her students. The tests were straightforward but quite comprehensive in covering all content. Her homework system was based on self evaluation which was great.

Dr. Zietsman was one of the nicest professors I have had. She really does care about her students. Her homework system was far superior than any other math class, as you would grade your own work, and would get 100% for your effort on it. Additionally, her exams were pretty straight-forward, and we did a project instead of the CTE exam.

Genuinely one of the best professors I've had at Tech. Trust me diff eq at first can be hard and confusing because it's a new concept but if you put in some effort and ask for help you can easily get an A. Professor Zietsman has been so helpful and amazing and she actually cares about you and your grade.

Probably the only teacher I had at VT my first semester that genuinely cared about making sure we knew what we were doing and was willing to put in the hours outside of class to ensure we knew what we were doing. Quick responses via email and dedicated office hours right after class that were very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I don't think I could've asked for a better first experience with a college math class than with Dr. Zietsman. In her lectures, she makes the content interesting, and breaks down exactly why the concepts are what they are. Her office hours are held directly after class in the same building, which is a no-brainer to go to. Strongly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Zietsmann was the best professor I've had so far at VT. Though our lectures were 1hr and 30mins, she managed to keep the entire class engaged and focused by being engaging, warm, and easily understandable. She will challenge you but with how well she teaches plus all the resources she gives to you, it won't seem like such a burden.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: As a freshman I would bet that at the end of my time at VT I will still think Dr. Zietsman is the best math professor I have ever had. She makes the lectures and math as a whole extremely interesting and class is always eventful. She is more than happy to give you feedback, and will help find a time that works for you if office hours don't.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She was a very good lecturer and knew the material well. She was very helpful and cared not only about how the students were learning but also how they did in the class. She made the class relatively easy but still made sure you knew the matieral. Very good professor

Very enthusiastic teacher who really wants her students to learn.  She set up her office hours as extra learning opportunities where we could teach ourselves then ask her for help or confirmation at various points of the exercises.

Dr. Zietsman is very thorough and explains everything very clearly, addressing all questions as they come. She prepares for all her lectures and has her notes on hand. She's also extremely helpful during office hours. She's a kind, positive, and encouraging professor who knows her stuff, and she can make just about anything seem much easier.
Great teacher. Attendance is mandatory and so is participation. The class is strictly graded on your essays. He is a harsh grader so make sure your grammar is top tier.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall, a little boring. The assignments weren't too bad. 5 reflection essays, one after each chapter, and 2 larger essays, before and after the simulation. The simulation itself wasn't as bad as I thought it would be; it was sort of just a whole class project! Also, make sure to read to the end of the syllabus; I got extra points because of it!

If you're willing to actually engage with the material, it is a great and insightful class. Prof Z's assignments allow you to express your own interests and opinions, which I enjoyed. Prof Z is always willing to talk and give very helpful feedback. You get what you put into this class - I learned a ton in this course and would highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: probably holds the title for worlds most boring lectures given. the essays are graded kinda harshly, so make sure to get it reviewed by the writing center. the simulation was very boring as my role didnt do much and pretty much did almost nothing for 5 class periods.

This was my 2nd time having Dr. Zick: In Spring 2023, I had her for GEOG 4524 - Physical Meteorology; I've just completed Tropical Meteorology. I took this class, because it was recommended for Graduate School. I ended up with an A by doing the labs ahead of time, attending lectures, and asking questions. Labs are LONG. She's an amazing professor!

I am taking Dr. Zick for tropical and dynamic l. She is a nice lady, but the lectures were not sufficient to perform adequately on labs. In other words, it was difficult to absorb the information for assignments. So much time and effort is spent learning on my own that is not even funny.

Dr. Zick is great, but the way the Trop is set up is just plain awful. I was so excited to it and was so disappointed with how it was taught. The videos and readings in lieu of lectures made it hard for me to understand what was going on in the labs and quizzes. Why take a class in person when you do the work in class and the learning out of it?
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Physical Meteorology with Dr. Zick before teaches the Dynamic Meteorology sequence for 2023-24 academic year, and Dr. Ellis teaches Physical in Spring 2024. Exams were hard to complete in 50 minutes; she had to curve at least 5 points. She's very nice though, and she will do anything to help you in her classes if you ask at the right time!

Terribly structured class. Mandatory group labs that force you to work on weekends AND teach yourself. Class time not productive (not worth attending). Why are students making and presenting 10 identical PowerPoints on things the teacher should be teaching instead?! Teacher acts nice, but is not flexible or accommodating. Her laugh is annoying too.

This course was not designed effectively. The flipped classroom setting makes it difficult to learn as the professor does not lecture in person. There are no tests and very lab heavy with groups. Dr. Zick was really nice and cared for her students.

Do not take this class! You will be doing everything on your own and learn very minimal. Class time is not utilized well and several complaints have been made. Although she is very nice and wants the best for her students, the education does not come through throughout the class times.

Great professor, clearly passionate about what he is teaching. Tests are worth around 4/5ths of the grade, but they are not hard and you can usually ace them with a little bit of preparation. One thing that I did not like is that he did not give that many practice problems.

Overall, definitely recommend.

Very smart guy but just didn't know how to teach. Would often skip many steps during problems in class on the assumption that it was self explanatory. Tests made up 80% of the grade and were difficult but were graded somewhat easily (not fully solving any problems could still earn you at least a B). Did not prepare us for the CTE at all though.

Very nice and easy to talk to. I went to office hours a lot and he was very willing to help there. Tests were harder than expected, but he gives a decent amount of partial credit if you have the right idea and they are mostly similar to the practice exams he gives.

Skip classes at your peril
Kind and extremely intelligent teacher
You will get bad grades on the tests (class test avg between 68-72%)
Tests are 80% of your grade 
Favourable grader but ridiculously hard questions
He curves your final grade not assignments 
does HW with you in class
difficulty HW>practice tests>tests
He loves math & it shows
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I get that this is his first year teaching, but there are still so many things he could do better. First, don't make tests 80% of the class grade. Half the class failed the first test and he didn't care at all. Next, he hardly assigns homework, and when he does, it is for accuracy, which puts us in a bad spot due to few opportunities for practice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Uses big words that are not correct because he wants to look smarter and then has to spend time in future lectures going back and admitting that he had no idea what he was talking about. Terrible professor avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've ever had at tech. He spends more time teaching us about stuff he finds interesting than what is on the exams. He also believes that we are all math majors and already know everything that he is supposed to teach us in the class. When he does teach us it is always convoluted and his slides provide no information.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Zimmer is a great teacher. He pushes his students to do their best, and really cares.
He cannot teach. He does not know his content, and he is very disorganized. Horrible instructor.
Talk to him about your essays and you'll be fine. I got one not so great grade basically because we had a different opinion about something, but whatever. He's a good teacher over all.

This class was intense and offered an amazing background of Env. Science.  Insane amount of writing assignments and essay tests, but you really walk away with ability to talk about topic.  Strongly recommend for Envir./Civil Engineers.  Found Dr. Z. very knowledgeable, helpful, caring, and fair.  Easily one of best profs I've had at VT!

Whoever doesn't like this class and its instructor is a slacker. Zipper is passionate about the subject and interested in how his students are doing. It would be a good idea to take chem before this class though.

Not helpful. Answers to test questions seem to change based on his mood. Never completely answers questions on material. Is a nice guy, but a terrible professor...easily the worst I've had in college. =(

Everyone is too hard on him. He tries really hard, you can tell. He just has a lot of trouble with clarity. Let's face it, it's not an easy class. Very in depth and involves a lot of chemistry. If you're taking it be prepared to do some serious studying. And go tothe review sessions; they really help!
the worst teacher i have ever had. EXTREMLY boring. gives TONS of detailed notes and almost everything in the notes is on the test. dont take this class!!!
No Comments

He's pretty passionate about the subject.  However, I found him super annoying!  His jokes are soo corny, although he tries.  The tests are okay.  And he gives 3 writing assignments throughout the year. You better be an extremely good writer, because he grades harder than my freshman English professor did.  Nice guy overall, but boring class.

Easy Professor, talks really loud, so no problem hearing him. His lectures are straight powerpoint, so study that and you'll be fine. Has writing assignments (3) that u need to use a primary sources book for your references. Corny jokes, tries to keep it interesting. Maybe 5 questions from his test come from the book, don't really need it.

He is an animated teacher. He has his lectures online, but in class he highlights the points that will be on the exams. He makes corny jokes :) I didn't read the text and got A's on the exams. Lecture is the main source. Excellent teacher, get him if you can. He will help you any way he can if you just ask. Def go to his office hours.

Dr. Zimring is a good teacher.  he talks very clear and loud so you can hear and tries his hardest to keep the stuff interesting.  Tests are the main factor for grades, there is no homework.  So study mainly the powerpoints and you will hopefully do fine.  I screwed up the first test so ended up bad, but its not that hard of a class.

Best linear professor. His lectures are specific and actually make sense; if there is a topic that isn't fully understood by the class he will spend more time explaining it. His tests and very straight forward and easy if you do the practice and study. He assigns written HW's and webassigns but they are also straight forward and not long.

linear algebra GOAT. I am so thankful he came to the virginia tech math department. His lectures were all great and I left each class with a better understanding of Linear Algebra. the test's aren't hard if you study. He's also just a funny guy and genuinely enjoys teaching. 10/10 professor
Best Linear professor by far. Homework isn't too hard, and the exams are easy to study for if you just do the work. Great guy too and enjoyable to be around

All I say show up to class and listen. He really cares about you understanding the material and will give great tips. Exam are relatively easy and extremely similar to class problems and HW (just study). He is also very charming and funny.

Very good professor, teaches everything in a way that is easy to learn and if you actually show up to class he will try his best to ensure you do good in his class! Assigns weekly written hw and textbook problems which are relatively easy and are very similar to the test questions.

I was only nine years old when Zobe aka zzzobac came to me in my dreams. I was terrified, but yet, pleased... in a weird way. Years later he returned again but in my lab, to his children. He is a god, all praise zzzobac and his mighty meme playlist that keeps me going throughout every single day of my life.
I love the dude. He made my life so much better and because of him I no longer hate myself. He encouraged a new passion within me and now I am pursuing my PhD in the chem field.

Where do I begin? He isn't a human, but a divine beast. The religion of zzzobac has moved me like no other religion has.  Whenever he was near, I could sense the Sheik mains presence near me. Papa bless zzzobac. You have changed me, and I know he will continue to change those who cross his path.
A literal god among men, when he speaks you can feel the earth shift in the wake of his divine presence. Literally the best super smash bros player in the US.
Very helpful. Accessible outside of class. Replies emails immediately.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: lectures are very disorganized, super confusing when teaching but very easy to talk to to get help.
Teona is a very dedicated teacher. Her lectures are fun and partocipation oriented.

Excellent instructor.  I would recommend her if you value active participation and in class discussions.  She makes minor calculation errors but I think it's nothing too major.  I valued her dedication, if you put efforts, so will she.

Teona is very accessible outside class and willing to help if you ask; however, her lectures are confusing and she makes frequent mistakes. Most lectures consistent of a few formulas then completed problems, and most problems are solved incorrectly, making this class very confusing. I would not recommend her if you haven't taken calculus before.

She doesn't give much homework, but she used the highest homework score to replace the lowest one, so it didn't hurt my grade. She's super helpful, stays after class to answer questions, and replies to emails really fast.

She's super helpful and encouraging. She does make the occasional typo, but it's more about arithmetic than concepts. She really makes an effort to help you learn during class and doesn't leave her students to struggle on their own. Even though she's a non-native speaker, she's always consistent and well-prepared.

Shes all over the place in her lectures, she solves problems in class, which i think is good, but does not do them well enough. Does a few written homeworks thus each one is a bigger percentage of your grade. Honestly she is very humble, but imma not take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She has a very thick accent and very hard to understand. Makes a lot of mistakes during lecture and students had to correct her often. A 5 year old has better handwriting.

The class itself was fine, Teona isn't the best teacher but is definitely willing to put the work in to help you understand. She's ver accessible (I've emailed her late at night and got quick responses).
As long as you put in the effort, so will she!

The worst professor I've ever had. Would only teach by doing the problems on the board, and wouldn't do them ahead of time, so she would get them wrong 50% of the time and then send out announcements correcting her lecture notes. I would be sitting in tests and remembering the math that she taught me incorrectly, and then get the question wrong.
